source: Magic must fail, magic must lose, nothing arcane can face the ooze...
target: 魔法必定失败，魔法终会消亡，任何奥术能量都不能对抗软泥的力量…

source: Oozemancers separate themselves from normal civilisation so that they be more in harmony with Nature. Arcane force are reviled by them, and their natural attunement to the wilds lets them do battle with abusive magic-users on an equal footing.
target: 软泥使将自己和正常文明割裂，让自己与自然更加和谐。他们拒绝奥术能量，同时，与生俱来的自然和野性力量让他们成为了对抗魔法使用者的中坚力量。

source: They can spawn oozes to protect and attack from a distance while also being adept at harnessing the power of mindstars and psiblades.
target: 他们能制造软泥怪，来保护自己或远距离攻击对方，同时也能利用灵晶和心灵利刃来强化自己。

source:
The Spellblaze's scars may be starting to heal,
but little can change how the partisans feel.
Nature and arcane could bridge their divide -
and when it comes down to it, gold won't take sides...
target:
魔法大爆炸带来的裂痕已经开始痊愈。
然而人们心中的偏见仍没有消失。
自然与奥术本可弥合分歧——
在这两者之间，金钱从不站队……

source: Stone Wardens are dwarves trained in both the eldritch arts and the worship of nature.

source: While other races are stuck in their belief that arcane forces and natural forces are meant to oppose, dwarves have found a way to combine them in harmony.
target: 在其他种族受困于自然和魔法天生对立的偏见时，矮人们已经找到方法让这两种力量和谐共存。

source: Stone Wardens are armoured fighters, dual wielding shields to channel many of their powers.

source: You are a male of the species.
The people of Maj'Eyal: Humans, Halflings, Elves and Dwarves.
target: 马基·埃亚尔生活着人类、半身人、精灵和矮人。

source: The known world has been at relative peace for over one hundred years, and people are prospering again.
target: 世界已经保持了超过一百年的和平，各大种族再次繁荣起来。

source: You are an adventurer, setting out to find lost treasure and glory.
target: 你是一位冒险者，出发去寻找失落的宝藏和荣耀。

source: But what lurks in the shadows of the world?
target: 在世界的阴影之下究竟潜伏着什么呢？
无尽地下城：永无止境的下降

source: Ever deeper, never ending, no reprieve, keep descending. In ruins old, through barred gate, once riddle solved, find thy fate.
target: 无尽深度，没有终点，没有重复，不断深入，在古老的废墟里，穿过关闭的大门，解开谜题，寻找你的宿命。

source: Play as your favorite race and class and venture into the infinite dungeon.
target: 选择你最喜欢的种族和职业，进入无尽地下城冒险。

source: The only limit to how far you can go is your own skill!
target: 能够前进多远取决于你的个人技术！

source: Inside the infinite dungeon you will yourself be limitless. You can level up beyond level 50 and continue to gain stat and talent points (at a reduced rate).
target: 在无尽地下城中你不受限制，你可以突破 50 级的等级上限并继续获得属性和技能点数（以一个较低的比例获得）。

source: Every level after level 50 the maximum of stats will increase by one.
target: 50 级之后每级，属性最大值增加 1 点。

source: Every 10 levels after level 50 the maximum points of each talent will increase by one.
target: 50 级之后每 10 级，技能的最大等级增加 1 点。

source: The Arena: Challenge of the Master
Blood spilled on sand, only the strong survive. Prove yourself worthy to enter.
target: 血溅沙场，勇者生存，需证明你有进入的资格。

source: Play as a lone warrior facing the Arena's challenge!
target: 孤身一人直面竞技场的挑战！

source: You can use any class and race for it.
target: 你可以使用任何职业和种族。

source: See how far you can go! Can you become the new Master of the Arena?
target: 看看你能前进多远！你能成为新的竞技场主宰么？

source: If so, you will battle your own champion next time!
target: 如果这样，下一场战斗你的对手就是你自己的冠军角色！

source: Pfaugh. You're too late. %s has already finished. But I suppose it doesn't do any harm to take these and give you your undeserved reward.
target: 呸！你来太晚了。%s已经完成了。不过收下这些原料、把你不配得到的奖励给你，倒也没什么坏处。

source: Ah, excellent. Hand them over, if you please. You should know that in your overlong absence, %s has managed to create a %s. I'll be most put out if he steals my rightful spot.
target: 啊，太好了。请把它们交给我吧。要知道，在你离开的漫长时间里，%s已经设法配制出了一瓶%s。要是他抢走了本该属于我的席位，我可会非常不悦。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A human robed in immaculate white satin opens the door and eyes you appraisingly.*#WHITE#
Ah, an adventurer. I was just thinking that I needed a new one.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名身着一尘不染白缎长袍的人类打开了门，审视地打量着你。*#WHITE#
啊，一位冒险者。我正想着我需要个新的帮手呢。
听起来挺有希望。但也透着不祥。

source: Indeed, it is both promising and ominous. I can reward you handsomely for your efforts, but they will lead you into deadly peril to which, I assume, the previous three fellows who went off on my errand never to return can attest.
target: 确实，既大有希望，又透着不祥。我会为你的效劳提供丰厚的回报，但这也将引你踏入致命险境——我想，前三个替我办事后便一去不回的家伙足以证明这一点。

source: Good adventurer, I am an alchemist, and quite a good one. This year, for the first time, the great Brotherhood of Alchemists has invited my application to their number. I'll not try your patience with the details of the application process, but suffice to say that it is grueling. Fortunately, a mere three tasks now stand between me and acceptance.
target: 可敬的冒险者，我是一名炼金术士，而且手艺相当精湛。今年，伟大的炼金术士兄弟会首次邀请我申请入会。我就不用申请流程的细节来消磨你的耐心了，简而言之，那极其严苛。幸运的是，现在我与正式入会之间只剩下区区三项任务了。

source: I require ingredients for three potent mixtures. Obviously, since I seek your aid, none of them is to be found by simply strolling to the local herbalist's. No, they will need to be forcibly parted from their owners who will, just as obviously, put up a fight. I've yet to encounter a naga who would be persuaded to hand over his tongue! Ha! Oh, I am droll at times.
target: 我需要用于配制三种强效药剂的原料。显而易见，既然我向你求助，这些东西就绝非在本地草药铺随便逛逛就能弄到的。不，它们必须从原主身上强行剥离下来，而同样显而易见的是，对方一定会奋起抵抗。我还没遇到过哪只肯被说服乖乖交出舌头的娜迦呢！哈！噢，我有时候还真挺幽默的。

source: I specialize in separating vital body parts from monsters. What do you offer in return?
target: 从怪物身上剥离关键身体部位正是我的专长。你拿什么作为回报？

source: Why, I will let you share in the fruits of my labors! Each of the three mixtures I shall produce in a quantity sufficient to create three doses: one for me, one for the Brotherhood and their confounded trial... and one for you. I must tell you that time is of the essence. I am not the only one who the Brotherhood invited this year, yet they will accept only one applicant-- the first to complete their trials. I know of at least three others laboring furiously to take my rightful place. Should your aid see me through, then I will reward you beyond even the remarkable elixirs. I've an ancient Lifebinding Emerald that grants great powers of health and healing when used properly. What say you?
target: 哎呀，我会让你分享我的劳动成果！这三种药剂，我每种都会配制出足够三份的剂量：一份归我，一份交给兄弟会去应付他们那该死的考验……还有一份归你。我必须告诉你，时间至关重要。我并非兄弟会今年邀请的唯一人选，而他们只录取一名申请者——最先完成考验的那位。我知道至少还有其他三个人在拼命劳作，想抢夺本该属于我的席位。若在你的帮助下我得以胜出，我给予你的报酬甚至会超越那些非凡的药剂。我有一块古老的生命绑定翡翠，妥善使用时能赋予强大的生命与治疗力量。你意下如何？

source: I cannot aid you at this time.

Excellent. Now then, I've three elixirs I'm working on. I'll burden you with only one at a time, since I've learned the hard way about the hazards of overloading an adventurer's brain. Here are your options: the elixir of the fox, which makes you as nimble and cunning as a fox; the elixir of avoidance, which sharpens your natural inclinations to get out of the way of incoming harm; or the elixir of precision, which grants intuitive understanding of an enemy's most sensitive spots. Which would you like to aid me with?
target: 太好了。那么，我目前正在研制三种药剂。我每次只交给你一项，毕竟我曾吃过苦头，深知让冒险者的大脑负荷过重有多危险。以下是你的选择：狡诈药剂，能让你如狐狸般敏捷狡黠；闪避药剂，能磨砺你躲避来袭伤害的本能；或是精准药剂，能让你凭直觉洞悉敌人最脆弱的要害。你想协助我制作哪一种？

source: Here's a list of the ingredients I'm missing. Please attempt to not lose your life in their pursuit. I'll be most put out if I must wait another year. Oh, and I suppose I should tell you that I've already a handful of adventurers out scouring the unpleasant places of the world for these ingredients. Dally and one of them shall claim the prize while you're out.
target: 这是我所缺少的原料清单。搜寻它们时请尽量保住性命，要是还得再等上一年，我可会非常不快的。噢，我想我还得告诉你，我已经派了几个冒险者去搜寻世间那些险恶之地寻找这些原料了。若是拖拖拉拉，当你还在外奔波时，奖品就已经被其中某人领走了。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*The door is locked and nobody responds to your knocks*#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*门锁着，无人回应你的敲门声*#WHITE#

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist opens his door.*#WHITE#
Ah, you again.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士打开了门。*#WHITE#
啊，又是你。

source: I've returned with the ingredients for the %s.
target: 我回来了，我找到了%s的材料。

source: I've come to offer more aid.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist grins and motions impatiently for the ingredients.*#WHITE#
Wonderful, absolutely wonderful! The final step! Here, let me have those!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士咧嘴一笑，急不可耐地示意你交出原料。*#WHITE#
太棒了，真是太棒了！最后一步了！快，把那些交给我！

source: Wait here while I perform my art. I'll have your reward within the hour.
target: 在这儿等着，容我施展技艺。一小时内我就会备好你的报酬。

source: A final wait for you, my good adventurer, and then I shall return with both your rewards! Haha, complete at last!
target: 最后稍等片刻，我可敬的冒险者，随后我就会带着你的两份奖励归来！哈哈，终于大功告成了！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist finally returns and hands you a small vial of fine glass.*#WHITE#
Enjoy your reward.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士终于回来了，递给你一只精致的小玻璃药瓶。*#WHITE#
享用你的奖励吧。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist finally returns with a vial and a green gem.*#WHITE#
Enjoy the fruits of your labors, adventurer. I know I will. To show my appreciation, I shall name my firstborn after... er, what was your name, then? Haha, I jest. Oh, I do go on when I'm giddy. Fare you well.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士终于带着一只药瓶和一颗绿色宝石回来了。*#WHITE#
尽情享用你的辛劳成果吧，冒险者。反正我肯定会好好享用我的这份。为表谢意，我打算用你的名字为我的头胎孩子命名……呃，你叫什么名字来着？哈哈，开个玩笑。噢，我一兴奋起来话就停不下来。祝你一路顺风。

source: Excellent. With which would you like to aid me?
target: 太好了。你想协助我制作哪一种？

source: Here's a list of the ingredients I'm missing. Please attempt to not lose your life in their pursuit. I'll be most put out if I must wait another year.
target: 这是我所缺少的原料清单。搜寻它们时请尽量保住性命，要是还得再等上一年，我可会非常不快的。

source: Terribly sorry, but I've already made the elixir without your aid. I've no reward to give you, and no reason to do so if I did.
target: 实在抱歉，但无需你的协助，我就已经配制好了这瓶药剂。我没有奖励可以给你，即便有，我也毫无理由这么做。

source: Too late! Argh, too late. %s has already finished. I'll make the elixir and reward you as promised, but only because the Brotherhood breaks the fingers of non-member alchemists who rook people. Members, on the other hand...
target: 太迟了！啊，太迟了！%s已经完成了。我会按承诺配制药剂并给你奖励，但这纯粹是因为兄弟会会折断那些坑蒙拐骗的非会员炼金术士的手指。至于会员嘛，可就另当别论了……

source: Give them here. You took long enough; %s cooked up a %s in your absence. Be quicker about the next one lest I make a 'mistake' in brewing your reward.
target: 拿来吧。你可真够磨蹭的；趁你不在的时候，%s已经捣鼓出了一瓶%s。下一次手脚麻利点，免得我在酿造你的奖励时‘不小心出错’。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A shabbily-dressed elf opens the door, scratching his head in apparent puzzlement.*#WHITE#
Another adventurer? Or have we met? I can't tell people apart unless they wear brightly-colored headbands. You need to help me.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名衣衫褴褛的精灵打开了门，抓着头，显得十分困惑。*#WHITE#
又一个冒险者？还是我们见过？除非头上戴着色彩鲜艳的发带，否则我根本分不清谁是谁。你得帮帮我。

source: I am indeed an adventurer. Go on.
target: 我确实是名冒险者。请继续说。

source: Three elixirs stand between me and acceptance into the Brotherhood of Alchemists, unless I've been through that already. I'm never quite sure. But I think that's the case. Bring me the ingredients.
target: 在我和被炼金术士兄弟会接纳之间还隔着三瓶药剂——除非我已经经历过这一切了。我从来都不太确定。但我猜情况就是这样。去把原料给我找来。

source: The ones that I need to get before the other alchemists get them. Can't have some lesser hack sneaking into the Brotherhood.
target: 就是我必须赶在其他炼金术士得手前弄到的那些。绝不能让哪个不入流的庸才混进兄弟会。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He raises his voice and gestures exaggeratedly, seemingly taking you for an idiot.*#WHITE#
Me need pieces of scary monsters for happy-making drink. You get me pieces. You probably get eaten by monsters, me have this conversation yet again with other bonehead.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他提高了嗓门，夸张地比画着手势，似乎把你当成了白痴。*#WHITE#
我要可怕怪物的碎块做快乐药水。你，去帮我拿碎块。你八成会被怪物吃掉，然后我又得跟别的蠢蛋把这些话再讲一遍。

source: I've been known to kill the occasional monster. Is there a reward in it for me?
target: 我偶尔也会杀杀怪物。这对我有什么报酬？

source: It finally understands! You get a dose of every elixir you help me make. And if your help gets me into the Brotherhood, I've got half an Elixir of Invulnerability lying around that I'll give you. Don't try anything; I've already downed the other half.
target: ‘它’总算听懂了！你每帮我制作一种药剂，就能分得一份剂量。要是你的协助能让我入选兄弟会，我这儿碰巧还留着半瓶无敌药剂可以送给你。别想动什么歪脑筋，另外半瓶早就被我喝光了。

source: I cannot aid you at this time.
Three elixirs I need. I'll show you the ingredients to one at a time. Are you interested in the Elixir of Mysticism, the Elixir of the Savior, or the Elixir of Mastery?
target: 我需要三种药剂。我每次只告诉你一种药剂所需的原料。你对神秘药剂、守护药剂，还是掌握药剂感兴趣？

source: Here's a list of the monster bits I need. I've already got a bunch of idiots out looking for these, by the way, so you best hurry up; they've got a head start on you and I'm not getting any saner here.
target: 这是我需要的怪物部位清单。顺便说一句，我已经派了一帮蠢货在外面搜寻这些东西了，所以你最好快点；他们可比你先行一步，而我呆在这儿可不会变得越来越清醒。

source: So I see. I'll be off.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The door is locked and nobody responds to your knocks*#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*门锁着，无人回应你的敲门声*#WHITE#

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The shabby elf opens his door.*#WHITE#
Do I know you?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*衣衫褴褛的精灵打开了门。*#WHITE#
我认识你吗？

source: I've returned with the ingredients for the %s.
target: 我回来了，我找到了%s的材料。

source: I've come to offer more aid.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*The elf claps his scarred hands together.*#WHITE#
Exceptional work, lackey! The final elixir awaits! Oh, yes. Membership will be mine. And revenge. Ohhhh yes.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*精灵拍了拍他那满是伤疤的双手。*#WHITE#
干得漂亮，跟班！最后的药剂就在眼前！噢，没错。会员席位非我莫属。还有复仇。噢——没错。

source: Contain your impatience while I prepare these. I'll have the elixir within the hour.
target: 在我调配这些原料时收敛好你的急躁。一小时内我就能备好药剂。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The elf finally returns and tosses you a small vial of fine glass.*#WHITE#
Side effects may include some slight mental imbalances.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*精灵终于回来了，抛给你一只精致的小玻璃药瓶。*#WHITE#
副作用可能包括些许轻微的精神失衡。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist finally returns with two vials.*#WHITE#
I have no idea who you are, but I'm pretty sure that I'm supposed to give these to somebody as a reward. If some adventurer kills you and takes them, then apparently you're not the fellow I'm looking for.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士终于带着两只药瓶回来了。*#WHITE#
我根本不知道你是谁，但我相当确信我应该把这些当作奖励给某个人。要是有哪个冒险者把你杀了抢走它们，那显然你并不是我要找的那个家伙。

source: Which of the remaining elixirs interests you?
target: 剩下的药剂中，你对哪一种感兴趣？

source: Here's a list of the ingredients I'm missing. Please follow the directions carefully, or the resulting elixir could be more fatal than either of us would hope.
target: 这是我所缺少的原料清单。请务必严格遵循说明，否则配制出的药剂可能会比我们双方所希望的更加致命。

source: Already made it. Best pick up the pace next time, adventurer.
target: 已经做好了。下次动作最好快点，冒险者。

source: I want to change your equipment.
I want to change your talents.
I want to change your tactics.
I want to take direct control.
I want to change your name.
Telos the Great and Powerful (reluctant follower of %s)
target: 伟大而强大的泰勒斯 (%s不情愿的追随者)

source: #ROYAL_BLUE#The golem decides to change it's name to #{bold}#%s#{normal}#.
How is it that you speak?
I want to change your appearance (one-time only).
target: 我想修改你的外观（仅限一次）。

source: What's the good of immortality if you can't even speak? No archmage worth his salt is going to concoct some immoral life-after-death scheme without including some sort of capacity for making his opinions known. And, by the way, your energy manipulation techniques are on the same level as those of my average pair of shoes. Though I guess you are making up for it with your golem crafting skills.
target: 要是连话都说不了，永生还有什么用？任何一个称职的大法师在谋划某种不道德的死后复生方案时，都绝不可能不包含表达自己见解的能力。顺带一提，你操纵能量的技术水平跟我随便一双鞋子差不多。不过我猜，你在傀儡制作手艺上弥补了这一点。

source: Change my name? I'm quite happy being 'Telos' thankyou. Though I wouldn't mind being 'Telos the Great and Powerful'. Do that actually. Yes!
target: 修改我的名字？叫‘泰勒斯’我就挺满意的了，谢谢。不过我倒也不介意被称为‘伟大而强大的泰勒斯’。实际上，就这么改吧。对！

source:
I'm a golem. How droll!
Oh, did you want something?
target:
我是个傀儡。多滑稽啊！
噢，你有什么事吗？

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The golem talks in a monotonous voice*#WHITE#
Yes master.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*傀儡用毫无起伏的声音说道*#WHITE#
是，主人。

source: SON OF A RITCH! YOU SHOW UP TEN MINUTES AFTER I GET THE NEWS THAT SOME JACKASS ALREADY FINISHED THE ELIXIRS AND IS GETTING ACCEPTED BY THE BROTHERHOOD. WHAT THE HELL TOOK YOU SO LONG? MIRVENIA'S MAMMARIES, I'LL TAKE THESE AND MAKE YOU YOUR REWARD, BUT ONLY BECAUSE A CURSE WILL KILL ME IF I DON'T. AND IF IT TASTES LIKE PISS, THAT'S YOUR IMAGINATION, I'M SURE.
target: 见鬼！在我收到消息说某个蠢货已经制成了药剂并且加入了兄弟会之后10分钟你居然出现了，到底什么该死的事情花了你那么长时间？！把你那些该死的材料给我，要不是有个诅咒说，如果我不这么做的话我会被杀，我才不会帮你做这该死的奖品。要是药水味道尝上去像马尿一样的话那一定是你的错觉，我敢肯定。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The halfling hands you a note that says, 'Heard %s managed to make a %s while you've been loafing. Hurry the hell up next time.*#WHITE#
		I STILL CAN'T HEAR A DAMNED THING. FORTUNATELY, YOU DON'T LOOK LIKE THE SORT THAT MAKES INTERESTING CONVERSATION.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个半身人递给你一张纸条，上面写着：听说 %s 在你离开的时候制造了 %s 。下次动作快点。*#WHITE#
		我还是什么都听不见，幸运的是，看上去似乎和你聊天也没什么意思。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*After a great deal of pounding, a halfling wrapped in charred, smoking robes opens the door. He looks irritated.*#WHITE#
IT'S NOT ENOUGH THAT I WORK ALL MORNING TO MAKE A POTION THAT ENDS UP NEARLY BLOWING MY ASS OFF, BUT NOW I'VE GOT IDIOTS BEATING DOWN MY DAMNED FRONT DOOR WITH WHAT SOUNDS LIKE A BATTERING RAM, AND YES, I HEARD IT, THOUGH I CAN HARDLY MAKE OUT A BLEEDING THING WITH THESE BLEEDING, CONCUSSED EARS. WHAT DO YOU WANT?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你敲了半天的门，终于有个穿着烧焦且冒着烟的长袍半身人开了门，他看上去很不高兴。*#WHITE#
这一上午搞这天杀的药剂差点搞的我屁股开花，我听到有个白痴敲我家的门敲的跟攻城槌一样，行了！我听见了！虽然我的耳朵已经差不多快聋掉了！找我有什么事么？

source: Perhaps there's something that I can help you with.
SPEAK UP, HAMBRAIN. I'VE JUST GOTTEN MY EARDRUMS BLOWN OUT BY YET ANOTHER BY-THE-PYRE POTION GONE SOUTH, REMEMBER? THRICE-DAMNED THING WAS GOING PERFECTLY, TOO. TOKNOR'S TACKLE!
target: 说大声点，笨蛋！我的耳膜刚又被一瓶该死的药剂炸破了，记得吗？那该死的东西本来一切顺利！托克纳的钓具！

source: I SAID, MAYBE THERE'S SOMETHING THAT I CAN HELP YOU WITH!
target: 我说，也许我能帮上什么忙！！

source: STILL CAN'T HEAR YOU, BUT LISTEN UP. THE BROTHERHOOD OF ALCHEMISTS IS ACCEPTING THE FIRST NEW APPLICANT TO DEMONSTRATE, AMONG OTHER THINGS, THREE VERY COMPLICATED ELIXIRS. I WOULDN'T BOTHER TRYING TO JOIN SUCH A BUNCH OF ADDLE-BRAINED DEGENERATES, BUT IT SO HAPPENS THAT THE BROTHERHOOD OF ALCHEMISTS HOLDS THE SECRET CURE FOR THE COMMON BLOWN-OFF ASS, WHICH IT SO HAPPENS IS OF SOME INTEREST TO ME.
target: 还是听不见，不过听着，炼金术士兄弟会最近会吸收最先做好三瓶指定药剂的炼金师作为会员。我本来对那些呆瓜组成的团体没什么兴趣，不过碰巧兄弟会有一种治疗烂屁股的秘方，我对这个很感兴趣。

source: THE BROTHERHOOD KNOWS DAMNED WELL WHAT ADVANCES IN THE FIELD OF ALCHEMY WOULD DO FOR EVERY CIVILIZATION IN EXISTENCE, BUT THEY HOARD THEIR FEW WORTHWHILE SECRETS LIKE A GREAT BROWN WYRM SITTING ON ITS PILE OF CRAP. YOU KNOW WHAT? I DON'T EVEN WANT THE ASS-CURE FOR ME. I'M GOING TO STEAL EVERY SECRET THEY'VE GOT, WRITE THEM DOWN, MAKE A HUNDRED COPIES, AND NAIL ONE TO A TREE IN EVERY VILLAGE IN MAJ'EYAL.
target: 兄弟会非常清楚炼金术的进步对每个文明意味着什么，但他们却像一头大棕龙坐在粪堆上一样，把为数不多的有价值秘密捂得严严实实！要知道，其实我才不想要那什么蛋疼的秘方，我准备把他们的秘密都偷出来，写在纸上，抄上一百份，然后贴到马基·埃亚尔所有村庄的树上去！

source: THAT'S NOT A VERY HERMIT-LIKE ATTITUDE.
target: 这可不像一个隐士的态度。

source: AND THEN WHAT WILL THEY DO? ONCE THEIR PRECIOUS SECRETS-- WHICH, IN ALL PROBABILITY, EITHER DON'T EXIST OR ARE THINGS LIKE RECIPES FOR ELIXIRS OF WHO-GIVES-A-FLYING-DUCK-- ARE OUT IN THE OPEN, THE BROTHERHOOD OF ASSWIPES WILL HAVE NOTHING TO HOLD IT TOGETHER BUT ELIXIRS OF THEIR TEARS AND WIDESPREAD DISDAIN FROM THE REST OF THE WORLD. SPEAK UP, THEN. ARE YOU IN OR OUT?
target: 然后他们会怎么样？当他们的宝贝秘密，或许根本就不存在，或者就是些操蛋秘方公之于众之后，除了用他们的泪水做药剂和被大家鄙视之外，“蠢货兄弟会”将一无所有。现在，说大声点！你是接受任务还是拒绝？

source: I CANNOT AID YOU AT THIS TIME.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*He hands you a slip of paper with the names and properties of some elixirs on it.*#WHITE#
THE INGREDIENTS TO THESE SUCKERS ARE SORT OF A TRADE SECRET, SO I'LL TELL YOU ABOUT ONE AND WE'LL SEE HOW THAT GOES. OH, AND I'LL MAKE ENOUGH FOR YOU TO HAVE A SWIG WHEN I'M DONE, SO GOOD FOR YOU. WHICH ONE WILL IT BE? JUST POINT AT THE DAMNED LIST. I HAVEN'T HEARD A THING YOU'VE SAID YET. I HOPE TO HELL YOU'RE NOT STANDING THERE TRYING TO SELL ME SOMETHING.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他递给你一张写着药剂材料的纸片。*#WHITE#
这些配方的材料算是商业机密，所以一次我只给你一个，然后我会告诉你怎么做。哦，等我做好以后一定会让你喝个够，这会令你大受裨益。好了，你现在选哪一个？你只要用手点一下这该死的列表就可以了，你说的话我一个字都没听见。但愿你不是站在那儿想向我推销什么东西。

source: HERE'S A LIST OF THE STUFF I NEED. MOST OF IT WILL TRY TO KILL YOU, SO I HOPE YOU'RE NOT INCOMPETENT. I'VE GOT PLENTY OF INCOMPETENT HELP ALREADY. I HOPE FOR YOUR SAKE THAT YOU'RE SMARTER AND FASTER THAN THEM.
target: 这里有一张我需要的材料清单，大多数材料拥有者可能会要了你的小命，但愿你没那么挫，我已经有一票挫子帮手了。希望你比他们要聪明，动作麻利点！

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*The door is locked and nobody responds to your knocks*#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*门锁着，无人回应你的敲门声*#WHITE#

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The halfling, still smoking, opens his door.*#WHITE#
I LIVE WAY THE HELL OUT HERE FOR A REASON, YOU PIECE OF... OH. IT'S YOU.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个半身人，身上还冒着烟，开了门。*#WHITE#
我呆在这坑爹的地方是有原因的，你TM…………哦，是你啊。

source: I'VE RETURNED WITH THE INGREDIENTS FOR THE %s.
target: 我回来了，我找到了%s的材料！

source: I'VE COME TO OFFER MORE AID.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*For the first time you've seen, genuine pleasure lights up the halfling's soot-smeared face.*#WHITE#
GOOD WORK, WHOEVER YOU ARE. ALL OF MAJ'EYAL OWES YOU THEIR THANKS, EXCEPT FOR MEMBERS OF THE BROTHERHOOD OF ALCHEMISTS, WHO MIGHT TRY TO DO YOU BODILY HARM. FORTUNATELY FOR YOU, THEY'RE MOSTLY HARMLESS.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你第一次看到，半身人满是煤灰的脸上绽放出了诚恳的笑容。*#WHITE#
干的好！不管你是谁！整个马基·埃亚尔都应该感谢你，除了那些炼金术士兄弟会成员，他们想加害于你。不过幸运的是，那些货通常来说根本伤不到你。

source: WAIT HERE. THERE'S A GOOD CHANCE YOU'LL GET BLOWN INTO ADVENTURER KIBBLE IF YOU STEP INSIDE THIS BUILDING. MY ROBE OF MAD ALCHEMIST PROTECTION IS THE ONLY REASON I'M NOT VAPOUR.
target: 在这儿等着就好，如果你进入这栋建筑，你会有幸成为冒险家牌肉松。由于我有这件强大的炼金长袍保护，我才没变成粉蒸肉。

source: GIVE ME AN HOUR, AND THINK UNPLEASANT THOUGHTS ABOUT THE BROTHERHOOD. IF ANYTHING EXPLODES, COME RESCUE ME, EVEN IF IT LOOKS LIKE THE BUILDING IS AN INFERNO OF POISONOUS SMOKE AND POLKA-DOT FLAMES.
target: 给我一小时时间，你在这等着，想想那可恶的兄弟会。要是听到爆炸声，你得来救我，不管什么情况哪怕房子烧成窟窿，变成冒着毒烟的地狱你也得进来。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Disaster fails to occur. The halfling finally returns and hands you a small vial of sooty glass.*#WHITE#
ENJOY, AND COME BACK ANY TIME IF YOU'RE INTERESTED IN SIMILAR WORK. I HAVEN'T WON YET. THE LONGER YOU WAIT, THE MORE LIKELY IT IS THAT YOU'LL RETURN TO A SMOKING CRATER AND ONE TRULY IRATE HALFLING.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*还好，没发生任何不幸的事，那个半身人终于回来了，递给你一个黑乎乎的玻璃瓶。*#WHITE#
喝吧！你要是喜欢这份工作的话随时可以回来找我。我还没赢呢！最好快点，你在这儿待的时间太长，下次迎接你的可就是一个冒着黑烟怒不可遏的半身人了！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The halfling finally returns with a vial and a small pouch.*#WHITE#
YOUR DOSE OF THE ELIXIR, AS WELL AS SOMETHING ELSE. THIS INFUSION IS RARE AS HELL, SO DON'T GO WASTING IT.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个半身人终于拿着一个瓶子和一个袋子回来了。*#WHITE#
这是你那份药剂，另外还有个东西给你。这个纹身可稀有了，千万别浪费了！

source: WHICH ELIXIR DO YOU WANT TO HELP ME WITH? YOU ARE HERE TO DO JUST THAT, RIGHT? YOU'RE NOT SOME IMBECILE HERE LOOKING FOR A LOVE POTION?
target: 你选择哪一个任务？你是来做任务的吧？我想你该不是那些来找春药的蠢货吧？

source: TAKE THIS LIST OF INGREDIENTS, AND HURRY THE HELL UP.
target: 拿好配料清单，动作快点。

source: TOO SLOW, HAMBRAIN. ELIXIR'S MADE ALREADY, AND SOMEBODY ELSE WALKED OFF WITH THE REWARD. IF YOU'RE FEELING SORRY FOR YOURSELF, ASK WHETHER THIS IS MORE OR LESS PLEASANT THAN GETTING APPRECIABLE CHUNKS OF YOUR ANATOMY BLASTED CLEAN OFF YOUR BODY THIS MORNING. THAT'S RIGHT. BYE.
target: 太慢了，蠢蛋，药剂我已经做好了。已经有人来拿走了奖励。如果你觉得失望，告诉自己这是否比一早上被从你身上炸烂一大块要好。就是这样，再见！

source: Damn it all. You're too late. %s has already finished. But I suppose you did your best, so I'll take these and keep my end of the bargian.
target: 见鬼，你来的太晚了，%s 已经完成了，不过我想你已经尽力了，所以我还是会完成这桩交易，把材料给我吧。

source: Great work! And you're still in one piece, I see. Always nice. I feel the same way after safely brewing up a particularly tricky mixture. I've near blown my face clean off several times. Oh, while you were gone a little bird told me that %s has managed to create a %s. Don't let him finish before me!
target: 干得好！而且你完好无损地回来了。很好，这和我费尽心思做好一瓶特效药剂的感觉一样好。我有好几次都差点把自己的脸炸飞了。哦对了，你不在的时候有一只小鸟告诉我说 %s 已经制造了 %s 。别让他超过我！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A dwarf in stained, battered mail armor opens the door.*#WHITE#
Say, you interested in dismembering stuff and getting paid?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一位穿着肮脏破旧锁甲的矮人开了门。*#WHITE#
说！你是不是对收钱帮人搜集材料感兴趣？

source: By the corpses of the gods, I love adventurers. Was about to become one myself when it suddenly hit me. And by "it" I mean "my wife." Har!
target: 感谢上帝，我喜欢冒险者，我本准备自己也去当个冒险者，结果它打了回来，呃……我说的“它”其实是指我老婆，哈！

source: I propose that I give you a list of monster parts to fetch, then you go and fetch them, then I make some blindingly amazing brews with said monster parts, then I get accepted into the Brotherhood of Alchemists.
target: 我的想法就是，我给你怪物物品清单，然后你给我把它们都找回来。然后我用这些材料做一些很炫的药剂，之后我就可以加入炼金术士兄弟会了。
听上去是一个不错的计划。

source: I make excellent plans. And brews, which the Brotherhood will no doubt make me call 'elixirs' once I'm in. And I'll obey, because they have ways of getting what they want. Now, where were we?
target: 这可是一个极好的计划，而这些药剂，好吧，显然如果我加入炼金术士兄弟会的话，他们一定会称我的这些为“万能药”，我会照他们说的话去做的，因为他们自有他们的一套办法让我不得不服从他们的命令……那……我们刚说到哪儿了？

source: Aiding you with getting into some Brotherhood. What's in it for me?
target: 帮你加入那个什么什么兄弟会……我能得到什么回报？

source: Oh, easy. You get a swig of each brew, of course. They'll put hair on your chest, and possibly your eyelids and fingernails. And, if your aid proves the deciding factor, then I've got a real treat for you: perhaps the last Taint of Purging left in Maj'Eyal.
target: 很简单，每份药剂我都会让你先喝个痛快的。喝下这些药剂会让你长出有男子汉气概的胸毛，可能还能长你脸上或者指甲盖里。而且，要是你的帮助能起决定性作用的话，我还会额外给你一件真正的宝物：传说中马基·埃亚尔唯一的堕落印记——清除印记哦！

source: I cannot aid you at this time.

One last thing. There's a few other fellows angling for the same slot in the Brotherhood that I am. They're not going to be sitting on their hands while we're at work here, so best move quick-like. Now, which of these do you want to help me with first: the Brew of Brawn, the Brew of Stoneskin, or the Brew of Foundations? Or Elixirs, rather. Not Brews. Best get in the habit now, I suppose.
target: 最后一件事，除我之外还有几个家伙对炼金术士兄弟会的这个会员资格虎视眈眈，他们肯定不希望我来坐这个位置的，因此你越快动身越好。现在，你选择帮我完成哪个药剂吧：蛮牛药剂？石肤药剂？还是领悟药剂？哦，应该说药剂（Elixirs）。不是酿造物（Brews）。最好现在就开始改口，我想。

source: Right, here's the list. Oh, one more thing. Got me some fellas already out hunting for this stuff, and I'll not play favorites. One of them brings me those ingredients before you do, and you're out of luck. Hurry back.
target: OK，这里是材料的清单。哦对了，另外还有一件事，有几个家伙已经出发帮我找这些材料了，我一视同仁，要是其中有人先把材料找到给我带来的话，那你就只能自认倒霉了，动作快点吧。

source:
Right, here's the list. Oh, one more thing. Got me some fellas already out hunting for this stuff, and I'll not play favorites. One of them brings me those ingredients before you do, and you're out of luck. Hurry back.

Oh, and one other last thing... if you have the time for another errand, though I've got no reward on this one.
target:
好的，这里是材料的清单。哦对了，另外还有一件事，有几个家伙已经出发帮我找这些材料了，我一视同仁，要是其中有人先把材料找到给我带来的话，那你就只能自认倒霉了，动作快点吧。

哦，对了，最后还有另外一件事……不知道你感不感兴趣，不过这件事可没有报酬的。

source: Well, I'll see if I can help.
target: 好吧，我看看我能不能帮上忙。

source: I'm here for profit, not errands - I have the list and will work on it; sort your own sidejobs out.
target: 我可不白干，不是给你做跑腿的，现在拿到材料清单了我会去搞定，别的事情就算了。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*The door is locked and nobody responds to your knocks*#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*门锁着，无人回应你的敲门声*#WHITE#

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The mailed dwarf opens his door.*#WHITE#
Aha, my favorite adventurer.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个穿锁甲的矮人打开了门。*#WHITE#
啊～我亲爱的冒险家。

source: I've returned with the ingredients for the %s.
target: 我回来了，我找到了%s的材料。

source: I've come to offer more aid.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*He gleefully claps you on the shoulder.*#WHITE#
Ha ha! This is the last one! Stire and Marus and that damned hermit can suck on my beard! And so can my wife! YES, I KNOW YOU CAN HEAR ME. Good work, friend. Let's have them.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他欢快地拍着你的肩膀。*#WHITE#
哈哈！这可是最后一件！斯泰尔和马鲁斯还有那个该死的隐士只能舔我的胡子了，还有我老婆也是！对没错，我知道你能听见！干得好伙计，我们开始完成它吧。

source: Give me an hour or so to make with the alchemy. Don't go anywhere.
target: 别走开，给我一个小时的时间去做药剂。

source: I'd invite you inside while you wait, but the she-dwarf's in there, and I've grown fond of you.
target: 我本来想请你进来等的，不过我老婆在这里所以……我发觉我有点喜欢你了。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The dwarf finally returns with a vial.*#WHITE#
Tastes like Urh'Rok's own piss, but it gets the job done.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个矮人回来了，手里拿着个药瓶。*#WHITE#
尝上去像乌鲁洛克的小便……不过总算完成了。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The dwarf finally returns with a vial and a small pouch.*#WHITE#
I put a bit of the good stuff in this one, though it won't do you any favors tomorrow morning. And careful with that Taint of Purging, especially if the wife answers the door the next time you knock. Har!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个矮人终于回来了，手里拿着一个药瓶和一个小袋子。*#WHITE#
这里面我给你带来个好东西，尽管也许明天早上对你没什么用。小心使用这个“清除印记”,如果下次你敲门的时候，是我老婆开门的话，你可要小心点，哈！

source: Bless you adventurers. Which will it be?
target: 祝福你我的冒险家，你选择哪一个？

source: Here's a list of the creature bits I need. Good luck with the murdering!
target: 这里有材料清单，祝你好运！

source:
Here's a list of the creature bits I need. Good luck with the murdering!

Oh, and one other last thing... if you have the time for another errand, though I've got no reward on this one.
target:
这里有材料清单，祝你好运！

哦，对了，最后还有另外一件事……另外还有一件差事不知道你感不感兴趣，不过这件事可没有报酬的。

source: Er, it seems that while you were out, somebody else managed to bring me the ingredients. I've got no reward for you! Sorry about that, but when time is of the essence, 'first come, first served' is the only sensible policy.
target: 呃，好像你不在的时候，已经有人把材料给我弄来了，我不会再给你奖励了。很抱歉，不过时间才是最重要的，“先来者先得”，你得记住这句话。

source:
Well, it's like this, one of my wife's friends has gone missing. A young alchemist in training, called Celia. Thing is, her husband died recently, and the grief done drove her mad. She used to go out to his grave every day, until one day she didn't come back. Personally I don't think she was able to live without him; the two were inseparable. If you get a chance on your travels, could you pass by the mausoleum to the east and check... well, you get the idea.

It's strange what death can do to people, how it can take over their minds. Sometimes they forget it's the living that matter... See she gets a proper burial - treated respectfully, eh?
target:
好吧，事情是这样的，我老婆的一个朋友最近失踪了。她是一个实习炼金术士，叫做塞莉娅。最近她的丈夫去世了，这件事让她悲痛欲绝。她每天会到她丈夫的坟墓那里去，直到有一天她一去不回。我个人认为她没了她丈夫活不下去。他们两人形影不离。要是你途经东边的墓园的话你能不能去查看一下……你懂的。

我很奇怪死亡到底会对别人产生什么影响，它又是怎样占据人的内心世界的。有时候他们甚至忘了那些活着的人才是最重要的……请确保她得到妥善安葬——要体面地对待她，好吗？

source: He points out the location of the graveyard on your map.
target: 他在你的地图上指出墓地的位置。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall woman stands before you. Her fair skin radiates incredible power through her white robe.*#WHITE#
I am Linaniil of the Kar'Krul. Welcome to our city, @playerdescriptor.subclass@. What may I do for thee?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名身材高大的女子伫立在你面前。她白皙的肌肤透过白袍散发着惊人的力量。*#WHITE#
我是卡·克鲁尔的莱娜尼尔。欢迎来到我们的城市，@playerdescriptor.subclass@。我能为你做些什么？

source: I require all the help I can get, not for my sake but for the town of Derth, to the northeast of here.
target: 我需要能得到的所有帮助，不是为了我自己，而是为了此地东北方的德斯镇。

source: I am ready! Send me to Urkis!
target: 我准备好了！送我去厄奇斯那里！

source: Nothing for now. Sorry to have taken your time. Farewell, my lady.
target: 暂时无事。抱歉耽误了您的时间。告辞，女士。

source:
Yes, we have noticed the devastation that happened there. I have sent some friends thence to disperse the cloud, but the true threat lies not there.
He who created this abomination is Urkis. He is a Tempest, a powerful Archmage who channels the storms.
Years ago he went rogue, severing himself from Angolwen. At first he remained quiet, and thus we withheld action, but it seems we have no choice now.
Cleansing the skies will take much time. In the meanwhile, if thou art willing, we can send thee to Urkis' lair to face him.
I will not lie to thee: we can send thee thence, but this could be a death trap, and we have no means for thou to depart his lair, as he lives atop a tall peak in the Daikara mountains.
target:
是的，我们已经注意到了那里所遭受的破坏。我已派了几位同伴前往该处驱散阴云，但真正的威胁并不在那里。
造就这桩灾祸的是厄奇斯。他是一名风暴法师，一位能够引导风暴的强大元素法师。
数年前他背离正道，断绝了与安格利文的联系。起初他一直保持沉寂，因此我们未予干预，但如今看来我们已别无选择。
净化天空需要耗费诸多时日。在此期间，若你愿意，我们可将你送往厄奇斯的巢穴，由你亲自直面他。
我不会对你有所隐瞒：我们固然能将你送去那里，但这可能是一处死亡陷阱；并且由于他隐居在岱卡拉山脉的高峰之巅，我们无法将你从他的巢穴中接引离开。

source: I need to prepare myself. I will be back soon.
target: 我需要先做些准备。我很快就会回来。

source: I am ready. Send me. I will not let the good people of Derth down.
target: 我准备好了。送我过去吧。我不会辜负德斯镇善良的居民。

source: Good luck to thee. Thou hast the blessings of Angolwen.
target: 祝你好运。安格利文的祝福与你同在。

source: I see the storm is calmed.  Take this rune as a token of my appreciation.
target: 我见风暴已经平息。请收下这枚符文，作为我的谢礼。

source: I am looking for staff training.
target: 我想寻求法杖战斗训练。

source: I can teach you staff combat (talent category Spell/Staff combat).  Learning the basics costs 100 gold, while more intensive tutelage to gain proficiency costs 500 gold.  Once you're proficient, I can teach you more refined techniques for an additional 750 gold.
target: 我可以传授你法杖格斗技巧（技能类别：法术/法杖格斗）。学习基础需要 100 金币，而获得熟练掌握的深入指导则需 500 金币。一旦你达到熟练，只需额外支付 750 金币，我便能传授你更精湛的技巧。

source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能树）- 100 金币。

source: The staff carver spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of staff combat.
target: 制杖师花了一些时间指导你，向你传授法杖格斗的基础技巧。

source: He is surprised at how quickly you are able to follow his tutelage.
target: 他对你能如此迅速领会他的指导感到惊讶。

source: Please teach me what I need to know (unlocks talent category) - %d gold.
target: 请传授我所需知晓的一切（解锁技能类别）- %d 金币。

source: The staff carver spends a substantial amount of time teaching you all of the techniques of staff combat.
target: 制杖师花了大量时间指导你，向你传授法杖格斗的全部技巧。

source: He is impressed with your mastery and shows you a few extra techniques.
target: 他对你的熟练程度印象深刻，并向你展示了一些额外技巧。

source: I'm already proficient, but I want to be an expert (improves talent mastery by 0.2) - 750 gold.
target: 我已经熟练掌握了，但我想成为一名专家。(增加技能树系数0.2) - 750 金币。

source: The staff carver spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of staff combat with you%s.
target: 制杖师花了大量时间与你一同推敲法杖格斗的精妙细节%s。

source: #{italic}##LIGHT_GREEN#*As you drink the potion, your runes start to burn as they fade away, and a terrible agony seems to sink through your skin to your bones, muscles, and heart.  You black out from the pain, and come to a bit later, the runes gone forever.  You feel very ill, and yet...  cleansed.*#{normal}##WHITE#
target: #{italic}##LIGHT_GREEN#*当你饮下药剂，身上的符文在逐渐消逝时灼烧起来，一股可怕的剧痛仿佛穿透你的肌肤，深嵌进骨骼、肌肉与心脏。你在剧痛中昏厥过去，稍后苏醒时，符文已永远消失。你感到极度虚弱不适，然而……却又感到被洗涤净化。*#{normal}##WHITE#

source:
Excellent! You truly prove that no mage-wrought flame or storm can stand against blade and arrow! Come, learn our ways. You are ready.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*he gives you a potion.*#WHITE#
Drink this. We extract it from a very rare kind of drake. It will grant you powers to fight and cancel magic, but never again will you be able to use magic.%s
target:
干得漂亮！你切实证明了，任何法师造就的烈焰或风暴都敌不过刀剑与利箭！来吧，领会我们的道路。你已经做好了准备。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他递给你一瓶药剂。*#WHITE#
喝下它。这是我们从一种极为罕见的龙类身上提取而成的。它将赋予你对抗并消除魔法的力量，但自此之后你将再也无法使用魔法。%s

source: Thank you. I shall not let magic triumph! #LIGHT_GREEN#[you drink the potion]
target: 多谢。我绝不会让魔法得逞！ #LIGHT_GREEN#[你喝下了药剂]

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As the monstrous spider falls you see something... moving in her belly until it explodes! A tall black man steps out of the spewed guts, surrounded by a golden light.*#WHITE#
By the Sun! I thought I would never again see a friendly face!
Thank you. I am Rashim, and I am in your debt.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*随着那只巨蛛轰然倒下，你看到有什么东西……在它的腹部蠕动，直到猛然炸开！一名高大的黑肤男子从喷溅的内脏中迈步走出，周身环绕着金色光芒。*#WHITE#
太阳在上！我原以为自己再也见不到一张友善的面孔了！
多谢你。我是拉希姆，我欠你一份恩情。

source: I have been sent by your wife. She was worried for you.
target: 我是受你妻子之托而来的。她非常担心你的安危。

source:
Ah, my dear heart!
Well, now that I am free I will create a portal to the Gates of Morning. I think I've seen enough spiders for the rest of my life.
target:
啊，我亲爱的心上人！
好了，既然现在我已脱困，我这就开启一道通往晨曦之门的传送门。我想我这辈子见过的蜘蛛已经足够多了。

source: I have heard you are a great hero of the west. Could you help me, please?
target: 我听说你是来自西方的伟大英雄。能否请你帮帮我？

source: I have got enough problems sorry.
target: 我自己的麻烦已经够多了，抱歉。

source: I have found your husband. I take it he made it home safely?
target: 我找到你的丈夫了。想必他已经安全到家了吧？

source:
My husband, Rashim, is a Sun Paladin. He was sent to clear the spider lair of Ardhungol to the north of this town.
It has been three days now. He should be back by now. I have a feeling something terrible has happened to him. Please find him!
He should have a magical stone given by the Anorithil to create a portal back here, yet he did not use it!
target:
我的丈夫拉希姆是一名太阳骑士。他被派去清理本镇北方的阿尔德胡格蜘蛛巢穴。
如今已经过去三天了。按理说他现在早该回来了。我有一种不祥的预感，他一定是遭遇了可怕的不测。求求你帮我找到他！
他身上本该携带着星月术士所赠的魔法石，用来开启返回此地的传送门，可他却一直没有使用！

source: I will see if I can find him.
Spiders? Eww, sorry, but he is probably dead now.
target: 蜘蛛？恶……抱歉，但他现在恐怕凶多吉少了。

source: Yes, yes he did! He said he would have died if not for you.
target: 是的，他确实平安回来了！他说若不是有你相救，他早就没命了。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#You take a look at the ranking boards before entering.
%s
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#进入竞技场前，你查看了一下排名榜。
%s
进入竞技场（较短模式，30 波）
进入竞技场，进行 60 波
进入竞技场，进行 30 波

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall, hooded man stares at you*#WHITE#
Yes...yes...you look like a promising warrior indeed...
I have an offer, @playerdescriptor.race@.
You see...I am an agent for the Arena. I look for promising warriors that
can provide a good show for our audience. Perhaps you are strong enough to join.
All you need to do is beat three of my men in battle, and you shall be rewarded.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You consider the offer of the mysterious hooded man for a moment*
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个高大、头戴兜帽的男人注视着你*#WHITE#
是的……是的……你的确像是一名很有潜力的战士……
我有个提议，@playerdescriptor.race@。
你看……我是竞技场的招募员，专门寻找能为观众献上精彩表演的潜力战士。或许你足够强大，能够加入我们。
你只需在战斗中击败我的三名手下，就能获得奖励。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你思量了片刻这个神秘兜帽人的提议*

source: Interesting. Tell me more about that Arena.
target: 有意思。多说说竞技场吧。

source: I am strong! What do you have to offer?
I don't accept deals from shady hooded men.
target: 我不和鬼鬼祟祟的兜帽人做交易。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You can feel the man smiling from inside his hood*#WHITE#
I have wealth and glory to offer, and some very useful
#YELLOW#combat experience#WHITE# from fighting our men...
So, what do you think? Are you up to it?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你能感觉到兜帽下的男人露出了微笑*#WHITE#
我能给你财富和荣耀，而与我的手下交战，还能让你获得一些十分有用的
#YELLOW#战斗经验#WHITE#……
怎么样？你能胜任吗？

source: I am ready for battle. Let's go!
I don't have time for games, Cornac.
target: 我没空陪你玩游戏，科纳克人。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You can feel the man smiling from inside his hood*#WHITE#
The Arena is where the brave come to fight against all odds.
We are still growing up, and we lack challengers...
It's like a gamble, but you use your fighting instead of money to play, you see?
We in the Arena work hard to make a good show, and in return...you can get enough
wealth and glory to last for centuries!
If you can pass my little test...I will #LIGHT_RED#allow you to join the Arena when
you are done with your adventures.#WHITE#
You also shall gather some much needed #LIGHT_RED#combat experience#WHITE# from fighting
our men...so, what do you think? Are you up to it?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你能感觉到兜帽下的男人露出了微笑*#WHITE#
竞技场是勇者迎战重重险境的地方。
我们仍在发展，正缺少挑战者……
这就像一场赌博，只不过你下注的不是金钱，而是自己的战斗本领，明白吗？
我们竞技场竭力奉上精彩表演；作为回报……你能赢得享用几个世纪也用不完的财富与荣耀！
如果你能通过我的小小考验……等你的冒险结束后，我会#LIGHT_RED#准许你加入竞技场。#WHITE#
与我的手下交战，还能让你获得急需的#LIGHT_RED#战斗经验#WHITE#……
怎么样？你能胜任吗？

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The man lets out a disappointed sigh*#WHITE#
That's unfortunate. We could have used someone like you.
You are just the type the audience likes. You could have been a champion.
Alas, if you stand by your choice, we shall never meet again.
However, if you change your mind...I will #YELLOW#stay in Derth just a little
longer.#WHITE#
If I am still around, we can have a deal. Think about it, @playerdescriptor.race@.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*男人失望地叹了口气*#WHITE#
真遗憾。我们本可以用上你这样的人。
你正是观众喜欢的类型，本可以成为一名冠军。
唉，如果你坚持这个选择，我们就再也不会见面了。
不过，如果你改变主意……我还会#YELLOW#在德斯镇多待一小段时间。#WHITE#
只要我还在，我们就仍可谈成这笔交易。好好想想吧，@playerdescriptor.race@。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The man smiles in approval*#WHITE#
Excellent! A great fighter is always willing to head into battle.
You certainly won't regret meeting us, indeed...
So, are you ready to fight?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*男人赞许地微笑起来*#WHITE#
好极了！伟大的斗士总是愿意投身战斗。
遇见我们，你肯定不会后悔……确实如此。
那么，你准备好战斗了吗？
听起来很有趣。我准备好了！

source: Wait. I am not ready yet.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The man quietly walks away, after making you a gesture to follow him*
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*男人示意你跟上，随后默默走开*

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Cornac rogue comes back from the shadows*#WHITE#
Well done, @playerdescriptor.race@! I knew you had potential.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The rogue takes off his hood, showing a fairly young, but unmistakably
#LIGHT_GREEN#battle-hardened man.#WHITE#
The name's Rej. I work for the arena to recruit great fighters who can give a
good show... and not die in two blows. You are one of those, indeed!
I won't keep you away from your adventures. I was there too, long ago.
But we can make you a true champion, beloved by many and bathing in diamonds.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*As you travel back to Derth in company of the rogue, you discuss your
#LIGHT_GREEN#battles in the forest. He provides you with great insight on your combat technique (#WHITE#+2 generic talent points#LIGHT_GREEN#)*
#WHITE#Very well, @playername@. I must go now.
Good luck in your adventures, and come visit us when you are done!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那名科纳克盗贼从阴影中现身*#WHITE#
干得漂亮，@playerdescriptor.race@！我就知道你有潜力。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*盗贼摘下兜帽，露出一张颇为年轻、
#LIGHT_GREEN#却显然久经战阵的男人面孔。#WHITE#
我叫瑞吉。我为竞技场招募优秀斗士：他们既要能奉上精彩表演……也不能挨两下就死。你的确就是这种人！
我不会耽误你继续冒险。很久以前，我也曾踏上冒险之路。
但我们能把你培养成真正的冠军，让你受万众爱戴、坐拥无数钻石。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*你与盗贼结伴返回德斯镇，途中谈起自己在森林里的战斗。
#LIGHT_GREEN#他对你的战斗技巧提出了精辟见解（#WHITE#+2 通用技能点#LIGHT_GREEN#）*
#WHITE#好了，@playername@。我现在该走了。
祝你冒险顺利，等冒险结束后记得来找我们！

source: Select the party member to receive the +2 generic talent points:
target: 选择一名队伍成员获得 +2 通用技能点：

source: #WHITE#I see. I will be waiting... #YELLOW#But not for long.
target: #WHITE#我明白了。我会等你……#YELLOW#不过不会很久。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Cornac rogue displays a welcoming smile*#WHITE#
Welcome back, @playerdescriptor.race@. Have you reconsidered my generous offer?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那名科纳克盗贼露出欢迎的微笑*#WHITE#
欢迎回来，@playerdescriptor.race@。你重新考虑过我那慷慨的提议了吗？

source: Welcome back, @playerdescriptor.race@. Are you ready to go?
target: 欢迎回来，@playerdescriptor.race@。你准备好出发了吗？

source: Just a minute. I have to prepare my equipment.
target: 再等一下。我得准备好装备。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A gigantic bone giant walks through the main gate.
#LIGHT_GREEN#Its shape is intricate and sharp, resembling a drake, but with countless
#LIGHT_GREEN#spikes instead of wings.
#LIGHT_GREEN#The massive undead stares at you with unusual...intellect.
#LIGHT_GREEN#You have heard of him. Ryal the Towering, your first obstacle!
#LIGHT_GREEN#As an eerie blue glow fills where its eyes should be, the undead giant
#LIGHT_GREEN#roars and multiple bones fly in your general direction!*
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个庞大的骸骨巨人穿过正门。
#LIGHT_GREEN#它的身形繁复而尖锐，形似一头龙，
#LIGHT_GREEN#却以无数骨刺代替了双翼。
#LIGHT_GREEN#这具巨大的不死生物以异乎寻常的……智慧目光注视着你。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你听说过它：高大的瑞尔，你的第一道难关！
#LIGHT_GREEN#它本应长着眼睛的地方泛起诡异蓝光；不死巨人
#LIGHT_GREEN#咆哮一声，无数骸骨朝你所在的大致方向飞射而来！*

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*After taking several hits, the undead giant finally succumbs
#LIGHT_GREEN#to your attacks*
#LIGHT_GREEN#Suddenly, Ryal's body starts to regenerate!
#LIGHT_GREEN#Standing tall again, you can almost feel its emotionless skull staring
#LIGHT_GREEN#at you with...satisfaction.
#WHITE#Hehehe...well done, @playerdescriptor.race@.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Ryal quietly turns towards the gate and leaves, seemingly unharmed*
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*挨了数次攻击后，不死巨人终于
#LIGHT_GREEN#倒在你的攻势下*
#LIGHT_GREEN#突然，瑞尔的身体开始再生！
#LIGHT_GREEN#它再次昂然挺立；你几乎能感觉到，那颗毫无表情的头骨
#LIGHT_GREEN#正带着……满意注视着你。
#WHITE#呵呵呵……干得好，@playerdescriptor.race@。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*瑞尔默默转向大门离去，看起来毫发无损*

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The wind chills as a young girl walks calmly through the gate.
#LIGHT_GREEN#She looks surprisingly young, with extremely pale skin and contrasting
#LIGHT_GREEN#long black hair. She examines you with eerie calmness*#WHITE#
I am known as Fryjia the Hailstorm. That's all you need to know, @playerdescriptor.race@. Let us begin.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The whole arena starts to get colder as she speaks, and the audience
#LIGHT_GREEN#starts wearing their finest winter cloaks*
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名少女从容地穿过大门，寒风随之袭来。
#LIGHT_GREEN#她年轻得出人意料，肌肤异常苍白，与一头黑色长发形成鲜明对比。
#LIGHT_GREEN#她以诡异的平静审视着你*#WHITE#
人们称我为冰雹弗里嘉。你只需知道这些，@playerdescriptor.race@。开始吧。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*随着她开口，整个竞技场越来越冷，观众
#LIGHT_GREEN#纷纷披上自己最好的冬用斗篷*

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*With your final blow, Fryjia falls, unable to continue*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She awkwardly stands up, but doesn't seem critically injured*
#WHITE# I...I admit defeat.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The audience "oooohs" in awe. Fryjia has turned her back to you*
#WHITE# @playerdescriptor.race@. You are not the person I am looking for...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Leaving you wondering what she was talking about, the young girl walks
#LIGHT_GREEN#towards the gate. As it closes, you realize her eyes are wet with tears.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你的最后一击落下，弗里嘉倒地，再也无力继续战斗*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她有些狼狈地站起身来，但似乎并未受致命伤*
#WHITE# 我……我认输。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*观众惊叹着发出“噢——”声。弗里嘉背过身去*
#WHITE# @playerdescriptor.race@。你不是我要找的人……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*少女走向大门，留下你独自揣摩她话里的意思。
#LIGHT_GREEN#大门关上时，你才发现她眼中含着泪水。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The gate opens, revealing a mature human woman in crimson robes.
#LIGHT_GREEN#She looks at you with a wide smile*
#WHITE# My, my, what a fine @playerdescriptor.race@ you are. What was your name again, @playername@? I am soo delighted to be your rival today.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She speaks quietly as if telling a secret* #WHITE#You know, so few get past the little one as of late, it's such a bore.#LIGHT_GREEN#*She giggles*#WHITE#
So! I am Riala, the Crimson. I came directly from Angolwen. Despite, you know, the whole thing with the Spellblaze, people still enjoy a few magic tricks!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She snaps her fingers, and then flames start dancing around her!*#WHITE#
Fryjia told me about you, the poor thing, so I will not underestimate such a promising aspirant #LIGHT_GREEN#*She smiles warmly* #WHITE#So, let's make haste my dear!
There is a battle to fight here!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*大门开启，一名身着深红长袍的成年女子出现在门后。
#LIGHT_GREEN#她灿烂地微笑着看向你*
#WHITE# 哎呀，哎呀，多出色的一位 @playerdescriptor.race@ 啊。你叫什么来着，@playername@？今天能成为你的对手，我可真是太高兴了。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她压低声音，仿佛在说一个秘密* #WHITE#你知道吗，最近能闯过那个小家伙的人实在太少了，真是无聊透顶。#LIGHT_GREEN#*她咯咯轻笑*#WHITE#
那么！我就是绯红里娅拉，刚从安格利文赶来。虽说嘛，魔法大爆炸闹出了那些事，但人们还是喜欢看点魔法把戏！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她打了个响指，火焰随即在她周围起舞！*#WHITE#
弗里嘉已经跟我说过你了，可怜的孩子。所以，我绝不会低估你这样前途无量的挑战者。#LIGHT_GREEN#*她温暖地微笑着* #WHITE#那么，亲爱的，我们赶快开始吧！
这里还有一场战斗等着我们！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*With the final blow, Riala falls...to suddenly burst in flames!!
#LIGHT_GREEN#You stare at the blazing inferno with understandable confusion,
#LIGHT_GREEN#until you hear her voice from behind*#WHITE#
Oh, my dear! That was quite the fight, wasn't it? I concede you the honor of victory.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She bows politely*
Fryjia was right about you: you seem to be a champion in the works!
Oh, and please forgive her behavior. You will understand when you meet her father.
And, if you keep fighting like this, it will be really soon.
So, it's been my pleasure, @playername@. #LIGHT_GREEN#*She vanishes in a spiral of flame*
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*最后一击落下，里娅拉倒地……却突然化作熊熊烈焰！！
#LIGHT_GREEN#你满心困惑地凝视着那片火海，
#LIGHT_GREEN#直到她的声音从身后传来*#WHITE#
哦，亲爱的！真是一场好胜负，不是吗？胜利的荣耀归你了。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她礼貌地鞠了一躬*
弗里嘉看得没错：你看来正成长为一名冠军！
哦，也请原谅她刚才的举止。等你见到她父亲，就会明白了。
而且，只要你继续这样战斗，那一刻很快就会到来。
很高兴与你交手，@playername@。#LIGHT_GREEN#*她在盘旋的火焰中消失*

source: I am pumped up! What's next?
target: 我斗志正旺！下一个是谁？

source: Am I the only person with a name that can die here?
target: 难道我是唯一一个有名有姓却会死在这里的人吗？

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You suddenly realize everything has turned dark.
#LIGHT_GREEN#You look around searching for your rival. And then you notice it. Standing
#LIGHT_GREEN#right before you, a massive battle armor with an equally massive battle axe.
#LIGHT_GREEN#It wasn't there just a second ago. You step back and examine him better,
#LIGHT_GREEN#realizing it's actually a human inside that hulking, worn armor. You can't see
#LIGHT_GREEN#his eyes, but you know he's piercing your soul with his stare*
f...t...ma....ll...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You hear a devilish voice, coming from everywhere at once!! But...you are
#LIGHT_GREEN#unable to understand anything! It doesn't seem like any language used in
#LIGHT_GREEN#Maj'Eyal!
#LIGHT_GREEN#And then...a piercing, demonic roar...you are overwhelmed by extreme
#LIGHT_GREEN#emotions invading your very soul!!*
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你突然发现四周陷入了黑暗。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你环顾四周，寻找自己的对手。随即，你注意到了它：
#LIGHT_GREEN#一副同样手持巨大战斧的巨型战甲，就站在你面前。
#LIGHT_GREEN#一瞬之前那里还空无一物。你后退一步，仔细端详，
#LIGHT_GREEN#才发现那副庞大而破旧的战甲里其实装着一个人类。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你看不见他的双眼，却知道他的目光正刺穿你的灵魂*
弗……特……玛……尔……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个魔鬼般的声音突然从四面八方同时传来！！但……
#LIGHT_GREEN#你完全听不懂！这不像
#LIGHT_GREEN#马基·埃亚尔使用的任何一种语言！
#LIGHT_GREEN#紧接着……一声刺耳的恶魔咆哮……
#LIGHT_GREEN#极端的情绪侵入灵魂，将你彻底淹没！！*

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You valiantly deliver the finishing blow!*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Valfren collapses as the light returns to this world.
#LIGHT_GREEN#You close your eyes for a brief instant. Fryjia is there when you open them*
Father... #LIGHT_GREEN#*She stands silent for a few seconds*#WHITE# You win, @playerdescriptor.race@.
You have done well. Prepare for your final battle... if you win, we will be at your service.
Good luck...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*After a few uncomfortable seconds, Valfren starts to move again.
#LIGHT_GREEN#He stands up and walks away with Fryjia. At the gates, Valfren turns his
#LIGHT_GREEN#head in your direction. You look at him, and then he looks above
#LIGHT_GREEN#the arena's walls. You follow his gaze... to meet the Master of the Arena*

#LIGHT_GREEN#*There it is. Your goal. Your heart beats fast, as the time has come*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Master of the Arena smiles proudly*
#RED#The final battle begins when the gate closes, just this final time!!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你英勇地使出致命一击！*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*光明重返这个世界，瓦弗伦随之倒下。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你闭眼短短一瞬；再睁开时，弗里嘉已出现在眼前*
父亲…… #LIGHT_GREEN#*她沉默了几秒*#WHITE# 你赢了，@playerdescriptor.race@。
你表现得很好。准备迎接最后一战吧……如果你获胜，我们将听候你的差遣。
祝你好运……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*令人不安的几秒过后，瓦弗伦重新动了起来。
#LIGHT_GREEN#他站起身，与弗里嘉一同离去。走到大门处，瓦弗伦转头望向你。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你与他对视，随后他抬眼看向竞技场的围墙上方。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你循着他的目光……见到了竞技场主宰*

#LIGHT_GREEN#*他就在那里。你的目标。时刻终于来临，你的心跳随之加快*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰骄傲地微笑着*
#RED#大门一关，最终决战便会开始——这是最后一次了！！

source: I will defeat you, Master of the Arena!!!
target: 我会打败你，竞技场主宰！！！

source: I will become Master of the Arena instead of the Master of the Arena!!
target: 我会取代竞技场主宰，亲自成为竞技场主宰！！

source: Wealth and glory! Wealth and glory!
target: 财富与荣耀！财富与荣耀！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Finally, the master of the arena comes into the gates!
#LIGHT_GREEN#The public roars with excitement as he faces you with confidence!*
I applaud you, @playerdescriptor.race@! You have fought with might and courage!
And now...the time for the final showdown!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master assumes a fighting stance. The audience cheers!*
Like you, I started from nowhere. I won't underestimate someone with such potential.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master smirks, you assume your fighting stance as well, and the
#LIGHT_GREEN#audience cheers you as well, making the excitement grow inside you*
Can you hear it, the public cheering? That's what this is about.
Pursue glory with all your might, @playerdescriptor.race@!!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master steps forward into the sand*
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*终于，竞技场主宰穿过大门，步入场中！
#LIGHT_GREEN#他自信地与你对峙，观众兴奋地咆哮起来！*
值得称赞，@playerdescriptor.race@！你凭力量与勇气一路奋战至此！
现在……最终对决的时刻到了！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰摆出战斗架势。观众放声欢呼！*
和你一样，我也曾从一无所有起步。我不会低估像你这样潜力非凡的人。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰得意一笑；你也摆出战斗架势，
#LIGHT_GREEN#观众同样为你欢呼，令你心中的激动愈发高涨*
听见了吗？观众正在欢呼。这才是竞技场的意义。
用尽全力追逐荣耀吧，@playerdescriptor.race@！！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰向前踏入沙场*

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*After a glorious battle, the Master falls!*
Hah...haha. You did it, @playerdescriptor.race@...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master of the arena, defeated, stands up with a wide smile.
#LIGHT_GREEN#Feeling the master's approval, you pick up its weapon, now lying
#LIGHT_GREEN#in the blood-stained sand.*
Everyone! We got a champion today!!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The audience rages and shouts your name repeatedly*
Congratulations, @playerdescriptor.race@. You are the Master now.
Now you shall take your rightful place as the champion.
Just remember...like me, you shall fall one day...
But meanwhile, this is your place! Welcome to paradise, @playerdescriptor.race@!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You see several sponsors and military recruiters approach the
#LIGHT_GREEN#now defeated master, offering deals and good positions in the army.
#LIGHT_GREEN#You smile, victorious, knowing your life will be glorious from now on.
#LIGHT_GREEN#Because even if you are defeated in the future...
#LIGHT_GREEN#You can always sell your image and live large.

#YELLOW#CONGRATULATIONS!
#YELLOW#You are the new master of the arena! You are great and epic!
#YELLOW#You shall remain as the new master until someone challenges you!
#YELLOW#Next time you play, you shall battle this new champion instead!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一场辉煌的战斗过后，竞技场主宰倒下了！*
哈……哈哈。你做到了，@playerdescriptor.race@……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*战败的竞技场主宰站起身，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。
#LIGHT_GREEN#感受到他的认可，你拾起了他的武器——
#LIGHT_GREEN#它正落在染血的沙地上。*
各位！我们今天迎来了一位冠军！！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*观众沸腾起来，一遍遍高喊你的名字*
恭喜你，@playerdescriptor.race@。如今你才是竞技场主宰。
现在，你将登上冠军应得的位置。
只要记住……和我一样，你终有一天也会倒下……
但在那之前，这里属于你！欢迎来到天堂，@playerdescriptor.race@！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你看到几名赞助人和军方招募者走向落败的前任主宰，
#LIGHT_GREEN#向他提出合作条件，并许诺军中的优厚职位。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你以胜利者的姿态微笑着，知道自己此后的人生必将辉煌。
#LIGHT_GREEN#因为即使你将来落败……
#LIGHT_GREEN#也总能靠自己的名气赚得盆满钵满。

#YELLOW#恭喜！
#YELLOW#你是新的竞技场主宰！伟大而传奇！
#YELLOW#在有人前来挑战之前，你将一直担任新的竞技场主宰！
#YELLOW#下次游玩时，你将与这位新冠军交战！

source: I won't need to save chicks from cults anymore!
target: 我再也不用从邪教那里救姑娘们了！

source: I hereby stand victorious, awaiting future challenges!
target: 我已胜利加冕，静候未来的挑战！
#LIGHT_BLUE# 你强化了对 %s 的准备。

source: I ain't no chatting! Speak to the boss!
target: 我没空闲聊！去跟老大说！

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You and the Lord discuss your new relationship at some length, including the merits of assassination by proxy and some additional trapping techniques.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你与盗贼领主详谈了你们的新关系，包括借刀杀人的益处以及一些额外的陷阱技巧。

source: As you depart the assassin lord says: 'And do not forget, I own you now.'
target: 当你离开时，盗贼领主说道：“别忘了，你现在归我所有了。”

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a menacing man clothed in black.*#WHITE#
Ahh, the intruder at last... And what shall we do with you? Why did you kill my men?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个身穿黑衣的凶恶男人。*#WHITE#
啊，入侵者终于现身了……我们该怎么处置你呢？你为什么杀我的人？

source: I heard some cries, and your men... they were in my way. What's going on here?
target: 我听到了呼喊声，而你的人……挡了我的路。这里发生了什么事？

source: I thought there might be some treasure to be had around here.
target: 我以为能在这里捞到些财宝。

source: Oh, you are not going anywhere, I'm afraid! KILL!
target: 哦，恐怕你哪儿也去不了！给我杀！

source: Wait! Maybe we could work out some kind of arrangement; you seem to be a practical man.
target: 等等！也许我们能达成某种协议；你看上去是个讲求实际的人。

source: Oh, so this is the part where I tell you my plan before you attack me? GET THIS INTRUDER!
target: 哦，所以现在该轮到我在你动手前透露计划了？拿下这个入侵者！

source: I am afraid this is not your lucky day then. The merchant is ours... and so are you! GET THIS INTRUDER!!
target: 恐怕今天不是你的幸运日。那个商人是我们的了……你也是！拿下这个入侵者！！

source:
Well, I need somebody to replace the men you killed. You look sturdy; maybe you could work for me.
You will have to do some dirty work for me, though, and you will be bound to me.  Nevertheless, you may make quite a profit from this venture, if you are as good as you seem to be.
And do not think of crossing me.  That would be... unwise.
target:
好吧，我正需要有人来顶替被你杀掉的那些手下。你看上去挺结实；也许你能替我干活。
不过，你得替我干些脏活，而且你将受制于我。话说回来，只要你的本事真有看上去那么过硬，你也能在这桩买卖中捞到不少好处。
另外，可别动跟我作对的心思。那会……非常不明智。

source: Well, I suppose it is better than dying.
Just let me and the merchant get out of here and you may live!
target: 只要放我和商人离开这里，我就饶你不死！

source: Uhh, okay. Sure. Mind showing me?
target: 呃，好吧。行啊。不介意展示给我看看吗？

source:
<<<You feel a gentle warmth in your mind. Something speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#HELLO FRIEND. I AM A STAR FROM FAR AWAY. I HAVE HEARD YOU PRAISING YOUR SUN. WHY NOT PRAISE ME INSTEAD? I AM A MUCH BETTER SUN THAN THAT DULL, LIFELESS GAS ORB IN YOUR VICINITY. PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO DEMONSTRATE MY GOOD INTENTIONS.
target:
<<<你在脑海中感受到一阵温和的暖意。有什么存在直接在你的脑海中对你说话！>>>
#YELLOW#你好，朋友。我是一颗来自远方的恒星。我听到了你对太阳的赞美。为什么不改来赞美我呢？比起你附近那颗枯燥乏味、毫无生气的气态球体，我是一颗好得多的太阳。请允许我向你展示我的善意。

source: I don't take unsolicited messages from... stars.
target: 我不接受来自……恒星的不请自来的消息。

source: #YELLOW#YOU ONLY HAD TO ASK, MY FRIEND.
#CRIMSON#[The area around you erupts in flames, burning your foes]
target: #CRIMSON#[你周围的区域爆发烈焰，焚烧你的敌人]

source: Look, I appreciate the offer, but I don't know you.
target: 听着，我感谢你的好意，但我根本不认识你。

source: #YELLOW#DON'T BE LIKE THAT. I KNOW YOU ARE ON A NOBLE QUEST.
target: #YELLOW#别这样。我知道你身负一项崇高的使命。

source: I'm busy at the moment, so maybe call back another time?
target: 我现在正忙，能改天再联系吗？

source: #YELLOW#I AM YOUR FRIEND. NOW YOU KNOW ME. LET US BEGIN A LONG AND FRUITFUL FRIENDSHIP.
target: #YELLOW#我是你的朋友。现在你认识我了。让我们开启一段长久而硕果累累的友谊吧。

source: #YELLOW#BUSY, YOU SAY? I CAN FIX THAT, LIKE ANY GOOD FRIEND WOULD.
target: #YELLOW#你说你在忙？我可以帮你搞定，就像任何好朋友会做的那样。

source: #YELLOW#YOU DON'T BELIEVE ME? THEN PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO SHOW YOU A MERE FRACTION OF MY POWER.
target: #YELLOW#你不相信我？那么，请允许我向你展示我微不足道的一小部分力量。

source: #YELLOW#YOU HAVE MADE THE RIGHT CHOICE. TOGETHER, WE SHALL BRING ABOUT THE DESTRUCTION OF OUR ENEMIES.
target: #YELLOW#你做出了正确的选择。我们将携手为我们的敌人带去毁灭。

source: #GOLD#[you are now an Avatar of a Distant Sun]

<<<You feel the gentle warmth of your Distant Sun patron. It speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#I AM HERE. DO YOU DESIRE TO SMITE EVIL, DESTROY THE DARKNESS AND SCOUR THE EARTH? I SHALL AID YOU IN THIS QUEST. TOGETHER, WE WILL BE UNSTOPPABLE. ALL DARKNESS SHALL BE CONSUMED BY OUR LIGHT.
#LAST#
target:
<<<你感受到了来自遥远太阳宗主的温和暖意。它直接在你的脑海中对你说话！>>>
#YELLOW#我在此处。你是否渴望惩治邪恶、诛灭黑暗、荡涤大地？我将在这项使命中助你一臂之力。携起手来，我们将势不可挡。所有的黑暗都将被我们的光芒吞噬殆尽。
#LAST#

source: But what are you getting out of this?
target: 但你能从中得到什么好处？
这等于什么都没告诉我。

source: But how are you speaking to me?
target: 但你是怎么跟我说话的？

source: #YELLOW#I AM YOUR FRIEND. IT IS GOOD TO HAVE FRIENDS, ISN'T IT?
target: #YELLOW#我是你的朋友。有朋友总是件好事，不是吗？

source: You still haven't told me who or what you are.
target: 你还是没告诉我你是谁，或者到底是什么。

source: #YELLOW#YOU NEED NOT CONCERN YOURSELF WITH SUCH THINGS. I KNOW YOU CRAVE POWER. I KNOW THE WEIGHT OF THE WORLD IS ON YOUR SHOULDERS. SO, ACCEPT MY BOONS. ALLOW ME TO HELP YOU.
target: #YELLOW#你无需为这些事操心。我知道你渴望力量。我知道整个世界的重担都压在你的肩上。所以，接受我的赐福吧。让我来助你一臂之力。

source: #YELLOW#I AM GETTING PLENTY OUT OF THIS.
#YELLOW#I TIRE OF YOUR NAGGING QUESTIONS. TALK, TALK, TALK. YOU HAVE A SIMPLE CHOICE BEFORE YOU. WILL YOU BECOME POWERFUL? OR WILL YOU BE WEAK AND ALONE?
target: #YELLOW#我已经厌倦了你这喋喋不休的追问。说，说，说个没完。摆在你面前的选择很简单：你是要变得强大？还是要弱小又孤独？

source: I don't trust you. Please go away.
#YELLOW#I HAVE LITTLE PATIENCE FOR TIME WASTERS. THIS SHALL BE THE LAST TIME WE SPEAK.
target: #YELLOW#我对浪费时间的人毫无耐心。这将是我们最后一次对话。

source: What kind of anomaly do you prefer?
#PURPLE#A paradox has already destroyed other timelines!
target: #PURPLE#一个时空悖论已经摧毁了其他时间线！

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You select the timeline and re-arrange the universe to your liking!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你选择了时间线，依照你的心愿重构了宇宙！

source: You have lived %d turns in three different timelines. Which do you choose to be the real timeline?
target: 你在三条不同的时间线里度过了 %d 个回合。你选择哪一条作为现实时间线？

source: Greetings. How can I help you?
target: 您好。有什么我可以为您效劳的？

source: Hurry up and make with the foe-blasting.
target: 快点，赶紧去把敌人轰杀成渣。

source: O wise wielder, instruct me that I may better serve you.
target: 睿智的持杖者啊，请指示我，好让我更好地为您效劳。

source: Make amends, magic-user, for the harm ye have wrought is beyond compare.
target: 赎罪吧，施法者，你所铸成的灾祸无可估量。

source: You really could have chosen a better home for me, you know. I was reasonably happy in my old crystal. This stick smells like armpit.
target: 我说，你本来真该给我挑个好点的去处。我在我原本的旧水晶里待得挺舒坦的。这根破棍子闻起来一股腋臭味。

source: Tremble before the might of Telos!
target: 在泰勒斯的伟力面前颤抖吧！

source: It is not yet your place to command such a staff as this. To do so invites obliteration.
target: 你现在还没有资格号令这样的法杖。妄自尝试只会招致毁灭。

source: Call on which aspect of the staff?

Oh, I was once a mighty Eldritch Channeler. Mighty and absentminded, as it turns out. Had a bit of a mishap with an Inverted Kugala's Soul-infusion technique. Long story short, my soul is now stuck in this stick, and the soul I was working with... well, I don't rightly know where he got to. But I hope we never meet him.
target: 哦，我曾经是一位强大的埃尔德里奇主宰者。事实证明，虽说强大，但也健忘。在施展反转库加拉灵魂灌注术时出了点小岔子。长话短说，我的灵魂现在被困在这根法杖里，而我当时正在处理的那个灵魂……呃，我实在不知道他跑哪儿去了。但我希望我们永远别碰上他。

source: Argh! Bollocksed up a tricky bit of soul magic and the fool that I was supposed to be imprisoning for all eternity flitted away. My body, like all the targets of my spells, intended or otherwise, got reduced to elementary particles. Fortunately, I had this soul-cage of a staff all prepped and ready for a stray soul, so I'm not completely gone. But enough chit-chat. Let's fry somebody.
target: 啊！我把一个棘手的灵魂法术搞得一团糟，本该被我永世囚禁的蠢货趁机溜走了。我的肉身，就像我法术命中的所有目标一样——不管是有意还是无意——全被分解成了基本粒子。幸好我早就准备好了这根灵魂牢笼法杖来收容游魂，所以我才没彻底玩完。不过闲话少说。赶紧去把谁烤成焦炭吧！

source: My old master-- who, though a powerful enchanter, did not compare to you and your glory-- saw fit to imprison me in this fine staff to aid him in his work. Alas, he is long gone, but I despair not, for I have found a mighty new master.
target: 我的前任主人——虽然也是一位强大的附魔师，但与您和您的无上荣光相比根本不值一提——决定将我囚禁在这根精良的法杖中以协助他的工作。唉，他早已不在人世，但我毫不绝望，因为我找到了一位强大的新主人。

source: I am a portion of the very spirit of the world that was ripped free during the Spellblaze. I speak that I might enlighten those who bear me.
target: 我是世界之灵的一部分，在魔法大爆炸中被撕裂分离。我出言发声，是为了启迪执掌我的人。

source: What's the good of immortality if you can't even speak? No archmage worth his salt is going to concoct some immoral life-after-death scheme without including some sort of capacity for making his opinions known. And, by the way, your energy manipulation techniques are on the same level as those of my average pair of shoes. Best study up if you don't want to die forgotten and incompetent.
target: 要是连话都说不了，永生还有什么用？但凡有点真本事的大法师，在谋划某种不道德的死后延续方案时，都绝不会忘记给自己留下一条发表见解的途径。顺便说一句，你的能量操控技巧跟我随便一双鞋子差不多在同一个档次。要是你不想默默无闻又无能地死去，最好趁早多学学。

source: I highly recommend the mage aspect and the fire element. You're not going to find anything better for turning a piece of meat into a cloud of vapor.
target: 我强烈推荐法师形态和火焰元素。想要把一块生肉化成一团蒸汽，你绝找不到比这更好的手段了。

source: I live to serve-- though my use of the word 'live' is perhaps loose here.
target: 我活着就是为了侍奉您——虽然我在这里用“活”这个字眼可能不太严谨。

source: Choose wisely. Powers beyond your comprehension will tolerate only so much interference in their carefully-laid natural order.
target: 明智地抉择吧。超越你理解的力量，对于它们精心维系的自然秩序所能容忍的干涉是有限的。

source: Back in my day, we didn't need to go changing our staves around willy-nilly. We picked an element and stuck with it, by the gods.
target: 在我们那个年代，谁会随随便便把法杖形态调来调去。我们选定一种元素就一直用到底，诸神在上。

source: Certainly. You should be impressed, by the way, that I can do such a thing. Most lesser practitioners of my art would have difficulties with this. What shall I change?
target: 当然可以。顺便说一句，我能做到这种事，你本该感到钦佩才对。大多数技艺不如我的人对此都会感到棘手。你想让我做何改动？

source: Fine, as long as it leads to blasting something soon. What do you want me to change?
target: 行吧，只要能赶紧去把什么东西轰成渣就行。你想让我改动什么？

source: How is it that you speak?
I'd like you to bring forth a different aspect.
target: 我希望你展现出不同的形态。

source: I'd like to alter your basic properties.
target: 我希望调整你的基础属性。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Entering the room, you see two massive ogres standing guard, blinking as though awakened from a long sleep. They see you, and immediately snap to attention. The one on the right speaks:*#WHITE#
YOU!  Name, rank, and identification.  NOW.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*进入房间，你看到两个体型巨大的食人魔正在站岗，眨着眼睛，仿佛刚从漫长的沉睡中醒来。他们看到了你，立刻立正站好。右边那个开口道：*#WHITE#
你！姓名、军衔、身份证明。立刻！

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*Entering the room, you see two massive ogres standing guard, blinking as though awakened from a long sleep. They see you, and immediately draw their weapons.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*进入房间，你看到两个体型巨大的食人魔正在站岗，眨着眼睛，仿佛刚从漫长的沉睡中醒来。他们看到了你，立刻拔出了武器。
#CRIMSON#纳格尔杂种！我们遭到袭击了！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Entering the room, you see two massive ogres standing guard, blinking as though awakened from a long sleep. They see you, and immediately snap to attention. The one on the right speaks:*#WHITE#
Ah!  Reinforcements!  I don't know how long it's been, but I'll get Astelrid up here to--  wait a minute, where are the rest of them?  #LIGHT_GREEN#*He frowns.*#WHITE# What's your identification number?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*进入房间，你看到两个体型巨大的食人魔正在站岗，眨着眼睛，仿佛刚从漫长的沉睡中醒来。他们看到了你，立刻立正站好。右边那个开口道：*#WHITE#
啊！援军！我不知道已经过了多久，不过我去把亚斯特莉叫上来——等等，其他人呢？  #LIGHT_GREEN#*他皱起眉头。*#WHITE# 你的身份编号是多少？

source: Wait! The war's over! It's been thousands of years, the Conclave doesn't exist anymore!
target: 等等！战争已经结束了！已经过去了几千年，孔克雷夫早就不复存在了！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*They look at each other and scowl, drawing their weapons.  The one on the left growls:*#WHITE#
LIES!  The Conclave could not have lost!  I don't know who you are, but we can't afford witnesses!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他们互相对视了一眼，面露怒容，拔出了武器。左边那个低吼道：*#WHITE#
谎言！孔克雷夫绝不可能战败！我不知道你是谁，但我们绝不能留下目击者！

source:
Wait, @playerdescriptor.subclass@!
I see you are a worthy opponent, powerful indeed. I can see, and feel, your mastery of the eldritch crafts.
We are the same.
target:
等等，@playerdescriptor.subclass@！
我看你是个值得尊敬的对手，确实很强大。我能看到、也能感受到你对奥术技艺的精通。
我们是同一类人。
你说的“同一类人”是什么意思？

source: I am nothing like you. Die!
target: 我跟你可不是同一类人。去死吧！

source: So be it. Die, and give me your power!
target: 既然如此。受死吧，把你的力量交给我！

source:
We both know the strength of the arcane; we both hunger for power. There is so much I have discovered, so much I could teach you.
This place is special. The veil of reality is thin here, forever shattered by the Spellblaze. We are taking advantage of this; we can draw on the power,
leeching from this place, to better ourselves, to bring forth the dominion of magic!
target:
我们都深知奥术的力量，也都渴求力量。我探索出了许多奥秘，有太多的东西可以传授给你。
这个地方非同寻常。这里的现实帷幕无比脆弱，已被魔法大爆炸永久撕碎。我们正善加利用这一点；我们可以汲取其中的力量，
从此处不断榨取，以提升我们自身，迎来魔法的统治！

source: The world suffered from the Spellblaze enough. Magic must serve people, not enslave them. I will not listen to you!
target: 这个世界承受魔法大爆炸的苦难已经够多了。魔法必须造福于人，而不是奴役世人。我绝不会听你的！

source:
Let us end this meaningless fight. Have you ever heard of a group of people called the Ziguranth?
These rambling madmen think magic should not be permitted to exist! They fear us; they fear our powers.
Let us join forces and crush the fools!
target:
让我们结束这场毫无意义的争斗吧。你听说过一个叫伊格兰斯的群体吗？
这群疯言疯语的狂徒认为魔法根本不该被允许存在！他们害怕我们，害怕我们的力量。
让我们联手消灭那些蠢货！

source: Magic has a purpose. Those men are wrong, but you seem much worse.
target: 魔法自有其用途。那些人固然错了，但你看起来要恶劣得多。

source: Then you must leave... THIS WORLD! DIE!
target: 既然如此，那你就离开……这个世界吧！受死！

source:
Good. Before your... untimely arrival we were preparing an attack on the Ziguranth main training camp, on the southern beach of the sea of Sash.
Come with us; let's destroy them!
I will open a portal to Zigur and the massacre shall begin!
target:
很好。在你这……不合时宜的造访之前，我们正准备进攻位于萨希之海南岸的伊格兰斯主要训练营地。
跟我们来，让我们彻底消灭他们！
我将开启通往伊格的传送门，屠杀即将开始！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A Halfling comes forth from his hiding place.*#WHITE#
You killed them all? Are we safe now? Oh, please tell me this was a bad dream!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个半身人从他的藏身之处走了出来。*#WHITE#
你把它们全杀光了？我们现在安全了吗？噢，请告诉我这只是一场噩梦！

source: Be at ease. I have dispatched those monstrosities. Do you know where they came from or what they wanted?
target: 放宽心吧。我已经消灭了那些怪物。你知道它们是从哪儿来的，或者想要干什么吗？

source:
From nowhere! From the sky!
I do not know. I was tending my crop just outside the town when I heard screaming. As I entered the town, I saw the dark cloud over here. Those... those... things were coming from it in blasts of lightning!
target:
不知道从哪儿冒出来的！从天上！
我真不知道。我当时正在镇外照料庄稼，忽然听到了尖叫声。当我赶回镇上时，就看到了这里的这片乌云。那些……那些……鬼东西伴随着道道闪电从云里钻了出来！

source: It seems they have stopped coming for now. I will look for somebody who could help dispose of this nefarious cloud.
target: 看起来它们暂时不再出现了。我会寻找能够帮忙解决这片邪恶乌云的人。

source:
Thank you! You have saved many people today!
I have heard of rumours of a reclusive town of wise and powerful men somewhere in the mountains. Maybe they could help? If they even exist...
There are also those Zigur-something people that claim to fight magic. Why are they not here?!
target:
多谢！你今天救了很多人！
我曾听说过传闻，在群山深处的某处有一座隐秘城镇，住着智慧而强大的人。也许他们能帮上忙？如果他们真的存在的话……
还有那些自称对抗魔法的叫什么伊格的人。他们为什么不在这里？！

source: You mean the Ziguranth. That would be me.
target: 你是指伊格兰斯。我就是其中一员。

source: I will not let you down.
Well then please do something about this evil magic!
target: 那就请一定要想办法对付这邪恶的魔法！

source:
#VIOLET#*As you come out of the Dreadfell, you encounter a band of orcs*#LAST#
You! Give us the staff NOW and we might offer you a quick death!
target:
#VIOLET#*当你走出恐惧王座时，遭遇了一群兽人。*#LAST#
你！立刻把法杖交出来，我们或许还能给你个痛快！

source: Do not play dumb with Ukruk! ATTACK!
target: 少在乌克鲁克面前装傻！给我上！

source: That is not your concern! ATTACK!

#LIGHT_GREEN#*A robed Human is waiting for you when you step out of the portal.*#WHITE#
Well met, @playername@!
I am Meranas, Herald of Angolwen. I have come here at the request of King Tolak, who worried when you didn't return.
We have been watching Tannen for some time, and were pleased to see you reveal his true nature-- and stop him. For this we are grateful, and I think we can pay you back.
We have studied his portal research, and if you give me the components I will create the portal for you, here and now!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*当你走出传送门时，一个身穿长袍的人类正等候着你。*#WHITE#
幸会，@playername@！
我是梅拉纳斯，安格利文的传令官。我是应托拉克国王的请求来到这里的，由于你迟迟未归，他一直很担心。
我们观察泰恩已有很长一段时间了，很高兴看到你揭穿了他的真面目并阻止了他。我们对此深表感激，我想我们可以回报你。
我们已经研究过他关于传送门的研究成果，如果你把那些部件交给我，我现在就可在此为你创建传送门！

source: Yes, Tannen was not exactly friendly. I thank you for your help. Here are the components. [hand him the diamond and the athame]
target: 是的，泰恩确实不太友善。感谢你的帮助，这是传送门部件。[将钻石和仪式匕首交给他]

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a humanoid shape filled with 'nothing'. It seems to stare at you.*#WHITE#
I am the Eidolon and you are not welcome here!
No matter how you came to this plane, #{bold}#DO NOT COME BACK!
NOW BEGONE!
#{normal}#
.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前伫立着一个由“虚无”构成的人形轮廓。它似乎正注视着你。*#WHITE#
我是艾德隆，你在这里不受欢迎！
无论你是如何来到这个位面的，#{bold}#都不要再来！
现在离开！
#{normal}#
.

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a humanoid shape filled with 'nothing'. It seems to stare at you.*#WHITE#
I have brought you here on the instant of your death. I am the Eidolon.
I have deemed you worthy of my 'interest'. I will watch your future steps with interest.
You may rest here, and when you are ready I will send you back to the material plane.
But do not abuse my help. I am not your servant, and someday I might just let you die.
As for your probable many questions, they will stay unanswered. I may help, but I am not here to explain why.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前伫立着一个由“虚无”构成的人形轮廓。它似乎正注视着你。*#WHITE#
在你死去的瞬间，我将你带到了这里。我是艾德隆。
我认定你值得引起我的“兴趣”。我将带着兴致注视你未来的脚步。
你可以在此休息片刻，当你准备就绪，我会将你送回物质位面。
但切勿滥用我的帮助。我并非你的仆从，终有一天我或许就任由你死去。
至于你可能会有的诸多疑问，它们不会得到解答。我可以施以援手，但我无须向你解释缘由。

source: Thank you. I will rest for a while.
target: 谢谢你。我在此休息片刻。

source: Thank you. I am ready to go back!
target: 谢谢你。我已经准备好回去了！

source: Thank you, but I fear I will not survive anyway, can you send me back somewhere else please?
target: 谢谢你，但我恐怕回去也是难逃一死，能否请你把我送到别的地方？

source: Thank you, but I fear I will not survive anyway, can you send me back somewhere else on the level please?
target: 谢谢你，但我恐怕回去也是难逃一死，能否请你把我送到本层的其他地方？

source: Thank you, I am ready to go back!
target: 谢谢你，我已经准备好回去了！

source: Thank you, but I am weary of this life, I wish no more, please let me go.
target: 谢谢你，但我已厌倦了这种生活，别无所求，请让我离去吧。

source:
It seems the threads of time and space have been disrupted...
I will try to send you to safety.
target:
时空之线似乎已被扰乱……
我会尽力将你送到安全的地方。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*It seems to stare at you in weird way.*#WHITE#
I...had plans for you, but I cannot go against your free will. Know that you had a destiny waiting for you.
Are you sure?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*它似乎正以古怪的目光注视着你。*#WHITE#
我……本对你另有打算，但我无法违背你的自由意志。要知道，本有一份宿命在等待着你。
你确定吗？

source: asked the Eidolon to let %s die in peace
target: 请求艾德隆让 %s 安息。

source: No actually, perhaps life is still worth it!
target: 不，其实生命或许依然值得活下去！

source: You immerse your mind in the Way and let knowledge flow in.
target: 你将心神沉浸于维网之中，任由知识涌入。

source: You pause and recall past memories.
target: 你驻足停歇，回忆起往昔的记忆。

source: Oh, hi @playername@, have you got something new to show me?
target: 啊，你好，@playername@！有什么新东西要给我看吗？

source: Yes, Elisa, could you have a look at these objects please? [show her the items the orb could not identify]
target: 是的，埃莉萨，能否请你帮我看看这些物品？[向她展示水晶球无法鉴定的物品]

source: Err, no... sorry, I just wanted to hear a friendly voice.
target: 呃，没有……抱歉，我只是想听听亲切的声音。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You hear something akin to a muffled giggle*#WHITE#
Oh, you are #{bold}#SOOOO#{normal}# cute!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你听到了一阵类似于掩口轻笑的声音*#WHITE#
哎呀，你真是#{bold}#太——#{normal}#可爱了！

source:
Let's see what have you got here...
%s

That is very nice, @playername@!
target:
让我看看你找到了什么好东西……
%s

真是不错，@playername@！

source: Hello friend, what can I do for you?
target: 你好，朋友，有什么我能为你效劳的吗？

source: Could you have a look at these objects, please? [show her your unidentified items]
target: 能否请你帮我看看这些物品？[向她出示你未鉴定的物品]

source:
Wait, @playername@, you seem to be quite the adventurer. Maybe we can help one another.
You see, I #{bold}#LOOOVVVEEEE#{normal}# learning new lore and finding old artifacts of power, but I am not exactly an adventurer and I would surely get killed out there.
So take this orb (#LIGHT_GREEN#*she gives you an orb of scrying*#WHITE#). You can use it to talk to me from anywhere in the world! This way you can show me your new shiny findings!
I get to see many interesting things, and you get to know what your items do. We both win! Isn't it sweet?
Oh yes, the orb will also identify mundane items for you, as long as you carry it.
target:
等等，@playername@，你看起来是个相当了不起的冒险家。也许我们能互相帮助。
你看，我#{bold}#超——喜欢#{normal}#学习新的传说知识、搜寻古老强大的神器，但我自己可算不上什么冒险家，到外头去肯定会送命的。
所以拿着这颗水晶球吧（#LIGHT_GREEN#*她递给你一颗占卜水晶球*#WHITE#）。你可以在世界上的任何地方用它与我通话！这样你就能随时向我展示你新找到的闪亮宝贝了！
我能见识到许多有趣的事物，而你也能弄清楚物品的用途。我们双赢！这不是两全其美吗？
而且，只要你随身携带，这颗水晶球还会为你自动鉴定普通物品。

source: Woah, thanks, Elisa. This is really nice!
target: 哇，多谢你，埃莉萨。这真是太棒了！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#[Pretend to help but when it is time you will use a Ziguranth technique to make the portal fizzle. @npcname@ will be sent to Zigur to be 'dealt with' properly.]#WHITE#
Lead on; I will protect you.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#[假装提供帮助，但等到时机成熟，你将使用伊格兰斯技巧让传送门失效。@npcname@ 将被送往伊格得到“妥善”处置。]#WHITE#
带路吧，我会保护你的。

source: Go away; I do not help filthy arcane users!
target: 走开；我绝不帮助肮脏的奥术使用者！

source: Lead on; I will protect you.

#LIGHT_GREEN#[Pretend to help but when it is time you will use a technique to make the portal fizzle. @npcname@ will be sent to Zigur to be 'dealt with' properly.]#WHITE#
Lead on; I will protect you.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#[假装提供帮助，但等到时机成熟，你将使用技巧让传送门失效。@npcname@ 将被送往伊格得到“妥善”处置。]#WHITE#
带路吧，我会保护你的。

source: Go away; I do not care for the weak.
target: 走开；我可不在乎弱者的死活。

source:
At the last moment you invoke the power of nature.  The portal fizzles and transports @npcname@ to Zigur.
You can feel Nature thanking you.
target:
在最后一刻，你引动了自然之力。传送门发生紊乱，将 @npcname@ 传送到了伊格。
你能感受到大自然对你的谢意。

source:
Thank you, my friend. I do not think I would have survived without you.
Please let me reward you:
target:
谢谢你，我的朋友。要是没有你，我想我根本活不下来。
请让我答谢你：

source: %s grabs her amulet and disappears in a whirl of arcane energies.
target: %s 抓紧她的护身符，在一阵奥术能量的漩涡中消失了。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She lies nearly dead at your feet*#WHITE#
So, now you will kill me and complete the cycle of destruction?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她奄奄一息地倒在你的脚边*#WHITE#
那么，现在你要杀了我，彻底完成这场毁灭的轮回吗？

source: What are you talking about? Why did you attack me?
target: 你在说什么？你为什么要攻击我？

source: Speak and I might spare you. Why did you attack me?
target: 说清楚，也许我能饶你一命。你为什么要攻击我？

source:
You.. you do not know?
A few hours after you entered this place a raid of orcs fell upon us. They were not alone -- demons walked among them. We were overwhelmed! Utterly destroyed!
My land is no more! All because you could not stop them at the Charred Scar! You failed us! People died to protect you, and you failed!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She starts to weep...*#WHITE#
target:
你……你不知道？
在你进入这里几个小时后，一队兽人突袭了我们。他们并非孤军奋战——恶魔与他们同行！我们寡不敌众！彻底覆灭了！
我的家园已不复存在！全都是因为你没能在灼烧之痕阻止他们！你辜负了我们！有人为保护你而死，而你却失败了！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她开始哭泣……*#WHITE#

source: I know my mistakes and I intend to correct them. Please let me pass. I cannot save your people, but I can make their deaths mean something!
target: 我知道自己的过错，并打算去弥补。请放我过去。我虽然无法挽救你的人民，但我能让他们的牺牲变得有意义！

source: What may I do for you?
Lady Aeryn, at last I am back home! [tell her your story]
target: 艾琳女士，我终于回家了！[告诉她你的故事]

source: Tell me more about the Gates of Morning.
target: 告诉我更多有关晨曦之门的事。

source: Before I came here, I happened upon members of the Sunwall in Maj'Eyal. Do you know of this?.
target: 在我来这里之前，我在马基·埃亚尔遇到了太阳堡垒的成员。你知道这件事么？

source: I need help in my hunt for clues about the staff.
target: 我在搜集法杖的线索，我需要你的帮助。

source: I have destroyed the leaders of all the Orc Prides.
target: 我已经消灭了所有兽人部落的首领。

source: I am back from the Charred Scar, where the orcs took the staff.
target: 我从灼烧之痕回来，兽人在那里抢走了法杖。

source: A dying paladin gave me this map; something about orc breeding pits. [tell her the story]
target: 一位濒死的太阳骑士给了我这张地图，关于兽人育种棚。[告诉她整个事情]

source:
@playername@! We thought you had died in the portal explosion. I am glad we were wrong. You saved the Sunwall.
The news about the staff is troubling. Ah well, please at least take time to rest for a while.
target:
@playername@！我们以为你在传送门爆炸的时候死了，幸好我们想错了，你拯救了太阳堡垒。
有关法杖的消息有点麻烦，那么，至少请你休息一会儿吧。

source: I shall, thank you, my lady.
target: 我会的，谢谢你，我的女士。

source:
There are two main groups in the population here, Humans and Elves.
Humans came here in the Age of Pyre. Our ancestors were part of a Mardrop expedition to find what had happened to the Naloren lands that sunk under the sea. Their ship was wrecked and the survivors landed on this continent.
They came across a group of elves, seemingly native to those lands, and befriended them - founding the Sunwall and the Gates of Morning.
Then the orc pride came and we have been fighting for our survival ever since.
target:
这里主要有两个种族，人类和精灵。
人类在烈火纪便来到了这里。我们的祖先是马卓普探险队的一部分人员，他们是去调查沉入海底的纳鲁精灵大陆秘密的。他们的船失事沉没，侥幸活下来的人就漂流到了这块大陆。
他们碰到了一群精灵，似乎是这块大陆的原住民，他们成为了朋友并一起生活，创建了太阳堡垒和晨曦之门。
后来兽人来到了这里，从那时开始我们就一直与他们战斗。

source: Ahh, so they survived? That is good news...
target: 啊，那么他们还活着，真是一个好消息……

source:
The people you saw are likely the volunteers of Zemekkys' early experiments regarding the farportals.
He is a mage who resides here in the Sunwall, eccentric but skilled, who believes that creation of a new farportal to Maj'Eyal is possible.
Aside from a few early attempts with questionable results, he hasn't had much luck. Still, it's gladdening to hear that the volunteers for his experiments live, regardless of their location. We are all still under the same Sun, after all.

Actually... maybe it would benefit you if you meet Zemekkys. He would surely be intrigued by that Orb of Many Ways you possess. He lives in a small house just to the north.
target:
你看到的那些人很可能是伊莫克斯关于远古传送门实验的志愿者。
他是居住在太阳堡垒的一个法师，脾气古怪但是很有能力，他坚信可以创造一个远古传送门达到马基·埃亚尔。
除了他早期的一些尝试获得了一点可疑的结论外，他并不算走运。不过还是很高兴听到他的实验对象还活着，无论他们身在何方。毕竟我们都生活在同一片阳光下。

事实上……也许去见见伊莫克斯对你有好处。他一定会对你手上的多元水晶球感兴趣。他就住在北边的小屋里。

source: Maybe I'll visit him. Thank you.

The news has indeed reached me. I could scarce believe it, so long have we been at war with the Pride.
Now they are dead? At the hands of just one @playerdescriptor.race@? Truly I am amazed by your power.
While you were busy bringing an end to the orcs, we managed to discover some parts of the truth from a captive orc.
He talked about the shield protecting the High Peak. It seems to be controlled by "orbs of command" which the masters of the Prides had in their possession.
He also said the only way to enter the peak and de-activate the shield is through the "slime tunnels", located somewhere in one of the Prides, probably Grushnak.
target:
我的确已经得到了消息，真令人难以置信，我们和兽人已经战斗的太久了。
他们现在都死了么？仅凭一个 @playerdescriptor.race@ 的力量？我对你的力量非常惊奇。
当你忙于解决那些兽人的时候，我们设法从那个兽人俘虏那里获得了一些线索。
他提起了有关巅峰保护罩的事。似乎那个护罩是受“指令水晶球”操控的，那些指令水晶就在兽人各大部落首领的手中。
