他还说想要进入顶层并关闭护罩的唯一通道是“史莱姆通道”，位于某一个兽人部落内，有可能是格鲁希纳克的部落。

source: Thanks, my lady. I have not been able to find all of the orbs of command in my travels; could you have some of your men search for me?
target: 谢谢，我的女士。我没能找到所有的指令水晶球；请问你可以让你们的人来帮我寻找一下吗？

source: Thanks, my lady. I will look for the tunnel and venture inside the Peak.
target: 谢谢，我的女士，我会寻找史莱姆通道，探寻前往巅峰的道路。

source:
I have already sent parties to clear out the remainder of the prides as you progressed, and have instructed to keep a sharp eye out for any orbs of command you may have missed.
	Which do you not have? I can check with the parties if they found any. Our sources indicate that you should have four: one of Undeath, one of Destruction, one of Dragons, and one of Elemental might.
target:
我们已经派出部队，清理那些被你所击溃的部落的残军。我命令他们仔细搜查，确保找到可能落下的任何指令水晶球的踪影。
	你缺少了什么水晶球？我会去问问他们，看看他们有没有找到什么线索。我们得到情报，应该有四颗指令水晶球：亡灵水晶球，毁灭水晶球，巨龙水晶球，元素水晶球

source: Thanks, my lady, that is all of them. I will look for the tunnel and venture inside the Peak.
target: 谢谢你，我的女士，看来我已经集齐了所有的水晶球。我会寻找史莱姆通道，打开通向巅峰的道路。

source: Ah yes, my men have found that in Rak'Shor Pride. Here:
target: 啊，是的，我们的人在拉克·肖部落找到了这个水晶球。给你：

source: Ah yes, my men have found that in Vor Pride. Here:
target: 啊，是的，我们的人在沃尔部落找到了这个水晶球。给你：

source: Ah yes, my men have found that in Grushnak Pride. Here:
target: 啊，是的，我们的人在格鲁希纳克部落找到了这个水晶球。给你：

source: Ah yes, my men have found that in Gorbat Pride. Here:
target: 啊，是的，我们的人在加伯特部落找到了这个水晶球。给你：

source:
As much as I would like to help, our forces are already spread too thin; we cannot provide you with direct assistance.
But I might be able to help you by explaining how the Pride is organised.
Recently we have heard the Pride speaking about a new master, or masters. They might be the ones behind that mysterious staff of yours.
We believe that the heart of their power is the High Peak, in the center of the continent. But it is inaccessible and covered by some kind of shield.
You must investigate the bastions of the Pride. Perhaps you will find more information about the High Peak, and any orc you kill is one less that will attack us.
The known bastions of the Pride are:
- Rak'shor Pride, in the west of the southern desert
- Gorbat Pride, in a mountain range in the southern desert
- Vor Pride, in the northeast
- Grushnak Pride, on the eastern slope of the High Peak
target:
我真的很想帮助你，不过我们的军队已经十分分散而且薄弱，我们无法直接给你提供军事援助。
但是我尽我所能，告诉你兽人部落的组成结构。
最近我们接到情报说兽人选举了新的领袖，他们很有可能就是抢夺神秘法杖的幕后主使人。
我们相信，他们的力量中心就是巅峰，在这个大陆的中部区域。不过它被某种护罩保护无法进入。
你必须调查兽人部落的各个基地，或许你能找到更多有关巅峰的线索，而且你每杀死一个兽人，我们就少了一个攻击我们的敌人。
已知的兽人部落有：
- 拉克·肖部落，在南部沙漠的西面。
- 加伯特部落，在南部沙漠的群山之中。
- 沃尔部落，在东北方。
- 格鲁希纳克部落，在通往高塔之巅的东部山坡上。

source: Aeryn points to the known locations on your map.
target: 艾琳在你的地图上指出了位置。

source:
One more bit of aid I might give you before you go. Your tale has moved me, and the very stars shine with approval of your relentless pursuit. Take their blessing, and let nothing stop you in your quest.
	#LIGHT_GREEN#*She touches your forehead with one cool hand, and you feel a surge of power*
target:
在你出发之前我还有一样东西可以帮助你，我被你的故事所感动，闪耀的群星将赐予你“无尽追踪”的能力。带上这个祝福，不要让任何事物阻碍你的使命。
	#LIGHT_GREEN#*她用冰凉的手触摸了你的额头，你感觉到身上涌现出一股力量。*

source: I'll leave not a single orc standing.
target: 我会将那些兽人赶尽杀绝。

source: #VIOLET#You have learned the talent Relentless Pursuit.
I have heard about that; good men lost their lives for this. I hope it was worth it.
target: 我已经听说了，很多好人为此牺牲了生命，但愿这是值得的。

source: Yes, my lady, they delayed the orcs so that I could get to the heart of the volcano. *#LIGHT_GREEN#Tell her what happened#WHITE#*
target: 是的，我的女士。他们拖住了敌人，使我能够前进至火山中心。*#LIGHT_GREEN#告诉她发生的事。#WHITE#*

source: I am afraid I was too late, but I still have some valuable information. *#LIGHT_GREEN#Tell her what happened#WHITE#*
target: 恐怕我太迟了，不过我还是带来了有价值的消息。*#LIGHT_GREEN#告诉她发生的事。#WHITE#*

source:
Sorcerers? I have never heard of them. There were rumours about a new master of the Pride, but it seems they have two.
Thank you for everything. You must continue your hunt now that you know what to look for.
target:
法师会？我从来没听说过他们。传说部落有了一个新的领袖，看样子现在应该有两个。
感谢你所做的事，你必须进一步搜寻更多的消息，你知道你该去做什么。

source:
Sorcerers? I have never heard of them. There were rumours about a new master of the Pride, but it seems they have two.
I am afraid with the power they gained today they will be even harder to stop, but we do not have a choice.
target:
法师会？我从来没听说过他们。传说部落有了一个新的领袖，看样子现在应该有两个。
恐怕依他们现在所具有的力量我们更难阻止他们了，不过我们别无选择。

source: Ah! This is wonderful! Finally a ray of hope amidst the darkness. I will assign my best troops to this. Thank you, @playername@ - take this as a token of gratitude.
target: 太好了！一线希望的曙光终于穿过了黑暗。我会派我最好的军队去那里。多谢你了，@playername@——以此物来表示我们对你的感激。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a beautiful woman clad in shining golden armour*#WHITE#
Stop! You are clearly a stranger! Where do you come from? The Gates of Morning are the last bastion of freedom in these lands, so who are you? A spy?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一位身披闪耀金色铠甲的美丽女士。*#WHITE#
站住！你显然是个陌生人！你是从哪里来的？晨曦之门是这片土地上最后的自由堡垒，你到底是谁？是间谍吗？

source: My lady, I am indeed a stranger in these lands. I come from the west, from Maj'Eyal.
target: 女士，在这片土地上我确实是个陌生人。我来自西方，来自马基·埃亚尔。

source:
Maj'Eyal! For many years have we tried to contact your people. We always failed.
In any event, what is your purpose here?
target:
马基·埃亚尔！多年来我们一直尝试与你们的人民取得联系，但都失败了。
不管怎样，你来这里有何目的？

source: It seems that I am stranded in these unfamiliar lands. #LIGHT_GREEN#*Tell her about your hunt for orcs and your encounter with Fillarel.*#WHITE#
target: 我似乎被困在了这片陌生的土地上。#LIGHT_GREEN#*向她讲述你追杀兽人并遭遇菲拉瑞尔的经历。*#WHITE#

source: Sun Paladins? What do you mean? We know of no such thing where I come from.
target: 太阳骑士？你是什么意思？在我来的地方，我们从没听说过这种存在。

source:
We are the mighty warriors of the Sunwall, channeling the power of the Sun and merging it with martial training.
For hundreds of years, we stood between the Orc Pride and the free people. Our numbers are diminishing, but we will stand firm until our last breath.
target:
我们是太阳堡垒的强大战士，引导太阳之力并将其融入武技训练之中。
数百年来，我们始终屹立在兽人部落与自由人民之间。我们的人数正在不断减少，但我们将坚守到底，直至咽下最后一口气。

source: You have a noble spirit, my lady.
target: 女士，您的精神令人钦佩。

source: The Orc Pride obeys a master? I see... 'pride' indeed!
target: 兽人部落会听命于主人？我明白了……还真是“骄傲”啊！

source: The Pride chooses its allies. It has no master! ATTACK!
target: 部落自己选择盟友。部落没有主人！攻击！

source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

source: This costs %d gold, you need more gold.
target: 这将花费 %d 金币，你需要更多金币

source: This will cost you %s gold, do you accept?
target: 这将花费你 %s 金币，你确认接受吗？
使用哪颗做第一个宝石？
使用哪颗做第二个宝石？

source: Limmir needs more gold for the magical plating.
target: 利米尔需要更多钱用于镀金工艺

source: You need to use %s gold for the plating, do you accept?
target: 你需要花费 %s 金币用于镀金，你确认接受吗？

source: I am looking for special jewelry.
target: 我在找一些特殊的珠宝。

source: So you can infuse amulets in this place?
target: 据说你可以给项链附魔？

source: I have found this tome; it looked important.
target: 我找到了这本手册，看上去好像很重要。

source:
Then you are at the right place, for I am an expert jeweler.
If you bring me a gem and a ring, I can create a new ring imbued with the properties of the gem.  The original traits of the ring will be lost in the process but new ones of similar quality will be generated.
There is a small fee dependent on the level of the ring, and you need a quality ring to use a quality gem.
target:
你算找对地方了，我可是一个珠宝专家。
如果你给我找来一颗宝石和一枚戒指，我可以帮你把宝石的力量镶嵌到戒指里去。这颗戒指里面原来所有的属性会丢失掉，不过也会生成一些质量相似的新属性。
不过根据戒指等级我要收取一小笔费用。你得寻找高品质的戒指来用于高品质的宝石。

source:
Yes! Thanks to you this place is now free from the corruption. I will stay on this island to study the magical aura, and as promised I can make you powerful amulets.
Bring me a an amulet and two different gems and I will turn them into a powerful amulet, though the original properties of the amulet will be lost.
I will not make you pay a fee for it since you helped me so much, but I am afraid the ritual requires a gold plating. This should be equal to about 1000 gold pieces.
target:
对！感谢你让这个地方从腐化中脱离了出来。我会留在这个岛上学习魔法光环，我会遵守我的诺言帮你制作一条强力的项链。
给我带来一条项链还有两颗不同的宝石，我会利用它们制作一条强力的项链。
你帮了我那么多，这次我不收任何费用。不过制作过程中需要镀金工艺，这大约得花费 1000 金币，而且项链原本的属性将不复存在。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He quickly looks at the tome and looks amazed.*#WHITE# This is an amazing find! Truly amazing!
With this knowledge I could create potent amulets. However, it requires a special place of power to craft such items.
There are rumours about a site of power in the southern mountains. Old legends tell about a place where a part of the Wintertide Moon melted when it got too close to the Sun and fell from the sky.
A lake formed in the crater of the crash. The water of this lake, soaked in intense Moonlight for eons, should be sufficient to forge powerful artifacts!
Go to the lake and then summon me with this scroll. I will retire to study the tome, awaiting your summon.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他快速浏览了那本手册，露出了惊讶的表情。*#WHITE# 这真是神奇的发现！太神奇了！
有了这些知识我就能制造更强大的项链了。不过这需要一个特殊的地方来完成制作过程。
传言在南部山脉之中有个地方充满能量。有个古老的传说，当冬月与太阳距离太接近的时候它的一部分从空中掉落了下来并融入了大地，使那个地方充满能量。
在坠落的地方形成了一个湖泊，湖水吸收了万年月光的力量，应该足以锻造出强大的神器。
去找到那个湖泊，然后使用这个卷轴将我召唤过去，从现在开始我要潜心研修你的这本手册，等待你召唤我的那一刻。

source: I will see if I can find it.
target: 我看看能不能找到那个地方。

source: #VIOLET#*Before you stands Berethh. His face shows no emotion, but his posture is threatening.#LAST#
target: #VIOLET#*贝里斯站在你的面前。他面无表情，但姿态充满威胁。#LAST#

source: I'm not sure if you deserved your fate. Still I cannot let you live.
target: 我不确定你落得这般下场是否罪有应得。但我依然不能留你活命。

source: Then you will die like Kyless. #LIGHT_GREEN#[Attack]#LAST#
target: 那么你也会像克里斯一样死去。#LIGHT_GREEN#[攻击]#LAST#

source: I need your help. I want to overcome my curse.
target: 我需要你的帮助。我想要摆脱我的诅咒。

source: I do not want to kill you.
#VIOLET#*Berethh ignores your comment, unslings his bow and prepares his attack.*#LAST#
target: #VIOLET#*贝里斯无视了你的话，取下背上的弓，准备发起攻击。*#LAST#

source:
#VIOLET#*As the last member of the caravan lies dying, you look at him and see the hate that fills his eyes.*#LAST#
We should have finished you off that day. You deserved no mercy!
target:
#VIOLET#*当商队的最后一名成员奄奄一息时，你看着他，看到他眼中充满了仇恨。*#LAST#
我们那天真该彻底除掉你。你根本不配得到怜悯！

source: And I will show you no mercy. #LIGHT_GREEN#[Kill him]#LAST#
target: 而我也绝不会对你手下留情。 #LIGHT_GREEN#[杀了他]#LAST#

source: #VIOLET#*Before you can help him, he collapses to the ground and dies.*#LAST#
target: #VIOLET#*在你来得及帮助他之前，他就倒在地上死去了。*#LAST#

source:
#VIOLET#*Kyless lies dying on the floor. In his hand he holds a book.*#LAST#
Please! Before I die I have one request. Destroy the book. It wasn't me. The book brought this on us. It must be destoyed!
target:
#VIOLET#*克里斯躺在地板上奄奄一息。他的手里还握着一本书。*#LAST#
求求你！在我死前我有一个请求。毁掉这本书。其实不是我，是这本书将灾难带给了我们。它必须被毁掉！

source: I'm sorry but I need it. #LIGHT_GREEN#[keep the book]#LAST#
target: 对不起，但我需要它。#LIGHT_GREEN#[留下这本书]#LAST#

source: #VIOLET#*You destroy the book. When you finish you look up and see that Kyless is already dead.*#LAST#
target: #VIOLET#*你毁掉了这本书。当你做完这一切后，你发现克里斯已经死了。*#LAST#

source: #VIOLET#*You place the book in your pack. When you finish you look up and see that Kyless is already dead.*#LAST#
target: #VIOLET#*你将这本书放到了背包里。当你做完这一切后，你发现克里斯已经死了。*#LAST#

source: Welcome, @playername@, to Last Hope. Traveler, please be quick as my time is precious.
target: 欢迎你，@playername@，来到最后的希望。旅行者，请长话短说，我的时间很宝贵。

source: I have found a strange staff in my travels (#LIGHT_GREEN#*describe it in detail*#LAST#)  It looked very old and very powerful. I dared not use it.
target: 我在旅途中找到了一根奇怪的法杖（#LIGHT_GREEN#*详细描述它的外观*#LAST#）。它看起来非常古老且威力强大，我不敢使用它。

source: The hunt for the staff took me to a continent far to the east, accessible only by magic portal. I've recently returned by just such a portal, and I come bearing instructions on how to construct a similar portal here in Last Hope to make the return journey possible. I'm sure the Elves there would welcome trade with the west.
target: 追查法杖的线索让我去往了遥远的东方大陆，那里只能通过魔法传送门前往。我最近刚通过这样一个传送门返回，并带来了如何在最后的希望建造类似传送门以重返东方的指引。我相信那里的精灵会很乐意与西方开展贸易。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He remains silent for a while*#WHITE# Indeed you were right to come here.
The staff you describe reminds me of an artifact of great power from ancient times. May I see it?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他沉默了片刻*#WHITE# 你来这里确实是对的。
你所描述的法杖让我想起了一件来自远古的强大神器。能让我看一眼吗？

source: Here it is. #LIGHT_GREEN#*Tell him about the encounter with the orcs*#LAST# You should keep it. I can feel its power and it would be safer if it were guarded by the armies of the kingdom.
target: 就在这里。#LIGHT_GREEN#*告诉他遭遇兽人的事*#LAST# 应该由你来保管它。我能感受到它的力量，如果由王国军队看守会安全得多。

source: I am afraid I lost it. #LIGHT_GREEN#*Tell him about the encounter with the orcs*
target: 恐怕我把它弄丢了。#LIGHT_GREEN#*告诉他遭遇兽人的事*

source: I had it briefly but have lost it somehow.  It could have been some orcs I encountered ...
target: 我曾短暂持有过它，但不知怎么弄丢了。可能与我遇到的那些兽人有关……

source:
I am truly astonished by your strength; surviving that encounter was an epic feat.
As for the orcs, it is deeply troubling.  We have not seen any for eighty years... could they have come from the far east?
Anyway, thank you again, @playername@, for your help.
target:
你的实力令我由衷惊叹；能在遭遇战中生还真是一项史诗般的壮举。
至于兽人，这令人深感忧虑。我们已经有八十年没见过他们了……难道他们来自远东？
无论如何，再次感谢你的帮助，@playername@。

source:
Orcs?! In the west?! This is deeply alarming! We have not seen any for nearly eighty years. They must have come from the far east...
But do not let me trouble you; you brought important news and you are lucky to be alive.
target:
兽人？！在西方？！这令人深感忧虑！我们已经将近八十年没见过任何兽人了。他们必定来自远东……
不过我不该用这些烦扰你；你带来了重要消息，能够死里逃生已是万幸。

source:
We have heard rumours from the Dwarves that there may still be an orc presence deep in the old kingdom of Reknor, in the Iron Throne.
I know you have been through a lot, but we need somebody to investigate and determine if there is a connection with the staff.
target:
我们从矮人那里听到传闻，在钢铁王座境内的瑞库纳古王国深处可能仍有兽人出没。
我知道你历经艰险，但我们需要有人前去调查，查明这是否与那根法杖有关。

source: That's extraordinary! I know a number of merchant princes who will salivate at the idea of new trade routes opening. But tell me, how fares your quest for the staff?
target: 真不可思议！我知道不少巨商一想到开辟新商路就会垂涎三尺。不过快告诉我，你追查法杖的进展如何了？

source: The staff is recovered and the culprits slain. They will trouble us no more. [tell him the whole story]
target: 法杖已经找回，元凶已被诛杀。他们不会再危害我们了。[告诉他事情的完整经过]

source: The hunt continues. The construction of this portal will be of great assistance in the staff's recovery.
target: 追查仍在继续。建造这座传送门将极大地帮助我们找回法杖。

source: Excellent! Well then, concerning this fascinating portal, I'm afraid that men have largely forgotten whatever they once knew about the great magics of old. I know of only one man in these lands who might be able to help you, a wise man and recent arrival to Last Hope named Tannen. He claims to hail from Angolwen, a supposed haven for practitioners of magic and mysticism. He arrived just months ago with fabulous wealth and has already constructed his own tower in the northern part of the city. I know little of him, but if he is to be believed, then he is your best hope.
target: 太棒了！那么，关于这座引人入胜的传送门，恐怕人类大多早已遗忘了曾经掌握的远古宏大魔法。在这片土地上，我只知道有一人或许能帮上你——一位最近刚来到最后的希望的智者，名叫泰恩。他自称来自安格利文，那是传闻中魔法与神秘主义修行者的避难所。他几个月前带着巨额财富来到这里，已经在城北建造了自己的法师塔。我对他了解不多，但如果他的话可信，那他就是你最大的希望。

source: In that case, let us proceed as quickly as possible. Now, concerning this fascinating portal. I'm afraid that men have largely forgotten whatever they once knew about the great magics of old. I know of only one man in these lands who might be able to help you, a wise man and recent arrival to Last Hope named Tannen. He claims to hail from Angolwen, a supposed haven for practitioners of magic and mysticism. He arrived just months ago with fabulous wealth and has already constructed his own tower in the northern part of the city. I know little of him, but if he is to be believed, then he is your best hope.
target: 既然如此，那我们就尽快行动吧。那么，关于这座引人入胜的传送门，恐怕人类大多早已遗忘了曾经掌握的远古宏大魔法。在这片土地上，我只知道有一人或许能帮上你——一位最近刚来到最后的希望的智者，名叫泰恩。他自称来自安格利文，那是传闻中魔法与神秘主义修行者的避难所。他几个月前带着巨额财富来到这里，已经在城北建造了自己的法师塔。我对他了解不多，但如果他的话可信，那他就是你最大的希望。

source:
Ah, my #{italic}#good#{normal}# friend @playername@!
Thanks to you I made it safely to this great city! I am planning to open my most excellent boutique soon, but since I am in your debt, perhaps I could open early for you if you are in need of rare goods.
target:
啊，我的#{italic}#好#{normal}#朋友 @playername@！
多亏了你，我才得以安全抵达这座伟大的城市！我正打算近期正式开张我的精品商行，不过既然我欠你一份人情，要是你需要稀有货物，也许我可以提前为你破例营业。

source: during our escape I found the plans for an #YELLOW#Ambush Trap#LAST#
target: 在逃亡途中我找到了一份#YELLOW#伏击陷阱#LAST#的设计图

source: organizing my inventory, I came across some #YELLOW#Smelly Toxin#LAST# that a colleague claimed could actually turn creatures to stone.  Truly exotic!
target: 整理货物时，我偶然发现了一些#YELLOW#恶臭毒素#LAST#，一位同行声称它竟然能将生物变成石头。真是奇特！

source: You would not happen to be interested, by any chance?
Oh my friend, good news! As I told you I can now request a truly #{italic}#unique#{normal}# object to be crafted just for you. For a truly unique price...
target: 噢我的朋友，好消息！正如我之前对你说的，我现在可以专门为你定制一件真正#{italic}#独一无二#{normal}#的物品了。当然，价格也同样独一无二……

source: I eventually plan to arrange a truly unique service for the most discerning of customers. If you come back later when I'm fully set up I shall be able to order for you something quite marvellous. For a perfectly #{italic}#suitable#{normal}# price, of course.
target: 我计划日后为最具眼光的顾客提供一项真正独特的服务。等我彻底布置停当，你日后再来的话，我将能为你订制一件绝妙的物品。当然，价格也会十分#{italic}#公道#{normal}#。

source: Yes please, let me see your wares.
target: 好的，让我看看你的货物。
关于那件独一无二的物品呢？
伏击陷阱？听上去挺有用。

source: Smelly Toxin?  What kind of smell?
target: 恶臭毒素？什么样的气味？

source:
You know, I have asked here and there and it happens to be a very rare thing this contraption...
But since you have saved me, I'm willing to part from it for only 3000 gold pieces, a real bargain!
target:
你要知道，我四处打听过，这种机关可是极其罕见的玩意儿……
不过既然你救了我，我愿意只收 3000 金币就把它割爱给你，这可是实打实的划算！

source: Expensive, but I will take it.
Nice doing business with you my friend. There you go!
target: 和你做生意真愉快，我的朋友。拿去吧！

source:
Ungrol told me this substance contains some exceedingly rare components.
"More Toxin than Medicine" he said.  Allas, he had not the funds to buy it.  On the other hand, because of our special relationship, I'm willing to let you have it #{italic}#at cost#{normal}# -- only 1500 gold pieces!
target:
温格洛告诉我，这种物质含有一些极其罕见的成分。
“与其说是药，不如说是毒。”他这么说。可惜他没有足够的资金买下来。不过鉴于我们的特殊关系，我愿意按#{italic}#成本价#{normal}#转让给你——只要 1500 金币！

source: Fairly pricey, but seems useful.  We have a deal!
target: 相当贵，不过看起来用得上。成交！

source: That price ... er stuff really stinks ...
target: 这价格……呃，我是说这东西确实够臭的……

source: Here you are.  Just be sure not to get any on yourself!
target: 给你。可千万小心别弄到自己身上！

source: I normally offer this service only for a truly deserved price, but for you my friend I am willing to offer a 20% discount - #{italic}#only#{normal}# 4000 gold to make an utterly unique item of your choice.  What do you say?
target: 我通常只在价格足够相称时才提供这项服务，但为了你，我的朋友，我愿意提供八折优惠——#{italic}#只要#{normal}# 4000 金币，就能按你的要求定制一件绝无仅有的独特装备。你意下如何？

source: Why, 'tis a paltry sum - take my order, man, and be quick about it!
target: 哈，这点小钱何足挂齿——收下我的订单，伙计，动作快点！

source: HOW MUCH?! Please, excuse me, I- I need some fresh air...
target: 多少钱？！抱歉失陪，我……我得去透透气……

source: Which kind of item would you like ?
target: 你想要哪种类型的装备？

source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

source:
Do you want to name your item?
%s
target:
你想要命名你的物品吗？
%s

source: Oh I am sorry, it seems we could not make the item your require.
target: 啊真抱歉，看来我们无法制作你所要求的装备。

source: Oh, let's try something else then.
target: 好吧，我们试试别的东西。

source: *This store does not appear to be open yet*

#LIGHT_GREEN#*A man talks to you from inside, the door half open. His voice is sad.*#WHITE#
Sorry, the store is closed.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门半开着，一个男人从屋里对你说话，声音听上去很悲伤。*#WHITE#
抱歉，商店打烊了。

source: Hi, I was just checking in to see if Melinda is all right.
target: 你好，我只是来看看梅琳达是否安好。

source: Hi, I would like to talk to Melinda please.
target: 你好，我想和梅琳达说说话。

source: Please take this. It is nothing compared to the life of my child. Oh, and she wanted to thank you in person; I will call her.
target: 请收下这个。比起我孩子的性命，这点礼物微不足道。噢，而且她想当面向你道谢，我去叫她。
梅琳达的父亲交给了你：%s

source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

source: @playername@! #LIGHT_GREEN#*She jumps for joy and hugs you while her father returns to his shop.*#WHITE#
target: @playername@！#LIGHT_GREEN#*她高兴得跳了起来并紧紧拥抱你，而她的父亲则回到了店里。*#WHITE#

source: I am glad to see you are fine. It seems your scars are healing quite well.
target: 很高兴看到你平安无事。看来你的伤疤恢复得挺好。

source: I am glad to see you well. Take care.
target: 很高兴看到你身体安好。多保重。

source:
Yes it has mostly healed, though I still do have nightmares. I feel like something is still lurking.
Ah well, the bad dreams are still better than the fate you saved me from!
target:
是的，大多都已经愈合了，不过我还是会做噩梦。我总觉得还有什么东西仍在潜伏。
唉，不过做噩梦总比你拯救我脱离的那种悲惨命运好得多！

source: Should I come across a way to help you during my travels, I will try to help.
target: 如果我在旅途中找到能帮助你的办法，我会尽力帮你的。

source: Thank you, you are most welcome.
target: 谢谢，我非常欢迎你这样做。

source: Most certainly, so what are your plans now?
target: 那是自然。那么你现在有什么打算？

source: Hi @playername@! I am feeling better now, even starting to grow restless...
target: 你好，@playername@！我感觉好多了，甚至开始有点闲不住了……

source: So what are your plans now?
target: 那么你现在有什么打算？

source: About that, I was thinking that maybe you'd like to go out with me sometime ...
target: 说到这个，我在想也许你哪天愿意和我一起出去走走……

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Melinda appears at the door and kisses you*#WHITE#
Hi my dear, I'm so happy to see you!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*梅琳达出现在门口，亲吻了你*#WHITE#
嗨，亲爱的，见到你我太高兴了！

source: I am still looking out for an explanation of what happened at the beach.
target: 我仍在寻找那天海滩上所发生事情的解释。

source: About what happened on the beach, I think I have found something.
target: 关于海滩上发生的事，我想我找到办法了。

source:
I do not know yet, my father won't let me out until I'm fully healed. I've always wanted to do so many things.
That is why I got stuck in that crypt, I want to see the world.
My father gave me some funds so that I can take my future into my own hands. I have some friends in Derth, maybe I will open my own little shop there.
target:
我现在还不知道，在我完全康复之前我父亲都不准我出门。我一直想做很多事情。
这也是为什么我会被困在那个地穴里，我想去看看外面的世界。
我父亲给了我一笔钱，让我能够自己把握未来。我在德斯镇有几个朋友，也许我会在那里开一家属于自己的小店。

source: I have seen how you fought those corruptors, the way you destroyed their magic. I want to learn to do the same, so that such horrors never happen again. To anyone.
target: 我见过你是如何对抗那些腐化者的，还有你摧毁他们魔法的方式。我也想学会这些，这样如此可怕的惨剧就再也不会发生在任何人身上了。

source:
Or maybe, well I suppose I can trust you with this, I've always secretly dreamed of learning magic. Real magic I mean not alchemist tricks!
I've learnt about a secret place, Angolwen, where I could learn it.
target:
又或者……好吧，我想这件事我可以信任你，我一直偷偷梦想着能学习魔法。我是指真正的魔法，而不是炼金术士的小把戏！
我得知了一个叫做安格利文的隐秘之地，在那里我就能学习它。

source: Derth has its up and downs but I think they could do with a smart girl yes.
target: 德斯镇虽有利有弊，但我想他们确实需要一个像你这样聪明的姑娘。

source: You wish to join our noble crusade against magic? Wonderful! I will talk to them for you.
target: 你想加入我们对抗魔法的高尚圣战？太棒了！我会替你去和他们说说的。

source: I happen to be welcome among the people of Angolwen, I could say a word for you.
target: 我恰好在安格利文挺受接纳，我可以替你美言几句。

source: What?!? Just because you rescued me from a moderately-to-extremely gruesome death, you think that entitles you to take liberties?!
target: 什么？！就因为你把我从相当乃至极其凄惨的死亡中救了出来，你就觉得有权对我放肆了？！

source: WHY AREN'T WOMEN ATTRACTED TO ME I'M A NICE %s.
target: 为什么女人就是不被我吸引呢？我明明是个大好%s啊。

source: Uhh, sorry I hear my father calling, see you.
target: 呃，不好意思，我听到我父亲在叫我了，再见。

source: Just a minute, I was just...

#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks at you cheerfully.*#WHITE#
Just kidding. I would love that!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她欢快地看着你。*#WHITE#
开个玩笑啦。我很乐意！

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[walk away with her]#WHITE#What about a little trip to the south, from the coastline we can see the Charred Scar Volcano, it is a wonderous sight.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[和她一起漫步]#WHITE#去南边来一趟小小的旅行如何？从海岸线上我们可以看到灼烧之痕火山，那是一处壮丽的奇景。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You take Melinda in your arms and press her against you. The warmth of the contact lightens your heart.*#WHITE#
I feel safe in your arms. Please, I know you must leave, but promise to come back soon and hold me again.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你将梅琳达搂入怀中，紧紧抱住她。相拥的温暖让你的心情为之一畅。*#WHITE#
在你的怀抱里我觉得好安心。求求你，我知道你必须离开，但答应我快点回来再次抱抱我。

source: I think I would enjoy that very much. #LIGHT_GREEN#[kiss her]#WHITE#
target: 我想我也会非常乐意的。#LIGHT_GREEN#[亲吻她]#WHITE#

source: That thought will carry me in the dark places I shall walk. #LIGHT_GREEN#[kiss her]#WHITE#
target: 这份思念将陪伴我走过即将踏足的黑暗之地。#LIGHT_GREEN#[亲吻她]#WHITE#

source: Oh, I am sorry. I think you are mistaken. I was only trying to comfort you.
target: 噢，抱歉，我想你误会了。我只是想安慰你。

source: Oh, sorry, I was not myself. Goodbye, then. Farewell.
target: 噢，对不起，我刚才失态了。那么，再见吧。保重。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Melinda looks worried*#WHITE#
Please tell me you can help!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*梅琳达面露忧色*#WHITE#
请告诉我你能帮帮我！

source: Yes, I think so. Some time ago I assumed ownership of a very special home... #LIGHT_GREEN#[tell her the Fortress story]#WHITE#
target: 是的，我想能行。前些日子我接管了一处非常特别的家园……#LIGHT_GREEN#[向她讲述关于堡垒的故事]#WHITE#

source:
An ancient fortress of a mythical race?! How #{bold}#exciting#{normal}#!
And you say it could cure me?
target:
神话种族的古代堡垒？！太#{bold}#令人兴奋#{normal}#了！
你是说它能治好我？

source: The Fortress seems to think so. I know this might sound a bit .. inappropriate .. but you would need to come live there, at least for a while.
target: 堡垒似乎是这么认为的。我知道这听起来可能有点……不太合适……但你得搬去那里住，至少要住一阵子。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks at you cheerfully*#WHITE#
Ah the plan to sleep with me is finally revealed!
Shhh you dummy, I thought we were past such silliness, I will come, both for my health and because I want to be with you.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She kisses you tenderly*#WHITE#
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她欢快地看着你*#WHITE#
啊哈，想跟我睡在一起的计划终于暴露了吧！
嘘，你这个大傻瓜，我还以为我们早就不用再为这种事扭扭捏捏了。我会去的，既是为了我的健康，也是因为我想和你在一起。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她温柔地亲吻了你*#WHITE#

source: Then my lady, if you will follow me. #LIGHT_GREEN#[take her to the Fortress]
target: 那么，小姐，请随我来。#LIGHT_GREEN#[带她前往堡垒]

source: I am looking for martial training.
I can indeed offer some martial training (talent category Technique/Combat-training) for a fee of 50 gold pieces; or the basic usage of bows and slings (Shoot talent) for 8 gold pieces.
target: 我的确可以为你提供战斗训练（技巧/战斗训练系），你需要花费50金币，或者可以学习使用弓和投石索（射击天赋），花费8金币。

source: Please train me in generic weapons and armour usage.
target: 请教我通用武器和护甲的使用方法。

source: The smith spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of armour and weapon usage.
target: 铁匠花了一些时间，教你武器和护甲的基础使用方法。

source: Please train me in the basic usage of bows and slings.
target: 请教我弓和投石索的基础使用方法。

source: The smith spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of bows and slings.
target: 铁匠花了一些时间，教你弓和投石索的基础使用方法。

source: I do not have time to talk. This ritual is intense, and we are not alone here. Stop them!
target: 我没时间和你说话。仪式非常紧迫，而且这里并不是只有我们两个，阻止他们！

source: I will not let you down!

Please save me! I will make it worth your whi..
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The assassin lord hits him in the face.#WHITE#*Shut up!
target:
救救我！我会好好报答你的……
*#LIGHT_GREEN#刺客领主猛抽了一下他的脸。#WHITE#*闭嘴！

source: Please get me out of here!
Come, there is a way out!
target: 跟我来，这里有条路可以出去！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Ben lies defeated at your feet*#WHITE#
T...thank you for... *cough*... saving me from the curse.
I did no... not want for this to...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*he coughs one last time and dies, a smile on his face as his curse is gone.*#WHITE#
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*本恩倒在你的脚下。*#WHITE#
谢……谢谢你……*咳嗽*……救我摆脱了诅咒。
我不……不想让事情变成……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他最后咳嗽一声，含笑死去，诅咒终于消散。*#WHITE#

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a man covered in dirt and blood. He is out of breath and half mad.*#WHITE#
PLEASE! You must help! #{bold}#IT#{normal}# is slaughtering everybody in my village! Please!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He points his finger at the nearby forest.*#WHITE#
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个满身是血和污泥的男人。他上气不接下气，失魂落魄。*#WHITE#
救命！求你救救我们！#{bold}#它#{normal}#正在屠杀我们村里的所有人！求求你！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他伸手指着附近的树林。*#WHITE#

source: I will go there and see what I can do.
This is not my problem. Go away!

#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a young man, a novice mage by his looks*#WHITE#
Good day to yo...#LIGHT_GREEN#*He stares at you and starts to run away fast!*#WHITE#
Do not kill me please!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个年轻人，看上去像是一个法师学徒。*#WHITE#
你好……#LIGHT_GREEN#*他盯着你，随即撒腿就跑！*#WHITE#
请不要杀我！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a young man, a novice mage by his looks*#WHITE#
Good day to you, fellow traveler!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个年轻人，看上去像是一个法师学徒。*#WHITE#
你好啊，旅行者！

source: What brings an apprentice mage out into the wilds?
target: 你一个法师学徒，怎么会跑到荒野里来？

source: I found this artefact; it looks powerful and arcane infused. Maybe it would be enough?
target: 我发现了这件充满奥术能量的神器，看上去很强大，应该够了吧？

source: So you have enough magical items now?
target: 这么说，你现在已经有足够的魔法物品了？

source: Ahh, my story is a sad one... I should not trouble you with it, my friend.
target: 啊，我的故事说来让人伤心……算了，我不应该打扰你的，我的朋友。

source: It is no trouble at all! Please tell me!

Well, if you insist...
I am a novice mage, as you might have noticed, and my goal is to be accepted by the people of Angolwen and be taught the secrets of the arcane.
target:
好吧，假如你坚持的话……
我是个法师学徒，你可能已经看出来了。我的目标是得到安格利文人的接纳，向他们学习奥术的秘密。

source: Who are the people of Angolwen?
Ah yes, Angolwen, I have called it home for many years...
target: 啊，安格利文，我多年来一直把那里当作家……

source:
The keepers of ar... err, I do not think I am supposed to talk about them... sorry, my friend...
In any case, I must collect many items. I have some already but I am still looking for an arcane-infused artefact. You do not happen to have one, I imagine... Well, if you do, tell me please!
target:
他们守护着奥……呃，我好像不该谈论他们……抱歉，我的朋友……
无论如何，我必须收集许多物品。我已经有了一些，但还在寻找一件充满奥术能量的神器。我想你不会碰巧有一件吧……嗯，要是你有，请一定告诉我！

source: I will keep that in mind!

I hope I will too...
In any case, I must collect many items. I have some already but I am still looking for an arcane-infused artefact. You do not happen to have one, I imagine... Well, if you do, tell me please!
target:
我也希望有朝一日能把那里当作家……
无论如何，我必须收集许多物品。我已经有了一些，但还在寻找一件充满奥术能量的神器。我想你不会碰巧有一件吧……嗯，要是你有，请一定告诉我！

source:
Let me examine it.
Oh yes, my friend, this is indeed a powerful artefact! I think that it should suffice to complete my quest! Many thanks!
target:
让我仔细看看。
哦，没错，我的朋友，这确实是一件强大的神器！我想有了它就足以完成我的任务了！万分感谢！

source: Well, I cannot use it anyway.

Ah yes! I am so glad! I will be able to go back to Angolw...err... Oh well, I guess I can tell you; you deserve it for helping me.
During the dark years of the Spellhunt, many thousands of years ago, Linaniil, the great mage of the Kar'Krul, worried that magic might disappear with her generation and be lost to mortals should they need it again.
So she set a secret plan into action and built a secret place where magic would be kept alive.
Her plan worked and the group built a town called Angolwen in the western mountains. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He marks it on your map, along with a portal to access it*#WHITE#
Not many people are accepted there but I will arrange for you to be allowed inside.
target:
啊，太棒了！我终于可以回到安格利……呃……好吧，我想我可以告诉你；你帮了我，理应知道这些。
几千年前，在魔法狩猎的黑暗年代，卡·克鲁尔的大法师莱娜尼尔担心魔法会随她那一代一同消失，日后凡人再需要时便无从寻觅。
于是她秘密实施了一项计划，建造了一处隐秘之地，让魔法得以传承。
她的计划成功了，众人在西部群山中建起了一座名为安格利文的小镇。#LIGHT_GREEN#*他在你的地图上标出小镇及其入口传送门的位置。*#WHITE#
能获准进入那里的人不多，但我会安排让你进去。

source: Oh! How could such a place be kept secret for so long... This is interesting indeed. Thank you for your trust!
target: 哦！这样的地方怎么能保密这么久……确实很有意思。谢谢你信任我！

source:
Ah yes! I am so glad! I will be able to go back to Angolwen now, and perhaps we will meet there.
Please take this ring; it has served me well.
target:
啊，太棒了！我终于可以回到安格利文了，也许我们会在那里再次见面。
请收下这枚戒指，它帮了我不少忙。

source: Thanks, and best luck in your studies!
I want to recharge some of my equipment.
I'm sorry I didn't manage to protect you and as you were about to die you... fired a powerful wave of blight.
target: 抱歉，刚才我没能保护住你，而就在你快要死去的时候……你发射出了一道强大的枯萎能量波。

source: But I have never cast a spell in my life!
You are still tainted by that ... foul Demon! The taint is not all gone!
target: 你仍然被那个……可恶的恶魔污染着！污染还没有完全清除！

source: There must be some of that demon's taint still inside you.
target: 你体内一定还残留着那个恶魔的污染。

source: This is terrible! I assure you I had no idea this would happen. You must trust me!
target: 太可怕了！我向你保证，我完全不知道会发生这种事。你一定要相信我！

source: I do. The Ziguranth are not raving zealots, you know. We will look for a way to cure you, as long as you reject the blight.
target: 我相信你。你要知道，伊格兰斯可不是一群丧失理智的狂信徒。只要你拒绝这股枯萎之力，我们就会设法治好你。

source: This is terrible! What is happening to me?!? You must help me!
target: 太可怕了！我这是怎么了？！你一定要帮帮我！

source: I will. We will find a cure for this together.
target: 我会的。我们会一起找到治好你的办法。

source: I'm a very lucky girl, am I not... This is the second time I've had you to save me now.
target: 我真是个幸运的女孩，不是吗……这是你第二次救我了。

source: Over the last weeks you've become very important to me, and I am glad to have you. This is certainly not the place to talk, though, let's go.
target: 最近的几个星期里，你对我非常重要，有你在身边我很高兴。不过，这里显然不是说话的地方，我们走吧。

source: You're right, let's get out of here.
target: 你说得对，我们离开这里吧。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two of you spend some time relaxing on the beach.
The air is fresh, the sand shimmers, and the surf roars softly.*#WHITE#

This was such a lovely idea!
I have had a wonderful time with you today.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks longingly into your eyes.*#WHITE#
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你们两个在沙滩上放松了一阵子。
空气清新，沙滩闪闪发光，
海浪发出轻柔的涛声。*#WHITE#

来海边真是个好主意！
今天和你玩得很开心啊。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*她含情脉脉地凝视着你。*#WHITE#

source: Just before your lips touch, you sense that something is very wrong.
target: 在你们俩嘴唇相碰之前，你注意到有什么不对劲……

source: I want to open my own little shop in Derth?
I want to study magic at Angolwen?
target: 我想去安格利文学魔法？

source: I want to train at Zigur?

Well let me say that tank is #{bold}#dreadful#{normal}#, but that weird butler says it is the only way.
I do start to feel better too.
However I must say I get bored around here a little.
Do you remember, I once told you %s Maybe we could find a way to get me there during the day and return for my treatment during the night?
target:
好吧，那个再生槽实在是#{bold}#糟透了#{normal}#，不过那个古怪的管家说这是唯一的办法。
我的确开始感觉好些了。
不过，我必须说，待在这里有点无聊。
你还记得吗？我以前说过：%s也许我们可以想个办法，让我白天去那里，晚上再回来接受治疗？

source: Oh yes, I think we could arrange that. Shadow, would it be possible to create a portal for her?
target: 当然可以，我相信我们能做到。堡垒之影，能为她制造一个传送门吗？

source:
Yes Master. I will arrange for that right now.
She will be able to come and go unnoticed.
target:
是的，主人。我马上做。
她将能够无声无息地来往于两地之间。

source: Oh this is great, thank you! My own secret lair, my own life.
target: 噢，太棒了！谢谢！属于我自己的秘密巢穴，属于我自己的人生。

source: I only wish your happiness, I am glad to provide.
target: 我只希望你幸福，也很高兴能为你做这些。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Looking all glamorous she comes closer*#WHITE#
Now my sweet one, where were we the last time?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她打扮得光彩照人，向你走近*#WHITE#
亲爱的，我们上次进行到哪儿了？

source: My memory fails me, care to help me remember? #LIGHT_GREEN#[smile playfully at her]
target: 我记不清了，愿意帮我回忆一下吗？ #LIGHT_GREEN#[你调皮地冲她微笑]

source:
Well met, @playername@. I was sent with a message from King Tolak of Last Hope.
I followed the trail of bodies that you left - very impressive! We are lucky to have you on our side.
But enough talk; take this message. I must go now.
#LIGHT_GREEN#He gives you a sealed scroll and vanishes into the shadows.#LAST#
target:
幸会，@playername@。我奉最后的希望国王托拉克之命前来送信。
我循着你沿途留下的尸体找到了这里——真令人印象深刻！幸好你站在我们这一边。
闲话少说；收下这封信吧。我必须走了。
#LIGHT_GREEN#他递给你一个密封的卷轴，然后消失在阴影中。#LAST#

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A Halfling woman stands before you, clad in dark steel plate.*#WHITE#
Take the test, and then we can talk.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名半身人女子站在你面前，身穿暗色钢制板甲。*#WHITE#
先接受考验，然后我们再谈。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A Halfling woman stands before you, clad in dark steel plate.*#WHITE#
I am Protector Myssil. Welcome to Zigur.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名半身人女子站在你面前，身穿暗色钢制板甲。*#WHITE#
我是守护者米歇尔，欢迎来到伊格。

source: I require all the help I can get, not for my sake but for the town of Derth, to the northwest of here.
target: 我需要一切能得到的帮助，不是为了我自己，而是为了西北方的德斯小镇。

source: Protector, I have dispatched the Tempest as you commanded.
target: 守护者，我已经按您的意思将风暴术士杀死了。

source:
Yes, we have sensed the blight of the eldritch forces there. I have people working to dispel the cloud, but the real threat is not there.
We know that a Tempest, a powerful Archmage who can control the storms, is responsible for the damage. Those wretched fools from Angolwen will not act. All corrupted!
So you must act, @playername@. I will show you the location of this mage - high in the Daikara mountains.
Erase him.
target:
是的，我们已经感受到那里奥术力量带来的腐化。我已经派人去驱散乌云，但真正的威胁并不在那里。
我们知道，造成这场灾难的是一名风暴术士，一个能操纵风暴的强大元素法师。安格利文那些可悲的蠢货不肯行动。他们全都腐化了！
所以你必须采取行动，@playername@。我会告诉你这名法师的所在——岱卡拉山脉高处。
除掉他。

source: You can count on me, Protector.

So I have heard, @playername@. You prove worthy of your training. Go with the blessing of nature, @playername@ of Zigur.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She touches your skin. You can feel nature infusing your very being.*#WHITE#
This shall help you on your travels. Farewell!
target:
我已经听说了，@playername@。你证明了自己无愧于所受的训练。愿自然赐福于你，来自伊格的 @playername@。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她轻触你的肌肤。你感到自然正在浸润你的整个身心。*#WHITE#
这个应该会对你的旅途有所帮助。保重！

source: #00FF00#You gain the fungus talents school and your Mana Clash is enhanced.
target: #00FF00#你获得了真菌技能树，你的奥术对撞也被强化了。

source:
Thank you, @playername@! We both survived for the wealth of the Empire. I will bring them the news and then rest.
I do not think I want to see death so closely for some time now.
Farewell.
target:
谢谢你，@playername@！为了帝国的财富，我们俩都活下来了。我会把消息带给他们，然后好好休息。
我可不希望和死神再来一次亲密接触了。
再见。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A ray of light illuminates the gleam of steal amidst the grass. Investigating, you find a lone sun paladin lying stricken on the ground. Her wounds are minor, but her pallid features bely a poison that is taking its final toll. She whispers to you.*#WHITE#
Help, Help me.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一道光照亮了草丛间闪烁的钢光。你上前查看，发现一名孤身的太阳骑士瘫倒在地。她的伤口并不严重，但苍白的面容表明毒素正夺去她最后的生机。她向你低声恳求。*#WHITE#
救命，请帮帮我。

source:
I found it... the abomination Aeryn sent me to seek out. The breeding pits of the orcs... It is more vile than you can imagine... They have it hidden away from their encampments, out of sight of all their people. Their mothers, their young, all there - all vulnerable!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She pulls out a sketched map, and with some effort puts it in your palm.*#WHITE#

This could be the final solution, the end to the war... forever. We must strike soon, before reinforcements...

#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks hard at you, exerting all her effort into a final pleading stare.*#WHITE#
target:
我找到了……艾琳派我寻找的那个丑恶之地。兽人育种棚……它比你能想象的还要邪恶……他们将其藏在远离营地的地方，避开了所有族人的视线。他们的母亲和幼儿都在那里——全都毫无防备！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她抽出一张手绘地图，吃力地将它放进你的手心。*#WHITE#

这可能是最终解决方案，让战争终结……永远终结。我们必须尽快动手，赶在援军之前……

#LIGHT_GREEN#*她直直地看着你，用尽全部力气投来最后恳求的目光。*#WHITE#

source: I cannot do this myself... I will tell Aeryn about it, it is in her hands.
target: 我无法亲手这么做……我会把这件事告诉艾琳，交给她处置。

source: I will go myself and ensure this is thoroughly dealt with.
target: 我会亲自前往，确保彻底解决此事。

source: You want me to kill mothers and children? This is barbaric, I'll have nothing to do with it!
target: 你让我去杀害母亲和孩子？！这过于残忍了，我绝不接受！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands... you. You seem to be slightly older, and by the look of it you have been through hell.*#WHITE#
NO! YOU CAN'T! NO GOING THERE! YOU... I... YOU MUST NOT GO THERE!
THIS CANNOT BE AVOIDED! I MUST STOP IT! PLEASE DON'T!
I MUST KILL MYSELF TO PROTECT MYSELF!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you can react, you... I... yourself vanishes into a rift hanging in midair.*#WHITE#
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你面前站着……你自己。这个你看上去年长了一些，仿佛在地狱中走过一遭。*#WHITE#
不！你不能！不能去那儿！你……我……你不许去那儿！
这无法避免！我必须阻止它！请不要这样！
我必须杀死我自己来保护自己！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你来得及做出反应之前，你……我……你自己消失在悬于半空的裂缝中。*#WHITE#

source: Buy a new slot with one #{bold}#talent category point#{normal}#.
target: 花费 1 个#{bold}#技能树解锁点#{normal}#购买一个新刻印位。

source: You have too many of this type of inscription. You can only override an existing one. The old inscription will be lost.
target: 你拥有的此类刻印过多，只能覆盖一个现有刻印。旧刻印将会消失。

source:
You have reached your maximum number of inscriptions (infusions/runes).
If you have unassigned #{bold}#talent category points#{normal}# you can use one to create a new slot (up to 5).
You can replace an existing one or cancel.
The old inscription will be lost.
target:
你的刻印（注入/符文）数量已经达到上限。
如果你还有未分配的#{bold}#技能树解锁点#{normal}#，可以花费 1 个来创建新刻印位（最多 5 个）。
你可以替换一个现有刻印，也可以取消。
旧刻印将会消失。

source: @playername@, nice to see you again! Or is this the first time that you have seen me?
target: @playername@，很高兴再次见到你！还是说，这是你第一次见我？

source: Yes, this is our first meeting.
target: 是的，我们是第一次见面。

source:
Ah, for you perhaps, but not for me.
Listen, someday you will encounter me again but it will not be me you see now. It will be younger me, if you will.
This is very important: do not tell my previous me about me. Understood?
target:
啊，对你来说也许是的，不过对我来说可不是。
听着，有一天你会再次遇到我，但你见到的不会是现在的我，而是更年轻的我。
这一点非常重要：不要把我的事告诉过去的我。明白吗？

source:
@playername@, I am one of a party of Sun Paladins sent by Aeryn. We arrived here tracking the orcs.
They have gone through the portal, and a few of my friends were pulled in with them.
We captured an orc earlier.  He revealed that the staff you seek is to be used to absorb the power of a remote place for dark rituals.
You must traverse this portal, if you have any means to, and stop the orcs.
target:
@playername@，我是艾琳派来的一队太阳骑士中的一员。我们追踪兽人来到了这里。
他们穿过了传送门，我的几个朋友也被卷了进去。
之前我们抓住了一个兽人。他透露，你所寻找的法杖将被用来吸收某个遥远之地的力量，以供黑暗仪式之用。
如果你有办法穿过这道传送门，就必须过去阻止那些兽人。

source: I think I can use the portal. Do not worry!
target: 我想我能够使用这个传送门，别担心！

source:
One of our patrols noticed some strange orc movements around the southern part of the continent, in the desert of Erúan.
A group of orcs were guarding something that looked like the staff you asked about.
You should go there to investigate. This might be your only chance.
target:
我们的一支巡逻队在大陆南部的艾露安沙漠发现了一些兽人的异常动向。
一群兽人在守卫着一件东西，看上去好像是你提到的那个法杖。
你应该去调查一下，这可能是你仅有的机会。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a small humanoid creature with a disproportionate head.*#WHITE#
Ah, what have we here? @playerdescriptor.race@, I believe you have turned at the wrong corner.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个矮小的人形生物，长着一个不成比例的脑袋。*#WHITE#
看，来了个什么人，@playerdescriptor.race@，我相信你一定走错地方了。

source: So it would seem. What is going on here?
target: 看起来确实如此。这里发生了什么事？

source:
This is my Ring of Blood! Listen, you have now two choices.
Since you do not look like slave fodder to me I will offer to let you pay to play the game.
If you feel you cannot take part in a slaver's game, I am afraid you will need to... disappear.
target:
这里是鲜血之环！听着，你现在有两个选择。
既然你看起来不像是当奴隶的料，我可以让你付费参加这个游戏。
要是你不愿参加奴隶贩子的游戏，恐怕你就得……消失了。
奴隶贩子？这太邪恶了！[攻击]

source: Game? I like playing, what's this about?
target: 游戏？我喜欢玩，怎么个玩法？

source:
Well, you see, it's quite simple. I will mentally take control of various wild creatures or slaves while you use the orb of command on the other side of this room to take control of a slave.
Then we fight using our pawns for 10 rounds. If your slave survives you will win the Bloodcaller.
target:
你看，很简单。我会精神控制各种野生生物或奴隶，你则用房间另一头的指令水晶球控制一个奴隶。
然后我们操纵各自的棋子对战10轮。如果你的奴隶活了下来，你就会赢得“鲜血呼唤”。

source: Blood, death without self-harm risks? Great fun!
target: 鲜血和死亡，但自己却不用冒生命危险，太有趣了！

source: Normally you would be taken as a slave, but you look like you would be more useful as a full-time player, so you can just try again.
target: 通常你会被抓去当奴隶，不过看起来，让你当个长期选手会更有用，所以你只管再试一次。

source:
Superb. Oh yes, before I forget, to use the orb you will need to pay the standard fee of 150 gold pieces.
I'm sure this is small money to an adventurer of your class.
target:
好极了。哦，对了，差点忘了：要使用水晶球，你得支付150金币的标准费用。
对你这样的冒险家来说，这肯定不过是九牛一毛。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You place your hands on the orb.*#WHITE#
You must provide 150 gold to take part in the fight.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你把你的手放在水晶球上。*#WHITE#
你必须支付150金币参加比赛！

source:
So, you tasted blood? Liked it? I am sure you did; you are just that kind of people.
Anyway, I suppose you deserve your reward.
You can always participate again for fun, if you've got the gold to spare.
target:
那么，你尝到鲜血的滋味了？喜欢吗？我敢说你一定喜欢；你就是那种人。
总之，我想你配得上这份奖赏。
只要你还有闲钱，随时可以再来参加，找点乐子。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a cute little orange cat. It looks hungry and looks at you.*#WHITE#
Meowww?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一只可爱的橘色小猫。它看起来饿了，正眼巴巴地望着你。*#WHITE#
喵呜呜？

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*It rubs up against your leg and purrs.*#WHITE#
Rrrrrrrrrrrr.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*它蹭着你的腿，打起了呼噜。*#WHITE#
呼噜噜噜噜噜。

source: Hey maybe you would like some of this delicious lookin troll intestines? #LIGHT_GREEN#[Feed him the intestines]#WHITE#
target: 嘿，想不想来点这看起来很美味的巨魔肠子？ #LIGHT_GREEN#[把肠子喂给它]#WHITE#

source: Sorry little fellow, I can't help you.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*It eats it all and looks happy. After a while it strolls away. Somehow you feel you have not seen the last of it.*#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*它全部吃光了，看起来很开心。过了一会，它溜达着离开了。不知为何，你感觉你还会再见到它。*#WHITE#

source: No time to talk fellow Wayist! ATTACK! FOR THE WAY!
target: 没时间说话了，维网信徒同胞！进攻！为了维网！

source: The foolish cultist that created me is no more. What am I to do now...
target: 创造我的那个愚蠢邪教徒已经死了。我现在该怎么办……

source: You are me, come with me!
target: 你就是我，和我一起走吧！

source: You should head back to Irkkk.
I fear that would get confusing very fast. I think I will go back to Irkkk. Farewell my clone!
target: 恐怕那样很快就会乱套。我想我还是回伊尔克去吧。再见了，我的克隆！

source: Clone? No you are the clone.
Sure... if you prefer to think about it this way. We are all part of The Way anyway.
target: 啊……如果你愿意这么想也没问题。反正，我们都是维网的一份子。

source: I think so too, farewell my clone.
target: 我也是这么想的，再见了，我的克隆。

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature slowly turns to you. You hear its terrible voice directly in your head.#WHITE#*
Welcome, master.
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物慢慢转向你。你听到它可怕的声音直接在你脑海中响起。#WHITE#*
欢迎你，主人。

source: What are you, and what is this place?
target: 你是什么东西？这是什么地方？

source: Master? I am not your mas...
Why do I understand you? The texts are unreadable to me.
target: 为什么我能听懂你的话？那些文字我根本看不懂。

source: What else can this place do?
Would it be possible to improve my Cloak of Deception so I do not need to wear it to pass as a living being?
target: 可以升级我的欺诈斗篷，让我不必穿戴它也能伪装成活物吗？

source: You asked me to come, about a farportal?
target: 你叫我来，是为了远古传送门？

source: You asked me to come, about the rod of recall?
target: 你叫我来，是为了回归之杖？

source: Would it be possible for my Transmogrification Chest to automatically extract gems?
target: 可以让我的转化之盒自动提取宝石吗？
这里是不是有一间训练室？

source: Can you use your magic to alter the appearance of my gear?
target: 你能用魔法改变我装备的外形吗？

source: I find your appearance unsettling. Any way you can change it?
target: 你的样子让我感到不安，你能改变一下外形吗？

source: I have come upon a strange thing indeed. #LIGHT_GREEN#[tell him about Melinda]
target: 我的确遇到了一件奇怪的事。 #LIGHT_GREEN#[告诉它梅琳达的事]

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You possess a control rod. You are the master.
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你拥有一根控制棒，你就是主人。

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master; you have the rod. I am created to speak to the master.
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你是主人；你有那根棒。我被创造出来，就是为了与主人交谈。

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you with intensity. You 'see' images in your head.
You see titanic wars in an age now forgotten. You see armies of what you suppose are Sher'Tuls since they look like the shadow.
They fight with weapons, magic and other things. They fight gods. They hunt them down, killing or banishing them.
You see great fortresses like this one, flying all over the skies of Eyal - shining bastions of power glittering in the young sun.
You see the gods beaten, defeated and dead. All but one.
Then you see darkness; it seems like the shadow does not know what followed those events.

You shake your head as the vision dissipates, and your normal sight comes back slowly.
#WHITE#*
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物集中精神注视着你，你“看到”了脑海中的影像。
你看到了发生在一个早已被遗忘的时代里的浩大战争。你看到一支支军队，猜想他们是夏·图尔人，因为他们的外形与堡垒之影相似。
他们用武器、魔法和其他事物作战。他们与众神交战，追猎众神，将其杀死或放逐。
你看到一座座与这里相似的宏伟堡垒飞遍埃亚尔的天空——这些力量强大的璀璨堡垒在尚且年轻的太阳下熠熠生辉。
你看到众神都被击败、杀死，除了一个。
随后你看到了黑暗；似乎堡垒之影并不知道那些事件之后发生了什么。

你摇了摇头，驱散了脑海中的影像，眼前慢慢恢复了现实的景象。
#WHITE#*

source: Those are Sher'Tuls? They fought the gods?!
target: 那是夏·图尔？他们和众神战斗？！

source: They had to. They forged terrible weapons of war. They won.
target: 他们别无选择。他们锻造了可怕的战争武器。他们胜利了。

source: But then where are they now if they won?
target: 他们是胜利了，但是现在他们又在哪里呢？

source: They are gone now. I cannot tell you more.
target: 他们已经消失，我不能告诉你更多了。

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master. You can use this place as you desire. However, most of the energies are depleted and only some rooms are usable.
To the south you will find the storage room.
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你是主人，可以随意使用这里。不过，这里的能量大多已经耗尽，只有少数房间还能使用。
南面是储藏室。

source:
This Fortress is designed as a mobile base for the Godslayers - it can fly.
It is also equiped with various facilities: exploratory farportal, emergency containment field, remote storage, ...
However, the Fortress is badly damaged and has lain dormant for too long. Its energies are nearly depleted.
Take this Transmogrification Chest. It is linked by a permanent farportal to the Fortress. Any item you put inside will be sent to the power core and dismantled for energy.
There are, however, unwanted byproducts to this operation: the generation of a metal known as gold. It is of no use to the Fortress and thus will be sent back to you.
target:
这座堡垒被设计为弑神者的移动基地——它能够飞行。
它还配备了各种设施：探索用远古传送门、紧急遏制力场、远程储藏……
然而，堡垒损毁严重，又休眠了太久，能量已近乎耗尽。
拿着这个转化之盒。它通过一座永久远古传送门与堡垒相连。你放入其中的任何物品都会被送往能量核心，拆解成能量。
不过，这个过程会产生一种不需要的副产物：名为黄金的金属。堡垒用不上它，因此会将它送还给你。

source: I have already found such a chest in my travel. Will it work?
target: 我在旅途中已经找到过一个这样的转化之盒。它能用吗？

source:
Yes, it will. I will attune it to this fortress.
Done.
target:
可以。我会将它与这座堡垒调谐。
好了。

source:
Long ago the Sher'tuls used farportals not only for transportation to known locations, but also to explore new parts of the world, or even other worlds.
This Fortress is equipped with an exploratory farportal, and now has enough energy to allow one teleportation. Each teleportation will take you to a random part of the universe and use 45 energy.
Beware that the return portal may not be nearby your arrival point; you will need to find it. You can use the rod of recall to try to force an emergency recall, but it has high chances of breaking the exploratory farportal forever.
You may use the farportal; however, beware - I sense a strange presence in the farportal room.
target:
很久以前，夏·图尔使用远古传送门不仅是为了前往已知地点，还会用它探索世界的未知区域，甚至其他世界。
这座堡垒配备了一座探索用远古传送门，现在已有足够能量进行一次传送。每次传送都会把你送往宇宙中的随机区域，并消耗 45 点能量。
注意，返回传送门可能不在抵达点附近，你需要自行寻找。紧急情况下，你可以用回归之杖强制返回，但这很可能会永久损坏探索用远古传送门。
你现在可以使用这座远古传送门；不过要小心——我感觉传送门房间里有某种异常存在。

source: I will check it out, thanks.
target: 我会去检查一下的，谢谢。

source:
The rod of recall you possess is not a Sher'tul artifact, but it is based on Sher'tul design.
The Fortress now has enough energy to upgrade it. It can be changed to recall you to the Fortress.
target:
你所拥有的回归之杖并非夏·图尔造物，但它采用了夏·图尔的设计。
堡垒现在有足够的能量来升级它。升级后，它便能将你传送回堡垒。

source: I like it the way it is now. Thanks anyway.
target: 我喜欢保持原样，不过还是谢谢了。

source: That could be quite useful. Yes, please do it.

Yes master, a training facility is available to the north, but it is not yet powered on.
I will need to use 50 energy to do this.
target:
是的，主人。北面有一处训练设施，但尚未通电。
我需要消耗 50 点能量来启动它。

source:
Yes master, the Mirror of Reflections is what you need. It is currently dormant but could be re-activated.
I will need to use 10 energy to do this.
target:
是的，主人。你需要的是反射之镜。它目前处于休眠状态，但可以重新激活。
我需要消耗 10 点能量来启动它。

source: #{italic}##CRIMSON#This feature is purely cosmetic is available only to donators/buyers. You can unlock the room and use the preview but you will not be able to validate your choices.#{normal}#
target: #{italic}##CRIMSON#此功能纯粹用于改变外观，且仅限捐赠者/购买者使用。你可以解锁房间并进行预览，但无法应用你的选择。#{normal}#

source: That could be quite nice. Yes, please do it.

Ah yes, you seem to master the simple art of alchemy. I can change the chest to automatically use your power to extract a gem if the transmogrification of the gem would reward more energy.
However, I will need to use 25 energy to do this.
target:
啊，是的，你似乎已经掌握了简单的炼金术。如果提取出的宝石经转化后能提供更多能量，我可以改造转化之盒，让它自动借助你的力量提取宝石。
不过，我需要消耗 25 点能量来完成改造。

source: I can alter the Fortress holographic projection matrix to accomodate your racial tastes. This will require 60 energy, however.
target: 我可以调整堡垒的全息投影矩阵，使我的外形符合你的种族审美。不过，这需要消耗 60 点能量。

source: Can you try for a human female appearance please?
target: 请试着变成人类女性的外形。

source: Can you try for a human male appearance please?
target: 请试着变成人类男性的外形。

source: Please revert to your default appearance.
target: 请变回原来默认的样子。

source: Well, you do not look so bad actually. Let it be for now.
target: 好吧，其实你看上去没那么糟，就保持这个样子吧。

source:
Yes Master. I can use 10 energy to infuse your cloak. When you take it off the effect should still persist.
However, I suggest you still carry it with you in case something manages to remove it from you.
target:
是的，主人。我可以消耗 10 点能量为你的斗篷注入力量。即使你脱下斗篷，效果也应当继续维持。
不过，我建议你仍将它随身携带，以防有什么东西设法消除你身上的效果。

source:
Demonic taint. Yes I have a way to help in the archives. However this is a long process, the subject will need to live here for a while.
She will have to spend 8 hours per day in the regeneration tank.
target:
恶魔污染。是的，我有办法在档案区帮她。不过这个过程很漫长，她需要在这里住上一段时间。
她每天必须在再生槽中待上 8 小时。

source: This is great news! I will tell her at once.

"You should not be here. How di-"#{normal}# It stops abruptly, and its attention seems to turn to the staff in your hands. #{italic}#"How did you get that?! You fool, you do not know what forces you play with! Get it away from here - BEGONE!"
target: "你不该来这里。你怎——"#{normal}# 它的话戛然而止，注意力似乎转向你手中的法杖。 #{italic}#"你是怎么得到它的？！蠢货，你根本不知道自己在玩弄怎样的力量！把它带离这里——滚！"

source: "You should not be here. How did you get here?! BEGONE!"
target: "你不该来这里。你是怎么进来的？！滚！"

source:
#{italic}#As you open the door you stare in amazement at what is beyond. A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!

But your wonder is cut short as the Sher'Tul notices you, and you feel its intense concentration bear down on you like an unstoppable force. A voice in your head booms, #{normal}#%s#{italic}#

A wave of mental and magical power blasts into you with the might of a falling star. You are lifted into the air, and intense pressure bears down on every inch of your skin, threatening to crush you into nothingness. You try to resist for a moment, until--#{normal}#
target:
#{italic}#打开门后，你惊讶地凝视着门后的景象。一个生物站在你面前，长着触手般的细长附肢，头部位置只有一个低矮的隆起。它身上散发出极其强烈的力量气息，是你前所未感受过的。它只能是一个夏·图尔。一个活生生的夏·图尔！

然而，你的惊叹很快被打断：那个夏·图尔注意到了你，你感到它高度集中的意念如不可阻挡的力量般压向你。一个声音在你脑海中轰然响起：#{normal}#%s#{italic}#

一股精神与魔法力量如坠星般猛烈轰入你的身体。你被抬到空中，巨大的压力挤压着每一寸肌肤，仿佛要将你碾得荡然无存。你试着抵抗了片刻，直到——#{normal}#

source: #{italic}#You wake up suddenly next to your farportal with a pounding headache. Your cheeks feel wet, and touching them you see your fingers stained red - you have been crying tears of blood. A dark and terrible memory lurks at the back of your mind, but the more you try to remember it the harder it becomes, and slowly it fades completely, like a dream.#{normal}#
target: #{italic}#你突然在远古传送门旁醒来，头痛欲裂。你的双颊湿漉漉的；伸手一摸，指尖竟染成了红色——你流下了血泪。一段黑暗而可怕的记忆潜伏在脑海深处，但你越想回忆，就越难抓住它；它慢慢彻底消散，仿佛一场梦。#{normal}#

source: *#LIGHT_GREEN#This orb seems to represent the world of Eyal as a whole. It is also probably used for controlling the fortress.
target: *#LIGHT_GREEN#这个水晶球似乎展现着整个埃亚尔世界，大概也用于控制这座堡垒。

source:
You do not understand the inscriptions there.#WHITE#*
#{italic}#"Rokzan krilt copru."#{normal}#
target:
你看不懂那里的铭文。#WHITE#*
#{italic}#"Rokzan krilt copru."#{normal}#

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The device seems to be made of pure crystal. It projects a very accurate map of the known world - including the forbidden continent of the south.
There seems to be a hole about the size and form of your Rod of Recall.#WHITE#*
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#这个装置似乎完全由水晶制成，里面显现出已知世界的精确地图，包括南部的禁秘大陆。
上面似乎有一个孔洞，其大小和形状都与回归之杖相仿。#WHITE#*

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#As you take the rod close to the orb it seems to vibrate and react.
A shadow appears in a corner of the room! You retract the rod immediately but the shadow stays.
It looks like the horrors you fought when coming inside, only less degenerated.
The thing looks roughly humanoid, but it has no head and its limbs look like tentacles. It does not seem hostile.#WHITE#*
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#当你将回归之杖靠近水晶球时，水晶球似乎振动起来，并有了反应。
房间的一角出现了一个影子！你立刻抽回回归之杖，但那个影子仍然留在那里。
它看起来很像你进来时战斗过的恐魔，只是退化程度较轻。
那东西大致呈人形，却没有头，四肢也如触手一般。它似乎并无敌意。#WHITE#*

source: *#LIGHT_GREEN#This orb is used to control the gladium arena.#WHITE#*
target: *#LIGHT_GREEN#这个水晶球用于控制堡垒竞技场。#WHITE#*

source: [Alter the appearance of your facial features]
[Alter the appearance of your cosmetic aura]
[Disable the visual effects of your sustains]
*#LIGHT_GREEN#As you gaze into the mirror you see an infinite number of slightly different reflections of yourself. You feel dizzy.#WHITE#*
target: *#LIGHT_GREEN#你凝视着镜子，看见无数个略有差异的自身倒影，不禁感到一阵头晕。#WHITE#*

source: *#LIGHT_GREEN#This orb is used to control the training facilities.#WHITE#*
target: *#LIGHT_GREEN#这个水晶球用于控制训练室。#WHITE#*

source:
What is this? Why have you entered my temple and slain my followers?
Speak or die, for I am Slasul and you shall not disrupt my plans.
target:
这是怎么回事？你为何闯入我的神庙，杀害我的追随者？
开口，否则就死！我是萨拉苏尔，休想破坏我的计划。

source: I was sent by Ukllmswwik to stop your mad schemes to control all underwater life!
target: 乌克勒姆斯维奇派我来阻止你的疯狂计划，不让你控制所有水下生物！

source:
I see. So the dragon sent you. He told you I am insane, I assume?
But which of us is truly evil? Myself, working to better my people, doing no harm to anyone, or you, who comes here to kill me, destroying my friends and planning to do the same to me?
Who is the insane one?
target:
我明白了，是那条龙派你来的。想必他告诉你我疯了吧？
但我们之中究竟谁才是真正邪恶的一方？我努力改善族人的处境，从未伤害任何人；而你却来到这里，杀死我的朋友，还打算以同样的手段对付我？
谁才是疯子？

source: Your feeble attempt to sway me from the side of good will not work. Pay for you sins!
target: 你这番拙劣的说辞动摇不了我站在正义一方的决心。为你的罪行付出代价吧！

source: If you refuse to see reason, you leave me no choice!
target: 既然你执意不肯讲理，那我别无选择！

source: Your words are... disturbing. Why should I spare you?
target: 你的话……令人不安。但我为什么要饶你？

source:
Spare me?#LIGHT_GREEN#*He laughs.*#WHITE#
Do not be so hasty to assume YOU are in a position to offer mercy to ME!
Yet I shall tell you my story. You surface dwellers do not know much about nagas, but let me tell you this: our current condition was not our choice.
When Nalore sank, many of us died, so we resorted to using the magic of this temple. It worked, it saved us, and yet we are cursed. Cursed in this form by the terrible magic.
If you do not believe anything else of what I say, please believe at least this: the Sher'Tul are hiding, not gone, and they are not benevolent entities.
Recently, that water dragon that sent you here started sending "agents" to secure the temple. I can only imagine his goals, but they are clearly not peaceful.
target:
饶我一命？#LIGHT_GREEN#*他笑了起来*#WHITE#
别急着认定你有资格饶我一命！
我会告诉你我的故事，你们地面上的居民并不了解娜迦，让我告诉你：我们目前的处境并不是我们自己的选择。
当纳鲁大陆沉没时，我们很多人死了，因此不得不借助这座神庙的魔法。魔法奏效了，救了我们，却也诅咒我们变成如今这副模样。
即使你不相信我说的其他任何话，也请至少相信这一点：夏·图尔只是藏了起来，并未消失，而且他们绝非仁慈的存在。
最近，那条派你来这里的水龙开始派“代理人”来控制这座神庙。我只能猜测他的目的，但显然不会是为了和平。

source: You do not sound mad to me... could Ukllmswwik have lied?
target: 听上去你不像是个疯子，难道乌克勒姆斯维奇说谎了么？

target: 使用这个传送门，可以把你传送回他的洞穴，去问他事情的真相吧。

source: I will make him pay for his treachery.
target: 我会让他为自己的背叛付出代价。

target: 那头巨龙在说谎，我能看出来。我决定支持你的事业。

source:

target:
我暗自盼望你会作出这个选择。

作为回报，我会赐予你这柄强大的三叉戟。

source: I shall accept your offer, my liege.
target: 我接受你的提议，领主大人。

target: 听起来有点奇怪，我要考虑一下。

哦，但我们想做的正是帮助人们。我们得出了一个不言自明的结论：普通人根本不适合治理自己，只会不断争吵、争执……
自从上次兽人入侵以来，再也没有能够让他们团结起来的威胁了！

target: 所以你们决定亲自成为那个威胁？

造物主，创造这个世界的神。他默默注视着各个种族争战不休，将大地付之一炬。

source: I *WILL* stop you! The world will not end today!
target: 我一定会阻止你们！世界不会在今天灭亡！

source:
The Creator. The God who made this world, He who watched silently as the races fought and burnt the land.

The staff will allow us to drain enough energy from this world to open the portal to the Void and summon Him through!
