target:
造物主，创造这个世界的神。他默默注视着各个种族争战不休，将大地付之一炬。
他为这个世界深感悲痛。如今他将击碎这个世界的屏障，将它重塑得更加美好！
这根法杖将让我们得以从这个世界抽取足够的能量，打开通往虚空的传送门并召唤他降临！
你现在已经无法阻止我们了！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The air whirls at your side and suddenly High Sun Paladin Aeryn appears!*#WHITE#
Then you shall not fight alone! Together we shall stop them, or die trying!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*空气在你身边回旋，突然高阶太阳骑士艾琳出现了！*#WHITE#
你不必独自作战！我们要一起阻止他们，哪怕付出生命！

source: I am glad to have you at my side, my Lady. Let's hunt some wizards!
target: 很高兴你能协助我，女士！我们来打败这些巫师！

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*Nobody answers. Tannen is probably still busy studying the orb.*#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*没人回答，泰恩估计还在忙着研究多元水晶球。*#WHITE#

source: How may I be of service, good @playerdescriptor.race@?
target: 我能为你提供什么服务？我亲爱的 @playerdescriptor.race@？

source: [Relate to him the story of the staff and the Orb of Many Ways and the portals.]
target: [告诉他关于法杖、多元水晶球和传送门的事。]

source: I have the diamond and the athame. [Hand over the Athame and Diamond]
target: 我有共鸣钻石和血符仪式匕首。[把血符仪式匕首和共鸣钻石交给他]

source: Thieving, murderous wretch. Prepare to die!
target: 窃贼，卑鄙的凶手，准备去死吧！

source: How fares your research? Are we ready to create the portal?
target: 你研究的怎么样了？我们可以创造传送门了么？

source: Astonishing! I have heard tell of this Orb in ancient texts and legends. Might I see it?
target: 真令人惊讶！我在古代的文献和传说中读到过关于多元水晶球的资料。能让我看看么？

source: [Show him the Orb of Many Ways]
Truly, it is the work of a great master. Perhaps Linaniil herself had a hand in its making. And you say you come bearing instructions in its usage?
target: 确实，这是一位杰出伟人的杰作。也许莱娜尼尔她自己也曾经参与过建造。你说你带来了它的使用说明？

source: I do. [Show him Zemekkys's scribbled notes]
target: 是的。[给他看伊莫克斯潦草的笔记]

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*He spends a few minutes reading*#WHITE# Ah! I see. I did not at first grasp this Zemekkys's methods, but I see now that they are sound, and it is simply his penmanship that needs improvement. We can manage to reproduce his work here, but, as he says, we will need the Blood-Runed Athame and a Resonating Diamond.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*他花了几分钟阅读笔记*#WHITE# 啊！我明白了。一开始我没看懂伊莫克斯的方法，现在看来方法本身没有问题，只是他的字迹需要改进。我们可以在这里重现他的成果，不过，正如他所说，我们需要一把血符仪式匕首和一块共鸣钻石。

source: Have you any idea where they might be found?
target: 你知道去哪里寻找这两样东西么？

source: If the orcs created a portal in the depths of Reknor, they must have had access to such items. And if these items cannot pass through the portal they created, then it stands to reason that they must still be in Maj'Eyal. I would search Reknor, starting near the portal itself. Perhaps they did not move the Athame and Diamond far after its creation.
target: 假如兽人在瑞库纳深处制造了这样一个传送门，他们肯定拥有这两样东西。如果这些物品无法穿过他们制造的传送门，那么它们理应还在马基·埃亚尔。我会从传送门附近开始搜寻瑞库纳；或许造好传送门后，他们并没有把仪式匕首和共鸣钻石搬得太远。

source: One last thing. I will need to hold onto the Orb of Many Ways while you search. I lack the expertise this Chronomancer Zemekkys possesses, and have much learning on the subject to do if I am to follow in his footsteps.
target: 最后一件事，在你搜寻期间，我得暂时保管多元水晶球并加以研究。我缺少时空法师伊莫克斯所拥有的专业知识，如果我要重复他的工作我必须得花些时间研究这些内容。

source: I still require the Orb for now.
target: 我现在还需要多元水晶球。

source: Thank you. I will treat it with the utmost care.
target: 谢谢，我一定会极其小心地保管它。

source: Farewell. I'll return with the Athame and Diamond.
target: 再见，我会把血符仪式匕首和共鸣钻石带回来的。

source: Very well. There is no hurry. But I will need to spend a number of days studying it before we can create your portal.
target: 好极了，不用着急。要创造你需要的传送门我还得花上几天来学习一下呢。

source: I understand. I'll return with the Athame and Diamond.
target: 我明白了，我会把血符仪式匕首和共鸣钻石带回来的。

source: Excellent. Return in a few days, and I'll have everything prepared. Oh, take this. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He hands you a key*#WHITE# It opens the ruins of Telmur, which the men of Sholtar sealed many years ago. If you happen to find a text in the ruins entitled "Inverted and Reverted Probabilistic Fields," return with it and your odds of surviving our portal attempt will go up drastically.
target: 很好，几天后你回来，我肯定把一切都准备好了。哦，带上这个。#LIGHT_GREEN#*他交给你一把钥匙。*#WHITE#它可以打开泰尔玛废墟，那是多年前肖尔塔人封印的地方。要是你在废墟之中找到一份标题是《反转与复原概率场》的文献，请帮我带回来，这能大大提高你通过传送门时存活的几率。

source: Excellent. Are you yet willing to leave the Orb in my care for a time?
target: 太好了，那你同意把多元水晶球留给我研究一段时间了？

source: I dare not let it out of my sight. I'm sorry.
target: 我可不希望它离开我的视线，抱歉。

source: Here it is. Guard it carefully. I must return to the Far East soon.
target: 给你，小心保护好。我必须得返回远东大陆了。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*The old man sighs*#WHITE# Very well. I suppose I must make do with a cursory examination under your supervision.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*那个老人叹了口气。*#WHITE# 好吧，那我只好在你的监督下对它做个粗略检查了。

source: Thank you. Give me a few minutes. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He begins to pace back and forth absently, staring at the Orb.*#WHITE#
target: 谢谢，给我几分钟。#LIGHT_GREEN#*他开始心不在焉地前后踱着步，盯着多元水晶球。*#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*He stops pacing and returns the Orb to you.*#WHITE# I believe I know most of what I need to. But I need a few details cleared up. You'll have to return to this Elven Chronomancer and ask him whether he meant an inverted probabilistic field or a reverted probabilistic field. I dare not guess, as the result could be quite unpleasant for you.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*他停下踱步，把多元水晶球交还给你。*#WHITE# 我想我知道大多数我需要的东西，不过一些细节内容还得搞搞清楚。你得回去找那个精灵时空法师，问问他到底指的是反转概率场还是复原概率场。我可不敢瞎猜，否则后果可能会非常糟糕。

source: Fear not. Return in a few days, and I'll have everything prepared. Oh, take this. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He hands you a key*#WHITE# It opens the ruins of Telmur, which the men of Sholtar sealed many years ago. If you happen to find a text in the ruins entitled "Inverted and Reverted Probabilistic Fields", return with it and your odds of surviving our portal attempt will go up drastically.
target: 别害怕，几天后你回来，我肯定把一切都准备好了。哦，带上这个。 #LIGHT_GREEN#*他交给你一把钥匙。*#WHITE#它可以打开泰尔玛废墟，那是多年前肖尔塔人封印的地方。要是你在废墟之中找到一份标题是《反转与复原概率场》的文献，请帮我带回来，这能大大提高你通过传送门时存活的几率。

source:
I think not, fool. Look down.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You notice you're standing on an etched portal.*#WHITE#
target:
我可不这么想，笨蛋，低头看看。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你注意到你正站在一个铭文传送门上。*#WHITE#

source:
I am ready. You are not. Look down.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You notice you're standing on an etched portal.*#WHITE#
target:
我准备好了，你还没准备好，低头看看。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你注意到你正站在一个铭文传送门上。*#WHITE#

source:
Yes @playername@, I have heard you plan on going into the wild world, looking for some adventures of your own.
This is good, more of us should get out of here once in a while and actually help people out there.
Say, maybe you might want to get an adventure and help Angolwen?
target:
是的，@playername@，我听说你计划到野外，去寻求冒险。
这样很好，我们中应该有更多人偶尔走出这里，真正帮助外面的人们。
这么说，也许你会想进行一场冒险，来帮助安格利文？

source:
During the Spellblaze the world was torn apart - literally. A part of it, that we now call the Abashed Expanse, was ripped from the world and thrown into the void between the stars.
We managed to stabilize it and it is now orbiting Eyal. Recently we have noticed a disturbance there; if we do nothing it will crash onto Eyal, bringing much destruction in its wake.
Because it was once part of a land we know well we can teleport you there. You will need to stabilize three wormholes by firing any attack spells at them.
The instability is also to your advantage there, your simple phase door spell will be fully controllable.

So, you think you can help us ?
target:
魔法大爆炸从字面意义上撕裂了这个世界。其中一部分，我们称它为次元浮岛，从这个世界分离了出去，落入了群星之中的无尽虚空。
我们设法让它稳定了下来，如今它正环绕埃亚尔运行。最近我们在那儿也注意到一些骚动，如果我们任其发展它会撞向埃亚尔大陆造成极大的灾难。
由于我们以前对那块大陆比较熟悉，我们可以将你传送至那里，你需要向三个不稳定的虫洞施放各种攻击性法术使它们稳定下来。
虽然那里的时空很不稳定，它同时也能给你带来好处，你的相位之门法术在那里可以变得完全受你控制。

那么，你认为你可以帮助我们么？
是的大法师，把我送去那里！

source: No sorry, I need to go.
Oh well, farewell on your trips. Now I need to find somebody else to go up there.
target: 那好吧，祝你旅途顺风，我得找其他人帮我这个忙了。

source:
I say, you there. Yes, you, young one!
You seem like the adventuring fare, up to all sorts of doo-daddle in the outside world, I imagine. Well, don't forget to pay patronage to our good library here in the city. The riches of the world are all well and good, but where would we be without the gift of knowledge? And all proceeds go towards the funding of further research. No greater cause, yes?
target:
我说，那边那个，对对，就是你，年轻人！
你看上去像一个冒险者之类的，想必在外面的世界里也做过不少稀奇古怪的事。好吧，别忘了为这个城里最好的图书馆捐点钱。世间的财富固然很好，但若没有知识的馈赠，我们又会怎样？所有募集的资金都会直接用于进一步研究。没有比这更崇高的理由了，对吧？

source: Uh, yes, of course... I'll be moving on now.
target: 啊，是的，当然……我得继续赶路了。

source: Hold on! You... You're that apprentice mage I met in the wilds!
target: 打住！你……你不就是那个荒野之中的法师学徒么？

source: Why, well-spotted, whippersnapper! Indeed, when the mood takes me I sometimes travel under the guise of an apprentice. It permits me to traverse the land unnoticed in my research, and if I meet any I deem worthy and sympathetic to Angolwen's cause, then so much the better. And it does provide the odd chortle, I tell you!
target: 眼力不错嘛，小家伙！的确我有时会心血来潮假扮成一个学徒到处旅行，这样在我的研修旅行中就不会引人注意。如果我遇到值得信赖、且认同安格利文事业的人，那就更好了。而且我告诉你，这偶尔也确实让我觉得好笑！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall man, glowing like a star, appears out of nowhere.*#WHITE#
You destroyed *it* both? I am sorry for my harsh tone when we first met, but repairing time threads is stressful.
I cannot stay. I still have much to do. But take this-- it should help you.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He disappears again before you can even reply. A rift opens, to Maj'Eyal... you hope.*#WHITE#
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个高大的男人，全身像星星一样闪耀着光芒，在你面前出现了。*#WHITE#
你把它们都摧毁了？真抱歉我们刚见面时候我对你有点刻薄，不过修复时间线是件压力很大的事。
我不能留在这里，我还有很多事情要做。带上这个，它也许会对你有帮助。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你刚想回答，他就又消失了。面前出现一道时空裂缝，希望是通往马基·埃亚尔的……*#WHITE#

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall man, glowing like a star, appears out of nowhere.*#WHITE#
Oh no, another *adventurer*! You should not mess with things beyond your comprehension!
Do not meddle in the affairs of Time, for it passes swiftly and is easily disrupted!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He looks at you more closely.*#WHITE#
You seem capable. Help me, fight the abominations while I repair the timeline. It is your only way out!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个高大的男人，全身像星星一样闪耀着光芒，在你面前出现了。*#WHITE#
噢，不，又来了一个“冒险家”！你不该插手超出你理解范围的事物！
不要搅进有关时间的事物里，时间流逝非常快，而且很容易被搅乱！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他更仔细地端详着你。*#WHITE#
你看上去很强，帮帮我，在我修理时间线的时候帮我干掉那些憎恶，只有这样你才能离开这里！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Master crumbles before you, vanquished. Yet in the blink of an eye you see his form recreating from dust; unharmed and ready to fight again!*#WHITE#
Ahah you fool! See how even death has no meaning for me; for I am the Master and you are my toy, now and forever.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*领主在你面前倒下，化成灰烬。突然，你发现他从尘土里站了起来，毫发未伤，正准备战斗！*#WHITE#
啊哈，你这个愚蠢的傻瓜！看吧，死亡对我毫无意义；我是主人，你只是我的玩具，永远如此！

source:
Choose a trap to prepare with a primed (instant) trigger or to dismantle.
#YELLOW#Newly prepared traps are placed on cooldown.#LAST#
target:
选择一个陷阱，以即爆机关将其准备好，或将其拆解。
#YELLOW#新准备的陷阱将进入冷却。#LAST#

source: Hello there. What subject interests you?
target: 你好，你对哪一个主题比较感兴趣？

source: Is there nothing more for me to learn here?
target: 没别的东西可以学了么？

source:
You have completed all the tutorials, and should now know the basics of ToME4. You are ready to step forward into the world to find glory, treasures and be mercilessly slaughtered by hordes of creatures you thought you could handle!

During this tutorial some creatures were adjusted according to the needs of the lessons. In the unforgiving world of Eyal, monsters are rarely this nice!

If you need a reminder of which key does what, you can access the game menu by pressing #GOLD#Escape#WHITE# and checking the key binds. You can also adjust them to suit your needs.

If this is your first time with the game, you will find the selection of races and classes limited. Don't worry; many, many more will become available as you unlock them during your adventures. 

Now go boldly and remember: #GOLD#have fun!#WHITE#
Press #GOLD#Escape#WHITE#, then select #GOLD#Save and Exit#WHITE#, and create a new character!
target:
你已经完成了所有的教程，现在你对ToME4的基本情况应该有所了解了。你现在已经准备好去世界中寻找荣耀和财富，然后被一大群你以为自己能应付的怪物无情地屠杀！

在教学过程中，一些怪物为了教学目的被相应地做过修改，不过在真实的埃亚尔世界中，怪物可不会这么简单！

要是你想看看你的按键设置细节，你可以按下#GOLD#Esc键#WHITE#进入游戏菜单检查按键绑定，你可以更改设置直到你满意为止。

如果你第一次接触这个游戏，你会发现可供选择的种族和职业很有限。别担心，随着你在冒险中不断解锁，更多种族和职业将可供选择。

现在，勇敢的前进吧，并且记住：#GOLD#玩的开心！#WHITE#
按下 #GOLD#Esc键#WHITE#，选择 #GOLD#保存并退出#WHITE#，然后创建一个新的角色吧！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@'s deep voice booms through the caverns.*#WHITE#
This is my domain, and I do not take kindly to intruders. What is your purpose here?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@的低沉嗓音在山洞里发出隆隆的回响*#WHITE#
这里是我的地盘，我会毫不客气地对付任何入侵者，你到这里想干什么？

source: I am here to kill you and take your treasures! Die, damned fish!
target: 我是来杀死你然后抢夺你的财宝的，死吧，该死的杂鱼！

source: I did not mean to intrude. I shall leave now.
target: 我无意闯入这里，我会离开的。

source:
Wait! You seem to be worthy, so let me tell you a story.
During the Age of Pyre the world was sundered by the last effects of the Spellblaze. A part of the continental shelf of Maj'Eyal was torn apart and thrown into the sea.
The Naloren Elves perished... or so the world thinks. Some of them survived; using ancient Sher'Tul magic they had kept for themselves, they transformed to live underwater.
They are now called the nagas. They live deep in the ocean between Maj'Eyal and the Far East.
One of them, Slasul, rebelled against his order and decided he wanted the world for himself, both underwater and above. He found an ancient temple, probably a Sher'Tul remain, called the Temple of Creation.
He believes he can use it to #{italic}#improve#{normal}# nagas.
But he has become mad and now looks upon all other intelligent water life as a threat, and that includes myself.
I cannot leave this sanctuary, but perhaps you could help me?
After all, it would be an act of mercy to end his madness.
target:
等下！你看上去够资格，让我告诉你一个故事。
在烈火纪，世界被魔法大爆炸的余波撕裂，马基·埃亚尔的一部分大陆架被撕裂出去漂向了海洋。
纳鲁精灵种族灭亡了……至少世界上的人都这么认为。事实上他们之中的一些人使用秘藏的古代夏·图尔魔法存活了下来，并改变自身以适应水下生活。
他们现在被称为娜迦，他们生活在马基·埃亚尔和远东大陆之间的海洋深处。
他们中的一个，萨拉苏尔，背叛了自己所属的组织，妄图独占水上和水下的整个世界。他发现了一座古老神庙，可能是夏·图尔的遗迹，名为造物者神庙。
他相信可以利用它来#{italic}#进化#{normal}#娜迦。
但是他陷入了疯狂，把一切水下智慧生物都视为对他的威胁，包括我自己。
我不能离开这个圣所，但是也许你能帮我结果了他？
毕竟，终结他的疯狂也算是一种仁慈。

source: I would still rather kill you and take your treasure!
target: 我还是要杀了你，夺取你的财宝！

source: I shall do as you say, but how do I find him?
target: 我会照着你的话去做，但是去哪儿找他呢？

source: That seems... unwise. My apologies, but I must refuse.
target: 这似乎不是明智之举，很抱歉，我必须拒绝。

source: I can open a portal to his lair, far away in the western sea, but be warned: this is one-way only. I cannot bring you back. You will have to find your own way.
target: 我可以为你打开一道传送门，抵达他在西部海洋的巢穴，不过我提醒你：传送是单程的，我没法带你回来，你必须自己去想办法找到返回的路。

source: This is a death trap! Goodbye.
I want your treasures, water beast!
target: 我需要你的财宝，水下怪物！

source: Oh, is that so? Well, COME GET THEM!
I spoke with Slasul, and he did not seem hostile, or mad.
target: 我与萨拉苏尔交谈过，他似乎并无敌意，也没有发疯。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ roars!*#WHITE# You listen to the lies of this mad naga!
You are corrupted! TAINTED!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ 发出了怒吼！*#WHITE# 你居然听信这个疯子娜迦的谎言！
你已被腐化！被玷污了！

source: DO NOT MEDDLE IN THE AFFAIRS OF DRAGONS!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Shake your head.*#LAST#He swayed my mind! Please, I am not your enemy.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*你摇摇头。*#LAST#他蛊惑了我的心智！求你了，我不是你的敌人。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ calms down!*#WHITE# Very well; he is indeed a trickster.  Now go finish your task, or do not come back!
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ 冷静了下来！*#WHITE# 好吧，他的确是个骗子，那现在去完成你的任务吧，要不然就不要回来了！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a Human clothed in black robes. He seems to be ignoring you.*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You stand inside some kind of summoning circle, which prevents you from moving.*#WHITE#
Oh yes! YES, one more for my collection. My collection, yes. A powerful one indeed!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个穿着黑色长袍的人类，他目前似乎无视了你。*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你站在一个召唤法阵里，没法移动。*#WHITE#
啊，对！好！又一件我的收藏品，没错，的确是很强力的一个！

source:
A powerful tool against my enemies. Yes, yes. They all hate me, but I will show them my power!
I will show them! SHOW THEM!
target:
一个对抗敌人的强力工具，对，没错，他们都仇恨我，我要让他们尝尝我的厉害！
给他们点颜色看看！等着瞧！

source: I am not a tool! RELEASE ME!
target: 我不是你的工具！放开我！

source:
You cannot talk. You cannot talk! You are a slave, a tool!
You are mine! Be quiet!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As his mind drifts off you notice part of the summoning circle is fading. You can probably escape!*#WHITE#
target:
你不可能说话，你不可能说话的啊！你是一个奴隶，一件工具！
你是我的，安静点！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*当他的注意力开始分散时，你注意到召唤法阵的一部分正在消退，你应该可以逃出去！*#WHITE#

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He falls to his knees.*#WHITE#
Please spare me! I am pitiful. I will not stop you. Let me leave!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他跪了下来*#WHITE#
饶恕我吧，饶了我这个可怜的人，我不会再阻止你了，让我走吧！

source:
But, but, you were my... you...
You need me! What do you think you will do on the surface? Everything you will meet will try to destroy you.
You are strong but you cannot resist them all!
target:
但……但……你是我的……你……
你还需要我！你想你到外面会怎么样？所有你见到的东西都会想摧毁你。
你虽然很强，但是你不可能对抗所有人！

source: ARRGGggg... You are alone! You will be destroyed!
target: 啊啊啊啊噶……你孤身一人！注定走向毁灭！

source:
I can give you a cloak that will conceal your true nature!
With it all people will see when they look at you is a normal average Human. You can go about your business.
Please!
target:
我可以给你一件斗篷，它能隐藏你的真实本质！
穿上它，任何人看到的都只会是一个普通人类，你便可以自由行事。
求求你！

source: Thanks for the information. Now you may die. [kill him]
target: 谢谢你的情报，现在你可以死了。[杀了他]

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A beautiful Elven woman in golden robes stands before you, facing an orc clad in mail.*#WHITE#
Fillarel: "Abandon this fight, orc! You cannot win: I stand with the power of the Sun and the shadows of the Moons."
Krogar: "Ha! It's only been one hour and you already look tired, my 'lady'."
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As you enter the room they notice you.*#WHITE#
Fillarel: "You! @playerdescriptor.race@! Help me defeat this monster or begone!"
Krogar: "Ah, looking for help? Bah. @playerdescriptor.race@, kill this wench for me and I shall reward you!"
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个穿着金色长袍的美丽精灵女子站在你面前，另一边是穿着锁甲的兽人。*#WHITE#
菲拉瑞尔：“罢手吧，兽人！你不会赢的，太阳的伟力、月亮的暗影与我同在。”
克罗加尔： “哈！才过了一个小时而已，你看上去都很疲惫了，‘女士’。”
#LIGHT_GREEN#*当你进入房间时他们注意到了你*#WHITE#
菲拉瑞尔： “你！ @playerdescriptor.race@！帮我干掉这只怪物，不然就快离开！”
克罗加尔： “哦？想找人帮忙？呸，@playerdescriptor.race@，给我干掉这个臭婊子，我会报答你的！”

source: Thank you, @playername@. I hate to admit it, but you saved my life.
target: 谢谢你，@playername@。不得不承认，你救了我的命。

source: At your service. But may I ask what you were doing in this dark place?
target: 我乐意效劳，但你能告诉我你在这个黑暗的地方干什么吗？

source: At your service. I have been gone for months, but I can feel it, at last this is my homeland!
target: 我乐意效劳。我已经离开几个月了，不过我能够感觉到，这里就是我的故乡！

source:
I am an Anorithil, a mage of the Sun and Moons; we fight all that is evil. I was with a group of Sun Paladins; we came from the Gates of Morning to the east.
My companions were... were slaughtered by orcs, and I nearly died as well. Thank you again for your help.
target:
我是借用太阳和月亮力量的星月术士，来自东面的晨曦之门，同太阳骑士一起对抗邪恶。
我的伙伴们…都被兽人杀死了，我也差点丧命，再次感谢你的帮助。

source: It was my pleasure. But may I ask a favor myself? I am not from these lands. I used a farportal guarded by orcs deep below the Iron Throne and was brought here.
target: 我的荣幸，不过我有个请求。我其实不是这个大陆的人，使用了钢铁王座地下深处，被兽人保护的远古传送门，然后就到了这里。

source:
Yes, I noticed you were not from here. Your only hope is the Gates of Morning, the last bastion of freedom in this orc territory. When you leave the caves, head southeast; you cannot miss it.
Tell High Sun Paladin Aeryn that you met me. I'll send word to let you pass.
target:
是的，我也注意到了你不是这里的人。晨曦之门是兽人领地中仅存的自由堡垒，将是你的唯一希望。离开洞穴后往东南走；你绝不会错过它。
告诉高阶太阳骑士艾琳你遇到了我，我会传信让他们放行。

source: Thank you, I will talk with Aeryn.
target: 谢谢你，我会找艾琳谈谈的。

source:
Gone? Wait, this face.. you are @playername@! We thought you died in the naga portal explosion!
Thanks to your courage the Gates of Morning still stand.
You should go there at once.
target:
离开了？等一下，这张脸……你是 @playername@！我们都以为你在娜迦传送门爆炸的时候死了！
因你的壮举，晨曦之门依然屹立不倒。
你应该马上去那里。

source: Sadly I am the bringer of bad news, the orcs are planning something. Good luck, my lady.
target: 恐怕我带来了一些坏消息，兽人正筹划着什么阴谋，祝你好运，女士。

source: @playerdescriptor.race@, you have helped me kill the Elf-wench. The Orc Pride thanks you... for now
target: @playerdescriptor.race@，你帮我干掉了那个精灵臭婊子。兽人部落感谢你……暂时如此。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a creature about as tall as a Halfling, covered in small white fur and with a disproportionate head.
You also notice he does not wield his greatsword. It seems to float in the air, bound to his will.*#WHITE#
Why did you save me, stranger? You are not of the Way.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个和半身人一样高的生物，身披细密的白色绒毛，脑袋与身体大小不协调。
你同时注意到他并没有用手握持大剑，剑正漂浮在空中，仿佛受他的意志控制。*#WHITE#
你为什么救我，陌生人？你不属于维网。

source: Well, you seemed to need help.
target: 你看上去似乎需要帮助。

source: So I could rip your throat myself!
target: 这样我可以亲自割破你的喉咙！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The greatsword floats to a less aggressive stance. He seems surprised.*#WHITE#
Then, on behalf of the Way, I thank you.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*大剑在空中变换到不那么咄咄逼人的架势。他好像很吃惊。*#WHITE#
那么，我代表维网感谢你。

source: What is the Way, and what are you?
target: 维网是什么，你是什么种族？

source: The Way is enlightenment, peace and protection. I am a Yeek. I came through this tunnel to explore this part of the world that was closed to us for centuries.
target: 维网是启迪、和平和守护，我是一个夺心魔。我穿过隧道，希望探索这个已经与我们隔绝了数个世纪的地方。

source: Can you tell me more about the Way?
target: 你能告诉我更多有关维网的事么？

source: Select the party member to receive the mental shield:
target: 选择接受精神防护的队伍成员：

source: The contact with the Wayist mind has improved your mental shields. (+15 mental save, +10%% confusion resistance)
target: 与维网信徒的心灵接触提高了你的精神防御。（+15精神豁免，+10%%混乱抵抗）

source: I am never alone. I have the Way.
target: 我并不孤单，我拥有维网。

source:
I cannot, but I may show you a glimpse.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He leans toward you. Your mind is suddenly filled with feelings of peace and happiness.*#WHITE#
This is the Way.
target:
不行，不过我可以让你看一下。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他靠向你，你的脑海里突然充满了平静和幸福。*#WHITE#
这就是维网。

source: Thank you for this vision. Farewell, my friend.
target: 谢谢你让我看到这些，再见吧，我的朋友。

source: Thank the Way. This... thing... would have killed me.
target: 感谢维网，这个……东西……差点杀了我。

source: The Way sent me to explore this side of the tunnel.
target: 维网派我来探索隧道这一侧。

source: Yes, me too. We should split up to cover more ground.
target: 是的，我也是。我们应该分头行动，以探索更多区域。

source: Farewell. We are the Way, always.

What? Ah, it is you, @playername@.
I take it you are satisfied with the portal.
target:
谁？啊，原来是你，@playername@。
我想你应该对传送门还满意。

source:
@playername@, you are called to serve. The nearby unhallowed morass inhabitants are growing restless.
You must go there and find the source.
target:
@playername@，你效力的时候到了。附近不洁沼泽中的居民正在蠢蠢欲动。
你必须去那里，找到这一切的源头。
我会的，现实至高守护者。

source: I am sorry, but I cannot do that.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*A slot in the door opens and a pair of wild eyes peer out.*#WHITE#
What do you want, @playerdescriptor.race@?
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门上开了一个小洞，一副狂乱的眼睛凝视着你。*#WHITE#
你想干什么，@playerdescriptor.race@？

source: Paladin Aeryn told me that you could help me. I need to get to Maj'Eyal.
target: 太阳骑士艾琳跟我说你能帮助我，我想去马基·埃亚尔。

source: I found the Blood-Runed Athame, but there was no Resonating Diamond.
target: 我找到了血符仪式匕首，不过没找到共鸣钻石。

source:
Pfaugh! Her goal in life is to waste my time! Maj'Eyal? Why not Narnia or Chicago? Just as easy to send you someplace entirely fictional as Maj'Eyal. Go away.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Slot slams shut.*#WHITE#
target:
呸！她的生活目标就是在浪费我的时间！马基·埃亚尔？怎么不是纳尼亚或者芝加哥？把你送到一个完全虚构的地方，和送到马基·埃亚尔一样简单。走开。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*小洞呯的一声关上了。*#WHITE#

source: I got here from Maj'Eyal, didn't I? I have this magic Orb I looted from a dead orc, see, and...
target: 我来自马基·埃亚尔，不是么，我有一个从一个兽人尸体上找到的魔法水晶球，看……

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Slot opens.*#WHITE#
Orb, you say? That you used to travel here from Maj'Eyal? Surely you don't possess the Orb of Many Ways! It's been lost for ages!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*小洞打开了。*#WHITE#
你说水晶球？你说你是从马基·埃亚尔来的？你拿到的肯定不是多元水晶球！它已经消失很多年了！

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*His eyes widen.*#WHITE#
Great Socks of Aeryn! It IS the Orb! Maybe we can get you home after all. Or maybe we can get you embedded in magma a thousand leagues straight down.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他瞪大了眼睛。*#WHITE#
艾琳的袜子啊！真是那个水晶球！说不定我们终究能让你回家，也说不定能把你嵌进正下方一千里深的岩浆里。

source:
You think I'm letting some filthy @playerdescriptor.race@ in my house with the Orb of Many Ways?
I blow myself up quite enough already without that thing in the house, thank you.
Besides, I still can't help you unless you have a Blood-Runed Athame to etch a portal.
Err, and that portal must be etched on a piece of prepared Resonating Marble.
The Gates of the Morning has a slab of Marble that once could have served, but a number of, um, incidents have taken their toll.
It'll require a Resonating Diamond to get it properly prepared. Oh, and I want 100 gold.
target:
你认为我会让一个肮脏的 @playerdescriptor.race@ 带着多元水晶球进我家么？
谢了，没有那东西在屋里，我已经够经常把自己炸得够呛了。
况且，我没法帮助你，除非你搞到一把血符仪式匕首来刻画这个传送门。
呃……要想把它准备好，传送门必须刻在一块准备好的共鸣大理石上。
晨曦之门原本有一块这样的共鸣大理石，不过过去发生过一些……呃……事故，对它造成了损伤。
要想妥善处理它，还需要一块共鸣钻石，哦，我还要收取 100 金币费用。

source: Where can I find all that?
target: 我上哪儿去找那些东西？

source: Try your purse for the 100 gold. As for an Athame and a Resonating Diamond, I assume the orcs have some if they're cooking up portals to use that Orb on. Try the Vor Armory. It so happens that I know a back way in. Never mind why.
target: 100 金币嘛……你摸摸自己的钱袋就有了。至于仪式匕首和共鸣钻石，既然那些兽人正准备配合多元水晶球开启传送门，我猜他们手上就有。去沃尔军械库找找吧。碰巧我知道一条后门，别问为什么。

source: Of course there was no Resonating Diamond. What makes you think Briagh would let one loose for even a second?
target: 你当然找不到共鸣钻石，你想想布莱亚怎么可能让一颗钻石溜走？

source: Briagh the Great Sand Wyrm. Where do you think Resonating Diamonds come from? They're just regular diamonds until they get stuck between Briagh's scales for a few centuries and get infused with his life rhythms. He sleeps on a hoard of precious gems and metals, you see.
target: 布莱亚，那条巨型沙虫，要不然你认为共鸣钻石是哪里来的？它们原本只是普通的钻石，卡在布莱亚的鳞片间长达几个世纪，逐渐被灌注了生命节律。你看，它正是睡在一堆珍贵宝石和金属上呢。

source: Where might I find Briagh's lair??
target: 布莱亚的老巢在什么地方？？

source: Well south of the Sunwall. I'll mark it for you on your map.
target: 在太阳堡垒以南很远的地方，我会在你的地图上给你做个记号。

source: I'll be back with a Resonating Diamond.
Yes? You got the Athame, the gem and 100 gold?
target: 怎么，你拿到仪式匕首、宝石和 100 金币了？

source: [Give him the gem, the athame and 100 gold]
target: [把宝石、仪式匕首和 100 金币交给他]

source: Sorry, it seems I lack some stuff. I will be back.
target: 抱歉，我去拿点材料，马上回来。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The door opens and a shabby Elf emerges.*#WHITE#
Off we go to prepare the portal!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门开了，一个衣衫褴褛的精灵走了出来。*#WHITE#
我们去准备制造传送门吧！

source: I am looking for mindstar training.
target: 我是来学习灵晶掌握的。

source: I can teach you mindstar mastery (talent category Wild-gift/Mindstar mastery).  Learning the basics costs 100 gold, while more intensive training to gain proficiency costs 500 gold.  Once you're proficient, I can teach you some additional skills for 750 gold.
target: 我能教授你灵晶掌握（自然/灵晶掌握 技能树）。基础训练需要 100 金币，进一步训练至熟练需要 500 金币。熟练之后，我还能以 750 金币的价格教你一些额外技巧。

source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能树）- 100 金币。

source: The shopkeeper spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of channeling energy through mindstars.
target: 商人花了一些时间，教授你引导能量流经灵晶的基础方法。

source: He is impressed with your affinity for natural forces.
target: 他对你与自然力量的亲和度印象深刻。

source: Please teach me what I need to know (unlocks talent category) - 500 gold.
target: 请教授我需要知道的一切（解锁技能树）- 500 金币。

source: The shopkeeper spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of channeling energy through mindstars with you.
target: 商人花了大量时间，向你讲解引导能量流经灵晶的精妙细节。

source: He is impressed with your mastery and shows you a few tricks to handle stronger energy flows.
target: 他对你的熟练程度印象深刻，并向你展示了一些驾驭更强能量流的技巧。

source: I'm already proficient, but I want to be an expert (improves talent mastery by 0.2) - 750 gold.
target: 我已经熟练掌握了，但我想成为一名专家。(增加技能树系数0.2) - 750 金币。

source: The shopkeeper spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of channeling energy through mindstars with you%s.
target: 商人花了大量时间，向你讲解引导能量流经灵晶的精妙细节%s。

source: , and teaches you enhanced mental discipline needed to maintain powerful energy fields
target: ，并传授你维持强大能量场所需的强化精神修养

source: You cannot use your %s anymore; it is tainted by magic.
target: 你不能再使用 %s ，它已被魔法所污染。

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A grim-looking Fighter stands there, clad in mail armour and a large olive cloak. He doesn't appear hostile - his sword is sheathed.*#WHITE#
%s, our guild has been watching you and we believe that you have potential.
We see that the hermetic arts have always been at the root of each and every trial this land has endured, and we also see that one day they will bring about our destruction. So we have decided to take action by calling upon Nature to help us combat those who wield the arcane.
We can train you, but you need to prove you are pure, untouched by the eldritch forces, and ready to fight them to the end.
You will be challenged against magical foes. Should you defeat them, we will teach you our ways, and never again will you be able to be tainted by magic, or use it.

#LIGHT_RED#Note:  Completing this quest will forever prevent this character from using spells or items powered by arcane forces.  In exchange you'll be given access to a mindpower based generic talent tree, Anti-magic, and be able to unlock hidden properties in many arcane-disrupting items.
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个面色阴沉的斗士站在那里，身穿锁甲，披着一件橄榄色大斗篷。他似乎没有敌意——剑还收在鞘中。*#WHITE#
%s，我们观察了你很久，你很有潜力。
我们看到，秘术一直是这片大地所经受的一次次磨难的根源，也看到它们终有一天会毁灭我们。因此，我们决定采取行动，借助自然之力对抗那些操纵奥术的人。
我们可以训练你，但你必须证明自己纯洁无瑕，未受奥术力量沾染，并已准备好与之战斗到底。
你将面对魔法敌人的挑战。若能击败他们，我们便会传授你我们的道路；从此以后，你将再也不会受魔法玷污，也无法使用魔法。

#LIGHT_RED#注：完成此任务会使该角色永久无法使用法术或由奥术之力驱动的物品。作为交换，你将解锁基于精神强度的通用技能树“反魔法”，并能解锁许多反魔法物品的隐藏属性。

source: Very well. I will say that this is disappointing, but it is your choice. Farewell.
target: 好吧，不得不说我有点失望，不过这是你自己的选择，再见。

source: Ah, you seem eager, but maybe still too young. Come back when you have grown a bit.
target: 啊，你似乎跃跃欲试，但等级或许还太低。等升到10级后再来吧。

source: Worry not, though, Ogre - we can replace your unclean runes with a newly-discovered mixture of infusions, eliminating your dependence on them.  The process will feel...  unpleasant, and will dramatically shorten your lifespan, but you will finally be free from the addictive grip of the arcane!
target: 不过别担心，食人魔——我们可以用一种新发现的复合纹身配方替换你的不洁符文，让你不再依赖这些符文。这个过程会让你感到……不适，也会大幅缩短你的寿命，但你终将摆脱奥术令人上瘾的控制！

source: We'll also reinforce the infusions you've been granted to replace your runes - the newest mixture should give you about five years of your life that the initial mixture took from you.
target: 我们还会加强授予你的那些纹身，用来替代你的符文——最新配方能弥补最初配方从你身上夺走的约五年寿命。

source:
Very well. Before you start, we will make sure no magic can help you:
- You will not be able to use any spells or magical devices
- Any worn objects that are powered by the arcane will be unequipped
%s
Are you ready, or do you wish to prepare first?
target:
很好。在开始之前，我们要确保没有魔法能助你一臂之力：
- 你将无法施放任何法术或使用任何魔法装置
- 所有已装备的奥术驱动物品都会被卸下
%s
准备好了吗？还是想先准备一下？

source:
#VIOLET#*You are grabbed by two olive-clad warriors and thrown into a crude arena!*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You hear the voice of the Fighter ring above you.*#WHITE#
%s! Your training begins! I want to see you prove your superiority over the works of magic! Fight!
target:
#VIOLET#*你被两个身着橄榄色服装的战士抓了起来，扔进了一个简陋的角斗场里！*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你听到斗士的声音在你头顶上方响起！*#WHITE#
%s！你的训练开始了！我要看到你证明自己胜过魔法造物！战斗吧！

source: But wha.. [you notice your first opponent is already there]
target: 但什……[你注意到你的第一个对手已经出现在战场上了]

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A naga steps through the portal, she seems to be a high ranked one.*#WHITE#
NO! You fool, the portal is breaking down!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个娜迦穿过传送门，她似乎身居高位。*#WHITE#
不！你这个蠢货，传送门正在崩溃！

source: And thus my task is done, serpent!
target: 那么，我的任务也完成了，臭蛇人！

source: You do not understand: it will explode!

The portal randomly teleported us before exploding.
You fool! You have doomed us, we could be #{bold}#anywhere!#{normal}#
DIE !
target:
传送门在爆炸前把我们随机传送到了某个地方。
蠢货！你害惨我们了，我们可能身处#{bold}#任何地方#{normal}#！
死吧！

source: You end your target with a crushing blow!
target: 你的毁灭一击终结了对手！

source: frozen and shattered into a million little shards
target: 被冰冻后碎裂为数百万冰晶

source: debilitated by noxious blight before falling
target: 死前吸入过多剧毒瘴气

source: spaghettified across the whole of space and time
target: 被时空之力拉成了面条

source: replaced by a time clone (and no one ever knew the difference)
target: 被时空克隆（其他人均不会感到任何差别）
因弹指间度过了无数美好的青葱岁月，转瞬间你已白发苍苍

source: * #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to reduce damage dealt by #YELLOW#%d%%#LAST#%s
* #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to reduce all saves and defense by #YELLOW#%d#LAST#%s
* #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to gain 10%% of a turn (3/turn limit)%s
#LIGHT_STEEL_BLUE#%s can't gain any more energy this turn!
target: #LIGHT_STEEL_BLUE#%s在本回合内无法得到更多能量!

source: * #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to reduce strength, dexterity, and constitution by #VIOLET#%d#LAST#%s
* #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to slow global speed by #YELLOW#%d%%#LAST#%s
* #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to #ROYAL_BLUE#daze#LAST# at end of turn%s
#DARK_ORCHID#Your damage shield cannot be extended any farther and has exploded.
target: #DARK_ORCHID#你的伤害护盾不能再被延长，终于破碎了

source: % chance to summon an orc spirit
An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a huge axe.
target: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，手里握着一把巨斧。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You notice an entrance to an underwater cave.
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你发现了一个水下洞穴的入口。
联合王国半身人巡逻队

source: You have got nothing to fear if you are not using filthy arcane magic. Otherwise: DIE!
target: 如果你没有使用肮脏的魔法，那不用害怕他们。否则的话：去死吧！

source: You find a hidden trap door, and hear cries for help from within...
target: 你发现了一个隐藏的活板门，并听到从里面传来呼救声……

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You carefully get away without making a sound.
#LIGHT_RED#You carefully open the trap door and enter the underground tunnels...
target: #LIGHT_RED#你小心打开地板上的活门进入了地下通道...

source: #LIGHT_RED#As you enter you notice the trap door has no visible handle on the inside. You are stuck here!
target: #LIGHT_RED#当你进入了地道你发现活门没有出去的开关，你被关在这里了！

source:
You find an entrance to an old crypt. An aura of terrible evil emanates from this place. You feel threatened just standing there.
You hear the muffled cries of a woman coming from inside.
target:
你发现了一个古老地窖的入口，里面笼罩着恐怖的邪恶气息，仅仅站在门口你就已经感受到了它的威胁。
你听到了里面传来了陌生女人的哭声。

source: #LIGHT_RED#You carefully open the door and enter the underground crypt...
target: #LIGHT_RED#你打开了活门，小心翼翼地进入了地窖...

source: #LIGHT_RED#As you enter you notice the door has no visible handle on the inside. You are stuck here!
target: #LIGHT_RED#当你进入后，你发现这扇门的里侧没有门把，你被困在这了！

source: Entrance to some ancient elven ruins

Only crumbling bones are left of what once was the proud Director Hompalan, chief of this facility.
Now those remains look at you with empty eyes but you can not mistake their intent.
target:
这个研究设施的主人，曾经如此高傲的研究主管红帕兰，现在已经只剩下摇摇欲坠的枯骨。
尽管这具遗骸只剩下空洞无神的眼窝，但你绝不会弄错它的意图。

source: An elven cultist. He doesn't seem to mind you.
target: 一个精灵邪教徒。他似乎并不在意你。

source: Something the cultists are doing is coming. Beware.
target: 邪教徒在做的事情将要到来。小心。

source: The cultist's soul seems to be absorbed by the strange stone he was guarding. You feel like something is about to happen...
target: 邪教徒的灵魂似乎被其守卫的奇异石头所吸收。你感觉似乎要出大事了……

source: This demon would be very attractive if not for the hovering crown of flames, the three tails and sharp claws. As you watch her you can almost feel pain digging in your flesh. She wants you to suffer.
target: 不看她那盘旋在头上的火焰王冠、三条小尾巴以及那锋利的爪子，这只恶魔仍然充满了奇异的魅惑。当你看着她时，你感觉痛苦像利刃一样，深入骨髓。她想让你受苦。

source: and used for her perverted desires
target: 并被用于她的变态欲望

source: This crown of pure flames possesses a myriad of small molten rocks floating wildly above it. Each can be removed to throw as a true meteor.
target: 这顶由纯粹火焰所打造的王冠上漂浮着许多小小的熔融石块，每个都可以用意念扔出，化作一块真实的陨石砸向大地。

source:
A terrible shout thunders across the level: 'Come my darling, come, I will be ssssooo *nice* to you!'
You should flee from this level!
target:
一个恐怖的声音突然自空中传来：“来吧，亲爱的，来吧，我将会好好的“疼”你的。”
你必须逃离此地！

source: %s pulls a dagger and opens his own chest, piercing his beating heart. The stone glows with malevolent colors.
target: %s拔出一把匕首，剖开自己的胸膛，刺穿了跳动的心脏。石头泛起了邪恶的光芒。
被破坏的恶魔空间入侵传送门

source: Do you wish to enter the portal, destroy it, or ignore it (press escape)?
target: 你想要进入传送门，摧毁它，还是无视它（按ESC键）？

source: It shimmers and changes the light all around. This is dazling!
target: 闪光石闪耀着，改变了周围的光线。真是令人目眩！
#GOLD#一件物品从宝箱中掉了出来!

source: As you walk you notice a huge rock falling from the sky. It crashes right near you!
target: 你正匆匆赶路时，你注意到一块巨大的石头正从天而降，在你的身旁坠落！
被破坏的娜迦入侵珊瑚传送门

source: Do you wish to enter the portal, destroy it, or ignore it (press escape)?
target: 你想要进入传送门，摧毁它，还是无视它（按ESC键）？

source: You feel a tremor in the ground for a few seconds and it disappears...
target: 你感到脚下的大地震颤了起来，但是几秒钟后这种感觉消失了……

source: #VIOLET# The ramp crumbles as you climb it, followed by the collapse of the cavern.
target: #VIOLET# 当你沿着坡道向上爬时，坡道崩塌了，洞穴随之坍塌。

source: Undead are rising from the ground! You must hold on!
target: 地上的亡灵正在复活！你必须坚持住！

source: You have survived the onslaught of undead. You notice a way to climb up you had not seen before in a wall nearby.
target: 你从不死生物的猛攻中存活了下来，你看到旁边的墙上有一条之前没有发现的通路，可以爬上去。

source: Do you wish to disturb the grave?
target: 你想要挖掘这个坟墓吗？

source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

source: As you began digging up the grave, the ground collapsed beneath you. You fall into an eerily lit cavern.
target: 当你开始挖掘坟墓时，脚下的地面塌陷了。你落入一个阴森地亮着光的洞穴。

source: #VIOLET# As you leave the crypt, the stairway collapses in upon itself.
target: #VIOLET# 当你离开洞穴的时候，楼梯崩塌了。

source: This ancient skull is all that remains of the Rat Lich. Some fragments of its power remain and a faint red light still glows within its eye sockets.
target: 这顶古老的骨盔是巫妖鼠仅存于世的东西，上面残留了巫妖鼠的部分精华能量。

source: raise one or two undead rats to fight beside you
target: 召唤1-2个亡灵鼠为你作战

source: You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
target: 你不能召唤，你被压制了！

source: %s raises %s %s, and a red light flashes from it's eye sockets!
target: %s 令 %s %s站了起来, 一道红光从它眼中闪过！

source: From the dust of decay a %s forms!
Stairs seem to lead into some kind of crypt.
You hear squeaks and the sounds of clicking bone echo around you... Pure death awaits. Flee!
target: 你听到老鼠的叫声夹杂着骨骼的响动的吱吱声……前面等待着你的是死亡的力量。快逃！
向下通往瓦砾之中的楼梯

source: Way into a strange lush forest
target: 通向一片奇怪的葱郁森林的道路

source: Suddenly it comes back to you. You remember long ago somebody told you about a strange lush forest... If only you could remember where!
target: 突然你想了起来。很久以前曾有人向你提起过一片奇异而葱郁的森林……要是你还能记得它在哪里就好了！

source: As you walk into the area you notice a huge snowstorm over your head. Beware!
target: 当你进入这个区域时，你感觉到一股暴风雪在你的头顶盘旋。小心！

source: #VIOLET# The stairway collapses completely as you ascend!
target: #VIOLET# 当你爬上楼梯的时候，楼梯彻底坍塌了！

source: #VIOLET# The decrepit stairs crumble some more as you climb them.
target: #VIOLET# 当你爬上这些破旧的楼梯的时候，它摇摇欲坠，又更加破碎了一点。

source: Crumbling stairs lead down to something.
target: 摇摇欲坠的楼梯向下通往某处。
向下的楼梯，已经坍塌了。

source: As you walk into the area you notice a huge thunderstorm over your head. Beware!
target: 当你进入这个区域时，你感觉到一股暴风雨在你的头顶盘旋。小心！

target: 你想要挖掘这个坟墓吗？

target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

source: You were not the first here: the corpse was turned into an undead.
target: 你不是第一个来到这里的：那个人的尸体已经变成了亡灵！

source: Do you wish to inspect the pedestal?
As you inspect it a shadow materializes near you, and suddenly it is no more a shadow!
target: 当你检查这个基座时，一团阴影出现在你身旁，突然间它凝成了实体！

source: %s's soul is absorbed by the pedestal. A glowing orb appears.
target: %s的灵魂被基座吸收了。一个发光的水晶球出现了。

source: You hear a terrible voice saying 'Their lives are mine! I am coming!'
target: 你听到一个可怕而低沉的声音：“他们的生死由吾掌控！吾即将降临！”

source: This door seems to have been sealed off. You think you can open it.
target: 这扇门似乎被封印了，你觉得你可以打开它。

target: 这扇门似乎被封印了，你需要设法打开它。

Loose sand is steadily filling this void, which could collapse suddenly and completely.
target: 松散的沙子填充了这一空间，但是这些沙子随时可能坍塌下来。
不稳定的流沙通道塌陷了！

source: You are crushed by the collapsing tunnel! You suffocate!
target: 你被压在了倒塌的通道中！你感到无法呼吸！
