source: It's a large black ant with huge mandibles.
target: 一只巨大的黑色蚂蚁，有巨大的下颚。

source: It's a large red ant, wreathed in flames.
target: 一只巨大的红色蚂蚁，全身燃烧着火焰。

source: It's a large white ant. The air is frigid around it.
target: 一只巨大的白色蚂蚁，它四周的空气都凝固了。

source: It's a large yellow ant with sparks arcing across its body.
target: 一只巨大的黄色蚂蚁，身体闪耀着电火花。

source: It's a large black ant.  Its porous skin oozes acid.
target: 一只巨大的黑色蚂蚁，皮肤渗透出酸液。

source: It's a large ant with a heavy exoskeleton, geared for war.
target: 一只巨大的蚂蚁，有厚重的用于战斗的外壳。

source: Queen of the ants, queen of the biting death!
target: 蚂蚁皇后，掌控死亡之啮的皇后！

source: A snake-like being, moving toward you.
target: 像蛇一样的生物，径直朝你游来。
一个辐射出电流的蛇形生物。
一只巨大、细长且泛着海蓝色的爬行动物。

source: A huge, elongated sea-green reptile, it looks old and impenetrable.
target: 一只巨大、细长泛着海蓝色的爬行动物。看上去苍老而结实。

source: Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to lock you down.
target: 它向你伸出触手，试图把你困住。

source: Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to blind you with its murky ink.
target: 它向你伸出触手，试图喷射黑色的墨汁，使你失明。

source: A small water demon, lobbing spells at you.
target: 水中的小恶魔，向你投出法术。

source: Walrog, the lord of Water, is fearsome to behold. The water writhes around him as if trying to escape, making his form indistinct. He does not seem surprised to see you.
target: 乌尔罗格，水之主，是水中的恐怖恶魔。水在他周围蠕动，仿佛想要逃离，使他的身形模糊不清。他看到你似乎并不惊讶。

source: The weakest of bears, covered in brown shaggy fur.
target: 熊中最弱的一种，浑身覆盖着棕色蓬乱的皮毛。

source: Do you smell like honey? 'Cause this bear wants honey.
target: 你闻起来像蜂蜜吗？这只熊喜欢蜂蜜哦～

source: It has come down from its cave foraging for food. Unfortunately, it found you.
target: 它从洞穴中下来觅食。不幸的是，它找到了你。

source: Bears with tusks, trained to kill.
target: 带着獠牙的巨熊，被训练过杀人的技巧。

source: A huge, beastly bear, more savage than most of its kind.
target: 一头巨大的野兽，比同类更加凶残。

source: This huge white bear has wandered south in search of food.
target: 这只巨大的白熊正在向南寻找食物。

source: Ever burning, ever dying, ever reviving, the Phoenix swoops down upon you, seeking to share its fiery fate with you.
target: 燃烧，死亡，重生。这只不死鸟试图将它燃烧的命运带给你。

source: A towering creature, made from the bones of dozens of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
target: 一个高大的生物，由数十具尸体的骨头构成。它全身围绕着邪恶的气息。

source: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
target: 一个高大的生物，由数百具尸体的骨头构成。它全身围绕着邪恶的气息。

source: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies, rune-etched and infused with hateful sorceries.
target: 一个高大的生物，由数百具尸体的骨头构成，它的骨头上布满符文和充斥着憎恨的魔法印记。

source: Lean, mean, and shaggy, it stares at you with hungry eyes.
target: 一头瘦弱的、狡猾的皮毛蓬松的饿狼，它正用贪婪的眼神看着你。

source: Larger than a normal wolf, it prowls and snaps at you.
target: 它比普通的狼更大，在你面前徘徊咆哮。

source: Easily as big as a horse, this wolf menaces you with its claws and fangs.
target: 这只狼像马一样大，用它的爪子和獠牙来威胁你。

source: A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and icy, and its fur coated in frost.
target: 一头来自北部荒野的狼，它膘肥身健，体型匀称。它呼吸冰冷，毛覆寒霜。

source: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning.
target: 这是一只狡猾且体型巨大的狼。

source: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
target: 这只灵巧的棕色狐狸从一只懒狗身上跳了过去。

source: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, thrice the size of a normal warg.
target: 一只超级大狼，眼睛里充满了狡猾，比普通座狼大两倍。

source: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
target: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

source: A mature cold drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条成年冰龙，拥有冰冷刺骨的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: An old and powerful cold drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条年长且强大的冰龙，拥有冰冷刺骨的吐息和锋利的爪子。
这个傀儡遭受过严重的破坏。

source: This golem's eyes glow with magical energies.
target: 这个傀儡的眼睛闪烁着魔法的能量。

source: A shining crystal formation charged with magical energies.
target: 一个由闪光水晶构成的生物，它通体围绕着魔法光芒。

source: A floating orb of magical energy. It shines with a radiant light. They explode upon contact.
target: 一个充满魔法能量的球体，散发着耀眼的光芒，接触其他物体时会爆炸。

source: A formation of red crystal. It emits bright red, scorching light.
target: 一个由红色水晶构成的生物，它散发着耀眼的红色光芒。

source: A formation of white crystal. It emits bright white, chilling light.
target: 一个由白色水晶构成的生物，它发出冰冷刺骨的白色光芒。

source: A formation of black crystal. It absorbs all light around it.
target: 一个由黑色水晶构成的生物，它可以吸收周围的光芒。

source: A formation of crimson crystal. It emits a crimson light reminiscent of blood.
target: 一个通体由深红色水晶构成的生物，它通体散发着血红色的光芒。

source: A formation of blue crystal. Its light shines like the ocean's waves.
target: 一个由蓝色水晶构成的生物，它通体荡漾着海蓝色的光芒。

source: A formation of multi-hued crystal. It shines with all the colors of the rainbow.
target: 一个由各色水晶构成的生物，它通体散发着彩虹般的光芒。

source: A formation of shimmering crystal. Orbs of light circle around it.
target: 一个由闪光水晶构成的生物，它通体围绕着球状的光芒。

source: An elven mage, dressed in dark robes.
target: 一位精灵法师，身着黑色长袍。

source: An elven mage, dressed in crackling blue robes, and smelling of ozone.
target: 一位精灵法师，穿着噼里啪啦的蓝色长袍，身上散发着臭氧的味道。

source: An elven cultist, dressed in sickening green robes.
target: 一位精灵邪教徒，身着令人作呕的绿色长袍。

source: An elven blood mage, dressing in dark, bloodied robes.
target: 一位精灵血法师，身着黑暗且鲜血斑斑的长袍。

source: An elven corruptor, drawn to these blighted lands.
target: 一位精灵堕落者，被吸引到这些枯萎的土地上。

source: An elven guard, scarred and sullen.
target: 一位阴沉的刀疤脸精灵守卫。

source: An elven warrior, clad in heavy armour.
target: 一位身穿重甲的精灵战士。

source: Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
target: 法罗是高智力的火元素，在火山以外的地方很少看到它们。也许，它们根本不属于这个世界。

source: A large cat with a grey fur matted with black.
target: 一只灰色皮毛中夹杂着黑色斑纹的大猫。

source: A large black cat, slender and muscular.
A truly magnificent beast, with fur striped black and yellow.
target: 一只真正威风凛凛的巨兽，长着黄黑相间的条纹皮毛。

source: This cat is simply enormous, and has fangs with the size and sharpness of short swords.
target: 这只猫简直大得惊人，长着短剑般大小和锋利度的犬齿。

source: A drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
target: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

source: A mature fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条成年火龙，拥有炽烈的火焰吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: An old and powerful fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条年长且强大的火龙，拥有炽烈的火焰吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself strives to banish it.
target: 它的可怕形象冲击着你的双眼。它是死亡的化身，它丑恶的身体似乎在向宇宙宣告着它与现实的格格不入。

source: It is an unlife of power almost unequaled. An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crumble rock and wither flesh with ease.
target: 它代表着无可匹敌的非生命力量。是对现实存在的否定。对它的轻微接触都会影响生命的流动，它那纯粹的不可思议的黑色肢体能够轻松地使岩石崩解，血肉成灰。

source: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.
target: 一个发出凄惨尖叫的女妖。

source: A vengeful, screaming soul given form with the breath of Urh'Rok himself. The vapors of the Fearscape seep from its dimension-bending form, withering and searing.
target: 乌鲁洛克的吐息中诞生，不断嚎叫的复仇之魂。恐惧之地的气息不断从她次元扭曲的身体中渗出，不断灼烧和腐蚀着周围的一切。

source: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.
target: 肉块正在不断的从这个腐朽的身体上掉落。

source: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.
target: 这个肮脏的生物是食尸鬼的分支，并且经常带领着一群食尸鬼。它散发着令人作呕的气息，并且它的噬咬会传播瘟疫。

source: Stench rises from this rotting abomination. Its brow is adorned with gold, and it moves at you with hatred gleaming in its eyes.
target: 这具腐烂的身躯散发着一股恶臭。它的额头用金子装饰着，它向你逼近，眼中闪烁着仇恨的光芒。

source: A body raised through dark magic.
target: 一具通过黑暗魔法复生的尸体。

source: Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.
target: 格维格罗斯是强大的气系元素，它们是电闪雷鸣的化身。

source: A small faceless humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features.  Its waraxe and shield look battered, rusted, and generally in ill repair.
target: 一个没有面孔、身材矮小且带有部分矮人特征的人形怪物。它的战斧和盾牌看起来破旧、生锈，几乎从未修理过。

source: A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits.  Its face is featureless; its eyesockets, empty and hollow.
target: 皮肤粗糙且长有角质骨刺的黑色巨人。它的脸没有五官；眼窝空空荡荡。

source: A disfigured humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features dressed in patched-together and rusted mail armor.  It seems to be in command of others, though its mouth is sewn shut.
target: 一个残缺畸形、带有部分矮人特征的人形怪物，穿着缝缝补补、锈迹斑斑的锁子甲。它似乎统领着其他生物，尽管它的嘴被缝上了。

source: A giant hairless bat with the face of a Dwarf twisted into a constant scream.  Pustulant sores cover its malformed body, and your heart weakens as it nears.
target: 一只巨大的无毛蝙蝠，它长着一张扭曲成永恒尖叫状的矮人脸。化脓的疮口覆盖着它畸形的身体，当它靠近时，你的心跳越来越弱。

source: A large sluglike creature that moves slowly, leaving a trail of acid in its wake.  Its head has strangely humanoid features.
target: 一只长的类似蛞蝓的生物，当它缓慢经过时，会留下一滩酸性的踪迹。它的头部有着奇怪的人类特征。

source: A large sluglike creature with the face of a man.  Shadows seem to be drawn to its massive form, and your light dims as it approaches.
target: 一只长有人脸的类似蛞蝓的生物。阴影似乎都被扯向了它厚重的身体，当它靠近你时，灯光似乎都模糊了。

source: This putrid mass of rotting flesh shifts and quivers, but shows no signs of intelligence or mobility.
target: 这块腐烂的血肉不断变形颤抖，不过似乎没有智力和移动力。

source: This monstrous form of putrid, torn flesh and chipped bone drags its mass towards you, spurting blood and viscera along the way.
target: 这块腐烂的被切碎的血肉，挣扎着向你移动，在路上喷出的血液和内脏。

source: #VIOLET#As the necrotic abomination is destroyed you see the remaining bones and flesh reassembling in the form of new foes!
target: #VIOLET#当亡灵憎恶被摧毁时，你发现它的剩余部分重组为新的敌人！

source: The massive ribcage in the middle beats with loud, audible cracks, as many a skeletal hand protrude forth, entwining, fusing, forming long skeletal appendages to support itself, while others crumble and collapse inward. During all this, somehow, it seems they grasp for you.
target: 中央的巨大胸腔伴随着响亮而清晰的碎裂声搏动着，许多骷髅手臂从中伸出，缠绕、融合，形成长长的骨骼肢体支撑自身，而其他部分则崩塌向内坍缩。在此期间，它们似乎都想抓住你。

source: #VIOLET#As the bone horror is destroyed you see the remaining bones reassembling in the form of new foes!
target: #VIOLET#当骨灵恐魔被摧毁时，你发现它的剩余部分重组为新的敌人！

source: This pulsing, quivering form is a deep crimson, and appears to be composed entirely of thick, virulent blood. Waves rhythmically ripple across its surface, indicating a still beating heart somewhere in its body.
target: 这个不断跳动不断颤抖的物体是深红色的，似乎完全由浓厚致命的血液组成。在其表面仍有富有节奏的波纹，也许在其身上的某个地方仍有心脏跳动

source: This crimson shape drips ceaselessly, spattering the nearby ground. The droplets seem to continue moving of their own volition.
target: 血红色的物体不断滴落液体，散落在地面上。滴落下来的血液似乎有着自己的意志。

source:
A bulging rotten robe seems to tear at the seams, with masses of bloated worms spilling out all around the moving form.  Two arm-like appendages, each made up of overlapping mucous-drenched maggots, grasp tightly around the handles of bile-coated waraxes.
Each swing drips pustulant fluid before it, and each droplet writhes and wriggles in the air before splashing against the ground.
target: 一件鼓鼓囊囊的腐烂长袍，长袍的缝隙里不断蠕动着浮肿的蠕虫。它有着两只臂膀一样的附属物，每只都由沾满黏液的蛆重叠而成，各握着一柄覆有胆汁的斧子。每一次挥舞都会向前溅出脓液，每一滴脓液在空中扭动翻滚，然后啪嗒一声落在地上。

source: #LIGHT_RED#A carrion worm mass has spawned from %s' wounds!
target: #LIGHT_RED#一团腐肉虫从%s的伤口孵化了出来。

source: A bulbous humanoid form floats here. Its bald, child-like head is disproportionately large compared to its body, and its skin is pock-marked with nasty red sores.
target: 一个臃肿的人形生物漂浮在这里。它的光头像个孩子，与身体相比大得不成比例，皮肤上布满痘坑，长着狰狞的红色脓疮。

source: A shifting form of darkest night that seems to reflect your deepest fears.
target: 在漆黑的深夜中不断变幻的存在，映照出你内心深处的恐惧。

source: A headless, gangly humanoid with a large distended stomach.
target: 一个无头、四肢细长的人形怪物，腹部巨大而鼓胀。

source: #AQUAMARINE#As %s falls all its eyes fall to the ground!
target: #AQUAMARINE#当%s倒下时它的眼睛掉落在了地上。

source: A small bloodshot eye floats here.
target: 一只带血的小眼睛漂浮在这里。

source: %s is blinded by the loss of all its eyes.
target: %s 失去了它所有的眼睛，无法看见东西。

source: A lanky humanoid shape composed of yellow light.
target: 一个身材瘦长的人形，由金色的光芒组成。

source: A lanky four-armed humanoid shape composed of bright golden light.  It's so bright it's hard to look at, and you can feel heat radiating outward from it.
target: 一个身材瘦长的四臂人形，由金色的光芒组成，令人无法直视，甚至感受到高温从它身上不断的向外辐射。

source: A headless, round creature with stubby legs and arms.  Its body seems to be all teeth.
target: 一只无头怪物，它有着圆润的体型和又粗又短的四肢。它的牙齿似乎占据了整个身体。

source: Blades whirl in the air around this thin, floating figure. The air around it swirls with force, threatening to tear apart anything that approches, if the blades don't do it first.
target: 刀锋环绕着这个瘦削漂浮的身影旋转。周围的空气猛烈涌动，威胁着要将任何靠近的东西撕成碎片——如果刀锋没有先做到的话。

source: A massive, amorphous blob of green slime crawls on the ground towards you. Eyes drift through the viscous mass, scanning for potential prey.
target: 一团巨大的、无定形的绿色粘液在地面上向你爬来。眼睛飘过粘稠的物质，扫描着潜在的猎物。

source: A dark shifting shape stalks through the shadows, blending in seamlessly.
target: 一个暗色变换的身影在阴影中潜行，完美地融入其中。

source:
A vaguely tentacled yet constantly changing form rests here apparently oblivious to your existence.
With each slow breath it takes reality distorts around it.  Blue twirls into red, green twists into yellow, and the air sings softly before bursting into a myriad of pastel shapes and colors.
target:
这是一个隐约长着触手、形态不断变化的生物，它在这里惬意地休息，显然无视了你的存在。
它每一次缓慢的呼吸都会让现实扭曲变形。蓝色旋成红色，绿色扭成黄色，空气轻声吟唱，随后绽开成无数柔和色彩的形状。
它看上去沉浸在睡梦之中。
#LIGHT_BLUE#一个梦境之种从%s的沉眠中释放。

source:
A vaguely tentacled yet rapidly changing shape floats here.  With each breath you can feel reality twist, shatter, and break. 
Blue burns into red, green bursts into yellow, and the air crackles and hisses before exploding into a thousand fragments of sharp shapes and colors.
target: 一只不断变幻形态的触手生物漂浮在这里，每一次呼吸，你都能感到现实在扭曲、碎裂、崩坏。蓝色烧成红色，绿色爆成黄色，空气噼啪嘶鸣，随后炸裂成千片尖锐的形状与色彩。

source: A pinkish bubble floats here, reflecting the world not as it is, but as it would be in that surreal place that exists only in our dreams.
target: 一个粉红色的气泡漂浮在这里，反映的不是世界的本来面目，而是那个只存在于我们梦中的超现实。

source: This powerful vortex of ice and lightning somehow gives you the impression of claws, teeth and intense hunger...
target: 这个由冰和闪电组成的强大漩涡不知为何给你一种利齿尖牙和强烈饥饿的印象...

source: You don't want to think about what sort of creature this lamprey-like horror was feeding on to grow so large.  Its skin pulsates and writhes, like things are moving underneath...
target: 你不想知道这个像七鳃鳗一样的恐魔是吃什么才能长这么大的。它的皮肤不停的扭动，就像有东西在下面移动一样...

source: Dozens - hundreds maybe? - of blood-gorged worms, of varying shapes and sizes, making a writhing, ichor-soaked sea of tooth-lined maws and sickly green skin, ready to latch onto you and drink until they burst or your veins run dry.
target: 几十个，也许几百个？各种形状和大小的、吸饱鲜血的蠕虫，由布满利齿的血盆大口和病态绿色皮肤组成的、翻腾的脓水海洋，随时准备缠住你并吸你的血，直到它们胀破或者你的静脉干涸。
格尔格勒克·黑暗吞噬者

source:
A horror from the deepest pits of the earth. It looks like a huge pile of tentacles all trying to reach for you.
You can discern a huge round mouth covered in razor-sharp teeth.
target: 这是来自地底最深处的恐魔。看起来像是一团巨大触手，它在不断的向你靠近。你可以在它那血盆大口里看到剃刀般的牙齿。

source: This is one of Grgglck's tentacles. It looks more vulnerable than the main body.
target: 这是格尔格勒克的一条触须。它看起来比主体更加脆弱。

source: #AQUAMARINE#With Grgglck's death its tentacle also falls lifeless on the ground!
target: #AQUAMARINE#随着格尔格勒克的死去它的那些触手也毫无生机地倒在了地上！

source: #AQUAMARINE#As #Source# falls you notice that #Target# seems to shudder in pain!
target: #AQUAMARINE#当#Source#倒下时，你发现#Target#似乎因为痛苦而颤抖!

source: This Blade Horror has been infused with intense temporal magic, causing its power to increase dramatically. Rifts in space open around it constantly, summoning and banishing blades before vanishing as quickly as they appear.
target: 这只刀锋恐魔被强烈的时空魔法灌注，力量急剧提升。空间裂隙在它周围不断开启，召唤与放逐着刀刃，随后又像出现时一样迅速消失。

source: Time seems to warp and bend around this floating weapon.
#AQUAMARINE#A rift opens and a free floating blade emerges!
target: #AQUAMARINE#时空裂缝打开了，里面出现了一把浮空的刀刃!

source: #AQUAMARINE#The %s no longer seems to be controlled and clatters to the ground before vanishing into a rift.
target: #AQUAMARINE#%s 似乎失去了控制，坠落在地面，消失在时空裂隙中。

source: This floating weapon shifts and shimmers, time and space warping and bending as it moves. It appears to vibrate, as if it may explode at any moment.
target: 这件漂浮的武器不断晃动闪烁，移动时连时空也随之扭曲弯折。它似乎在震颤，仿佛随时都会爆炸。

source: #AQUAMARINE#A rift opens and a free floating blade emerges! It looks unstable...
target: #AQUAMARINE#时空裂缝打开了，里面出现了一把浮空的刀刃!它看起来很不稳定…

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s explodes into a huge bubble of air!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s爆炸，成为了一个巨大的气泡!

source: This massive stony structure shifts and pulsates, its many long, thin tentacles probing the nearby water for food.
target: 这个巨大的石状生物震动起伏着，它许多细长的触手在附近的水中探测食物。

source: This tiny fish-like creature moves erratically, but is constantly surrounded by others of its kind.
target: 这种小鱼状生物行动飘忽不定，但身边总是围着一群同类。

source: A vile looking liquid flows from the teeth of this agile monster. It glides through the water towards you, spined fins jutting outwards.
target: 这个敏捷怪物的牙齿中不断滴落邪恶的液体，它穿过水面向你滑行，带刺的鳍向外凸出。

source: This frothing ball of water rages with an intense heat.
target: 这个冒着泡沫的水球带着强烈的热度汹涌而来。

source: This titanic mass of flesh pulsates and churns as tiny monsters burst from its orifices.
target: 巨大的肉块在不断振动、摇晃，从孔口处不断涌现生物。

source: This pitch black form is shrouded in darkness. All you can make out are a pair of deep red eyes, hidden behind a mass of tentacles.
target: 这个深黑的物体被黑暗围绕，你只能认出一对猩红的眼睛，藏在一堆触手后面。

source: A small pink-skinned humanoid with large bulbous eyes.
target: 一只小小的粉皮人形生物，长着巨大的球状眼睛。

source: A hulking pink-skinned creature with long arms as thick as tree trunks.  It drags its knuckles on the ground as it lumbers toward you.
target: 一只庞大的粉皮肤生物，手臂粗如树干。它拖着指关节，笨重地向你走来。

source: A thin pink-skinned creature with long spindly arms.  Half its body is old and wrinkly, and the other half appears quite young.
target: 一只纤瘦的粉皮肤生物，长着细长的手臂。它半边身体又老又皱，另外半边却显得相当年轻。

source: A slender metallic monstrosity with long claws in place of fingers, and razor-sharp teeth.
target: 瘦长的金属怪物，手指的位置长着长长的爪子，还有剃刀般锋利的牙齿。

source: It looks like a hole in spacetime, but you get the impression it's somehow more than that.
target: 它乍一看像是时空中的一道缝隙，但你对它的印象远远不止于此。

source: A strange blob on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的一团奇怪胶状物体。

source: A strange green blob on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的一团绿色胶状物体。

source: A strange red blob on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的一团红色胶状物体。

source: A strange blue blob on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的一团蓝色胶状物体。

source: A strange white blob on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的一团白色胶状物体。

source: A strange yellow blob on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的一团黄色胶状物体。

source: A strange black blob on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的一团黑色胶状物体。

source: A strange black blob on the dungeon floor; through it you seem to be able to see other times and places. As you stare you see things moving out of it.
target: 地板上的一团黑色胶状物体。通过它你似乎能看到其他时间和地点。当你盯着它时，你发现有东西正从它里面冒出来。

source: Only the most powerful spellcasters raised to unlife become liches. Doomed to haunt the world for an eternity, they have grown to hate all that breathes or trespasses on their domain. Unfortunately that includes you.
target: 只有最强大的法师，才会被复活成为巫妖。他们注定要永远萦绕在这个世界上，他们憎恨所有在他们的领地上呼吸或侵入的人。不幸的是，这包括你在内。

source: Having thought to discover life eternal, these beings have allowed undeath to rob them of the joys of life. Now they seek to destroy it as well.
target: 为了探索永恒的生命，这些人允许不死族剥夺他们的生趣。现在，他们同样在毁灭生者。

source: An elder being from a now-forgotten age, filled and fueled by its hate and rage toward all things living, it seeks to deprive all others of a prize it cannot have... life.
target: 一位存活了不知多少岁月的巫妖，它对这个世界和生者充满了仇恨，所以它试图去剥夺生者所拥有而它所没有的财富——生命。

source: Blacker than the deepest night, this cold cruel form of darkness approaches.  Long ago it laid aside its mortality, but it has not forgotten its power; rather, its malice and hate have bent this undead entity on the destruction of all things living.
target: 从比漆黑的夜还要深邃的黑暗中，你感受到了一股冰冷的寒意。很久以前它放弃了生命，但却没忘记力量，相反，它被怨恨和邪念所强化，这只扭曲的不死生物要毁灭所有的生者。

source: The seething, pumping, disembodied blood of a horrendously powerful necromancer. To strike it is to bathe in the rivers of the Fearscape itself.
target: 来自一位极其强大的死灵法师的沸腾、搏动、脱离躯体的血液。攻击它就等于在恐惧之地本身的河流中沐浴。

source: Losgoroth are mighty void elementals, native to the void between the stars. They are rarely seen on a planet's surface.
target: 洛斯格罗斯是强大的虚空生物，居住于群星之间的星空中。在星球表面几乎看不到这种生物。

source: Manaworms are losgoroth which feed on the mana of arcane users. If they ever come in contact with a spellcaster, they latch on and start draining mana away.
target: 魔法蠕虫是以施法者的魔力为食的虚空生物。如果它们近距离接触到法师，它们会缠上去并吸干对方的魔力。

source: A monstrous demon, covered in acidic thorns.
target: 一只畸形的恶魔，身上长有酸性尖刺。

source: Under a shroud of darkness you discern an evil shape.
target: 在黑暗之雾的笼罩下，依稀可见恶魔的形态。

source:
This demon would look like a minotaur, if a minotaur had a fiery aura surrounding it and horns all over its body.
Oh, and it is twice as big, too.
target:
这只恶魔长得像一只米诺陶斯，如果米诺陶斯周身环绕着炽焰光环、全身长满尖角的话。
哦，而且它还有两倍大。

source: This terrible demon is covered in blood, which flows *on* its skin in ever-changing patterns that disturb you simply when looking at it.
target: 这只可怕的恶魔浑身是血，鲜血在其皮肤*表面*以不断变化的图案流淌，光是看着就让你浑身不舒服。

source:
You can only guess at the real shape of this demon. Its body is surrounded by a cloud of fiery darkness.
It moves swiftly toward you, casting terrible spells and swinging its weapons at you.
target:
你只能猜测这只恶魔的真实形态。它的身体被一层炽热的黑暗所笼罩。
它迅速向你逼近，一边施放可怕的法术，一边挥舞武器攻击你。

source: One of Urh'Rok's own champions. A thousand nightmares made flesh and screaming steel tower before you in the form of a massive, armored humanoid.
target: 乌鲁洛克本人的冠军之一。一千个噩梦化作血肉与尖啸的钢铁，以庞大的装甲人形之姿耸立在你面前。

source: A burning giant wielding a forge hammer of the underworld in each hand -- weapons imbued by Urh'Rok himself with the power to crush and shape felsteel. Enter their range at your peril.
target: 锻造巨人的每只手都有一柄地底锻造巨锤——被乌鲁洛克加持以锻造魔钢的巨锤。进入他们的领地是极度危险的事情。
库马纳，乌鲁洛克的将军

source: This massive form, sheathed in dark flames, stands tall above a legion of lesser demons. In his hands he holds a massive blackened battleaxe, flames dancing around the blades.
target: 这个庞大的躯体笼罩在黑暗之炎中，他在一群小恶魔中显得鹤立鸡群。在他手里握着一柄沉重的双手斧，火焰在刀锋处舞动。

source: A small demon, lobbing spells at you.
target: 一只小恶魔，它向你发射法术。

source: Acid oozes all over this small demon's skin.  Beware, they tend to hunt in packs.
target: 酸液从这只小恶魔的身体上渗出。当心，它们喜欢群体行动。

source:
A gaunt vaguely humanoid shape featuring unadorned grey leathery skin. Its arms and legs seem somehow too long and it stands tall, projecting an ominous shadow even in darkness.
Its glowing red eyes shine with both cruelty and a deep frightening intellect.
target:
一个憔悴而模糊不清的人形生物，全身是未经修饰的灰色皮肤。不知为何，它的胳膊和腿很长。当它耸立在那里的时候，即使在黑暗中也会投下不祥的阴影。
它发光的红色眼睛闪烁着，目光里蕴含着既残酷又深邃可怕的智慧。

source: A small, heavily armoured demon, rushing toward you.
target: 一只装备了重甲的小恶魔，它向你发起冲锋。

source: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
target: 它拥有人类和牛的特征。

source: A belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, and armed with a hammer.
target: 好战的米诺陶，装备有一柄巨锤且拥有强力的魔法。

source: A strange growth on the dungeon floor.
A strange grey growth on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的奇特灰色植物。

source: A strange brown growth on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的奇特棕色植物。

source: A strange luminescent growth on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的奇特闪光植物。

source: A strange sickly green growth on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的奇特绿色植物。

source: Steeped in fungal malevolence, this mold refused to die.  How a mold becomes a skeleton, though, is beyond you.  Are those its own bones, or the bones of hapless adventurers?
target: 这团霉菌浸透着真菌的恶意，拒绝死亡。然而，霉菌是如何变成骷髅的，你想不明白。那是它自己的骨头，还是倒霉冒险者的骨头？

source: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
target: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

source: A mature multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.
target: 一条成年七彩龙，拥有许多致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: An old and powerful multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.
target: 一条年长且强大的七彩龙，拥有许多致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: A huge multi-hued drake. It seems to shift color rapidly.
target: 一只巨大的七彩龙。它似乎在快速的变幻颜色。

source: Before you stands a tall figure -- a very tall figure, propped high by a thick serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is human-like, with bulging muscles beneath fitted armour, and large hands gripping a fiercely sharp trident. He glares at you with dark intensity, like a wolf about to pounce on unsuspecting prey.
target: 在你面前站着一个高大的人影——一个非常高的人形怪物，在腿部长着巨大的蛇尾巴，他以此来支撑他的身体。他的上半身是人形,护甲下面隐约可见发达的肌肉，两只巨大的双手紧握着锋利的三叉戟。他带着阴沉的锐利目光盯着你，像一头随时准备扑向毫无防备猎物的狼。

source: Though the sharp point of an arrow pointed steadily at your head is of concern, more unnerving is the creature that wields it: a slim and lithe woman from the waist up, but a terrifying giant serpent beneath, her tail stretching for several feet behind her. Her eyes turn cold and ice seems to magically condense on the tip of her barbed arrow. Suddenly it is of concern again.
target: 尽管一支利箭稳稳地指着你的脑袋令人担忧，但更让人不安的是握着它的生物：上半身是一个纤细柔美的女人，下半身却是可怕的巨蛇，尾巴在身后延伸数英尺。她的眼神变得冰冷，冰似乎神奇地凝结在她带刺箭矢的尖端。突然间，那箭矢又令你心生恐惧了。

source: Such a mix of enchanting beauty and revolting horror you have never before seen combined. Above, a beautiful, ethereal woman, of scant form and entrancing grace. Below, the thick, smooth scales of a snake, its stretched tail gently waving back and forth in the air behind her. The movement is eye-catching and hypnotic, and whilst you watch a mysterious smile plays across her seductive lips.
target: 你从未见过如此妖娆和恐怖的结合。上半身是一个美丽而出尘，性感而又迷人的女人。下半身是厚实而光滑的蛇尾。尾巴在她身后缓慢的来回摆动着，摆动的幅度醒目而又具有迷惑性。当你抬头看她时，你看到她性感的嘴角漾起神秘的微笑。

source: A maul-wield ogre. Ready to CRUSH!
target: 一个手里拿着重锤的食人魔，随时准备将你一锤击碎。

source: A master of combat, she is impatient to test her newfound skills.
target: 一个精于战斗技巧的食人魔，她已经等不及在你身上试试自己的新技能了。

source: This ogre closes in fast on you, arms open for the hug of death.
target: 这个食人魔快速地接近你，张开他死亡的拥抱。

source: A towering ogre guard, her skin covered in runes and arcane designs.
target: 一个高大的食人魔守卫，她的皮肤上刻满符文和奥术图案。

source:
It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols.
Through its transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a few corpses as well.
target: 这是一个奇怪的、巨大的凝胶状结构，它充满所巡逻走廊的所有四面墙，呈立方体状。透过它透明的果冻状结构，你可以看到它吞噬的宝物，还有几具尸体。

source: It's very slimy and it's oozing.
A fierce orc attuned to the wilds.
target: 一个凶猛、与荒野相通的兽人。

source: A fierce soldier-orc highly trained in the discipline of dragons.
target: 一个彪悍的、经过龙战士训练的兽人士兵。

source: An orc clad in massive armour. Magic seems to die down all around him.
target: 一只穿着板甲的兽人，魔法能量在它的周围湮灭。

source: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.
target: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，装备有一面盾牌和一个致命的斧头。

source: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a huge axe.
target: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，手里握着一把巨斧。

source: An orc dressed in black robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
target: 一只身穿黑色长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

source: An orc dressed in blood-stained robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
target: 一只穿着鲜血斑斑长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

source: An orc dressed in putrid robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
target: 一个穿着腐烂长袍的兽人。他用刺耳的语言喃喃自语。

source: An orc dressed in bright red robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
target: 一只身穿亮红色长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

source: An orc dressed in cold blue robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
target: 一只身穿冰蓝色长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

source: He is a hardy, well-weathered survivor.
target: 它是一个勇敢的，历经多次战争洗礼的幸存者。

source: A fierce soldier-orc trained in the discipline of dragons.
target: 一个彪悍的、经过龙战士训练的兽人。

source: An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.
target: 一个掌握刺杀和潜行的兽人刺客。

source: A morbidly obese orc with greasy pockmarked skin and oily long black hair.  He's clad in plate mail and carries a huge granite battleaxe that's nearly as large as he is.
target: 一只肥胖过度的兽人，他有一头油腻的黑色长发，皮肤油腻且长满了痘痘。他身穿板甲，手握一个几乎和他一样大的花岗岩双手斧。

source: A not-so-strange growth on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的不奇怪的植物。

source: This flesh-eating plant has grown to enormous proportions and seeks to quell its hunger.
target: 这棵巨大的肉食性植物正在寻找果腹的东西。

source: A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become hostile to other living things.
target: 一棵极为强壮的半智慧树木，对其他生物充满了敌意。

source: This harmless little plant makes you all itchy.
target: 这棵无害的小植物使你全身发痒。

source: As you approach it, you hear a high-pitched buzzing sound.
target: 当你靠近它时，你听到一阵刺耳的嗡嗡声。

source:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
target:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型土著昆虫。
他们是凶残的猎食者，用锋利的爪子刺穿大部分的盔甲，将腐败的疾病注入敌人的体内。

source: Kill the wabbit, kill the wabbit, kill the wabbbbbiiiiiit.
target: 快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；吾辈就是要去，打小白兔……

source: Instead of fur, this rat has crystals growing on its back, which provide extra protection.
target: 与普通耗子不同，这只耗子背上长着晶化皮毛，它因此获得了额外的保护。

source: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. It seems quite unhappy about you being in its lair.
target: 一只伪装成沙子颜色的巨大沙虫。它很不高兴你闯入它的地盘。

source: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. This particular sandworm seems to have been bred for one purpose only: the eradication of everything that is non-sandworm, such as... you.
target: 一只伪装成沙子颜色的巨大沙虫。这只特殊的沙虫生来只有一个目标：消灭所有非沙虫的异类，比如……你。

source: This unholy creature looks like a wingless dragon in shape, but it is sand-colored, making it all the more dangerous for its prey.
target: 这只邪恶的生物外形酷似无翼之龙，但浑身呈沙色，这让它对其猎物更加危险。

source: The ground shakes as this huge worm burrows towards you, its gigantic mouth just as capable of devouring flesh as stone.
target: 这只巨大的沙虫挖地道靠近你时，大地在震颤。它的巨口既能吞噬血肉，也能吞下石头。

source: Space and time seem to bend around this huge worm.
target: 这只沙虫似乎扭曲了周围的时空。

source: This huge worm burrows through the earth using its powerful corrosive saliva.
target: 这只巨大的沙虫使用它腐蚀性的唾液挖掘泥土。

source: Through some terrible process that remains mysterious, this creature's shadow has been torn from its body and given unlife.
target: 通过某种神秘的可怕手段，这只生物的影子被剥离出来并被赋予了生命。

source: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
target: 西弗格罗斯是强大的寒冰元素，它们被一股强大的魔法从老家里赶出来

source: A haphazard collection of crumbling bones, with jerky movements that remind you of a child playing with a marionette.  It only has one arm, but that's all it needs to hold a sword.
target: 这具仿佛是死灵法师随意收集而成的，摇摇欲坠的骨骸，生涩地从你的眼前走过，仿佛孩童手中玩弄的木偶。虽然它只有一条手臂，不过反正这对于拿一把剑也够了，对吧。

source: A frail skeleton; just about the only bones that aren't cracked are its arms.  It's missing a hand, but a notch has been carved into its wrist to let it pull back a bowstring regardless.
target: 这具破烂不堪的骨架只有一根骨头是好的：它手持长弓的手臂。尽管它缺少了一只手，不过残缺的骨骼上雕刻的凹槽刚好可以卡住弓弦拉弓上箭。

source: Given its condition, you're less inclined to think this skeleton knows proper spells, rather than simply disgorging its magical energy as it breaks down.  This doesn't make it much less dangerous to be around, mind you.
target: 看着它残破的样子，你与其相信这只骷髅会释放魔法，不如相信是在它身躯逐渐破碎的同时将奥术能量胡乱喷射出来。不过，这一点也没有降低它的危险性，小心。

source: The forces binding this skeleton together are resilient enough to let it hold a shield and swing a weapon as well as it could have in life.  It's still wearing its old armor, in rusty but servicable condition.
target: 施展在这只骷髅身上的魔法已经足够强大，足以让它像还活着的时候那样严阵以待，挥动武器。它仍然穿着它原来的那件老盔甲，锈迹斑斑却值得信赖。

source: Nobody scavenged the high-quality bow from this archer before it was raised from the dead.  You're about to wish the world had more grave-robbers.
target: 在被复活之前，这位弓箭手的遗体上居然还保留着一张还不错的弓。你开始觉得，世界上如果有更多的盗墓贼就好了。

source: This skeleton has been imbued with far more magical energy than normal, and serves as a conduit of its master's spellcasting prowess.
target: 这只骷髅的身上充盈着更加丰沛的魔法力量，作为它的主人强大魔力的明证。

source: It feels no pain.  It moves with fluidity and strength that would tear natural muscles apart.  It must be from a fresh corpse, since its bones, armor, and weapon are all in pristine condition.  And it's furious.
target: 这只骷髅战士没有任何痛感，它的动作行云流水，强大的挥斩足以将常人的肌肉撕裂。它一定是来自一具新鲜的尸体：它的骨头、装甲和武器还是崭新的。并且，他仿佛怒不可遏。

source: This skeleton can fire arrows and nock new ones with blinding speed.  Arcane forces pull its bones with unnatural precision - its arms will never tremble or get tired.
target: 这只骷髅可以飞速的拈弓射箭，奥术的力量使它的身躯达到了常人无法企及的精确度——它的射击永远不会颤动，也永远不会疲累。

source: Most skeletons announce their presence with a chorus of rattling bones; this one's been charred black and has enough cartilage between its joints to muffle its approach.  The first you'll see of it will be the flash of its blade.
target: 普通骷髅骨节之间的吱嘎猛响会早早暴露他们的行踪，但这只骷髅的身躯被烧焦成暗夜的黑色，关节间的软骨缓冲着骨节的转动。当你看到它时，它银光闪耀的刀刃已经出现在你的眼前。

source: This large snake hisses at you, angry at being disturbed.
target: 这条大蛇向你发出嘶嘶声，对被打扰感到愤怒。

source: It has a copper head and sharp venomous fangs.
target: 它长着铜色的脑袋和锋利的毒牙。

source: As you approach, the snake coils up and rattles its tail threateningly.
target: 你一靠近，这只蛇便盘旋竖起并用尾巴发出警告的声音。

source: It is a large snake with a hooded face.
target: 这是一条面部呈兜帽状的大蛇。

source: It has glistening black skin, a sleek body, and highly venomous fangs.
target: 它有着油亮光滑的黑色皮肤、流线型的身体和剧毒的毒牙。

source: You recoil in fear as you notice this gigantic snake.  It seeks to crush the life out of you.
target: 看到这条巨蛇，你恐惧地向后退缩。它想要绞杀你的生命。

source: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.
target: 一只酷似人类却很高大的生物。它手握一个巨锤，看起来不是很友好。

source: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly. Lightning crackles over its body.
target: 一只酷似人类却很高大的生物。它手握一个巨锤，看起来不是很友好。闪电在它周身流动。

source: A maddened, enraged snow giant that towers over his comrades. You've heard legends mentioning this particular monstrosity; they say that when he's not rampaging around frothing at the mouth, he sits, almost childlike, engraving stories and mysterious patterns on any flat stone surface he can find.
target: 一个疯狂而暴怒的雪巨人，远远高于他的同胞。你以前听说过关于这个雪巨人的故事：据说，平时他不像现在这样愤怒得口沫横飞时，他会坐下来，像个孩子一样，在他能找到的任何一块平整的石头表面雕刻故事和神秘的图案。

source: A huge arachnid, it produces even bigger webs.
target: 一只巨大的蛛形纲动物，它可以织出更大的网。

source: A huge arachnid, it sprays venom at its prey.
target: 一只巨大的蛛形纲动物，它向猎物喷射毒液。

source: A huge arachnid with a massive exoskeleton.
target: 一只巨大的蛛形纲动物，它有着厚重的外壳。

source: These cunning spiders terrorize those who enter the ever-growing borders of their lairs.  Those who encounter them rarely return.
target: 这些狡猾的蜘蛛威胁着进入它们地盘的生物。没有人能从它们这生还。

source: The air reeks with noxious fumes and the ground around it decays.
target: 在它周围，毒雾散播，大地枯萎。

source: This spider seems to command the flow of mana, which pulses freely through its body.
target: 这只蜘蛛善于控制法力流动，它可以使法力在它体内有节奏的跳跃。

source: Largest of all the spiderkin, its folds of skin seem nearly impenetrable.
target: 它是体型最大的蜘蛛，它褶皱的皮肤看起来牢不可破。

source: The air seems to freeze solid around this frigid spider.
target: 这只寒冷的蜘蛛似乎使周围的空气都凝固了。

source: A tiny arachnid that phases in and out of reality.
target: 一只小小的蜘蛛，它在不断的出入相位现实。

source: A large blue arachnid with white markings on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.
target: 一只胸部有着白色花纹的巨大蓝蜘蛛。它不断的移动和闪烁，好像它只有部分连接在时间线上。

source: A large dark blue arachnid with a shifting yellow and white pattern on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.
target: 一只巨大的深蓝色蛛形生物，胸部有着不断变幻的黄白花纹。它不停地晃动闪烁，仿佛只是部分连接在时间线上。

source: A huge blue and white spiderkin whose form shifts and shimmers in and out of reality.  She spins the threads of fate and binds the destiny of all within her web.
target: 一只巨大的蓝白相间的蜘蛛，身形在现实内外不断闪烁。她编织命运之线，将落入网中的一切命运牢牢束缚。

source: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
target: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

source: A mature storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条成年风暴巨龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: An old and powerful storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条年长且强大的风暴巨龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
target: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

source: A human in shiny plate armour.
target: 一位穿着闪耀板甲的人类。

source: An elf dressed in glowing robes.
target: 一位穿着鲜艳长袍的精灵。
嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡。

source: A swarm of midges; they want blood.
target: 一群蚊子，它们渴望鲜血。

source: They buzz at you threateningly, as you have gotten too close to their hive.
target: 它们向你发出嗡嗡的警告声，因为你离它们的巢穴太近了。

source: You have intruded on their ground, and they will defend it at all costs.
target: 你已经闯入了它们的地盘，它们会不择手段的攻击你。

source: A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger dripping venom.
target: 一只巨大的黄蜂，它的尾刺滴着毒液。

source: A temporal elemental, rarely encountered except by those who travel through time itself.  Its blurred form constantly shifts before your eyes.
target: 一只时间元素，除了亲身穿越时间的人之外很少有人遇到。它模糊的形态在你眼前不断变幻。

source: Time and space collapse in upon this erratically-moving time elemental.
target: 时空在这只漂泊的时间元素周围不断塌陷。

source: The lowest of the thieves, this cutpurse is just learning the tricks of the trade.
target: 盗贼中最底层的扒手，他正在学习这一行的门道。

source: Stronger than a cutpurse, this thief has been promoted.
target: 比扒手更强，这个盗贼已经晋升了。

source: He eyes you and your belongings, then suddenly vanishes... strange, why is your pack lighter?
target: 他盯着你和你的背包，然后突然消失不见……好奇怪，你的背包似乎轻了许多？

source: These ruffians often employ brute force over thievery, but they are capable of stealing as well.
target: 这些恶棍往往更习惯用蛮力而非偷窃，但他们也同样会偷。

source: He is the leader of a gang of bandits. Watch out for his underlings.
target: 他是这伙强盗的首领，当心他的手下。

source: Before you looms a pair of eyes... a glint of steel... death.
target: 你面前浮现出一双眼睛……一道金属寒光……死亡。

source: Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!
target: 隐形的斗士，他们一直在追求欺诈的巅峰技巧。小心，他们会随时偷走你的生命！

source: Stealthy tricksters that leave a wake of deadfalls and other hazards.  They really just make a mess of things.
target: 狡猾的骗子，他们会留下死亡陷阱和其他危险的东西。他们真的只会让事态变得糟糕。

source: Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
target: 丑陋的绿皮生物正盯着你，同时它握紧了满是肉瘤的绿色拳头。

source: A giant troll with scabrous black skin. With a shudder, you notice the belt of dwarf skulls around his massive waist.
target: 有着粗糙黑色皮肤的巨魔，一阵战栗后，你惊讶的发现他的腰带是用矮人头骨制成。

source: This huge troll wields a massive spear and has a disturbingly intelligent look in its piggy eyes.
target: 这只巨魔手握一根笨重的长矛，它那双小猪般的眼睛里透露出一种令人不安的聪明神情。

source: A large and athletic troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.
target: 一只高大且强壮的巨魔，身披一张丑陋但异常坚硬的兽皮。

source: A disgusting and mismatched construct of necromantically-enhanced troll bits and shattered weapons. Confused and furious, it rends and shatters its surroundings with impossible strength, moving with speed found nowhere in nature.
target: 一个由死灵法术强化的巨魔残肢与碎裂武器拼凑而成的恶心造物。它困惑而暴怒，以不可思议的力量撕裂摧毁周围的一切，移动速度在自然界中无处可寻。

source: This old-looking troll glares at you with malice. His muscles appear atrophied, but a certain power surrounds him nonetheless.
target: 这只老迈的巨魔恶狠狠的盯着你。尽管它已经年老力衰，但是你仍能感受到一股强大的能量环绕着它。

source: A skeletal rat, teeth and claws ground to a sharp point. It glares at you menacingly.
target: 一只骷髅鼠，牙齿和爪子磨得尖利。它充满威胁地瞪着你。

source: Layers of rotting skin are peeling off of this rat. One of the eye sockets appears empty.
target: 斑驳的皮肤从这只老鼠身上脱落，它的一只眼窝空洞的看着你。

source: An eerie haze surrounds this translucent rat.
target: 怪异的烟雾环绕着这只透明的老鼠。

source: Looks much like a normal rat. That is, other than the very large fangs.
target: 不谈那大了一号的牙齿，它看起来还算比较正常的一只老鼠。

source: This massive beast appears to be a rat composed of countless bones fused together.
target: 这只巨大的怪物看起来像是许多骨头拼起来的老鼠。

source: The master of the pit is before you. It squeaks with menace as it and a horde of minions approach you.
target: 深坑的主人就在你面前。它发出威胁性的吱吱声，与一大群爪牙一同向你逼近。

source: #RED#Rising again, the Rat Lich's eyes glow with renewed energy!
target: #RED#鼠巫妖再次复活，它的眼睛放射着全新能量的光辉！

source: The Rat Lich's true power has been unveiled! Swirling with arcane energy, it stalks towards you uttering warsqueaks at its minions!
target: 鼠巫妖的真正力量展现出来了！它周身环绕着奥术能量，一边向仆从发出战斗吱叫，一边朝你逼近！

source: These ancient cursed beings often take the form of a bat and attack their prey.
target: 这些被诅咒的古代生物经常以蝙蝠的形式攻击猎物。

source: This vampire has only just begun its new life. It has not yet fathomed its newfound power, yet it still has a thirst for blood.
target: 这只吸血鬼刚开始它的新生活，还不能熟练运用它的新能力，但是它同样渴望鲜血。

source: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.
target: 这是一只成年吸血鬼，你注意到他有一副獠牙。

source: It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling frame.
target: 这是一个穿着长袍的人形身影。力量从它冰冷的身躯中散发出来。

source:
A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others.
It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.
target:
这个身披长袍的可怕不死生物，靠窃取他人的生命在亡者之身中存在了数百年。
它能从坟墓彼端召唤受害者的阴影，使其臣服前来协助自己。

source: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.
target: 当这只可怕的生物靠近时，你感到脊背一阵发凉。

source: A corrosive venom drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
target: 一只毒龙幼仔。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

source: A mature corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条成年毒龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: An old and powerful corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条年长且强大的毒龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: %s exudes a corrupted gas as it dies.
It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.
target: 它有着人类的脸孔，幽灵般的影子。

source: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.
target: 它呈幽灵形态，眼睛一直盯着你。

source: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.
Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.
target: 当这只强大的不死生物靠近时，你感觉生命能量被不断地撕扯出身体。

source: A monstrous, coiled wyrm, patient and hateful. Its hide, studded with spikes and crests and blades, turns aside steel and sorcery with equal ease.
target: 一只奇特的、盘绕的巨龙，它可憎却沉稳。它的表皮上布满了倒刺和利刃，可以轻松抵挡金属武器攻击和魔法能量。

source: A shifting, writhing, snake-like dragon, blinking in and out of existence, just waiting for you to turn your back.
target: 一只不断闪烁和换位的蛇状巨龙，它只是在等你回头。

source: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.
target: 这只怪异的生物长着怒目圆睁的眼睛和几只能咬穿岩石的巨大口器。

source: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.
target: 一只巨大的土元素。它有四只巨大的手臂，并且可以融合泥土。

source: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.
target: 它是索尔石怪更难对付的近亲，表皮闪烁着金属矿石的光泽。

source: Fragmented essence... maybe it'd be best if it stayed fragmented.
target: 精华碎片……如果它仍然呈碎裂状态就好了。

source: #AQUAMARINE#%s absorbs the energy of the destroyed fragment!
target: #AQUAMARINE#%s 吸收了被摧毁的碎片的能量！

source: #AQUAMARINE#%s is infused with all the energies of the fragments. The real Harkor'Zun is reconstituted!
target: #AQUAMARINE#%s吸收了所有碎片的能量，真正的哈卡祖重生了！

source: A gigantic demon composed of elemental Earth, resembling a twisted Xaren but much, much larger.  It doesn't seem pleased with your presence.
target: 一个由土元素构成的巨大恶魔，它长得像一只扭曲的钻石索尔石怪，但大得多得多。似乎你的到来使它很不高兴。

source: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.
target: 夺魂魔是夺心魔的一支亚种。他们拥有同样的灵能，但夺魂魔拒绝加入维网。
并被绑在火刑柱上烧死

source: A Ziguranth warrior, clad in heavy armour.
target: 一位身穿重甲的伊格兰斯战士。

source: A Ziguranth wilder, attuned to nature.
target: 一位能沟通自然的伊格兰斯自然师。

source:
A two-handed massive trident.
Tridents require the exotic weapons mastery talent to use correctly.
target:
一个沉重的双手三叉戟。
三叉戟需要异形武器掌握技能才能正确使用。

source: Black blood for foul deeds. This dagger serves evil.
target: 为邪恶行径而流的黑血。这把匕首侍奉着邪恶。

source:
The power of the tides rush through this trident.
Tridents require the exotic weapons mastery talent to use correctly.
target:
这把三叉戟上流动着潮汐的力量。
三叉戟需要异形武器掌握技能才能正确使用。

source: A choker made of pure flame, casting forever shifting patterns around the neck of its wearer. Its fire seems to not harm the wearer.
target: 一个由火焰形成的护符，在它的佩戴者身上不断地改变着形状。它的火焰似乎不会伤害到佩戴者。

source: This dragon scale harness shines with multiple colors, quickly shifting through them in a seemingly chaotic manner.
target: 这个以巨龙鳞片制成的护甲闪耀着五颜六色的光芒，它们在鳞甲表面不断的变化着。

source: The most prized treasure of the Battlemaster of the Pride, Grushnak. This gold ring is inscribed in the now lost orc tongue.
target: 这是普莱德的战争领主格鲁希纳克最宝贵的财富。这枚金戒指上铭刻着失传的兽人语。

source: A silk robe, darker than the darkest night sky, it radiates power.
target: 一件比夜色还黑的丝绸礼服，它向外辐射出能量。

source: This jeweled crown shimmers with colors.
target: 这顶镶嵌宝石的王冠闪闪发光。
战争之王格纳哥的饮血剑

source: A blood-etched greatsword, it has seen many foes. From the inside.
target: 一把血迹斑斑的大剑，它洞穿了许多敌人。

source: 10% chance to send the wielder into a killing frenzy
target: 10% 几率使持有者进入疯狂杀戮状态

source: With this unbearably bright whip of flame, the demon master Urh'Rok has become known for never having lost in combat.
target: 用这根炽焰打造的鞭子，恶魔领主乌鲁洛克未尝一败。

source: This dragonbone longbow is enhanced with bands of steel, which arc with intense lightning. Bolts travel up and down the string, ignorant of you.
target: 这把龙骨长弓由精钢镶制而成，一道道电弧缠绕在其身上，闪电球在其弓弦上徘徊，但是却绕过了你的手臂。

source: Automatically fires lightning bolts every game turn at nearby enemies dealing %d to %d lightning damage based on Magic with a chance to inflict Daze.
target: 每回合自动向附近敌人发射闪电，造成%d到%d基于魔法的闪电伤害，并有几率使其眩晕。

source: #GOLD#A bolt of lightning fires from #Source#'s bow, striking #Target#!
target: #GOLD# 一道闪电从#Source#的弓中射出，击中了#Target#！

source: All that remains of the Glacial Legion. This cloak seems to exude an icy cold vapor that freezes all it touches.
target: 冰川军团仅存的遗物。这件斗篷仿佛散发着冰冷的寒气，冻结一切触及之物。

source: release a radius %d chilling blast, instantly dealing %0.2f cold damage and condensing the air into freezing vapors that deal %0.2f cold damage (based on Magic) each turn for %d turns
target: 在半径 %d 范围内吹出冰风，立刻造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害，并将空气冻结成寒霜冰雾，每回合造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害（基于魔法），持续 %d 回合。

source: The massive stone limb of the Rotting Titan, a mass of stone and rotting flesh. You think you can lift it, but it is very heavy.
target: 这是腐化泰坦的一部分沉重肢体，一大块腐烂的石化躯体。你认为你可以轻易举起它，但事实证明，它重的不可思议。

source: Blasts creatures in a radius 1 shockwave around your target for %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Strength).
target: 在目标周围制造半径 1 的冲击波，轰击范围内的生物，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 物理伤害（基于力量）。

source: %s's %s shakes the ground with its impact!
knock away other creatures within radius %d), dealing %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Strength) to each
target: 击退半径 %d 的生物，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 物理伤害(基于力量)。

source: %s slams %s %s into the ground, sending out a shockwave!
This mass of fused molten bone from the Heavy Sentinel radiates intense power. It still glows red with the heat of the Sentinel's core, and yet seems to do you no harm.
target: 这团来自重型哨兵的融合熔融骨骼散发着强大的力量。它仍因哨兵核心的热量而发红发亮，不过似乎不会伤害到你。

source: This thin grey ring is adorned with a deep black orb. Tiny white dots swirl slowly within it, and a faint purple light glows from its core.
target: 这枚纤细的灰色戒指镶嵌着一颗深黑色的球体。微小的白点在球体内缓缓旋转，核心处发出微弱的紫光。

source:
The air seems to freeze around the blade of this sword, draining all heat from the area.
It is said the Conclave created this weapon for their warmaster during the dark times of the first allure war.
target:
这把剑的剑锋周围空气似乎都冻结了，吸走了这片区域的所有热量。
据说议会在第一次诱惑战争的黑暗时期，为他们的战争领主打造了这件武器。

source: Create a Winter Storm that gradually expands (from radius %d to radius %d), dealing %0.2f cold damage (based on Strength) to your enemies each turn and slowing their ability to act by 20%%.  Subsequent melee strikes will relocate the storm on top of your target and increase its duration.
target: 制造不断扩张的寒冰风暴（从半径 %d 到半径 %d），每回合造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害（基于力量）并减速 20%%。接下来的近战攻击将重置风暴位置并延长持续时间。

source: precipitate ice walls (lasting 10 turns) within your Winter Storm's area
target: 强化冰风暴的冰雪，冻结成冰墙，持续 10 回合。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s brandishes %s %s, releasing a wave of Winter cold!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s 挥舞着%s%s，释放出一阵寒风！

source: This phial seems filled with darkness, yet it cleanses your thoughts.
target: 这个小瓶子似乎充满了黑暗，但却净化了你的思想。

source: cleanse your mind of up to %d (based on Magic) detrimental mental effects
target: 净化你的思想，解除至多%d个（基于魔法）负面精神状态。

source: A pair of leather boots. Cold to the touch, they radiate a cold blue light.
target: 一双摸起来冰凉的皮靴，闪烁着冰冷的蓝色光芒。

source: Each step taken casts a ground frost effect in a radius of 1 around you for 5 turns, giving you a 20% cold damage bonus for 3 turns. Additionally, any enemy standing in the frost has a 20% chance of talent failure for 3 turns.
target: 你走出的每一步都会在周围1码范围内产生冻结地面效果，持续5回合，使你获得20%寒冷伤害加成，持续3回合。此外，所有踩在冻结地面上的敌人在3回合内有20%几率技能使用失败。

source: Traces of a dragon's power still remain in this bleached and cracked skull.
target: 在这个灰白而残破的头骨中还残留着巨龙的能量。

source: This armour seems to have been patched together from many eels. Yuck.
target: 这个护甲似乎是由很多电鳗碎片拼接起来的。真恶心。

source: A pitch black ring, unadorned. It seems as though tendrils of darkness creep upon it.
target: 一枚纯黑色的戒指。似乎无尽的黑暗缠绕着它。

source: A great helm that belonged to Garkul the Devourer, one of the greatest orcs ever to live.
target: 这是迄今为止最伟大的兽人，吞噬者加库尔的头盔。

source: Another of Garkul's heirlooms would bring out his spirit.
target: 另一件加库尔的遗物将唤醒他的英灵。

source: A large section of chitin removed from Nimisil. It continues to give off a strange white glow.
target: 一块从尼米希尔身上剥离下来的巨大甲壳。它持续发出奇异的白色光芒。

source: The barkwood of Wrathroot, made into roughly the shape of a shield.
target: 用狂怒树精的树皮制成的粗糙盾牌。

source: A piece of the scorched wood taken from the remains of Snaproot.
target: 从远古树精身上得到的木头残片。

source: This crystalline tree branch is remarkably rigid, and refracts light in myriad colors. Gazing at it entrances you, and you worry where its power may have come from.
target: 这根水晶树枝异常坚硬，折射出万千色彩的光芒。凝视着它会让你入迷，同时你会担心它的力量究竟来自何处。

source: create 2 living shards of crystal to serve you for 10 turns
target: 制造两片活的水晶体来为你服务10回合。

source: You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
target: 你不能召唤，你被压制了！

source: Crystals splinter off of %s's %s and animate!
target: %s的%s上的水晶碎片活动了起来!
散发着瘟疫气息的斧头

source: The land withers and crumbles wherever this cursed axe rests.
target: 无论这把斧头在哪里，大地都会枯萎和凋零。

source: Made from the bones of many creatures, this staff glows with power. You can feel its evil presence even from a distance.
target: 这根法杖由许多生物的骨头制成并散发着能量。你甚至可以在很远的地方感受到它的邪恶气息。

source: No force can hope to silence the wearer of this amulet.
target: 没有任何力量能使这个护身符的主人安静下来。

source: The top part of Telos' broken staff.
target: 泰勒斯破损法杖的上半部分。

source: The evilness of undeath radiates from this amulet.
target: 这件护符散发着不死生物的邪恶气息。

source: summon an elder vampire with Taunt to your side for 15 turns
target: 召唤一个会使用嘲讽的吸血鬼长老为你服务15回合。

source: You need an enemy nearby to summon!
target: 需要旁边有一个敌人才能召唤!
%s启动了%s%s，召唤出一个吸血鬼随从！

source: A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others. It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.
target: 这个身披长袍的可怕不死生物，靠窃取他人的生命在亡者之身中存在了数百年。它能从坟墓彼端召唤受害者的阴影，使其臣服前来协助自己。

source: Dull red runes are etched all over this blackened skull.
target: 这块黑色头骨上遍布着暗红色的符文。

source: This is a big, nasty-looking tree trunk that Bill the Troll used as a weapon. It could still serve this purpose, should you be strong enough to wield it!
target: 这是一个巨大的、丑陋的树干，但是巨魔比尔把它当做武器。如果你够强壮，你也可以把它当做武器！

source: Though tarnished and spattered with blood, the emblem of the Sun still manages to shine through on this shield.
target: 尽管这面盾牌已经失去光泽、溅满鲜血，太阳的徽记依然闪耀其上。

source: These gloves seems to be made out of the exoskeletons of ritches. They are hot to the touch.
target: 这副手套似乎是由里奇的甲壳组成。它们摸上去非常热。

source: This crystal radiates the power of the Spellblaze itself.
target: 这颗水晶散发着魔法大爆炸本身的力量。

source: (The created item can be activated to recover the Focus.)
target: （被创建的物品可以被激活，以重新取回魔力结晶）

source: combine with a weapon (makes a non enchanted weapon into an artifact)
target: 安装至一把武器（可以将未附魔的武器变成一件神器）

source: #GOLD#As the crystalline weapon and armour are brought together, they begin to emit a constant humming.
target: #GOLD#当水晶武器和护甲被放在一起时，它们开始发出持续的嗡鸣。

source: #GOLD#The humming from the crystalline artifacts fades as they are separated.
target: #GOLD#当两件水晶装备分开时共鸣消失了。

source: Transformed with the power of the Spellblaze.
target: 被魔法大爆炸的力量所转化。

source: recover the Crystal Focus (destroys this weapon)
target: 取回魔力结晶（摧毁武器）

source: You fix the crystal on the %s and create the %s.
target: 你将水晶安装在%s，制造了%s。

source: This crystal is huge, easily the size of your head. It sparkles brilliantly almost of its own accord.
target: 这颗水晶很大，几乎和你的头一样大。它闪烁着动人的光辉。

source: (The created item can be activated to recover the Heart.)
target: （被制造的物品可以被激活，以重新取回水晶之心）

source: combine with a suit of body armor (makes a non enchanted armour into an artifact)
target: 安装至一件护甲（可以将未附魔的护甲变成一件神器）

source: recover the Crystal Heart (destroys this armour)
target: 取回水晶之心（摧毁护甲）

source: You can feel magic draining out around this rod. Even nature itself seems affected.
target: 你可以感受到这根法杖周围的魔力流失，甚至自然本身也似乎受到了影响。

source: put up to 3 of the target's runes, infusions or talents on cooldown for 3-5 turns (range %d)
target: 将一个目标至多3个符文、纹身或技能打入3-5回合的冷却（范围 %d）。

source: A small but sharp axe, with a handle made of polished bone.  The blade has chopped through the skulls of many, and has been stained a deep crimson.
target: 一把小巧而锋利的斧头，斧柄由打磨过的骨头制成。这把斧头打破了许多头骨，并被染成了鲜红色。

source: A huge tooth taken from the Mouth, in the Deep Bellow.
target: 一颗取自深渊地腹中巨口的巨大牙齿。

source: These blackened boots have lost all vestiges of any former glory they might have had. Now, they are a testament to the corruption of the Deep Bellow, and its power.
target: 这些被玷污的靴子已经丧失了它们以前的荣耀，现在，它们只能作为深渊的存在以及腐蚀力量的证明。

source:
These opalescent orbs stare at you with deathly knowledge, undeceived by your vanities and pretences.  They have lived and died through horrors you could never imagine, and now they lie strung in black chords watching every twitch of the shadows.
If you close your eyes a moment, you can almost imagine what dread sights they see...
target:
这些泛着乳白色光芒的眼球用死亡般的知识凝视着你，你的虚荣和伪装欺骗不了它们。它们曾在你无法想象的恐惧中生生死死，如今被黑色丝线串起，注视着阴影的每一下颤动。
如果你闭上眼睛片刻，几乎能想象出它们所见过的恐怖景象……

source: a suit of pitted and pocked plate-mail

Inch-thick stralite plates lock together with voratun joints. The whole suit looks impenetrable, but has clearly been subjected to terrible treatment - great dents and misshaping warps, and caustic fissures bored across the surface.
Though clearly a powerful piece, it must once have been much greater.
target:
一英寸厚的蓝锆石板甲，关节部分由沃瑞钽组成。整套铠甲看起来异常坚固，但是显然它有过非常可怕的经历——巨大的凹痕、扭曲的关节以及腐蚀的表面。
虽然这显然是一件强大的装备，但它曾经一定更为强大。

source:
A filigree of silver set with many small jewels, this diadem seems radiant - ethereal almost. But its touch seems to freeze your skin and brings wild thoughts to your mind. You want to drop it, throw it away, and yet you cannot resist thinking of what powers it might bring you.
Is this temptation a weak will on your part, or some domination from the artifact itself...?
target:
一个镶嵌有很多珠宝的银制艺术品，这顶王冠看起来光芒四射而又美丽优雅。但是当你碰到它时，你感到你的皮肤都要冻僵了，许多狂暴的意识涌向你的大脑。你想丢弃它，扔掉它，但是你最终无法抗拒它能带给你的力量。
是你的意志太薄弱，还是这件神器支配了你？

source:
This well-tended sling is made from the leather and sinews of a large hare. It feels smooth to the touch, yet very durable. Some say that the skin of a hare brings luck and fortune.
Hard to tell if that really helped its former owner, but it's clear that the skin is at least also strong and reliable.
target:
这把投石索是由一只巨大的野兔皮精制而成。它摸起来光滑柔软却十分耐用。有人说，野兔皮可以带来幸运。
很难说它是否真的帮助了它的前任使用者，但是很显然这副毛皮既结实又可靠。
普罗克斯的幸运半身人脚

source:
A large hairy foot, very recognizably a halfling's, is strung on a piece of thick twine. In its decomposed state it's hard to tell how long ago it parted with its owner, but from what look like teeth marks around the ankle you get the impression that it wasn't given willingly.
It has been kept somewhat intact with layers of salt and clay, but in spite of this it's clear that nature is beginning to take its toll on the dead flesh. Some say the foot of a halfling brings luck to its bearer - right now the only thing you can be sure of is that it stinks.
target:
一只用细线串起来的巨大毛脚，很显然这是一位半身人的。目前的状态，很难讲它多久以前被割了下来，但是从脚踝处的齿痕来看，应该不是出于自愿。
它的外面有一层盐和粘土，被很好的保护着，尽管如此，大自然还是剥夺了它的活力，它已经成为了一块死肉。有人说，半身人的脚可以带来好运，但是现在唯一可确认的是——它臭死了！

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%#LAST# chance to stun, blind, pin, confuse, or silence the target for 3 turns
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%#LAST#几率震慑、混乱、沉默、定身或致盲目标3回合

source: A length of troll intestines. Fortunately, the troll appears to have eaten nothing in some time.
target: 一截巨魔肠子。幸运的是，这只巨魔碰巧没吃任何东西。

source: The skull of a skeleton mage. The eyes have stopped glowing... for now.
target: 一颗骷髅法师的头骨。现在……它的眼睛已经暗淡了。

source: A ritch stinger, still glistening with venom.
target: 一只里奇的螫针，还残留着许多粘稠的毒液。

source: The heart of an orc. Perhaps surprisingly, it isn't green.
target: 一颗兽人的心脏。很惊讶吧，它不是绿色的。

source: A severed naga tongue. It reeks of brine.
target: 一截娜迦的舌头。它散发着海水的气息。

source: A vial of greater demon bile. It hurts your sinuses even with the vial's stopper firmly in place.
target: 一瓶大恶魔的胆汁。尽管有着良好的阻隔，它仍刺激着你的鼻窦。

source: Once the magics animating the bone giant fled, its remains crumbled to dust. It might be your imagination, but it looks like the dust occasionally stirs on its own.
target: 当操纵骨巨人的魔法力量消散后，尘归尘，土归土。也许是你的幻觉，但是它似乎偶尔会自行移动起来。

source: Wickedly sharp and still freezing cold.
target: 异乎寻常的锋利且散发着阵阵寒气。

source: The severed front half of a minotaur snout, ring and all.
target: 一只米诺陶的鼻子的前半部分，上面有圆环装饰。
一瓶长老吸血鬼的血液

source: Thick, clotted, and foul. The vial is cold to the touch.
target: 粘稠的、凝固的、污秽的液体。瓶子摸起来很冷。

source: Beautiful and nearly impregnable. Separating it from the dragon must have been hard work.
target: 美丽且异常坚固的龙鳞。把它从龙身上扒下来一定费了不少力气。

source: An ugly, ripped-out chunk of giant spider. Bits of silk protrude from an orifice.
target: 从巨型蜘蛛身上扯下的一大块丑陋的器官，少量的丝线从某个洞中伸出。

source: The severed end of one of a honey tree's roots. It wriggles around occasionally, seemingly unwilling to admit that it's dead... and a *plant*.
target: 蜜蜂树的一根树根。它偶尔会蠕动下，似乎不承认它已经死了，而且还是个“植物”。

source: Diseased-looking and reeking. It seems to be decaying as you watch.
target: 病变且散发着恶臭的心脏，在你注视它时似乎仍在腐烂。

source: Slimy, wriggling, and crackling with electricity.
target: 黏滑、蠕动的尾巴，还闪着噼啪作响的电火花。
巨大的、长有利爪的脚掌

source: Large and hairy with flesh-rending claws. It smells slightly of fish.
target: 体型巨大、浑身长毛，还有能撕裂血肉的利爪。它闻起来略带鱼腥味。

source: This tooth has been blunted with age, but still looks more than capable of doing its job.
target: 这颗牙齿饱受岁月的侵蚀，但是仍然能胜任它的工作。

source: Tiny flames still dance ethereally inside this transparent crystal, though its heat seems to have faded... you hope.
target: 小巧的火焰依然在这颗透明的水晶里轻盈舞动，尽管它的热量似乎已经消退……你希望如此。

source: Clear and slightly thicker than water. It froths when shaken.
target: 龙涎比水更加粘稠，和水一样清澈，当你摇晃它时会有泡沫产生。

source: Rotten and reeking. It still twitches occasionally.
target: 这块肉腐烂且散发着恶臭，偶尔还会抽搐。

source: Bits of dry flesh still cling to this ancient bone.
target: 在这个古代的骨头上仍残留着一点肉块。

source: Tiny, dark grey, and wickedly sharp. It looks more like rock than bone.
target: 它小巧、暗灰且锋利得吓人。它看起来更像石头而不是骨头。

source: Unlike the rest of the black mamba, the severed head isn't moving.
target: 不像这条蛇的其他部分，这颗头一动不动。

source: As unpleasant-looking as any exposed organ.
target: 像其他解剖的器官一样，这个肾脏很难看。

source: Bluish and wickedly sharp. It makes your arm hair stand on end.
target: 这只爪子泛着蓝色光泽并且锋利的吓人，它使你汗毛竖立。

source: A dead green worm, painstakingly separated from its tangle of companions.
target: 一只死掉的绿色虫子，需要非常仔细才能把它从蠕虫团中挑拣出来。

source: Cloudy and thick. Only by bottling it can you prevent it from evaporating within minutes.
target: 浑浊且粘稠的液体。只有把它装进瓶子里，才能防止它在几分钟内蒸发。

source: Looks much like any other rock, though this one was recently sentient and trying to murder you.
target: 撇开最近这块石头对你的刺杀行为外，它看起来和其他石头一模一样。

source: Unpleasantly large and sharp for a canine's claw.
target: 这只爪子对于犬科动物而言大得反常，也锋利得吓人。

source: Small and bloodshot. Its dead gaze still burns your skin.
target: 小而充血。它死去后的凝视仍灼痛着你的皮肤。

source: It still drips venom and crackles with magical energy.
target: 它仍滴着毒液，魔法能量在上面噼啪作响。

source: Brilliantly white, but surrounded by blackest magic.
target: 亮白色的牙齿，周身却萦绕着黑色的魔法。

source: Translucent and delicate-looking, but surprisingly durable.
target: 半透明的翅膀看起来很脆，实际上你会发现它异常的坚韧。

source: Weightless and glowing; not your usual dust.
target: 不同于通常意义上的灰尘，这些粉尘毫无重量并发出阵阵光芒。

source: Metal gloves protecting the hands up to the middle of the lower arm.
target: 臂铠保护你的手至前臂的中间部分。

source: Gems can be sold for money or used in arcane rituals.
target: 宝石可用来卖钱或用于法术仪式。

source: Light gloves which do not seriously hinder finger movements, while still protecting the hands somewhat.
target: 轻便的手套不仅不影响手指的活动，还会多多少少保护手的安全。

source: A suit of armour made of mail.
target: 一套由金属环扣做成的锁甲。

source: Heavy boots, with metal strips at the toes, heels and other vulnerable parts, to better protect the wearer's feet from harm.
target: 重靴，用金属覆盖着脚趾、脚后跟和其他重要部位，保护穿戴者的足部免受伤害。

source: A large helmet that can protect the entire head. Ventilation and bad vision can be a problem, however.
target: 一顶巨大的头盔可以保护你的整个头部。不过，空气流通和较差的视野是一个问题。

source: Rings make your fingers look great!
target: 戒指让你的手指更加美丽！

source: Amulets make your neck look great!
target: 项链让你的脖子更加美丽！

source: A belt that goes around your waist.
target: 一条可以围住腰的皮带。

source: A pair of boots made of leather.
A suit of armour made of leather.
target: 一套用皮革制成的皮甲。

source: Light up the dark places of the world!
A brass container with a wick emerging from it, protected from draughts by a sheet of greased paper. It can be carried by a handle.
target: 一个黄铜容器，灯芯从中伸出，用一张涂油的纸挡风。它有一只把手，可以提着。

source: A normal brass lantern, enhanced by alchemy to make it brighter.
target: 一个普通的黄铜灯笼，炼金的力量增强了它的亮度。

source: Made by the Dwarves, this lantern provides light in the darkest recesses of the earth.
target: 矮人制造，这种灯笼可以在地底深处提供足够的光线。

target: 一首由……巨魔？所写的诗歌

target: 一首由……死灵法师？所写的诗歌

target: 一首写给某个盗贼的诗歌？

target: 如何成为死灵法师，第%d章

target: 如何成为强大的死灵法师!

target: “尘归尘”，不死猎人指南，作者：阿斯拉伯·波利斯

target: 不死猎人指南，作者：阿斯拉伯·波利斯

target: 猎魔人指南第一部分：怎样辨别法师

target: 猎魔人指南第三部分：如何杀死法师

target: 包含了一些手札的纸片。

target: 一套用金属片制成的板甲。

source:
Mindstars are natural products. Natural gems covered in living matter, they are used to focus the mental powers of all nature defenders and psionics.
Using mindstars in the offhand does not incur the normal offhand damage penalty.
target:
灵晶是天然产物。它们是覆盖着生命物质的天然宝石，用来凝聚所有自然守护者和灵能者的精神力量。
副手装备灵晶不会受到通常的副手伤害惩罚。

source: All that glitters is not gold; all that is gold does not glitter.
target: 发光的不都是金子，金子不都是发光的。

source: Ancient Tome titled 'Gems and their uses'
Magical potions can have wildly different effects, from healing to killing you -- beware! Most of them function better with a high Magic score.
target: 魔法药水具有许多不同的效果，有的可以治疗你，有的可以杀死你——小心！它们中的大部分的效果随魔力值提升。

source:
Carved with runes of power, this staff seems to have been made long ago, yet it bears no signs of tarnish.
Light around it seems to dim and you can feel its tremendous power simply by touching it.
target: 杖身铭刻着符文，这根法杖似乎是很久以前制造的，虽然它毫无侵蚀的痕迹。它周围的光线会变的暗淡，当你触摸它时可以感受到惊人的魔力。

source: This power seems too much to wield; you fear it might absorb YOU.
target: 这件装备的力量太强大了，你害怕它会把你吸收进去。

source: You cannot bring yourself to drop the %s

The orb projects images of distant places, some that seem to be not of this world, switching rapidly.
If used near a portal it could probably activate it.
target: 这个球体可以折射出远处的景象并快速的切换着，有些景象甚至不属于这个世界。如果你在传送点附近使用它，它可能会激活传送。

source: There is no portal to activate here.
target: 这里没有可用的传送门。

source: #VIOLET#The world twists sickeningly around you and you find yourself someplace unexpected! It felt nothing like your previous uses of the Orb of Many Ways. Tannen must have switched the Orb out for a fake!
target: #VIOLET#你周围的世界发生了扭曲，之后你发现你自己出现在了意料之外的地方。这和之前你使用多元水晶球时的情形完全不同，泰恩肯定用假水晶球掉了包！

source: It felt nothing like your previous uses of the Orb of Many Ways. Tannen must have switched the Orb out for a fake!
target: 这和之前你使用多元水晶球时的情形完全不同，泰恩肯定用假水晶球掉了包！

source: Dark visions fill your mind as you lift the orb. It is cold to the touch.
target: 当你拿起这个水晶球时，无尽的黑暗扑面而来。这个球摸上去冰凉。

source: This orb is warm to the touch.
target: 这个水晶球摸起来很暖和。

source: Flames swirl on the icy surface of this orb.
target: 火焰在覆满了冰霜的水晶球上旋转。

source: Visions of death and destruction fill your mind as you lift this orb.
target: 当你拿起这个水晶球时，你眼前浮现出死亡和毁灭的景象。

source: This orb will automatically identify items you find.
target: 这颗水晶球会自动鉴定你找到的物品。

source:
This rod is made entirely of voratun, infused with raw magical energies that can bend space itself.
You have heard of such items before. They are very useful to adventurers, allowing faster travel.
target: 这个法杖通体用沃瑞钽打造，充满了可以撕裂空间的奥术能量。你以前曾听说过此类物品。它们对于冒险者的快速旅行非常有帮助。

source: recall the user to the worldmap after 40 turns
target: 传送至世界地图（等待40回合）

source: The rod emits a strange noise, glows briefly and returns to normal.
target: 法杖发出奇怪的响声，闪了下光又恢复了正常。

source: Space around you starts to dissolve...
target: 你周围的空间开始消解...

source: The Fortress Shadow warned you that trying to force a recall without finding the portal back could break the exploratory farportal forever.
target: 堡垒之影警告你，如果尚未找到返回传送门便尝试强制返回，可能会永久损坏探索用远古传送门。

source: You found a Rod of Recall. You can use it to quickly get out of your current zone and return to the worldmap.
target: 你找到了一根回归之杖。你可以用它快速离开当前区域，返回世界地图。

source:
This chest is an extension of old Sher'tul places of power. Any items dropped inside are transported to an other place, processed and destroyed to extract energy.
The byproduct of this effect is the creation of gold, which is useless to process, so it is sent back to you.

When you possess the chest all items you walk upon will automatically be put inside and transmogrified when you leave the level.
Simply go to your inventory to move them out of the chest if you wish to keep them.
Items in the chest will not encumber you.
target:
这只宝箱是某个夏·图尔古代建筑的延伸，任何扔在里面的物品会被自动传送到那个地方，进行处理并摧毁，从里面提取能量。
这个过程的副产物是黄金，因为没有用，所以被自动传送给你。

当你有这只箱子时，所有你经过地面上的物品会被自动捡起，并且当你离开该层时会自动转化。
如果你想保留物品，只需要从宝箱里把它移到包裹中。在宝箱中的物品不会增加你的负重。

source: transmogrify all the items in your chest at once (also done automatically when you change level)
target: 立即转化盒子中的所有物品（当你切换地图时也会自动转化）

source: Make the Transmogrification Chest the default item's destroyer?
target: 将转化之盒作为默认的物品处理装置吗？

source: You do not have any items to transmogrify in your chest or on the floor.
target: 你的宝箱内和地板上没有任何需要转化的物品。

target: 转化地上的所有%s个物品？

source: Transmogrify all %s item(s) in your chest?
target: 转化盒子内的所有%s个物品？

target: 魔法卷轴有各种各样不同的效果！

source: Natural infusions may be grafted onto your body, granting you an on-demand nature talent.
target: 自然纹身可以烙印在你的身上，赋予你一个可按需使用的自然系技能。

source: inscribe your skin with the infusion
Magical runes may be inscribed onto your body, granting you an on-demand spell talent.
target: 魔法符文可以铭刻在你身上，赋予你一个可按需使用的法术技能。

source: inscribe your skin with the rune
target: 将符文铭刻在你的皮肤上

source: Corrupted taints may be inscribed onto your body, granting you an on-demand ability.
target: 堕落印记可以铭刻在你身上，赋予你一个可按需使用的能力。

source: inscribe your skin with the taint
target: 将印记铭刻在你的皮肤上
这张卷轴里包含了一些手札。

source: Slings are used to hurl stones or metal shots at your foes.
target: 投石索用来向敌人投掷石质或金属子弹。

source: Shots are used with slings to pummel your foes to death.
target: 弹丸配合投石索使用，用来把敌人砸死。

source: Telos was an extremely powerful mage during the Age of Dusk, hated by his peers and feared by the common folk; he was hunted for a long while. He finally fell from his place of power, Telmur, but his spirit still lingers.
target: 泰勒斯是黄昏纪的一位极其强大的法师，为同侪所嫉恨，为平民所惧怕；他被追捕了很长时间。最终他陨落于他的权力之地——泰尔玛，但他的灵魂依然徘徊不去。

source: turn into a corrupted losgoroth (poison, disease, cut and confusion immune; converts half damage into life drain; does not require breath) for 10 turns
target: 转变为一只堕落的洛斯格罗斯(毒素、疾病、撕裂和混乱免疫)十回合，转换一半伤害为生命吸收，不需要呼吸。

source: %s brandishes %s %s, turning into a corrupted losgoroth!
target: %s挥动%s%s，转化成了一只堕落洛斯格罗斯！

source: Staves designed for wielders of magic, by the greats of the art.
target: 由魔法技艺大师为魔法使用者设计的法杖。

source: Torques are made by powerful psionics to store psionic powers.
target: 项圈由强大的灵能者制造，用来储存灵能。

source: Natural totems are made by powerful wilders to store nature power.
target: 自然图腾是由自然守护者们制造，用以储存自然能量的。

source: Magical wands are made by powerful Alchemists and Archmagi to store spells. Anybody can use them to release the spells.
target: 魔杖被炼金术师和大法师用来储存法术。任何人可以用它来释放储存的法术。

source: A pointy cloth hat, very wizardly...
target: 一顶法师风格的尖帽子……
召唤卷轴（召唤珠宝匠利米尔）

source: summon Limmir the jeweler at the center of the lake of the moon
target: 在月之湖中心召唤珠宝匠利米尔

source: Pendant of the Sun and Moons
This small pendant depicts a hematite moon eclipsing a golden sun and according to legend was worn by one of the Sunwall's founders.
target: 一个小小的垂饰，雕刻着红月吞日的图案。传说其主人是太阳堡垒的建立者之一。

source: All your damage is converted and split into light and darkness.
target: 你造成的所有伤害被转化均分为光系和暗影伤害。
闪耀着金色光芒的盾牌

source: When Elmio Panason, captain of the Vanguard, first sought shelter for his shipwrecked crew, he reflected the last rays of the setting sun off his shield.  Where the beam hit they rested and built the settlement that would become the Sunwall.  In the dark days that followed the shield became a symbol of hope for a better future.
target: 当冲锋队队长艾米奥·帕纳森为他的遇难船员们寻求庇护所的时候，他的盾牌反射着落日的光辉。他们在光辉照耀的地方休息宿营，之后太阳堡垒在那里成立。在随后那些暗无天日的日子里，这面盾牌被人们当做美好未来希望的象征。

source: Glows brightly in the light of dawn.

The master blood mage Ru'Khan was the first orc to experiment with the power of the Sher'Tul farportals in the Age of Pyre.  However, that first experiment was not particularly successful, and after the explosion of energy all that could be found of Ru'Khan was a pair of scorched boots.
target: 血魔导师鲁·克汉是烈火纪第一个使用夏·图尔远程传送门进行试验的兽人。试验不是很成功，能量爆炸后，只剩下了一双烧焦的靴子。

source: A small rock that seems from beyond this world, vibrating with a fierce energy.  It feels warped and terrible and evil... and yet oh so powerful.
target: 这块小石头看起来不是这个世界的，它不时产生着激烈的能量震动，让人感到扭曲、可怕、邪恶……而又强大的能量。
一件闪着微光的白色斗篷

source: Untouched by the ravages of time, this fine spun white cloak appears to be crafted of an otherworldly material that shifts and shimmers in the light.
target: 这件精致的白色斗篷由异界材料制成，随光线变化而闪烁，永恒如新。

source:
This deep red sword weeps blood continuously. It was born in the labs of the orcish corrupter Hurik, who sought to make a crystal that would house his soul after death. But his plans were disrupted by a band of sun paladins, and though most died purging his keep of dread minions, their leader Raasul fought through to Hurik's lab, sword in hand. There the two did battle, blade against blood magic, till both fell to the floor with weeping wounds. The orc with his last strength crawled towards his fashioned phylactery, hoping to save himself, but Raasul saw his plans and struck the crystal with his light-bathed sword. It shattered, and in the sudden impulse of energies the steel, crystal and blood were fused into one.
Now the broken fragments of Raasul's soul are trapped in this terrible artifact, his mind warped beyond all sanity by decades of imprisonment. Only the taste of blood calls him forth, his soul stealing the lifeblood of others to take on physical form again, that he may thrash and wail against the living.
target:
这把深红色的剑不断的向下滴血。它诞生于兽人堕落者胡里克的实验室。最初，胡里克寻找了一枚水晶来制造他的命匣，但他的计划很快被一群太阳骑士打断，尽管大部分骑士死于不死军团的阻拦，但骑士团团长瑞苏尔却单枪匹马杀入了胡里克的实验室。在那里，两位强者展开了对决，利剑与血魔法你来我往，直到他们都重伤倒地。兽人想拼尽最后一分力气，拿到他的命匣，希望能拯救自己，但是瑞苏尔识破了他的阴谋，挥起沐浴着圣光的利剑击碎了水晶。命匣破碎的瞬间，钢铁、水晶与鲜血融为了一体。
如今，瑞苏尔残破的灵魂被困在这件可怕的造物中，数十年的囚禁早已扭曲了他的心智。只有鲜血的味道能唤醒他，他的灵魂窃取他人的生命之血以重获形体，好向生者咆哮哀嚎。

source: 15% chance to animate a bleeding foe's blood

A haze of blood, vibrant and pulsing through the air, possessed by a warped and cracked soul. Every now and then a scream or wail of agony garbles through it, telling of the mindless suffering undergone by its possessor.
target: 一团血雾在空气中鲜艳地搏动翻涌，被一个扭曲破碎的灵魂所占据。时不时有痛苦的尖叫或哀嚎从雾中传出，诉说着其占据者所遭受的无意识苦难。

source: #GOLD#As the blade touches %s's spilt blood, the blood rises, animated!
target: #GOLD#饮血剑接触到%s喷出的血液，血液开始活化，动了起来!

source: #GOLD#%s draws power from the spilt blood!
Said to have been forged in the earliest days of the Sunwall, this longsword shines with the light of daybreak, capable of banishing all shadows.
target: 传说是在太阳堡垒成立之初打造，这把长剑闪耀着黎明破晓之光，可以破除一切黑暗。

source: invoke dawn, inflicting %0.2f light damage in radius %d (based on Magic) and lighting the area within radius %d
target: 激发黎明的光芒，在半径%d内造成%0.2f光系伤害（基于魔法），并照明%d码。

source: %s raises %s and sends out a burst of light!
#GOLD#You feel a swell of positive energy!
If the sun doesn't set, dawn's power lasts forever.
target: 如果太阳永不落山，黎明的光辉将永恒。

source: #GOLD#As you wield the sword and shield of the Sunwall, you feel the Sun's light radiating from your core.
target: #GOLD#当你握住太阳堡垒的剑与盾，你感觉到从你身体内部散发出太阳的光辉。

source: #GOLD#You feel the Sun's light vanish from within you.
target: #GOLD#你感受到太阳的光辉从你的身体里流失了。

source: This small broken hourglass hangs from a thin gold chain.  The glass is cracked and the sand has long since escaped.
target: 这个坏掉的小沙漏系在一根金子做的细链上。沙漏的玻璃被打破了，里面的沙子早就掉光了。
弯曲的锯齿状黑色匕首

source: This obsidian-crafted, curved blade is studded with the deadly fangs of the Ungolmor. It seems to drain light from the world around it.
target: 这把黑曜石打造的利刃镶嵌有阿格尔莫的致命毒牙。光明在它周围消逝，无尽的黑暗缠绕着它。

source: inflicts spydric poison dealing 200 damage over 3 turns and pinning the target
target: 使目标感染蜘蛛毒素，在3回合内造成200伤害，并定身目标。

source: A simple, rudely crafted stone hilt, this object manifests a blade of wavering, nearly invisible force, like a heat haze, as you grasp it. Despite its simple appearance, it is capable of shearing through solid granite, in the hands of those with the necessary mental fortitude to use it properly.
target: 这是一只粗糙雕琢的石制剑柄，当你握住它时，它会显现出一道摇曳的、近乎无形的力场刀刃，如同热浪一般。尽管外观简陋，但在意志足够坚定、懂得正确使用它的人手中，它可以切穿坚硬的花岗岩。

source: fire a bolt of kinetic force (range %d), dealing 150%% (physical) weapon damage
target: 发射一发动能之力（范围 %d），造成150%%（物理）武器伤害。

source: The %s fires a bolt of kinetic force!
A plain looking ceremonial rod. It has connections with Time that even chronomancers do not yet understand.
target: 看上去普普通通的法杖，但是它和时间的神秘联系连时空法师都不清楚。

source: A powerful staff sent in secret to Angolwen by the Shaloren, to aid their fighting of the plagues following the Spellblaze. Its power is not to harm, but to heal and protect.
target: 永恒精灵秘密送往安格利文的强大法杖，用于帮助他们对抗魔法大爆炸后蔓延的瘟疫。它的力量并非用于伤害，而是治愈与守护。

source: cure up to %d diseases or poisons (based on Magic)
target: 治愈至多%d项疾病和毒素。(基于魔法)

source: #DARK_GREEN#You feel the cleansing power of Penitence attune to you.
target: #DARK_GREEN#你感受到忏悔法杖的净化力量与你共鸣。
大法师泰尔兰丢失的法杖

source: Archmage Tarelion travelled the world in his youth. But the world is not a nice place and it seems he had to run fast.
target: 大法师泰尔兰在年轻的时候曾环游世界。但是这个世界并不是那么美好以至于我们的大法师不得不飞速逃跑。

source: This ancient charm still retains a distant echo of the destruction wrought by the Spellblaze
target: 当你戴上这个古老的项链，似乎耳边仍回荡着魔法大爆炸的回响。

source: unleash a destructive wail, destroying terrain and dealing %0.2f physical damage (based on Magic) in a radius of %d
target: 释放毁灭哀嚎，摧毁地形，造成 %0.2f 物理伤害 (基于魔法) 伤害半径 %d

source: A thick steel gorget designed to protect its wearer from fatal attacks to the neck.  This particular gorget was worn by the Halfling General Daneth Tendermourn during the pyre wars, and judging by the marks along its surface may have saved the General's life on more than one occasion.
target: 一个厚重的钢护喉，旨在保护其穿着者颈部免受致命攻击。这个特殊的护喉是半身人将军丹纳斯·坦德莫恩在烈火战争中佩戴过的，上面的各种伤痕表明其可能救过这位将军不止一次。

source: In the aftermath of the Spellblaze, the Thaloren had to defend their forests against foes and fires alike. Many of the trees died despite the efforts of the Elves to save them. Their wood was fashioned into a bow to be wielded against the darkness.
target: 在魔法大爆炸的余波里，自然精灵不得不从敌人和大火中保卫他们的森林。尽管精灵们奋力的抢救它们，许多树还是死掉了。它们的遗体被打造成一张弓用来抵御黑暗的侵袭。

source: #DARK_GREEN#You understand this bow-and its connection to nature-in a way few can.
target: #DARK_GREEN#你理解了这把弓——以及它和自然的联系——这是很多人无法理解的。

source: A lost artifact of the Age of Dusk, the Corpsebow is filled with a lingering essence of that era's terrible plagues. Those struck by arrows fired from its rotten string find themselves afflicted by echoes of ancient sickness.
target: 一件黄昏纪遗失的武器，腐尸之弓浑身缠绕着那个时代的瘟疫精华。被腐朽弓弦射出的箭所击中的人，会因古老疾病在体内的共鸣而倍受折磨。

source: #DARK_BLUE#You feel a kindred spirit in this bow...
target: #DARK_BLUE#你在弓中感受到了共鸣的灵魂…

source: Mages sometimes have funny ideas. Archmage Varil once learned how to handle a sword and found he preferred wielding it instead of his staff.
target: 法师总是时不时冒出古怪的点子。大法师沃利尔曾学会了怎样擎起一柄剑，同时发现自己对耍剑比玩法杖更感冒。

source: Farian was King Toknor's captain, and fought by his side in the great Battle of Last Hope.  However, when he returned after the battle to find his hometown burnt in an orcish pyre, a madness overtook him.  The desire for vengeance made him quit the army and strike out on his own, lightly armoured and carrying nought but his sword.  Most thought him dead until the reports came back of a fell figure tearing through the orcish encampments, slaughtering all before him and mercilessly butchering the corpses after.  It is said his blade drank the blood of 100 orcs each day until finally all of Maj'Eyal was cleared of their presence.  When the final orc was slain and no more were to be found, Farian at the last turned the blade on himself and stuck it through his chest.  Those nearby said his body shook with convulsions as he did so, though they could not tell whether he was laughing or crying.
target: 法瑞安曾是图库纳国王的指挥官，在最后希望的伟大战役中跟随国王并肩作战。然而，当战争结束，凯旋归来之时，他却发现故乡处处燃烧着兽人的火焰，无边的怒火吞噬了他。复仇的欲望使他离开军队，孤身一人踏上了征程，他除了护甲之外只带了一柄剑。大多数人认为他已经死了。直到有消息称有一个毁灭者般的身影正在摧残兽人的营地，他屠杀了所有见到的兽人并残忍的肢解对方的尸体。据说他每天要用100个兽人的鲜血来祭刀直到杀光马基·埃亚尔的兽人。当最后一个兽人被杀死并且没有发现更多的时候，法瑞安最终把利刃转向了自己——那把剑刺穿了他的胸膛。那些在附近的目击者说，当法瑞安这样做的时候身体伴随着阵阵痉挛，他们说不清他到底是哭是笑。

source: A thick staff with a heavy knob on the end.  It was said to be used by the grand alchemist Bolbum in the Age of Allure.  Much renowned is the fear of his students for their master, and the high rate of cranial injuries amongst them.  Bolbum died with seven daggers in his back and his much-cursed staff went missing after.
target: 这是一根末端有着厚重门扣的沉重法杖。据说是炼金魔导师鲍尔本在厄流纪使用的法杖。它之所以闻名于世，大部分来源于鲍尔本的学生们对他的恐惧以及被它打伤脑袋的超高几率。鲍尔本被7把匕首插在后背而死，那根被众人诅咒的法杖也从此消失不见。
一颗散发着柔和光芒的水晶

source:
Said to have once belonged to Inquisitor Marcus Dunn during the Spellhunt this fist sized quartz crystal glows constantly with a soft white light and was rumoured to be a great aid in meditation, helping focus the mind, body, and soul of the owner as well as protecting them from the foulest of magics.
It seems somebody well versed in antimagic could use it to its fullest potential.
target:
曾经属于魔法狩猎时期的检察官玛库斯·丹。这个拳头大小的石英晶体不断散发出柔和的白光。而且据说对冥想有相当大的帮助，不但可以帮助集中精神、身体，还可以保护持有者的灵魂，并且保护他们免遭邪恶魔法的侵蚀。
似乎只有拥有反魔力量的人才能发挥它的全部潜能。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel a great hero guiding you!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你感到有个伟大的英雄在指引着你！

source: A sling with an inscription on its handle: 'May the wielder be granted cunning in his fight against the darkness'.
target: 投石器的把手上有一段铭文：“愿持有者在对抗黑暗之时被赐予机智。”

source: When dropping below 30% max HP, you gain 20% attack speed, lose 100% fatigue, and your shots don't consume ammo for 5 turns. 30 turns cd.
target: 当你的生命值低于最大生命值的30%时，在5回合内你获得20%攻击速度、100%疲劳减免，且射击不消耗弹药。冷却时间30回合。

source: During the invasion of Eldoral the Halfling Rogue Herah is said to have slain over one hundred orcs while defending a group of refugees.
target: 据说在艾德瑞尔战争中，半身人盗贼赫拉在保护一群难民时杀死了100多个兽人。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#Herah's guile and luck is with you, her successor!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#Herah的狡诈和幸运与你同在，她的继承人！
