source: This thick-set mace was used by the Spellhunter Vorlan, who crafted it from the wood of an ancient oak that was uprooted during the Spellblaze.  Many were the wizards and witches felled by this weapon, brought to justice for the crimes they committed against nature.
target: 这把加粗的权杖曾属于猎魔人沃尔兰，他从一棵在魔法大爆炸中被连根拔起的古老橡树中取材制造了它。众多法师和女巫倒在了这把武器之下，他们对自然犯下的罪行得到了制裁。

source:
These wickedly spiked gauntlets belonged to an orc captain in the Age of Pyre who conquered the western sands, using them as a base to lay raids on Elvala to the south.  Known as The Scorpion, he seemed unconquerable in battle, able to pull enemies towards him with vicious mental force and lay down lethal blows on them.  Often a flurry of these yellow and black gauntlets would be the last thing great Shaloren mages would see before having the life crushed from them.

Finally The Scorpion was defeated by the alchemist Nessylia, who went to face the fiendish orc alone.  The captain pulled the elf towards him with a brutish cackle, but before he could batter the life from her flesh she tore off her robes, revealing eighty incendiary bombs strapped to her flesh.  With a spark from her fingers she triggered an explosion that could be seen for miles around.  To this day Nessylia is still remembered in song for the sacrifice of her immortal life to protect her people.
target: 这副锋利的尖刺拳套属于一位烈火纪的兽人队长，他曾征服西部沙地，并以这片被征服的沙地为基地，对埃尔瓦拉发动了数次袭击。他外号沙蝎，在战场上所向披靡，他能以凶狠的精神力量将敌人拉近，然后对其施以致命的打击。通常永恒精灵法师们在死前看到的最后物品，便是这副黄黑相间的拳套残影。最终沙蝎在决斗中，被炼金术师奈瑟莉亚击败。当这副拳套的主人将精灵拉向他，还没来得及将她撕成两半时，精灵掀开了她的长袍——下面捆着的是八十枚炼金炸弹。精灵指尖的火花，引发了数里外都能看到的大爆炸。直到今天，民间仍流传着奈瑟莉亚为保护她的子民而牺牲的诗歌。

source: When the enchanter Razeen was cornered by Spellhunters near the Daikara mountain pass she wrapped her cloak about her and fled down a narrow ravine.  The hunters fired volley after volley of arrows at her, but by miracle or magic they all missed.  Razeen was able to escape and flee to the hidden city in the west.
target: 当魔法师瑞兹恩被猎魔人在岱卡拉的山隘逼入绝境时，她用斗篷包裹着自己逃下了峡谷。猎手们接连不断的把箭射向她，但由于奇迹或是魔法，他们全部射空了。瑞兹恩得以逃生并躲进了西部的隐秘之城。

source: Gwai, a Pyromanceress that lived during the Spellhunt, was cornered by group of mage hunters. She fought to her last breath and is said to have killed at least ten people with this wand before she fell.
target: 戈瓦，一个生活在魔法狩猎时的火焰术士，她被一群猎魔人逼入了绝境。她战斗至最后一刻，据说在她流尽最后一滴血之前她用这把魔杖干掉了至少十人。

source: shoot a cone of flames (radius %d) for %0.2f fire damage (based on Magic)
target: 发射长度 %d 的锥形火焰，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害（基于魔法）。

source: The killing of Kroltar, mightiest of wyrms, took seven months and the lives of 20,000 dwarven warriors.  Finally the beast was worn down and mastersmith Gruxim, standing atop the bodies of his fallen comrades, was able slit its throat with this axe crafted purely for the purpose of penetrating the wyrm's hide.
target: 对最强大的巨龙库洛塔的猎杀持续了七个月，并夺走了两万名矮人战士的生命。最终这头巨兽被消磨殆尽，工匠大师格鲁克西姆站在倒下战友的尸体之上，用这把专为穿透龙皮而锻造的战斧割开了它的喉咙。

source: A hand axe carved out of the most frozen parts of the northern wasteland.
target: 用北部荒原的寒冰之核雕成的手斧。

source: A closer look at this pure white crystal reveals that it is really a plethora of colors swirling and scintillating.
target: 近距离欣赏这颗纯净的白水晶，你会发现很多种颜色在上面盘旋闪耀。

source: You fix the crystal on the %s and create the %s.
target: 你将水晶安装在%s，制造了%s。

source: #CRIMSON#Telos's gem seems to flare and glows an unearthly colour.
target: #CRIMSON#泰勒斯的宝石闪耀着，发出非自然的光辉。
泰勒斯傀儡 (%s不情愿的追随者)

source: #ROYAL_BLUE#The golem decides to change it's name to #{bold}#%s#{normal}#.
A closer look at this pure white staff reveals that it is really a plethora of colors swirling and scintillating.
target: 对这根纯净的白色法杖近距离欣赏会发现很多种颜色在上面盘旋闪耀。

source: The simplest of belts, worn for centuries by Nessilla Tantaelen as she tended to her people and forests. Some of her wisdom and power have settled permanently into its fibers.
target: 最朴素的腰带，被奈希拉·坦泰兰在照料她的人民和森林期间穿戴了几个世纪。这条腰带永久的保存了她的部分智慧和力量。

source: #DARK_GREEN#Nessilla's belt seems to come alive as you put it on.
target: #DARK_GREEN#当你穿上它时，奈希拉之腰带似乎活过来了。

source: Ages ago this belt was worn by Linaniil herself in her youth, using its power she shielded herself from the Spellblaze rain of fire, but naught could she do for her sister Neira.
target: 许多年前这根腰带是年轻时的莱娜尼尔穿戴的，在魔法大爆炸的火焰之中它的力量保护了她，但却保护不了她的姐妹尼耶拉。

source: surround yourself with a magical shield (strength %d, based on Magic) for %d turns
target: 制造一层魔法护盾（强度%d，基于魔法），持续%d回合。

source: supple leather armour entwined with willow bark
target: 与柳树皮交织的柔韧皮甲

source: Worn by Protector Ardon, who first formed the Ziguranth during the mage wars between the Humans and the Halflings.  This armour is infused with the powers of nature, and protected against the disruptive forces of magic.
target: 曾被守护者阿尔登穿着，他在魔法战争中首次于人类和半身人之间建立了伊格兰斯。这件护甲灌注了大自然的力量，能够抵御魔法的破坏之力。
隐隐放光的沃瑞钽板甲

source: Beautifully detailed with images of King Toknor's defence of Last Hope. Despair fills the hearts of even the blackest villains at the sight of it.
target: 精细描绘着国王图库纳为最后的希望浴血的影像。即便是彻头彻尾的恶棍看到它，心底也会充满深深的绝望。

source:
A thin voratun blade with an ivory handle wrapped in purple cloth.  The weapon is nearly as legendary as its former owner, Marcus Dunn, and was thought to have been destroyed after Marcus was slain near the end of the Spellhunt.
It seems somebody well versed in antimagic could use it to its fullest potential.
target:
一把沃瑞钽长剑，象牙的剑柄被紫色的布包裹着。这把兵器的传奇性跟它上一任拥有者玛库斯·丹差不多了，人们都以为这把剑在魔法狩猎末期玛库斯被害的时候被摧毁了。
据说只有将全身心奉献给反魔法事业的人才能充分发挥它的力量。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel a great hero watching over you!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你感到有位伟大的英雄正在注视着你！

source:
A long slender staff, made of ancient dragon-bone, with runes emblazoned all over its surface in bright silver.
It hums faintly, as if great power is locked within, yet alone it seems incomplete.
target: 一根又细又长的法杖，由远古龙骨制成，它通体铭刻着银色的符文。它会发出微弱的嗡嗡声，似乎有一股强大的力量被锁在了里面，整体来看，它似乎是不完整的。

source: A true understanding of the arcane is needed to release its full power.
target: 只有理解奥术才能完全使用它的力量。

source: #STEEL_BLUE#You feel a swell of arcane energy.
target: #STEEL_BLUE#你感受到一股奥术能量在膨胀。

source:
A traditional pointed wizard's hat, made of fine purple elven-silk and decorated with bright silver runes. You sense it has been passed from ancient times, and has been born on the heads of great mages.
Touching the cloth you feel a sense of knowledge and power from bygone ages, yet it is partly sealed away, waiting for a trigger to release it.
target:
一只传统巫师的尖帽子，由精美的紫色精灵丝绸制成，装饰着亮银色的符文。你感觉到它曾经被众多伟大的法师戴在头上。
通过触摸你可以感受到远古的知识和能量，但仍有一部分被密封着，等待有缘人来释放它。

source: Only supremacy of the arcane can release its full power.
target: 只有奥术至尊才能完全发挥它的力量。
#STEEL_BLUE#围绕着你的奥术能量消退了。

source: Said to have been created by a powerful mage after his home was destroyed by a mob following the Spellblaze. Though he fled, his possessions were crushed, burned, and smashed. When he returned to the ruins, he made this amulet from the remains of his shattered mirror.
target: 据说由一位强大的法师制作，当时他的家园在魔法大爆炸后被暴民摧毁。虽然他逃走了，但他的财产被压碎、烧毁、砸烂。当他回到废墟时，他用破碎镜子的残骸制作了这枚护符。

source: create a reflective shield (50%% reflection rate, %d strength, based on Magic) for %d turns
target: 制造反射护盾（50%%反射率，%d吸收量，基于魔法）持续%d回合。
%s激活了%s，制造了一层反射护盾！

source: This cloak is made from the scales of an infamous Venom Drake that terrorized the country side towards the end of the Age of Dusk. It was slain by a party led by Kestin Highfin, who had this cloak fashioned personally.
target: 这件斗篷由一条恶名昭著的毒龙的鳞片制成，黄昏纪末年，那条毒龙曾肆虐乡间。它被科斯汀·赫菲因率领的小队杀死，而赫菲因亲自让人制作了这件斗篷。

source: This jagged crystal glows with an unnatural light. A strap of cloth is wrapped around one end, as a handle.
target: 这块锯齿状的水晶放射出异常的亮光，它的一端绑着几圈布条当作握把。

source: This dagger was used by a nameless healer during the Age of Dusk. The plagues that ravaged his town were beyond the ability of mortal man to treat, so he took to using his dagger to as an act of mercy when faced with hopeless patients. Despite his good intentions, it is now cursed with dark power, letting it kill in a single stroke against those already weakened.
target: 这柄匕首曾被黄昏纪一名无名的治疗师使用。瘟疫袭击了城镇，而医者终究是凡人，他只能用这柄匕首结束那些绝望的病人的痛苦。尽管初衷是好的，这柄匕首现在已经被黑暗力量污染，用它伤害虚弱的敌人威力更大。

source: deals 60 physical damage increased by 1% for each 1% life the target has lost
target: 造成60物理伤害。敌人每失去1%生命值，伤害增加1%。

source: Expertly hewn from the bark of trees, this wooden armor provides excellent protection at a low weight.
target: 由树皮制成，做工相当精巧，重量很轻，却能提供很好的防护。

source: #DARK_GREEN#The armor molds comfortably to one of its caretakers.
target: #DARK_GREEN#护甲对看守者来说非常合身。

source: Air currents swirl around this bright blue jewel.
target: 空气在这块亮蓝色宝石周围旋转。
这个野性纹身已经进化了

source: This unique-looking staff is carved with runes of destruction.
target: 这个品相独特的法杖上刻印着毁灭符文。

source: This azure ring seems to be always moist to the touch.
target: 这个海蓝色的戒指看上去总是水汪汪的。

source: summon a radius %d tidal wave that expands slowly over %d turns, dealing %0.2f cold and %0.2f physical damage (based on Willpower) each turn, knocking opponents back, and lowering their stun resistance
target: 召唤缓慢扩张的半径 %d 的潮汐，持续 %d 回合，每回合造成 %0.2f 寒冷和 %0.2f 物理伤害，击退敌人，并降低他们的震慑抗性。

source: %s brandishes %s, calling forth the might of the oceans!
This ring is imbued with powers from beyond the grave. It is said that those who wear it may find a new path when all other roads turn dim.
target: 这枚戒指充溢着坟墓的气息。据说佩戴它的人会在走投无路时发现新的道路。

source: Will bring you back from death, but only once!
target: 能将你从死亡边缘拯救1次

source: This ring shines with many colors.
target: 这枚戒指闪耀着多种不同的色彩。

source: All your damage is converted and split into arcane, fire, cold and lightning.
target: 你造成的所有伤害被转化均分为奥术、火焰、寒冷和闪电伤害。

source: The weight of the world seems a little lighter with this amulet around your neck.
target: 当你带着这个项链，似乎整个世界都轻飘飘的。

source: You can feel this strange metallic hand wriggling around, it feels as if space distorts around it.
target: 你能感受到这个奇怪的金属手在扭动着，似乎周围的空间被扭曲了。
一个用牙齿串成的项链

source: Hundreds of humanoid teeth have been strung together on multiple strands of thin leather, creating this tribal necklace.  One would have to assume that these are not the teeth of Garkul the Devourer but rather the teeth of Garkul's many meals.
target: 数以百计的人类牙齿被串在用多股皮革结成的绳索上，组成了这个部落项链。那些牙齿并非吞噬者加库尔自己的，而是来自于加库尔的食物。

source: Another of Garkul's heirlooms would bring out his spirit.
target: 另一件加库尔的遗物将唤醒他的英灵。

source: #CRIMSON#As you wear both Garkul's heirlooms you can feel the mighty warrior's spirit flowing through you.
target: #CRIMSON#当你穿上整套加库尔的遗物时，你感受到战士的精神流淌在你的身上。

source: A small crystal phial that captured Sunlight during the Summertide.
target: 一个小水晶瓶里捕获了夏日的阳光。

source: When attacking in melee, deals 15 light damage and lights tiles in radius 1.
target: 近战攻击时，在1码半径内造成15光系伤害并照亮区域。

source: call light, dispelling darkness and lighting tiles in radius 20.(%d power, based on Willpower)
target: 召唤阳光，驱除黑暗并照亮20格内的地面。（%d强度，基于意志）

source:
The first Halfling mages during the Age of Allure discovered how to capture the Sunlight and infuse gems with it.
This star is the culmination of their craft. Light radiates from its ever-shifting yellow surface.
target: 厄流纪最初的半身人法师们发现了如何捕捉日光并将其注入宝石。这颗星辰是他们工艺的结晶。光芒从其不断变幻的黄色表面放射出来。

source: %s brandishes the %s which radiates in all directions!
target: %s 挥舞着 %s，向各个方向辐射！

source: This dark red heart still beats despite being separated from its owner.  It also snuffs out any light source that comes near it.
target: 这颗暗红色的心脏虽然离开了它的主人，但仍在跳动着。它还会熄灭任何靠近它的光源。

source: The heart seems to absorb light when you deal darkness damage. Standing on unlit tiles, you feel stronger.
target: 这颗心脏在你造成黑暗伤害的时候会吸收光亮。站在未照亮的方格上，你会变得更强。

source: This vial of blood was drawn from an ancient race in the Age of Haze. Some of the power and vitality of those early days of the world still flows through it. "Drink me, mortal," the red liquid seems to whisper in your thoughts. "I will bring you light beyond darkness. Those who taste my essence fear not the death of flesh. Drink me, mortal, if you value your life..."
target: 这瓶血液是在混沌纪某个古老种族的身上抽取的。在那个世界的古老时代流动着的能量和生命，仍然在瓶子中流动。“喝下我吧，凡人”，这瓶红色的液体仿佛在你的耳边低语“我会给你带来超越黑暗的光芒。品尝我精华的人将永远不会害怕肉体的死亡。喝下我吧，凡人，如果你珍惜你的生命的话…”

source: quaff the Blood of Life to grant an extra life
target: 喝下生命之血以获得一次额外生命

source: #LIGHT_RED#You feel the Blood of Life rushing through your veins.
target: #LIGHT_RED#你感到生命之血涌入了你每一根血管。

source: The Blood of Life seems to have no effect on you.
target: 生命之血对你似乎没有什么作用。

source: The boots of a Rogue outcast, who knew that the best way to deal with a problem was to run from it.
target: 这双靴子属于一位流浪的盗贼，他处理麻烦的方法就是三十六计走为上计。
增加 %d%% 速度(基于灵巧)

source: This large shield was made using scales of many fire drakes from the lost land of Tar'Eyal.
target: 这个巨大的盾牌使用了很多生活在失落的大陆塔·埃亚尔的火龙的鳞片打造而成。

source: 30% chance that you'll breathe fire in a cone at the attacker (if within range 6).  This can only occur up to 4 times per turn.
target: 30% 几率向攻击者喷射锥形火焰（6格范围内）。该效果每回合最多触发4次。

source: This shield made of the darkest stralite is huge, heavy and very solid.
target: 这面用最深邃的蓝锆石打造的盾牌巨大、沉重且相当坚固。

source: Black, interwoven tendrils form this mesh that can be used as a shield. It reacts visibly to your touch, clinging to your arm and engulfing it in a warm, black mass.
target: 盾牌由许多黑色的触须交织而成。当你触摸它时，你可以感受它非常明显的反应，它缠绕住你的手臂并将其包裹在一团黑色而温暖的物质中。

source: Up to once per turn, pull an attacker up to 15 spaces away into melee range, pinning and asphyxiating it
target: 每回合一次，将15格内一名攻击者拉到身边，定身并使其窒息。

source: No rogue blades shall incapacitate the wearer of this armour.
target: 盗贼之刃将不能加于装备者之身。

source: Transfers a bleed, poison, or wound to its source or a nearby enemy every 4 turns.
target: 每4回合将一项流血、毒素或伤口效果转移给效果来源或者附近的敌人

source: #CRIMSON#Rogue Plight transfers an effect to its source!
target: #CRIMSON#刺客契约将一项效果转移给其来源!

source: #CRIMSON#Rogue Plight transfers an effect to a nearby enemy!
target: #CRIMSON#刺客契约将一项效果转移给周围敌人!

source: Dry and dusty to the touch, it still seems to retain some shadow of life.
target: 摸起来又干又布满灰尘，它看起来仍旧保存着一些生命的气息。

source: You cannot summon; you are suppressed!
target: 你不能召唤，你被压制了！

source: A Dwarven helm embedded with a single diamond that can banish all underground shadows.
target: 镶嵌着一颗钻石的矮人头盔，这颗宝石的光辉可以驱散地下一切阴影。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#The legacy of Dwarven Emperors grants you their wisdom.
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#矮人皇帝的传承将他们的智慧授予你。

source: A thin, dark dagger that seems to meld seamlessly into the shadows.
target: 一把纤细、暗色的匕首，似乎完全融入了阴影之中。

source: A viciously curved blade that a folk story says is made from a material that originates from the moon.  Devouring the light around it, it fades.
target: 一把弧形的匕首，传说是用取自月亮的材料打造的。它吞噬了周围的光芒，显得黯淡。

source: Deal 200%% of your Cunning as Darkness damage (%d).
target: 造成相当于你200%%灵巧值的暗影伤害(%d)。

source: The moon shines alone in a starless sky.
target: 没有星星的天空里，月亮显得非常孤单。

source: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#The two blades glow brightly as they are brought close together.
target: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#两把利刃互相靠近时发出耀眼的闪光。

source: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#The light from the two blades fades as they are separated.
target: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#两把利刃分开时耀眼的闪光消失了。

source: Legend tells of a blade, shining bright as a star. Forged from a material fallen from the skies, it glows.
target: 传说之刃，闪耀如星。由取自陨石的材料锻造而成，它散发着光芒。

source: Deal 200%% of your Dexterity as Light damage (%d).
target: 造成相当于你200%%敏捷值的光系伤害(%d)。

source: The star shines alone in a moonless sky.
target: 没有月亮的天空里，星星显得非常孤单。

source: A blade-edged ring that radiates power. As you put it on, strange thoughts of pain and destruction come to your mind.
target: 散发能量、边缘开刃的戒指。当你戴上它时，陌生的痛苦念头和毁灭的情景涌入你脑海。

source: A huge greatmaul of incredible weight. Wielding it, you feel utterly unstoppable.
target: 拥有难以想象重量的巨型大槌。挥舞它让你感觉势不可挡。

source: An oddly twisted club with a hefty weight on the end. There's something very strange about it.
target: 一根形态诡异的扭曲棍棒，末端坠着沉重的配重。它身上有些非常奇怪的东西。

source: Reduce targets accuracy and powers by 5 (stacks 5 times)
target: 降低目标命中和强度5，可叠加5次。

source: This set of robes is made wholly of spider silk. It looks outlandish and some sages think it came from another world, probably through a farportal.
target: 这套礼服完全用蛛丝制成。它看起来充满异国风情，一些智者推测它来自另一个世界，很可能穿越过时空之门。

source: As you wear the strange set of robes, you notice something folded into one of its pockets...
target: 当你穿上这套奇特的长袍，你注意到某个口袋里折叠着什么东西……

source: A visored steel helm, embossed and embellished with gold, that bears as its crest the head of Kroltar, the greatest of the fire drakes.
target: 一顶带护面的钢盔，饰以黄金浮雕，盔顶徽饰正是最伟大的火焰巨龙——库洛塔的头颅。

source: Kroltar's power resides in his scales.
target: 库洛塔的力量隐藏在他的鳞片里。

source: #GOLD#As the helm of Kroltar approaches the scale armour, they begin to fume and emit fire.
target: #GOLD#当库洛塔的头盔和鳞甲接触时，它们开始冒烟喷火了

source: This crown was worn by the Halfling king Roupar, who ruled over the Nargol lands in the Age of Dusk.  Those were dark times, and the king enforced order and discipline under the harshest of terms.  Any who deviated were punished, any who disagreed were repressed, and many disappeared without a trace into his numerous prisons.  All must be loyal to the crown or suffer dearly.  When he died without heir the crown was lost and his kingdom fell into chaos.
target: 半身人国王洛帕曾佩戴这顶王冠，他曾于黄昏纪统治着纳格尔大陆。那是黑暗的年代，国王通过最残暴的手段执行他的命令和法律。任何违背他思想的人都被严厉的惩罚，任何反对他的人都被无情的镇压，这些人大部分都无声无息的消失了——被关进了国王那不计其数的监狱里。所有人都必须表示忠诚或者付出昂贵的代价。他在没有子嗣的情况下死去，皇冠失踪的同时他的国家也陷入了混乱。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#As you don the %s, you gain understanding of the might of your race.
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#当你戴上%s，你感受到了你种族的力量。

source: These gloves make you feel rock steady! These magical gloves feel really soft to the touch from the inside. On the outside, magical stones create a rough surface that is constantly shifting. When you brace yourself, a magical ray of earth energy seems to automatically bind them to the ground, granting you increased stability.
target: 这副手套让你觉得坚如磐石！这双充满魔力的手套从里面摸起来无比松软。在其外，魔法石创造了一个不断转动的粗糙表面。当你振作精神，一束包含大地能量的魔法射线会将它自动扎根在地面上，赋予你更高的稳定性。
精工打造的矮人钢护手

source: Fashioned by Grand Smith Dakhtun in the Age of Allure, these dwarven-steel gauntlets have been etched with golden arcane runes and are said to grant the wearer unparalleled physical and magical might.
target: 厄流纪由大师级铁匠打造而成。那些矮人钢臂铠镂刻着晦涩难懂的金色符文，据说它们可以赋予穿戴者强大的魔武力量。

source: Voratun Hammer of the Deep Bellow

target: 被火烧焦的沃瑞钽之锤

source: The legendary hammer of the Dwarven master smiths. For ages it was used to forge powerful weapons with searing heat until it became highly powerful by itself.
target: 矮人神匠的传奇铁锤。由于年复一年的在高温下打造强力的武器，自身也变的相当强力。

source: Two large pieces of leather designed to be wrapped about the hands and the forearms.  This particular pair of wraps has been enchanted, imparting the wearer with great strength.
target: 两大块皮革被设计成包裹手和前臂。这副独特的护手经过了附魔，可给予穿戴者巨大的力量。

source: This would be great with a mighty matching belt.
target: 如果有一条相衬的腰带就好了。

source: This girdle is enchanted with mighty wards against expanding girth. Whatever the source of its wondrous strength, it will prove of great aid in the transport of awkward burdens.
target: 这条腰带被赋予了神秘的魔力来对抗膨胀的腰围。不管它蕴含着的是何种力量，它总是能在你负重不足时助你一臂之力。

source: Some giant wraps would make you feel great.
target: 集齐巨人的裹腕会让你感觉棒极了。

source: Cunning and malice seem to emanate from this cloak.
target: 这件斗篷散发着恶毒和狡诈的气息。

source:
An ancient set of robes that has survived from the Age of Allure. Primal magic forces inhabit it.
It was made by Humans for Humans; only they can harness the true power of the robes.
target: 这件古老的礼服从厄流纪保存了下来。上古的魔法力量占据着它。它由人类专门为人类制造；只有他们才能驾驭这件长袍的真正力量。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel as surge of power as you wear the vestments of the old Human Conclave!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#穿上这件人类孔克雷夫的古老法袍，你感到全身涌入了一股力量！

source: This fiery robe was worn by the mad pyromancer Halchot, who terrorised many towns in the late Age of Dusk, burning and looting villages as they tried to recover from the Spellblaze.  Eventually he was tracked down by the Ziguranth, who cut out his tongue, chopped off his head, and rent his body to shreds.  The head was encased in a block of ice and paraded through the streets of nearby towns amidst the cheers of the locals.  Only this robe remains of the flames of Halchot.
target: 这件炙热的长袍曾属于疯狂的烈焰术士哈克特。黄昏纪末期，他恐吓过许多城镇，在人们努力从魔法大爆炸中恢复之际烧杀抢掠村庄。最终他被伊格兰斯捕获了。伊格兰斯割下他的舌头，砍掉他的脑袋，并把他的身体撕成小块。他的脑袋被封在一个大冰块里，并且在附近城镇的居民欢庆中进行了游街。只有这件长袍从哈克特的烈焰中保留了下来。

source: Damage all enemies in range 4 for 40 fire damage and yourself for 5 fire damage every turn.
target: 每回合对周围4码范围内的敌人造成40火焰伤害，对你自己造成5火焰伤害。

source: #CRIMSON# A powerful fire aura appears around you as you equip the %s.
target: #CRIMSON#当你穿上%s，身边围绕起强大的火焰光环。

source: A plain elven-silk robe. It would be unremarkable if not for the sheer power it radiates.
target: 朴素的精灵丝绸长袍。如果不是它放射出的惊人威力，它真的毫不起眼。

source: Designed by a slightly quirky Paradox Mage, this robe always appears to be stylish in any time the user finds him, her, or itself in. Crafted to aid Paradox Mages through their adventures, this robe is of great help to those that understand what a wibbly-wobbly, timey-wimey mess time actually is. Curiously, as a result of a particularly prolonged battle involving its fourth wearer, the robe appends a very long, multi-coloured scarf to its present wearers.
target: 被有些古怪的时空法师设计出来，无论穿戴者在哪个时代，这袍子都显得格外时髦。它为协助时空法师冒险而制作。这件法袍对擅长摆弄那团乱糟糟、缠来绕去的时间的人来说有着巨大的作用。有趣的是，由于它第四任主人参与了一场相当漫长的战斗，长袍上附带了一条很长的多彩围巾。

source: Oddly it never produces a hat.
target: 奇怪的是，它没有一顶帽子。

source:
This fez once belonged to a traveler; it always seems to be found lying around in odd locations.
#{italic}#Fezzes are cool.#{normal}#
target: 这顶菲斯帽曾属于一位旅行家；它似乎总是出现在各种古怪的地方。#{italic}#菲斯帽很酷。#{normal}#

source: Needs something equally stylish and cool to go with it.
target: 需要一件同样时尚而炫酷的装备来搭配。

source: #STEEL_BLUE#A time vortex briefly appears in front of you.
target: #STEEL_BLUE#一个时间漩涡在你面前出现

source: Crude Iron Battle Axe of Kroll
Made in times before the Dwarves learned beautiful craftsmanship, the rough appearance of this axe belies its great power. Only Dwarves may harness its true strength, however.
target: 打造于矮人学会精巧工艺之前，外表的粗糙掩盖了这把斧头的强大威力。不过也只有矮人才能让它发挥出真正的力量。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel as surge of power as you wield the axe of your ancestors!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你装备这把先祖的战斧，感到全身涌入了一股力量！

source: A long whip of linked metal joints finished with a viciously sharp barb leaking terrible venom.
target: 一条金属串接的长鞭，尾端锋利的邪恶倒刺渗透着毒液。

source: A pristine belt of purest white leather with a runed voratun buckle. The ravages of neither time nor the elements have touched it.
target: 一条有着沃瑞钽雕刻标志的皮带扣，用纯白色皮革制作的古朴的腰带。不论时间还是环境都不能对它造成任何损害。

source: A belt rumoured to have been worn by the Conclave healers.
target: 传说这条腰带曾被孔克雷夫的治疗师们佩戴。

source: A rough hide made from a massive beast.  Seeing as it's so weathered but still usable, maybe it's a bit special...
target: 一张取自巨型猛兽的粗制兽皮。鉴于它已经被风吹日晒了这么久还能凑合用用，没准会有一点特别的……

source: The stitched-together skins of many creatures. Some eyes and mouths still decorate the robe, and some still live, screaming in tortured agony.
target: 缝在一起的许多人皮。有些眼睛和嘴巴依然待在这件袍子上，并且有一些仍然活着，在被酷刑折磨的痛苦中尖啸。

source: #BLUE#The skin seems pleased to be worn by the unliving, and grows silent.
target: #BLUE#这件人皮似乎很满意被亡灵穿着，沉默了下来。

source: Blood drips continuously from this fell suit of iron, and dark magics churn almost visibly around it. Bloody ruin comes to those who stand against its wearer.
target: 鲜血不断的从这套骇人的铁甲上滴落，几乎可以看得见黑魔法在它的周围流动。胆敢阻挡装备者的人会遭到血腥的毁灭。

source: A heavy shirt of scale mail constructed from the remains of Kroltar, whose armour was like tenfold shields.
target: 一件用库洛塔的遗物打造的重甲，她的护甲有盾牌的十倍重。

source: Kroltar's head would turn up the heat.
target: 库洛塔的头会加剧这里的炎热。

source: This heavy dwarven-steel armour was created in the deepest forges of the Iron Throne. While it grants incomparable protection, it demands that you rely only on your own strength.
target: 这件沉重的矮人钢护甲打造于钢铁王座最深的熔炉。虽然它被赋予了举世无双的防护能力，但你必须得靠自己的力量使用它。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel your dwarven power swelling to meet the challenge of this armor!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你感到你的矮人力量在这件护甲的挑战面前被激发！

source: The wise ones say that truth is a three-edged sword. And sometimes, the truth hurts.
target: 有些聪明人说真理是把三刃剑。因为有些时候，“真理”是会伤到人的。

source: 9% chance to stun or confuse the target
A shortened femur of the mighty prismatic dragon Ureslak, this erratic club still resonates with his volatile nature.
target: 强大的棱晶龙乌尔斯拉克被截断的腿骨，这根奇怪的棍子仍然流动着乌尔斯拉克的天性。

source: 10% chance to shimmer to a different hue and gain powers
target: 10% 几率变换不同颜色并且增加强度
#GOLD#乌尔斯拉克的股骨发出闪光!

source: What would happen if more of Ureslak's remains were reunited?
target: 当乌尔斯拉克更多遗物聚集在一起时，会发生什么呢？

source: This cloak is fashioned from the scales of some large reptilian creature.  It appears to reflect every color of the rainbow.
target: 这件斗篷用某些大型爬行动物的鳞片制成。它看上去可以反射出彩虹的每种颜色。

source: energize the scales for 16 turns, increasing resistance to %s damage by 15%% just before you are damaged. (This effect lasts 5 turns and only works on one type of damage.)
target: 为鳞片充能16回合，让你在受 %s 伤害前增加相应抗性15%%，持续5回合，只对一种伤害生效。

source: It would go well with another part of Ureslak.
target: 另一件乌尔斯拉克的遗物会增强它的能力。

source: #YELLOW_GREEN#An ironic harmony surrounds Ureslak's remains as they reunite.
target: #YELLOW_GREEN#乌尔斯拉克的遗物重聚时，一种讽刺的和谐笼罩四周。
#YELLOW_GREEN#乌尔斯拉克的遗物似乎更加不安定了。

source:
This mighty axe can cleave through armour like the sharpest swords, yet hit with all the impact of a heavy club.
It is said the wielder will slowly grow mad. This, however, has never been proven - no known possessor of this item has lived to tell the tale.
target:
这把强力的斧头可以像剑一样劈开护甲，却能造成如同钝器一般的重击。
据说持有者会慢慢变得疯狂。这个，不管怎样，从来没有被证实过——没有任何持有者能活到揭开真相。

source: Legend has it this blade is one of a pair: twin blades forged in the earliest of days of the Wardens. To an untrained wielder it is less than perfect; to a Warden, it represents the untapped potential of time.
target: 传说这把长剑是一对兵器中的其中一个；这对兵器打造于时空守卫最初的年代。对于未经训练的持有者来说它还不是那么完善；对于时空守卫来说，它将随着时间展现威力。

source: In the past there was a dagger with it.
target: 过去有柄匕首和它成套

source: 10% chance to reduce the target's resistances to all damage
target: 10% 几率降低目标对所有伤害的抗性。

source: #CRIMSON#The echoes of time resound as the blades are reunited once more.
target: #CRIMSON#当剑重合在一起时出现了时间的回音。

source: #CRIMSON#Time seems less perfect in your eyes as the blades are separated.
target: #CRIMSON#当剑分开时在你的眼中似乎时空不再完美。

source: Legend has it this blade is one of a pair: twin blades forged in the earliest of days of the Wardens. To an untrained wielder it is less than perfect; to a Warden, it represents the opportunity to learn from the mistakes of the past.
target: 传说这把匕首是一对兵器中的一个；这对兵器打造于时空守卫最初的年代。对于未经训练的持有者来说它还不是那么完善；对于时空守卫来说，它表示着从以前的失误中吸取教训的机会。

source: Potentially it would go with a sword in the future.
target: 未来可能有把剑和它成套

source: 10% chance to return the target to a much younger state
target: 有 10% 几率使目标回到更年轻的状态。

source: Fashioned in ancient times by cultists of Harkor'Zun, these heavy granite gauntlets were designed to protect the wearer from the wrath of their dark master.
target: 古时候由哈克祖的狂热崇拜者制作，这副花岗岩臂铠被设计为可以保护穿戴者免于遭受黑暗之主的暴怒。

source: Someone has strung a thick black cord through this large bloodshot eyeball, allowing it to be worn around the neck, should you so choose.
target: 有人用一条粗黑线穿过这颗充血的眼球，如果你愿意，可以把它挂在脖子上。

source: This ancient pickaxe was used to pass down dwarven legends from one generation to the next. Every bit of the head and shaft is covered in runes that recount the stories of the dwarven people.
target: 这把古老的十字镐被用来一代代的往下传颂矮人的传奇。从镐头到镐把每一寸都覆盖着记述矮人故事的符文。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel the whisper of your ancestors as you wield this pickaxe!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#当你挥舞这把十字镐时，你仿佛听到了先祖的低语！

source: This strange orange quiver is made of brass and etched with many bright red runes that glow and glitter in the light.  The arrows themselves appear to be solid shafts of blazing hot light, like rays of sunshine, hammered and forged into a solid state.
target: 这个奇特的橙色箭壶由黄铜制成，在阳光下，你可以看到壶身铭刻着许多亮红色的发光符文。箭矢似乎配有燃烧的箭杆，就像被锻造过的阳光。

source: Powerful telepathic forces emanate from the arrows of this quiver. The tips appear dull, but touching them causes you intense pain.
target: 箭袋中的箭矢中散发出一股强大的意念力，尖端虽然看上去不锋利，但是当你触摸时却让你感到剧烈的疼痛。

source: This voratun shield, coated with thick vines, was imbued with nature's power long ago by the Halfling General Almadar Riul, who used it to stave off the magic and diseases of orcish corruptors during the peak of the Pyre Wars.
target: 这块沃瑞钽盾牌表面被厚实的藤蔓所缠绕，其中注入了许多年前的半身人将军阿尔曼达·鲁伊尔的自然力量，他在烈火战争中用这个盾牌驱散了兽人堕落者的魔法与疾病。

source: purge up to %d diseases (based on Willpower) and gain disease immunity, %d%% blight resistance, and %d spell save for 5 turns
target: 除去至多 %d 项疾病（基于意志），并获得疾病免疫、%d%% 枯萎抗性和 %d 法术豁免，持续 5 回合。
%s将%s %s紧贴自身，净化%s身上的腐化！

source: Intense heat radiates from this powerful shot.
target: 子弹中放射出极高的热量。

source: The vast psionic force of the Way reverberates through this gemstone. With a single touch, you can sense overwhelming power, and hear countless thoughts.
target: 巨大的意念力在这颗宝石之中回响，仅仅轻触就可以让你获得无穷的力量和无限的思维。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel the power of the Way within you!
This bright violet gem exudes a calming, focusing force. Holding it, you feel protected against outside forces.
target: 这颗明亮的紫色宝石渗透出宁静、专注的力量，当你紧握它时，你可以感受到它保护你与外界力量隔绝。

source: Reduce damage from attackers more than 3 tiles away by 25%
target: 来自3格外的敌人造成的伤害降低25%。

source: This sceptre, carved of ancient, blackened bone, holds a single gem of deep obsidian. You feel a dark power from deep within, looking to get out.
target: 这根权杖上有古老焦黑的白骨雕刻，镶嵌着一颗黑曜石，你感受到里面有一股黑暗力量呼之欲出。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel the power of the sceptre flow over your undead form!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#在亡灵形态下你感受到了强大的力量流动！

source: It desires to be surrounded by undeath.
This mindstar oozes a thick, caustic liquid. Magic seems to die around it.
target: 这只灵晶在不断的向外渗出粘糊糊的液体。魔法似乎消逝在它周围。

source: #DARK_GREEN#The Heart pulses with antimagic forces as you grasp it.
target: #DARK_GREEN#当你握住它时，心脏辐射出反魔能量。

source: Pristine flowers coat the surface of this mindstar. Touching it fills you with a sense of calm and refreshes your body.
target: 纯洁的花瓣覆盖着灵晶，当你触摸它时你感受到宁静和清新。

source: Time and Space seem to warp and bend around the massive tip of this stave.
target: 法杖的尖端时空似乎陷入了扭曲。

source: A black iris cuts through the core of this mindstar, which shifts with myriad colours. It darts around, as if searching for something.
target: 一道黑色虹膜贯穿这颗灵晶的核心，灵晶变幻着万千色彩。它四处转动，仿佛在寻找着什么。

source: The breath attack has a chance to shift randomly between Fire, Ice, Lightning, Acid, and Sand each turn.
target: 喷吐攻击的属性每回合有几率在火、冰、闪电、酸和沙之间随机切换。

source: This mindstar constantly emits a low tone. Life seems to be pulled towards it.
target: 这只灵晶不断的发出低鸣，你感觉到生命能量似乎在向它聚拢。

source: Gives a 30% chance that your nature summons appear as wild summons.
target: 你的自然召唤有30%的几率升级为野性模式的召唤兽。

source: This helmet radiates a dark power. Its visor seems to twist and corrupt the vision of its wearer. You feel worried that if you were to lower it for long, the visions may affect your mind.
target: 这顶头盔散发着黑暗的力量。它似乎能够扭曲和腐化装备者的视觉。你担心如果长时间放下护面，那些幻象可能会影响你的心智。

source: This dagger seems to be formed of pure shadows, with a strange miasma surrounding it.
target: 这把匕首似乎由纯粹的阴影构成，周围萦绕着一团奇异的瘴气。

source: 20% chance to make the target bleed shadows. You heal for 15 whenever you hit an enemy bleeding shadows.
target: 有20%的几率让目标流出阴影。每当你击中流出阴影的敌人，恢复15点生命值。

source: Said to have belonged to a master of avoiding attacks, this gilded steel emblem symbolizes his talent.
target: 据说它曾属于一位闪避大师，这枚镀金的钢徽记象征着他的才能。

source: This tightly strung bow appears to have been crafted by someone of considerable talent. When you pull the string, you feel incredible power behind it.
target: 这把做工精良的弓相传由一位不知名的大师打造。当你拉动弓弦时，你能感受到这把弓蕴藏着难以置信的力量。

source: In this dark blue pouch lie several small orbs of ice. A strange vapour surrounds them, and touching them chills you to the bone.
target: 在这个深蓝色的袋子里，躺着几颗冰晶弹。一团奇异的冰雾环绕着它们，当你触摸它们时，你感到刺骨的凉意。

source: This steel plated whip arcs with intense electricity. The force feels uncontrollable, explosive, powerful.
target: 这根钢质的鞭子缠绕着许多电弧。你可以感受这根鞭子上散发出的力量强大且不可控制。

source: Focus the lightning forces on an enemy
target: 将雷霆的力量释放在敌人身上

source: The storm is on your side !
strike an enemy within range %d (for 100%% weapon damage as lightning) and release a radius %d burst of electricity dealing %0.2f to %0.2f lightning damage (based on Magic and Dexterity)
target: 攻击距离 %d 内的敌人，造成 100%% 闪电武器伤害并在半径 %d 内释放电弧，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 点闪电伤害 (基于魔法和敏捷)

source: #Source# strikes #Target# with %s %s, sending out an arc of lightning!
A small mindstar rests at top of this handle. As you touch it, a translucent cord appears, flicking with your will.
target: 这只手柄上镶有一颗小小的灵晶。当你触摸它时，一根半透明的绳子浮现在你面前，并随着你的意志闪烁。

source: Try to fry your enemies brain (25% chance to brainlock)
target: 试图封锁敌人的大脑（25%几率思维封锁）

source: strike all targets in a line (for 100%% weapon damage as mind) out to range 4
target:
打击一条长度为4码的直线上的所有目标，
造成相当于100%%武器伤害的精神伤害。

source: This massive, flame-coated greatsword was stolen by the adventurer Kestin Highfin, during the Age of Dusk. It originally belonged to a demon named Frond'Ral the Red.  It roars with vile flames and its very existence seems to be a blight upon the lands.
target: 这把巨大、覆满火焰的大剑在黄昏纪被冒险者科斯汀·赫菲因偷走。它原本属于一个名叫赤红之弗朗拉尔的恶魔。它燃烧着邪恶的火焰，它的存在本身似乎就是这片土地的灾祸。

source: accelerate burning effects on all creatures in a radius %d ball within range %d, consuming them to instantly inflict 125%% of all remaining burn damage
target: 加速射程 %d 内半径 %d 球体中所有生物身上的燃烧效果，消耗它们，立即造成剩余燃烧伤害的125%%。

source: %s's %s lashes out in a flaming arc, intensifying the burning of %s enemies!
target: %s的%s划出一条烈焰的弧线，加速了%s个敌人身上的燃烧!

source: This thin cloth robe is surrounded by a pulsating shroud of telekinetic force.
target: 这件薄薄的长袍被一团神秘的精神力量所包围。

source: send out a range %d beam of kinetic energy, dealing %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Willpower and Cunning) with knockback
target: 发射长度 %d 的动能射线，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 点物理击退伤害（基于意志和灵巧）

source: %s focuses a beam of force from %s %s!
A thick venom drips from this mindstar.
target: 凝厚的毒液不断地从这个灵晶上滴落。

source: Thick straps encircle this blade. Jagged edges like teeth travel down the blade, bisecting it. It fights to overcome the straps, but lacks the strength.
target: 这把剑被厚重的带所束缚。两排锯齿状的锋刃沿着剑身直到剑柄，它试图挣脱带子的束缚，但似乎缺乏足够的力量。

source: Corpathus bursts open, unleashing a horrific mass!
target: 卡帕萨斯爆裂开来，放出了一团恐怖的物质！

source: This mass of putrid slime burst from Corpathus, and seems quite hungry.
target: 这团腐烂的黏液从卡帕萨斯中放出，它现在十分饥饿。

source: The eye on the hilt of this blade seems to glare at you, piercing your soul and mind. Tentacles surround the hilt, latching onto your hand.
target: 剑柄上的眼睛似乎直视着你，试图撕裂你的灵魂。剑柄上环绕的触手可以使其很好的固定在你手上。

source: torments the target with many mental effects
target: 对目标附加多种精神状态

source: Anmalice focuses its mind-piercing eye on #Target#!
target: 扭曲之刃·圣灵之眼将它穿透灵魂的目光集中在了 #Target# 上！
#CRIMSON#触手餍足地松开了你的手臂。

source: #CRIMSON#As you tear the tentacles from your arm, horrible images enter your mind!
target: #CRIMSON#当你将触手从手臂上扯下，可怕的景象进入了你的大脑！

source: #CRIMSON#As you wield the sword, the tentacles on its hilt wrap around your arm. You feel the sword's will invading your mind!
target: #CRIMSON#当你持有这把剑时，触手开始在你手臂环绕。你感觉这把剑的意志侵入了你的大脑！

source: This heavy, ridged blade emanates magical power, yet as you grasp the handle an icy chill runs its course through your spine. You feel the disembodied presence of all those slain by it. In unison, they demand company.
target: 这把沉重的，有着锯齿状刀刃的长剑正在向外散发强大的魔法波动，当你握住剑时，一阵寒意从剑柄传来，直刺灵魂。你仿佛感觉到了葬身剑下的亡灵，他们渴望着更多同伴的到来。

source: deal %0.2f arcane and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic) in a radius 1 around the target
target: 在目标周围1码范围内，造成%0.2f奥术和%0.2f暗影伤害（基于魔法）

source: swallows the victim's soul, gaining a new power
target: 吞噬目标的灵魂，获得新的能力。

source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。
@Source@放出了%s#SALMON#被束缚的灵魂#LAST#，模仿了%s!

source: %s's %s #SALMON#CONSUMES THE SOUL#LAST# of %s, gaining the power of %s!
target: %s的%s #SALMON#吞噬了%s的灵魂#LAST#，获得了%s的能力！

source: This three-headed stralite flail strikes with the power of a hydra. With each attack it lashes out, hitting everyone around you.
target: 这把三头的蓝锆石连枷，使用的是一只三头龙的力量。它的攻击可以伤害到周围的所有敌人。

source: hit up to two adjacent enemies
target: 攻击目标相邻的2个单位
严重破损的沃瑞钽臂铠

source: These once brilliant voratun gauntlets have fallen into a deep decay. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, curing the world of their influence.
target: 你从这副锈迹斑斑的臂铠上勉强能看出其曾经的辉煌。它起源于魔法狩猎时期，用于摧毁奥术类装备，以惩罚法师们对这个世界的暴行。

source: Can't be worn by those with arcane powers.
target: 使用奥术力量的人无法穿戴。

source: #ORCHID#Your arcane equipment or powers conflict with the gauntlets!#LAST#
target: #ORCHID#你的奥术装备或能力和臂铠发生了冲突!#LAST#

source: These once brilliant voratun gauntlets appear heavily decayed. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, ridding the world of their influence.
target: 这件沃瑞钽臂铠看起来十分破旧。它起源于魔法狩猎时期，用于摧毁奥术类装备，以惩罚法师们对这个世界的暴行。

source: These voratun gauntlets appear to have suffered considerable damage. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, ridding the world of their influence.
target: 这件沃瑞钽臂铠曾经受到过可观的损伤。它起源于魔法狩猎时期，用于摧毁奥术类装备，以惩罚法师们对这个世界的暴行。
稍微破旧的沃瑞钽臂铠

source: These voratun gauntlets shine brightly beneath a thin layer of wear. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, ridding the world of their influence.
target: 这件沃瑞钽臂铠虽然有一些使用痕迹，仍然闪耀着光芒。它起源于魔法狩猎时期，用于摧毁奥术类装备，以惩罚法师们对这个世界的暴行。

source: These brilliant voratun gauntlets shine with an almost otherworldly glow. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, ridding the world of their influence. Pride in the fulfillment of this ancient duty practically radiates from them.
target: 这件沃瑞钽臂铠闪耀着夺目的光芒。它起源于魔法狩猎时期，用于摧毁奥术类装备，以惩罚法师们对这个世界的暴行。

source: attempt to destroy all magic effects and sustains on creatures in a radius %d cone (unnatural creatures are additionally dealt %0.2f arcane damage and stunned)
target: 在半径%d码弧形区域摧毁生物身上的所有魔法效果和魔法持续技能（非自然生物还会额外受到%0.2f奥术伤害并被震慑）

source: %s's animating magic is disrupted by the burst of power!
target: %s的魔法被强大的反魔法力量干扰了!

source: destroy an arcane item (of a higher tier than the gauntlets)
target: 摧毁一件奥术装备（比臂铠材质级别高）

source: #LIGHT_RED#You can not do that with a tinker attached. Remove it first.
target: #LIGHT_RED#当有配件附着时，你不能这么做。先移除配件。

source: You crush the %s, and the gloves take on an illustrious shine!
target: 你摧毁了%s,手套开始发光！

source: This bow is said to have been the tool of an infamous dwarven spy. Rumours say it allowed him to "steal" the eyes of his enemies. Adversaries struck were left alive, only to unknowingly divulge their secrets to his unwavering sight.
target: 这把弓据说属于一位臭名昭著的矮人间谍。更有传言称，这把弓能帮助他利用所有敌人的眼睛。被射中的敌人虽然不会丧命，但却没有意识到自己的眼睛已经把周围的秘密全都泄漏给了他。

source: A bright light shines from the center of this shield. Holding it clears your mind.
target: 从这面盾牌的中心放射出耀眼的光芒，当你紧握这面盾牌时，你的思维变得清晰。

source: send out a range %d beam, lighting its path and dealing %0.2f to %0.2f light damage (based on Willpower and Cunning)
target: 发射长度 %d 的射线，照亮路径，并造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 点光系伤害(基于意志和灵巧)

source: These boots feel nearly completely weightless. Touching them, you feel an enormous burden lifted from you.
target: 这双靴子几乎没有重量，触摸它，你觉得身上的重担一下子减轻了许多。

source: This deep blue robe flows and ripples as if pushed by an invisible tide.
target: 这件深蓝色的法袍荡起涟漪，仿佛有一股看不见的浪潮在涌动。

source: This whip appears to have been made from a human spine. A handle sits on one end, a sharply honed claw on the other.
target: 这根鞭子看上去像是人类的脊骨做成，一端有一个柄，另一端是一个磨光的爪子。

source: This blazing hot mindstar beats rhythmically, releasing a burst of heat with each strike.
target: 这块灼热发光的灵晶有节奏地律动着，每次攻击会放出一波热量。

source: A wispy purple aura surrounds these translucent black boots.
target: 一圈紫色光环围绕着这双半透明的黑色靴子。

source: Creates an arcane explosion dealing %d arcane damage based on magic in a radius of 3 around the user after any teleport.
target: 使用者传送后，在周围3码范围内造成奥术爆发，造成%d奥术伤害，伤害基于魔力值。

source: phase door up to range 6, within radius 2 of the target location
target: 传送到6码范围内的地点，误差在两码范围内。

source: %s is #PURPLE#ENVELOPED#LAST# in a deep purple aura from %s %s!
target: %s#PURPLE#被包裹在#LAST#%s%s发出的紫色光环中！

source: This intricate blade is impractically long and almost as wide as your body, yet contrary to its size and apparent girth it is not only light, but threatens to escape your grasp and fly away. You will need to be really strong to keep it grounded. Or really big.
target: 这把长得不可思议的剑几乎和人一样宽，与其巨大尺寸格格不入的是，它的重量极轻，而且似乎总想要从你的手中飞走一样。要么足够强壮，要么足够高大，你才能握紧这剑，防止其飞走。

source: Attack speed improves with your strength and size category.
target: 攻击速度随力量和体型变化。

source: An endless supply of arrows lay within this deep black quiver. Tiny white lights dot its surface.
target: 这个深黑色的箭壶中可以源源不断的抽出箭矢，它的表面闪烁着点点微光。

source: A vile poison drips from the tips of these arrows.
target: 箭矢的尖端滴落着剧毒。

source: afflicts the target with a poison dealing 20 damage per turn and causing actions to fail 20% of the time for 6 turns
target: 使目标中毒，每回合造成20伤害，使用技能有20%几率失败，持续6回合。

source: This lantern of pale white crystal holds a sphere of darkness, that yet emanates light. Everywhere it shines, darkness vanishes entirely.
target: 这个灰白色水晶制成的灯笼周围笼罩着一片黑暗，但是它仍放射着光芒。光之所在，黑暗尽除。

source: Absorbs all darkness (power %d, based on Willpower and Cunning) within its light radius, increasing its own brightness. (current charge %d).
target: 在光照范围内吸收所有黑暗(强度 %d,基于意志和灵巧) 并增加亮度。(当前增幅： %d)。
#ORCHID#暗影吞噬者充分获得了能量！

source: release absorbed darkness in a %d radius cone with a %d%% chance to blind (based on lite radius), dealing %0.2f darkness damage (based on Mindpower and charge)
target: 在%d码的锥形范围内释放吸收的黑暗，有 %d%% 几率致盲（基于光照半径） , 并造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害 ( 基于精神强度和吸收量)

source: %s unshutters %s %s, unleashing a torrent of shadows!
target: %s打开了%s%s，释放出一股暗影洪流!

source: This ancient, weathered lantern glows with a pale blue light emanating from several ghostly forms trapped within.  The metal is icy cold to the touch.
target: 这个古老、风化的灯笼放射出淡蓝色的光芒，光芒来自被困在其中的几个幽灵形体。它的金属表面摸上去像冰一样冷。

source: release a will o' the wisp that will explode against your foes for %d cold damage (based on your Magic)
target: 放出鬼火，可以对你的敌人自爆，造成%d寒冷伤害（基于魔法）

source: A chilling, ghostly form that floats in the air.
This totem of ancient stone oozes a thick slime from myriad cracks. Nonetheless, you sense great power within it.
target: 这个古老的石制图腾的石缝里不断涌出粘液。尽管如此，你仍能感受到它的巨大能量。

source: call forth an immobile antimagic pillar for 10 turns.  (It spits slime, pulls in, stuns, and burns the arcane resources of your foes, while emitting an aura of silence against them within range 5, and will silence you for 5 turns when first summoned.)
target: 召唤一个无法移动的反魔石柱 10 回合。（它可以喷吐史莱姆、拉拽、震慑并燃烧敌人的奥术资源，同时在5码范围内对它们施放沉默光环，并且首次召唤时会沉默你5回合。）

source: This massive stone pillar drips with a viscous slime. Nature's power flows through it, obliterating magic all around it...
target: 这根巨大的石柱滴落着粘稠的粘液。自然之力在其中奔涌，湮灭周围的一切魔法……

source: #Source# uses %s to summon a natural guardian!
Touching this cloak of otherworldly fabric makes you feel both drowsy yet completely aware.
target: 当你触摸这件超脱尘俗的披风时你既觉得昏昏欲睡又十分清醒。

source: This jagged shape looks like a hole in space, yet it is solid, though light in weight.
target: 这个锯齿状的影像看上去像是时空中的黑洞，但它又是固态的，尽管重量非常的轻。

source: release a radius %d burst of void energy at up to range %d, dealing %0.2f temporal and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic)
target: 在 %d 码范围内释放虚空能量，至多距离 %d。造成 %0.2f 时空和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。(基于魔法)

source: A chunk of jagged coral, dredged from the ocean.
target: 用大块的珊瑚制成，源自大海深处。

source: 30% chance to spray freezing water (radius 4 cone) at the target.
target: 30% 几率朝目标喷射4格锥形冰冷的水流。

source: A wave of icy water sprays out from #Source# towards #Target#!
target: 一束冰冷的水流从#Source#处喷向#Target#！

source: A deep red light glows from within this damaged amulet of black stone. When you touch it, you can hear voices whispering within your mind.
target: 从这条损坏的黑色项链上放出暗红色的光亮，当你触摸它时，你能听到脑海里的窃窃私语。

source: You find yourself constantly fighting an urge to handle this strange pouch of shot.
target: 你情不自禁的想使用这袋弹药。

source: These perfectly white spheres appear to have been worn down by years of exposure to strong winds.
target: 这些白色的弹丸似乎饱经风霜。

source: 35% chance for lightning to arc to a second target
target: 35% 几率闪电连锁至下一个目标

source: This large steel greatmaul has thick vines wrapped around the handle.
target: 这柄巨大的钢制巨锤，其手柄上覆盖着一层厚厚的藤蔓。

source: #DARK_GREEN#You feel a great power rise within you!
target: #DARK_GREEN#你感到体内涌现出一股强大的力量！

source: This heavy torque appears to draw nearby matter towards it.
target: 这副沉重的项圈将周围的所有物体拉向它。

source: This sword appears weightless, and nearly invisible.
Said to have belonged to a lost Anorithil, stars are reflected in the myriad surfaces of these otherworldly bindings.
target: 相传它曾属于一位失落的星月术士，星辰映照在这副异界束带的无数表面上。
普罗斯泰普的七彩之眼

source: This cracked gemstone looks faded with age. It appears to have once been the eye of a golem.
target: 这枚损坏的宝石看起来似乎有一定的年月了。种种迹象表明它曾经是某个傀儡的眼珠。

source: Casts lasers on spellcast when worn or imbued.
target: 当装备或镶嵌时，施放法术时附加激光

source: This deep black armor absorbs all light that touches it. A dark power sleeps within, primal, yet aware. When you touch the plate, you feel dark thoughts creeping into your mind.
target: 这件黑色的胸甲吸收了附近的所有光线。你能感受到其中沉睡着一股邪恶的力量。当你触摸它时，你感到黑暗的思想在不断的涌现在你的脑海。

source: This small tree-shaped totem is imbued with powerful healing energies.
target: 你能在这根小巧的树状图腾上感受到强大的治愈能量。

source: Heals all nearby living creatures by 5 points each turn.
target: 治疗周围的生物，每回合恢复5点。

source: #CRIMSON# A powerful healing aura appears around you as you equip the %s.
target: #CRIMSON#当你装备%s后，强大的治疗光环在你身边出现。

source: take root increasing health by 300, armor by 20, and armor hardiness by 20%% but rooting you in place for 4 turns
target: 扎根，增加300点生命、20点护甲和20%%护甲强度，但不能移动，持续4回合。

source: This small wooden ring has a single green stem wrapped around it. Thin leaves still seem to be growing from it.
target: 这枚小巧的戒指上缠绕着一根藤蔓，藤蔓似乎仍然在不断的吐出新叶。

source: This thick cloak is incredibly tough, yet bends and flows with ease.
target: 尽管这件石头斗篷又硬又厚，但是你仍能轻松地折叠它。

source: This deep black leather armor, wrapped with thick silk, is icy cold to the touch.
target: 这件黑色的皮甲上覆盖着一层厚厚的丝绸，触感冰凉。

source: turn yourself invisible (power %d, based on Cunning and Magic) for 10 turns
target: 隐形10回合（强度%d，基于灵巧和魔法）

source: %s pulls %s %s around %s like a dark shroud!

This lightweight armor appears to have been woven of countless sprouts, still curling and growing. When you put it on, you feel the weight of the world on your shoulders, in spite of how light it feels in your hands.
target: 这件护甲由数以千计的豆芽缠绕编成，豆芽们仍在不停的生长缠绕。尽管在你手里很轻，但当穿上它时，你感觉到肩上那世界一般的重量。

source: #DARK_GREEN#You feel the strength of the whole world behind you!
This hourglass of otherworldly crystal appears to be filled with countless tiny gemstones in place of sand. As they fall, you feel the flow of time change around you.
target: 这只漂亮的沙漏里装载着数以千计的宝石，用以代替沙子。当它们落下时，你能够感受到时间的变化。

source: Offers either offensive or defensive benefits, depending on the position of the sands.  Switching the direction of flow takes no time.
target: 根据沙的位置在进攻增益和防守增益间切换。切换沙的流向不消耗时间。

source: flip the hourglass (sands currently flowing towards %s)
target: 翻转沙漏(沙子目前流向%s)

source: #GOLD#As the final sands drop into place, you feel a surge of power.
target: #GOLD#当最后一粒沙子落下，你感觉到一股力量。

source: #GOLD#As the final sands drop into place, you suddenly feel safer.
target: #GOLD#当最后一粒沙落下，你感觉安全了不少。

source: This black hat once belonged to a powerful mage named Malslek, in the Age of Dusk, who was known to deal with beings from other planes. In particular, he dealt with many powerful demons, until one of them, tired of his affairs, betrayed him and stole his power. In his rage, Malslek set fire to his own tower in an attempt to kill the demon. This charred hat is all that remained in the ruins.
target: 这顶黑色的帽子曾属于一名强大的法师马斯拉克，在黄昏纪时以交游位面之广而著称。值得一提的是，他还与许多恶魔进行了交易。直到某一天，一名恶魔厌烦了契约的约束而背叛了他并偷走了马斯拉克的力量。马斯拉克一气之下烧毁了自己的高塔，意图杀死这只恶魔。最终，废墟中只剩下了这顶帽子流传至今。
#RED#马斯拉克的仇恨在你体内流淌。

source:
This finely crafted telescope once belonged to the explorer and adventurer Kestin Highfin. With this tool in hand he traveled in search of treasures all across Maj'Eyal, and before his death it was said his collection was incredibly vast. He often credited this telescope with his luck, saying that as long as he had it, he could escape any situation, no matter how dangerous. It is said he died confronting a demon seeking revenge for a stolen sword.

His last known words were "Somehow this feels like an ending, yet I know there is so much more to find."
target: 这副精致的望远镜曾属于一位著名的冒险家和探险家科斯汀·赫菲因。有此宝在手，赫菲因遍历了整个马基·埃亚尔大陆，在他死前据说他搜集了许多宝贵的财富。他相信这副望远镜能带给他好运，有此物在手，无论面对任何险境，都能死里逃生。相传，他死于一名恶魔的报复，报复他偷走了恶魔私藏的一把剑。他留下的最后遗言是“不知为何，这感觉像是结局，但我知道前方还有太多值得探寻的东西。”

source: This leather cap is overgrown with a thick moss, except for around the very front, where an eye, carved of wood, rests. A thick green slime slowly pours from the corners of the eye, like tears.
target: 这顶皮帽上长满了厚厚的苔藓，帽子正前方用木头刻上了一只眼睛——绿色的液体缓缓从眼睛的眼角流出，仿佛眼泪一样。

source: This smooth green crystal flows with a light green slime in its core. Droplets occasionally form on its surface, tufts of grass growing quickly on the ground where they fall.
target: 光滑的绿色晶体，内部有闪亮的绿色液体在流动。偶尔一小滴液体渗了出来，滴在地上，地面马上就长满了青草。

source: This thick robe is woven from a dark green moss, firmly bound and cool to the touch. It is said to have rejuvenating properties.
target: 这件厚厚的长袍使用一大块深绿的苔藓织成的，十分牢固，摸上去很清凉。据说，它能让人恢复青春。

source: This powerful sling is said to have belonged to a warrior so strong his shots could knock down a brick wall...
target: 据说这个强大的投石索曾属于一位强壮的战士，他射出的弹丸能击倒砖墙……

source: These massive arrows are honed to a vicious sharpness, and appear to be nearly unbreakable. They seem more like spikes than any arrow you've ever seen.
target: 巨大而尖锐的箭矢，不，与其说是箭，不如说是长钉。

source: pin the target to the nearest wall
target: 将目标钉在最近的墙上

source: This double-helical ring seems resistant to attempts to move it. Wearing it seems to extend this property to your entire body.
target: 双螺旋状的戒指，很难将它移动，戴上它后似乎可以将其力量延展到整个身体。

source: This ornate blade is carved from the wood of a tree said to burn eternally. Its hilt is encrusted with gems, suggesting it once belonged to a figure of considerable status. The flames seem to bend to the will of the sword's holder.
target: 这把华丽的剑由传说中永恒燃烧之树的木材雕刻而成。剑柄镶嵌着宝石，暗示它曾属于一位地位显赫的人物。剑身的火焰似乎能随持剑者的意志弯曲。

source: This tall staff is tipped with a pitch black sphere that yet seems to give off a strong light.
target: 这根高耸的法杖顶端镶有一颗漆黑的球体，它似乎正发出强光。

source: This gore-stained battleaxe was once used by an infamously sadistic king, who took the time to personally perform each and every execution he ordered. He kept a vault of every head he ever removed, each and every one of them carefully preserved. When he was overthrown, his own head was added as the centrepiece of the vault, which was maintained as a testament to his cruelty.
target: 这把沾满血迹的战斧曾被一位臭名昭著的残忍国王使用，他下令执行的每一场处决都会亲自操刀。他把砍下的每一颗头颅都保存在一间密室中，每一颗都被仔细防腐处理。当他被推翻后，他自己的头颅也被加入其中，成为那间密室的中心展品，密室则被保留下来，作为他残忍暴行的见证。

source: This pristine golden cloak flows with a wind that seems to be conjured from nowhere. Its inner surface is a completely plain white, but the outside shines with intense light.
target: 这件纯净的金色斗篷随一股仿佛凭空召唤来的风飘动。它的内侧是完全朴素的白色，外侧则闪耀着强烈的光芒。

source: These titanic boots appear to have been carved from stone. They appear weathered and cracked, but easily deflect all blows.
target: 这对巨大的靴子似乎是用石头雕刻而成的，尽管已经风化破裂，但仍旧能抵抗一切伤害。

source:
This rugged jacket is the subject of many a rural legend.
Some say it was fashioned by an adventurous mage turned rogue, in times before the Spellblaze, but was since lost.
All manner of shady gamblers have since claimed to have worn it at one point or another. To fail, but live, is what it means to be untouchable, they said.
target:
这件破旧的夹克是许多乡村传说的主角。有人说，在魔法大爆炸之前的年代，一位转行盗贼的冒险法师制作了它，但此后便遗失了。
形形色色的神秘赌徒都声称自己曾穿过它。他们说，失败却活下来，这就是“不可触及”的含义。

source: When you take a hit of more than 20% of your max life a shield is created equal to 130% the damage taken.
target: 当你受到一次攻击损失超过20%最大生命值时，你获得一个护盾，可吸收那个数值130%的伤害。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#A barrier bursts from the leather jacket!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#这件皮夹克突然爆发出一股护盾能量！

source: This wooden cup seems perpetually filled with a thick sap-like substance. Tasting it is exhilarating, and you feel intensely aware when you do so.
target: 这个酒杯里装满了粘稠的物质，尝一口能提神醒脑。

source: This green robe is engraved with icons showing clouds and swirling winds. Its original owner, a powerful mage named Proccala, was often revered for both his great benevolence and his intense power when it proved necessary.
target: 这件绿色长袍上刻有云朵和漩涡。它最初的主人，大法师普偌卡拉，因其善行和力量被人们敬畏

source: Your Lightning and Chain Lightning spells gain a 24% chance to daze, and your Thunderstorm spell gains a 12% chance to daze.
target: 你的闪电术和连锁闪电有24%几率使目标眩晕，闪电风暴有12%几率使目标眩晕。

source: This white cap is plain and dull, but as the light reflects off of its surface, you see images of faraway corners of the world in the sheen."
target: 这顶白色的帽子朴素暗淡，但是，当光线在它的表面反射时，你从光泽中看到了世界遥远角落的景象。

source: %s grasps %s %s and has a sudden vision!
This is a string of ancient, hardened clay beads, cracked and faded with age. It was used by Wilders in ancient times, in an attempt to enhance their connection with Nature.
target: 这是一串古朴而坚硬的陶制串珠，年代久远，已经破碎褪色。远古时代，荒野行者曾佩戴它来加强与自然的联系。

source: Enhances the effectiveness of Meditation by 20%
These heavy stone gauntlets make the very ground beneath you bend and warp as they move.
target: 当这双沉重的手套移动时，大地会随之扭曲。

source:
Forget the moons, the starry sky,
The warm and greeting sheen of sun,
The rays of light will never reach inside,
The heart which wishes that it be unseen.
target:
月色皎洁，星空璀璨
阳光温暖，光辉耀闪
我心暗淡，其光难入
我心苦楚，莫可见述

source:
Countless mages have fallen victim to the sharp sting of this blade, betrayed by those among them with greed for ever greater power.
Passed on and on, this blade has developed a thirst of its own.
target:
无数法师曾殒命这匕首之下，被那些渴望力量的同伴背叛。
这把匕首被不断转手，渐渐产生了自己的渴望。

source: steals up to 50 mana from the target
target: 从目标处吸取至多50点法力

source: This impossibly cold chain of frost-coated metal radiates a strange and imposing aura.
target: 这不可思议的金属链覆盖着极度寒霜，向外放射出诡异而强大的光环能量

source: Gives all your cold damage a 20% chance to freeze the target.
target: 你造成寒冷伤害有20%几率冰冻目标。

source: The blade of this sword seems to have been forged of a mixture of voratun and stralite, resulting in a blend of swirling light and darkness.
target: 这柄长剑似乎是用沃瑞钽和蓝锆石混合制成，光与暗在不断旋转交融。

source: release a burst of light and dark damage (scales with Magic)
target: 爆发光明和黑暗伤害(受魔法值加成)

source: As long as you wear this ring, you will never forget who you are.
target: 只要你戴上这枚戒指，你就永远不会忘记自己是谁。

source: When using a mental talent, gives a 10% chance to lower the current cooldowns of up to three of your wild gift, psionic, or cursed talents by three turns.
target: 每次使用精神技能时，有10%几率减少至多3个自然、灵能、诅咒系的技能冷却时间3回合。

source: This warped, blackened sword drips acid from its countless pores.
target: 这柄扭曲的黑刀从无数小孔中滴落酸液。

source: This impressive looking sword features two massive blades aligned in parallel. They seem weighted remarkably well.
target: 这柄剑令人印象深刻，因为它有两个平行的巨大刀锋。它们的配重极佳。

source: 25% chance to strike the target again.

Be it corruption, madness or eccentric boredom, the halfling butcher by the name of Caleb once took to eating his kin instead of cattle. His spree was never ended and nobody knows where he disappeared to. Only the blade remained, stuck fast in a bloodied block. Beneath, a carving said "This was fun, let's do it again some time."
target: 无论是堕落、疯狂还是古怪的无聊，名为凯莱布的半身人屠夫曾一度开始吃掉自己的亲人以代替牲口。他的杀戮狂欢从未结束，没有人知道他去了哪里。只留下这把刀刃，深嵌在一块血迹斑斑的肉墩上。下面刻着一行字“真有趣，下次再试试”。

source: Enter Rampage if health falls below 20%%%s
target: 当生命值降低到20%%%s时，进入暴走。

source: Attempt to devour a low HP enemy, striking again and possibly killing it instantly.
target: 试图吞噬一个低生命的敌人，再次攻击并有几率秒杀目标。
进入暴走（共享冷却时间）

source: This cloak waves and bends with shimmering light, reflecting the depths of space and the heart of the Aether.
target: 这件斗篷漂浮弯曲，发出闪耀的光芒，折射出空间深处、以太核心。

source: Damage shields have +1 duration and +15% power
target: 伤害护盾增加一回合持续时间和15%强度

source: These cracked boots are caked with a thick layer of mud. It isn't clear who they previously belonged to, but they've clearly seen extensive use.
target: 这对有裂缝的靴子涂着厚厚的一层泥浆。目前还不清楚它以前属于谁,但显然,它曾被很多人使用过。

source: boost movement speed by 300% for up to 5 turns (or until you perform a non-movement action)
target: 增加移动速度300%五回合。（任何非移动行动会打断这个效果）

source: These gloves are coated with a thick, green liquid.
target: 这双手套被粘稠的绿色液体覆盖。
布满尘土且有裂纹的戒指

source:
This ring is filled with an overwhelming, yet restrained, power. It lashes, grasps from its metal prison, searching for life to snuff out. You alone are unharmed.
Perhaps it feels all the death you will bring to others in the near future.
target: 这枚戒指充满了强大而克制的力量。它从自己的金属牢笼中挥舞、攫取，搜寻着可以扼杀的生命。唯独你安然无恙。也许它预感到了不久的将来你将给他人带去的所有死亡。

source: #DARK_GREY#Your ring releases a burst of necromantic energy!
target: #DARK_GREY#你的戒指释放出一股死灵能量！

source: This gold-tipped wand shines with an unnatural sheen.
target: 这根金头魔棒闪耀着非自然的光泽。

source: summon a stationary shining orb within range %d for 15 turns that will illuminate its area and deal %d light damage (based on your Magic and Strength) to your foes within radius %d each turn
target: 在 %d 码范围内召唤一个静止的发光球体，持续15回合，照亮其周围区域，并每回合对半径 %d 内的敌人造成 %d 光系伤害（基于魔法和力量）

source: #Source# points %s %s at #target#, releasing a brilliant orb of light!
target: #Source#将%s%s指向#target#, 放出一个光辉的光球!

source: Some mad Chronomancer appears to have affixed a handle to this hole in spacetime. It looks highly effective, in its own strange way.
target: 某个疯狂的时空法师似乎给这个时空洞装上了手柄。以它自己奇怪的方式来看，这东西似乎非常高效。

source: These titanic double-helical arrows seem to have been designed more for knocking down towers than for use in regular combat. They'll no doubt make short work of most foes.
target: 巨大的双螺旋箭，似乎是为推倒高塔而非常规战斗设计。毫无疑问,它们会迅速干掉敌人。

source: 25% of all damage splashes in a radius of 1 around the target.
target: 你造成的伤害的25%溅射在目标周围1格

source: This very thin sword cuts through the air with ease, allowing remarkably quick movement.
target: 这柄超乎寻常的薄刃能轻松地在空气中挥舞，让你行动更为迅速。

source: This robe was formerly owned by Callister the Psion, a powerful Psionic that pioneered many Psionic abilities. After his wife was murdered, Callister became obsessed with finding her killer, using his own hatred as a fuel for new and disturbing arts. After forcing the killer to torture himself to death, Callister walked the land, forcing any he found to kill themselves - his way of releasing them from the world's horrors. One day, he simply disappeared. This robe, soaked in blood, was the only thing he left behind.
target: 这件长袍曾被灵能者卡利斯特拥有，他是一名强大的灵能者，开创了许多灵能能力。在他的妻子被谋杀之后，卡利斯特执着于寻找凶手，用自己的仇恨作为燃料，创造了令人不安的技术。让杀手折磨自己致死后，他行走在地上，迫使任何他发现的人自杀——这是他从世界的恐怖中给予人解脱的方式。有一天，他消失了。这浸泡在血液中的长袍，是他留下的唯一物品。

source: Increases your solipsism threshold by 20% (if you have one). If you do, also grants 15% global speed when worn.
target: 增加 20% 唯我临界点（如果你有的话）。若有，穿戴时还将获得 15% 全局速度。

source: #RED#You feel yourself lost in the aura of the robe.
target: #RED#你觉得你在长袍的光环中迷失了。

source: #RED#The robe drapes comfortably over your doomed body.
target: #RED#长袍舒服地披在你被诅咒的身躯上。

source:
The chronomancer known as Solith was renowned across all of Eyal. He always seemed to catch his enemies alone.
In the case of opponents who weren't alone, he had to improvise.
target: 时空法师索利斯在马基·埃亚尔的世界中十分有名。他总是抓住了他的敌人落单之时。即使对手不是独自一人,他也能临场发挥。

source: attempt to inflict %0.2f temporal damage (based on Spellpower and Paradox, if any) on foes in a radius %d ball out to range %d (chance depends on rank, summons are always affected), removing any that survive from time for up to %d turn(s)
target: 尝试对半径 %d 内的所有目标造成 %0.2f 时空伤害（射程 %d，基于法术强度和紊乱，若有的话；成功率取决于等级，召唤物必定受影响），存活者将被移出时间线最多 %d 回合。

source: This gigantic shield has a stone eye embedded in it.
target: 这个巨大的盾牌上嵌有一个石质的眼睛

source: The eye locks onto %s, freezing it in place!
target: 眼睛凝视着%s，将其石化了

source: This surreal dagger crackles with the intensity of a vicious storm.
target: 这柄超现实的匕首周围环绕有强大的风暴

source: Causes lightning to strike and destroy any projectiles in a radius of 10, dealing damage and dazing enemies in a radius of 5 around them.
target: 触发闪电,击落半径10内所有抛射物，抛射物半径5以内的敌人受到伤害并被眩晕。

source: This ordinary blade is made of fine, sturdy voratun and outfitted with jagged hooks along the edge. This simple appearance belies a great power - the hooked maw of this dagger broke many a blade and the stride of many would-be warriors.
target: 这柄普通的匕首是由精制坚硬的沃瑞钽制成的，配有锯齿钩边。看似平凡的外表背后潜藏着强大的力量——它破坏过诸多刀刃，收割走那些战士的生命和未来。

source: Can block like a shield, potentially disarming the enemy.
target: 可以像盾牌一样格挡，并缴械目标。

source: Myths tell of shieldsmaidens, a tribe of warrior women from the northern wastes of Maj'Eyal. Their martial prowess and beauty drew the fascination of swaths of admirers, yet all unrequited. So began the saying, that a shieldsmaiden's heart is as cold and unbreakable as her shield.
target: 传说中的女武神，来自马基·埃亚尔世界的北方荒地。她的美貌和力量吸引了众多爱慕者前去，然而所有人都空手而归。因此，有这样一句谚语：女武神的心同她的盾一样冰冷而不可打破。

source: Granted talent can block up to 1 instance of damage each 10 turns.
target: 提供技能:每十回合能抵挡一次攻击。

source: This massive hammer is formed from a thick mass of strange crystalline growths. In the side of the hammer itself you see an empty slot; it looks like a gem of your own could easily fit inside it.
target: 这柄巨型锤子是用一种厚厚的古怪结晶体制成的，锤子里面能看到一个空槽，似乎很容易就能将宝石放进去。

source: Write a description for this gem's properties!
imbue the hammer with a gem of your choice
target: 把你喜欢的宝石镶嵌到锤子里。

source: These fell looking gloves glow with untold power.
target: 这对手套看上去十分恐怖，闪耀着不明能量。

source:
Increases all damage by %d%% of current vim 
Current Bonus: %d%%
target:
获得相当于你%d%%活力值的伤害加成
当前加成：%d%%

source: Only the masochistic can unlock its full power.
target: 只有受虐狂才能解锁它的能量

source: #STEEL_BLUE#The fist and the mangled clothing glow ominously!
target: #STEEL_BLUE#拳套和衣服开始发出不祥的光！

source:
Stolen flesh,
	Stolen pain,
	To give it up,
	Is to live again.
target:
窃取血肉,
    窃取苦痛,
    舍弃本我,
    秽尸复苏。

source:
Reduces all damage by %d%% of current vim or 50%% of the damage, whichever is lower; but at the cost of vim equal to 5%% of the damage blocked. 
Current Bonus: %d
target:
降低所有伤害相当于%d%%当前活力值的数值，但不超过伤害值的50%%;降低伤害时，消耗相当于5%%伤害量的活力值。
当前加成：%d

source: With a better grip it would be the destroyer of your enemies.
target: 如果有更好的掌控力，它将摧毁敌人。

source: This massive hammer strikes with deadly force. Bones crunch, splinter and grind to dust under its impact.
target: 这柄巨大的锤子挥击时拥有能粉碎骨头的巨力。

source: Sends a tremor through the ground which causes jagged rocks to erupt in a beam of length 5, dealing %d Physical damage (equal to your Strength, up to 150) and causing targets hit to bleed for an additional 50 damage over 5 turns. Bleeding can stack.
target: 使大地震颤裂开，露出尖石，在5码直线上造成%d物理伤害（与你的力量值相等，最高150），并使击中的目标流血，在5回合内额外造成50伤害。流血伤害可以叠加。

source: The golden bascinet crown, affiliated with Veluca of Yaldan. King of the mythical city of Yaldan, that was struck from the face of Eyal by the arrogance of its people. Lone survivor of his kin, he spent his last years wandering the early world, teaching man to stand against the darkness. With his dying words, "Fear no evil", the crown was passed onto his successor.
target: 这顶金色的颅盔王冠与雅尔丹的维卢卡息息相关。他是传说之城雅尔丹的国王，那座城因子民的傲慢而被从埃亚尔大陆上抹去。作为亲族中唯一的幸存者，他在生命最后的岁月里游历早期的世界，教导人类反抗黑暗。临终之际，王冠连同他的遗言——勿惧邪恶——一同传给了他的继任者。

source: lower the helmet's visor, blinding yourself (and protecting from other blinds) for 6 turns. If the helmet is taken off, the effect will end early.
target: 放下头盔的面甲，使你致盲6回合（同时免疫其他致盲效果）。如果脱下这件装备，效果会提前结束。
一把发出炫目光芒的剑

source: This impressive looking sword features a golden engraving of a sun in its hilt. Etched into its blade are a series of runes claiming that only one who has mastered both their body and mind may wield this sword effectively.
target: 初看这把外形令人印象深刻的长剑，最先吸引你目光的是雕刻在剑柄之中的金色太阳。而蚀刻在剑刃之上的复杂的符文仿佛在告诉你，只有真正掌握自己肉体和精神力量之人才能发挥出这把武器的最大威力。

source: Increases the damage of Sun Beam by 15%.
releases a burst of light, dealing %d light damage (based on Spellpower) in a radius 3 cone.
target: 放出光系爆炸，在3码扇形区域内造成%d光系伤害（基于法术强度）

source: attack everything in a line out to range %d, dealing 100%% weapon damage (as light), and healing for 50%% of the damage dealt
target: 攻击长度为 %d 的直线上所有目标 , 造成 100%% 光系武器伤  害,  并将 50%% 伤害转化为治疗。
一件荒诞般巨大的铠甲

source: This massive suit of plate boasts an enormous bulk and overbearing weight. Said to belong to a nameless soldier who safeguarded a passage across the bridge to his village, in defiance to the cohorts of invading orcs. After days of assault failed to fell him, the orcs turned back. The man however, fell dead on the spot - from exhaustion. The armor had finally claimed his life.
target: 这件结实硕大的板甲有着夸张的体积和难以想象的重量。相传这件板甲属于一位不知名的士兵，为了抵御洪水般的兽人军团入侵他的家乡，这名士兵守护在通向他村庄的大桥上。经过几天几夜惨烈的进攻，兽人没能击倒他，最终敌人撤退了。而这名传奇般的士兵，也因为精疲力竭当场倒毙，这件盔甲最终夺去了他的生命。

source:
When your effective movement speed (global speed times movement speed) is less than 100%%, reduces all incoming damage by a percent equal to the speed detriment (up to 70%%).
Current reduction bonus: %d%%
target:
当你的有效移动速度（全局速度乘移动速度）小于100%%的时候，降低所有伤害，比例相当于当前移动速度和100%%的差距，但最大不超过70%%。
当前减伤比例：%d%%

source: slow the movement speed of all creatures (including yourself) within range 5 by 40% for 3 turns
target: 将范围5内所有生物的移动速度（包括你自己）降低40%，持续3回合。

source: %s rebalances the bulky plates of %s %s, and things slow down a bit.
target: %s重新组合了%s%s的重型装甲板，放慢了速度。

source: This mask appears to be carved out of the skull of a creature that never should have existed, malformed and distorted. You shiver as you look upon it, and its hollow eye sockets seem to stare back into you.
target: 这件面具似乎用某种不明生物的头骨制成的，那是一种本不应该存在于世间的可怕生物，畸形并且扭曲。每当你盯着这个面具时，它那空洞的眼窝似乎也在注视着你，令你感到发自内心的颤栗。
一双被火焰覆盖的草鞋

source: A cautionary tale tells of the ancient warlock by the name of Caim, who fancied himself daily walks through Goedalath, both to test himself and the harsh demonic wastes. He was careful to never bring anything back with him, lest it provide a beacon for the demons to find him. Unfortunately, over time, his sandals drenched in the soot and ashes of the fearscape and the fire followed his footsteps outside, drawing in the conclusion of his grim fate.
target: 这是一个警示故事，讲的是有个叫凯姆的古代术士，为了勘查地狱般的恶魔荒原，也为了考验自己，自命不凡的认为可以在恶魔的老巢高达勒斯天天散步。他每次从恶魔位面归来都小心翼翼地不敢带回任何东西，生怕成为恶魔找到他的指引。不幸的是，来回很多次以后，他的草鞋浸满了恐惧之地的烟尘和灰烬。地狱之焰随他的脚步被带到了世间，同时也注定了他悲惨的命运。

source: Each step you take leaves a burning trail behind you lasting 5 turns that deals %d fire damage (based on Spellpower) to foes who enter it.
target: 你每踏出一步会在脚下留下一条持续5回合的燃烧痕迹，对所有经过的生物造成 %d 火焰伤害 (基于法术强度)

source: Worn by a villain long forgotten, this armor was powered by the blood of thousands of innocents. Decrepit and old, the dark lord died in solitude, his dominion crumbled, his subjects gone. Only this cuirass remained, dying to finally taste fresh blood again.
target: 这件胸甲属于一个早已被人遗忘的暴君，成千上万无辜死者的鲜血强化了这件铠甲。黑暗领主最终在衰老与虚弱中孤独的死去，他的统治分崩离析，他的人民四散而去。只有这件胸甲被保留了下来，渴望着再次品尝鲜血的味道。

source: drain blood from all creatures within range 5, causing them to bleed for %0.2f physical damage over 4 turns (based on your Physicalpower). For each creature drained (up to 10), the armor gains strength, which fades over 10 turns if it is not fed
target: 吸收半径 5 内所有生物的血液，令其在 4 回合内受到 %0.2f 点物理伤害（基于你的物理强度）。每吸收一个生物（至多10个），护甲的属性便会增强；若不再喂食，增益会在 10 回合后消退。

source: A desiccated mask of human skin, all that remains of a necromancer from the Age of Pyre who failed to achieve lichdom.  The transformative process partially succeeded, leaving him unable to die as his body slowly rotted from the inside out over several years.  Now his spirit resides within this last bit of mummified flesh, still hungering for eternal life.
target: 一小片人皮面具，是烈火纪一位死灵法师的遗物。转化过程部分成功了：他的身体逐渐腐烂，却无法死去，就这样过了数年。现在，他的灵魂仍藏身于这小块皮肤中，渴求着永恒的生命。

source: A large shimmering maul that seems to produce a ringing in your ears.  It is both as malleable as thought and as hard as the strongest steel.
target: 一个闪闪发光的大战槌，你的耳朵里似乎能听到它发出的鸣响。它既像思想一样可塑，又像最强的钢铁一样坚硬。

source: This hat's broad brim protects you from biting colds and sudden storms.
target: 这顶帽子宽阔的帽檐保护您免受呼啸的寒风和突如其来的暴风雨.

source: A small storm cloud follows you, dealing 15 lightning damage to all enemies in a radius of 3 each turn.
target: 一团小小的风暴包围着你，每回合对周围3码内的敌人造成15闪电伤害。

source: This torque feels tingly to the touch, but seems to enhance your thinking.
target: 这项圈摸起来让人觉得刺痛,但似乎增强了你的思考.

source:
Your mind is attuned to electricity.
Any lightning damage you do that is more than 10% of the victim's maximum life will attempt to brainlock the target.
Upon taking lightning damage >10% of your max life, your mind fires back, dealing 30% of the original damage as mind and trying to brainlock the target.
Upon taking mind damage >10% of your max life, you reflexively trigger the jolt, sending an arc of dazing lightning toward the target (damage based on mindpower).
This item can have up to 2 charges, with each charge having 4 turn cooldown.
target:
你的精神与电力连接。
你对敌人造成的超过其最大生命值10%的闪电伤害时，会试图附加思维封锁效果。
当你受到超过最大生命值10%的闪电伤害时，你的精神会发起反击，造成原伤害30%的精神伤害，并试图附加思维封锁效果。
当你受到超过最大生命值10%的精神伤害时，你会反射性地触发震击，朝目标射出一道致眩闪电（伤害基于精神强度）。
这个物品可以存储两次充能，每次充能冷却时间4回合。

source: The blade glows faintly blue, and reflects a sky full of stormy clouds.
target: 剑身泛着淡淡的蓝色,反射出了满天的乌云.

source: inflicts either shocked or wet, chosen at random
target: 随机造成震撼或浸湿效果。

source: This mindstar glows with a bright warm light, but seems somehow incomplete.
target: 这个灵晶散发着温暖的微光,但似乎有点残缺.

source: Nature requires balance in these matters.
target: 自然在这些事上需要平衡。

source: #GREEN#You feel the seasons in perfect balance.
target: #GREEN#你感受到四季进入了完美的平衡。

source: This mindstar glows with a dim cool light, but seems somehow incomplete.
target: 这个灵晶散发着寒冷的微光,但似乎有点残缺.

source: Crafted for a warlord who wanted to keep his subjects under a stralite grip. Dark thoughts went into the making of these gauntlets, literally.
target: 一位军阀为将臣民牢牢掌控于蓝锆石之掌中而打造了这副手套。制作过程中确实注入了黑暗的思想。

source:
As any scryer knows, the link between the murderer and the murdered is the murder weapon, and a scryer can follow that link from the murdered to the weapon to the murderer.
One rather cold blooded killer thought of a way around this. By carving blades out of ice, they could kill as they wished and the link would just melt away.
Their killing spree ended when one of the victims got lucky and managed to stab the murderer in the heart with the icey blade. After being united with the cold heart that created it, the final ice blade has never melted.
target:
任何占卜师都知道，凶器乃是缉查凶手最重要的线索；他们往往顺着这条线索顺藤摸瓜，从人群中找出凶手的真身。
然而，一个冷酷的杀手找到了一个办法：他用寒冰铸成了一把利刃，将其刺入受害者的胸口，让其随着受害者心脏的体温渐渐融化，消失于无形。
最终，这名杀手仍然没有逍遥于法外。一名受害者幸运地夺下了利刃，反身刺入了杀手的心脏里。杀手冷酷的内心没有温度，而这把与其相融的利刃从此再也不会融化。

source: explodes a frozen creature (damage scales with willpower)
target: 令一个冻结生物爆炸(伤害受意志加成)

source: Tremendous power is concentrated in this heavy mace. Just dropping it can knock down nearby walls.
target: 巨大的力量集中在这沉重的狼牙棒中。仅仅将它掉落在地就能震塌附近的墙壁。

source: perform a melee strike against a target at up to range %d for an automatic critical hit as lightning damage
target: 对至多 %d 格内的一个目标发动近战攻击，必定造成闪电暴击。

source: Kinetic energies are focussed in the core of this mindstar.
target: 动能集中在这个灵晶的核心里.

source: You feel two unconnected psionic channels on this item.
target: 在这个物品里你感受到了两种不相关的能量。

source: #YELLOW#You feel psionic energy linking the mindstars.
target: #YELLOW#你感受到灵晶之间建立了灵能的连接.

source: Electrical energies are focussed in the core of this mindstar.
target: 电能集中在这个灵晶的核心里.

source: Thermal energies are focussed in the core of this mindstar.
target: 热能集中在这个灵晶的核心里.

source: A fine mesh of metal threads held together by a sturdy chain. Sparks dance across it.
target: 一圈细密的金属丝网由一条坚固的锁链串起。火花在其上跳跃。

source:
Taking lightning damage or making critical hits builds 2 energy charges, which give you +5% lightning damage and +1 to all stats.
The charges decay at a rate of 1 per turn. Max 10 charges.
target:
受到雷电伤害或造成任意暴击时会获得 2 点充能，这些充能总共提供 5% 雷电伤害加成和 1 点全属性。
充能每回合衰减 1 点，最多 10 点充能。

source: %s appears out of the thin air!
Afflicts the target with a curse: talents inflict %d fire damage and have increased cooldowns.
target: 诅咒目标：释放技能时受到%d火焰伤害，冷却时间增加。

source: @Target@ walks on a trap, and there is a loud noise.
target: @Target@踩上陷阱，发出了巨大的声音

source: Releases a large boulder%s that smashes into the target for %d physical damage and knocks it back.
target: 释放一块大石头%s，砸向目标，造成%d物理伤害并击退它。

source: @Target@ activates a trap, and its magical energies change.
target: @Target@激活了陷阱，魔法能量变化了。

source: Projects a rapidly spinning beam of magical energies (range %d), dealing %d damage (%s%s#WHITE#) to those struck.
target: 投射一束快速旋转的魔法能量（射程%d），对被击中的人造成%d点伤害（%s%s#WHITE#）。

source: Releases a cloud of poison spores (radius %d), poisoning for #LIGHT_GREEN#%d#LAST# damage over 5 turns.
target: 释放一团毒气孢子（半径%d），在5回合内造成#LIGHT_GREEN#%d#LAST#毒素伤害。

source: The poison spore looks somewhat drained.
target: 毒性孢子的能量似乎被抽取了

source: Releases up to 4 delayed fuse fireballs within range %d that each explode for #LIGHT_RED#%d#LAST# fire damage after %d turns.
target: 在%d范围内释放最多4个延迟的引信火球，每个火球在%d回合后爆炸，造成#LIGHT_RED#%d#LAST#火焰伤害。

source: Cold flames start to appear around @target@.
Cold flames slowly spread from %d spots within radius %d, The flames deal %d cold damage with a chance to freeze.
target: 冷火焰在半径%d码范围内的%d点缓慢扩散，火焰造成%d点寒冷伤害并有机会冻结。

source: A stream of acid gushes onto @target@!
A bolt of fire blasts onto @target@!
A bolt of ice blasts onto @target@!
A bolt of lightning fires onto @target@!
A stream of poison gushes onto @target@!
A bolt of fire fires onto @target@!
Deals up to %d manaburn damage, draining mana, vim, and positive and negative energies within radius %d.
target: 在%d码范围内最多造成%d点法力燃烧伤害，并吸取法力值、活力值以及正负能量。

source: A powerful blast of fire impacts @target@!
All within radius %d are dealt %d fire damage, set on fire for %d more fire damage over 3 turns, and may be stunned.
target: %d码范围内的所有目标受到%d火焰伤害，在3回合内额外受到%d燃烧伤害，并有几率被震慑。

source: A motile vine that strikes out for %s%d#LAST# %s damage.
target: 一团活动的藤蔓，打击目标造成%s%d#LAST#%s伤害。

source: Teleports the victim away.  How does anyone get close enough to disarm this trap...?
target: 将目标传送走。能有人成功走近并解除这个陷阱吗…？

source: @Target@ is caught in a distorted pocket of time!
Creates a temporal anomaly when triggered.
@Target@ is caught in an extremely distorted pocket of time!
Creates a major temporal anomaly when triggered.
target: 触发时制造大型时空异常。

source: @Target@ is caught by a water siphon!

target: 一瓶长老吸血鬼的血液

source: A length of troll intestines. Fortunately, the troll appears to have eaten nothing in some time.
target: 一截巨魔肠子。幸运的是，这只巨魔碰巧没吃任何东西。
在把它带回来之前请把它清理干净。

source: The skull of a skeleton mage. The eyes have stopped glowing... for now.
target: 一颗骷髅法师的头骨。现在……它的眼睛已经暗淡了。

source: If the eyes are still glowing, please bash it around a bit until they fade. I'll not have another one of those coming alive and wreaking havoc in my lab.
target: 如果它的眼睛仍然亮着，请猛击它直到不再发光为止。我不想再要一个会突然活过来并把我的实验室搞得一塌糊涂的头骨了。

source: A ritch stinger, still glistening with venom.
target: 一只里奇的螫针，还残留着许多粘稠的毒液。

source: Keep as much venom in it as possible.
target: 请尽可能多地保留其中的毒液。

source: The heart of an orc. Perhaps surprisingly, it isn't green.
target: 一颗兽人的心脏。很惊讶吧，它不是绿色的。

source: If you can fetch me a still-beating orc heart, that would be even better. But you don't look like a master necromancer to me.
target: 如果你能给我一个新鲜的、跳动着的兽人心脏，那就太好了。但是在我看来，你不像是一个死灵魔导师。

source: A severed naga tongue. It reeks of brine.
target: 一截娜迦的舌头。它散发着海水的气息。

source: Best results occur with tongues never tainted by profanity, so if you happen to know any saintly nagas...
target: 最好的结果便是从未被污言秽语亵渎过的舌头，所以如果你正好碰到那些圣者娜迦……

source: A vial of greater demon bile. It hurts your sinuses even with the vial's stopper firmly in place.
target: 一瓶大恶魔的胆汁。尽管有着良好的阻隔，它仍刺激着你的鼻窦。

source: Don't drink it, even if it tells you to.
target: 不要去喝它，即使它诱惑着你……

source: Once the magics animating the bone giant fled, its remains crumbled to dust. It might be your imagination, but it looks like the dust occasionally stirs on its own.
target: 当操纵骨巨人的魔法力量消散后，尘归尘，土归土。也许是你的幻觉，但是它似乎偶尔会自行移动起来。

source: Never, ever to be confused with garlic powder. Trust me.
target: 绝对绝对不要和大蒜粉搞混，相信我……

source: Wickedly sharp and still freezing cold.
target: 异乎寻常的锋利且散发着阵阵寒气。

source: If you've the means to eliminate the little venom problem, these make miraculous instant drink-chilling straws.
target: 如果你有方法消除小小的毒液问题，这些螫针可以成为不可思议的冷冻吸管。

source: The severed front half of a minotaur snout, ring and all.
target: 一只米诺陶的鼻子的前半部分，上面有圆环装饰。

source: You'll need to find one with a ring, preferably an expensive one.
target: 你要寻找一个带有圆环的，最好是贵一些的那种。
一瓶长老吸血鬼的血液

source: Thick, clotted, and foul. The vial is cold to the touch.
target: 粘稠的、凝固的、污秽的液体。瓶子摸起来很冷。

source: Once you've gotten it, cross some moving water on your way back.
target: 拿到之后，回来时记得渡过一处流水。

source: Beautiful and nearly impregnable. Separating it from the dragon must have been hard work.
target: 美丽且异常坚固的龙鳞。把它从龙身上扒下来一定费了不少力气。

source: If you think collecting one of these is hard, try liquefying one.
target: 如果你认为收集一片龙鳞很困难，那么去尝试溶解它吧。

source: An ugly, ripped-out chunk of giant spider. Bits of silk protrude from an orifice.
target: 从巨型蜘蛛身上扯下的一大块丑陋的器官，少量的丝线从某个洞中伸出。

source: The spiders in your barn won't do. You'll know a giant spider when you see one, though they're rare in Maj'Eyal.
target: 你家仓库里的蜘蛛是不行的。当你看到一只时，你就会明白什么是巨型蜘蛛，尽管在马基·埃亚尔这种蜘蛛很稀少。

source: The severed end of one of a honey tree's roots. It wriggles around occasionally, seemingly unwilling to admit that it's dead... and a *plant*.
target: 蜜蜂树的一根树根。它偶尔会蠕动下，似乎不承认它已经死了，而且还是个“植物”。

source: Keep a firm grip on it. These things will dig themselves right back into the ground if you drop them.
target: 牢牢的抓住它，如果你不小心把它掉在地上，它会立刻挖地逃走。

source: Diseased-looking and reeking. It seems to be decaying as you watch.
target: 病变且散发着恶臭的心脏，在你注视它时似乎仍在腐烂。

source: Don't worry if it dissolves. Just don't get any on you.
target: 别担心它会溶解，只要别让它沾到你身上。

source: Slimy, wriggling, and crackling with electricity.
target: 黏滑、蠕动的尾巴，还闪着噼啪作响的电火花。

source: I know, I know. Where does the eel stop and the tail start? It doesn't much matter. The last ten inches or so should do nicely.
target: 我知道，我知道。你想问电鳗的尾巴是哪一段？没有确切的答案。最后 10 英寸或许是最合适的。

source: However annoying this will be for you to gather, I promise that the reek it produces in my lab will prove even more annoying.
target: 不管采集它会让你多么恼火，我保证它在我实验室里散发的恶臭会更令人受不了。

source: Large and hairy with flesh-rending claws. It smells slightly of fish.
target: 体型巨大、浑身长毛，还有能撕裂血肉的利爪。它闻起来略带鱼腥味。

source: You'd think I could get one of these from a local hunter, but they've had no luck. Don't get eaten.
target: 你认为我可以从本地的猎户手上取得它吗？甭想了，他们没那个运气。不要被吃掉了。

source: This tooth has been blunted with age, but still looks more than capable of doing its job.
target: 这颗牙齿饱受岁月的侵蚀，但是仍然能胜任它的工作。

source: Ice Wyrms lose teeth fairly often, so you might get lucky and not have to do battle with one. But dress warm just in case.
target: 冰龙每隔一段时间会换齿，所以你幸运的话，可以捡到几颗而不需要和它战斗。保险起见穿的暖和点……

source: Tiny flames still dance ethereally inside this transparent crystal, though its heat seems to have faded... you hope.
target: 小巧的火焰依然在这颗透明的水晶里轻盈舞动，尽管它的热量似乎已经消退……你希望如此。

source: I hear these can be found in a cave near Elvala. I also hear that they can cause you to spontaneously combust, so no need to explain if you come back hideously scarred.
target: 我听说这些小家伙可以在埃尔瓦拉附近的洞穴里找到。我还听说它们会使你自燃，所以当你高度烧伤回来的话，不要向我诉苦。

source: Clear and slightly thicker than water. It froths when shaken.
target: 龙涎比水更加粘稠，和水一样清澈，当你摇晃它时会有泡沫产生。

source: Keep this stuff well away from your campfire unless you want me to have to find a new, more alive adventurer.
target: 把这个瓶子离你的篝火远一些，我可不想明天重新找一个活的冒险家。

source: Rotten and reeking. It still twitches occasionally.
target: 这块肉腐烂且散发着恶臭，偶尔还会抽搐。

source: Unfortunately for you, the chunks that regularly fall off ghouls won't do. I need one freshly carved off.
target: 告诉你一个不幸的消息，平时从食尸鬼身上掉下来的肉是不行的。我需要新鲜的，刚切下来的肉。

source: Bits of dry flesh still cling to this ancient bone.
target: 在这个古代的骨头上仍残留着一点肉块。
