source: #LIGHT_BLUE#Various alchemists around Maj'Eyal are competing to gain entry into the great Brotherhood of Alchemists, and one or more have enlisted your aid.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#很多马基·埃亚尔的炼金术士想竞争加入强大的炼金术士兄弟会，其中有一个或者几个人请求你的帮助。#WHITE#

source: #RED#%s has completed an %s without your aid.#WHITE#
target: #RED#%s已经制造了%s，并没有获得你的帮助。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#Having failed to gain admittance to the Brotherhood of the Alchemists, %s no longer needs your help making the %s.
target: #SLATE#无法获得炼金术士兄弟会的承认，%s不再需要你帮忙制作 %s。

source: %s needs your help making an %s. He has given you some notes on the ingredients:
target: %s 需要你帮忙制作 %s。他给了你一张写着配方的小纸条：

source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

source: #VIOLET#You can check the ingredients you possess by pressing Escape and selecting 'Show ingredients'.
target: #VIOLET#你现在可以按ESC调出游戏菜单，选择“查看材料”检查自己所拥有的材料。

source: You were sent to the Charred Scar at the heart of which lies a huge volcano. In the Age of Pyre it destroyed the old Sher'Tul ruins that stood there, absorbing much of their latent magic.
target: 你被送到了灼烧之痕，其中心是一座巨大的火山——烈火纪元时，喷发的火山摧毁了当时矗立于此的古老夏·图尔遗址，并吸收了其中潜藏的大量魔法。

source: This place is still full of that power and the orcs intend to absorb this power using the Staff of Absorption!
target: 这里仍然充满了那种能量，兽人打算用吸能法杖的力量来吸收这里的能量。

source: Whatever their plan may be, they must be stopped at all cost.
target: 不管他们的目的是要干什么，必须不惜一切代价阻止他们。

source: The volcano is attacked by orcs. A few Sun Paladins made it there with you. They will hold the line at the cost of their lives to buy you some time.
target: 火山受到了兽人的攻击，一些太阳骑士正顶在最前线用他们的生命来帮助你争取一些时间。

source: Honor their sacrifice; do not let the orcs finish their work!
target: 向他们的献身精神致敬！不要让兽人们达成所愿。

source: You arrived too late. The place has been drained of its power and the sorcerers have left.
target: 你来的太晚了，这里的能量已经被吸干，而那些法师已经离开了。

source: Use the portal to go back to the Far East. You *MUST* stop them, no matter the cost.
target: 使用传送门到达远东大陆，你必须阻止他们，不惜一切代价！

source: You arrived in time and interrupted the ritual. The sorcerers have departed.
target: 你终于及时赶来阻止了仪式，法师们被驱散了。

source: #VIOLET#A portal activates in the distance. You hear the orcs shout, 'The Sorcerers have departed! Follow them!'
target: #VIOLET#远处一个传送门被激活，你听到兽人们吼道：“恶魔法师已经离开！跟上他们！”

source: #VIOLET#The Sorcerers flee through a portal. As you prepare to follow them, a huge faeros appears to block the way.
target: #VIOLET#恶魔法师从传送门逃跑了，当你准备跟随他们时，一个巨大的法罗挡住了去路。

source: Your escape from Reknor got your heart pounding and your desire for wealth and power increased tenfold.
target: 你从瑞库纳逃了出来，你觉得你的心脏狂跳不止，你对财富和力量的渴望增加了十倍～

source: Maybe it is time for you to start an adventurer's career. Deep below the Iron Throne mountains lies the Deep Bellow.
target: 也许是你开始冒险生涯的时候了，在钢铁王座山脉的深处有个无尽深渊地下城。

source: It has been long sealed away but still, from time to time adventurers go there looking for wealth.
target: 那里已被尘封已久，但是还是不断有冒险者前去寻找财宝。

source: None that you know of has come back yet, but you did survive Reknor. You are great.
target: 据你所知没有一个人能活着回来，不过你从瑞库纳幸存了下来，你比较牛 X。

source: You have heard that near the Charred Scar, to the south, lies a ruined tower known as the Dreadfell.
target: 你听说在灼烧之痕南部有一个叫做恐惧王座的荒塔废墟。

source: There are disturbing rumors of greater undead, and nobody who reached it ever returned.
target: 传说那里有强大的亡灵生物，凡是到达那里的人都有去无回。

source: Perhaps you should explore it and find the truth, and the treasures, for yourself!
target: 也许你应该去那里一探究竟，顺便可以找到埋藏在那里的财宝。

source: You have created a portal back to Maj'Eyal. You should try to talk to someone in Last Hope about establishing a link back.
target: 你创造了一个回到马基·埃亚尔的传送门，你应该试试找最后的希望的某个人谈谈关于这件事。

source: You talked to the Elder in Last Hope who in turn told you to talk to Tannen, who lives in the north of the city.
target: 你和最后的希望的长者交谈，得知要去找城市北边的泰恩

source: You gave the Orb of Many Ways to Tannen to study while you look for the athame and diamond in Reknor.
target: 你把多元水晶球交给泰恩研究，自己则去瑞库纳寻找仪式匕首和共鸣钻石。

source: You kept the Orb of Many Ways despite Tannen's request to study it. You must now look for the athame and diamond in Reknor.
target: 尽管泰恩想要研究多元水晶球，你还是把它留在了自己手中。现在你必须去瑞库纳寻找仪式匕首和共鸣钻石。

source: You brought back the diamond and athame to Tannen who asked you to check the tower of Telmur, looking for a text of portals, although he is not sure it is even there. He told you to come back in a few days.
target: 你把共鸣钻石和仪式匕首带回给泰恩；他让你去泰尔玛之塔寻找一本有关传送门的典籍，尽管他也不确定那里是否真有。他让你过几天再回来。

source: You brought back the diamond and athame to Tannen who asked you to contact Zemekkys to ask some delicate questions.
target: 你把共鸣钻石和仪式匕首带回给泰恩；他让你联系伊莫克斯，询问一些敏感问题。

source: You brought back the diamond and athame to Tannen who asked you to come back in a few days.
target: 你把共鸣钻石和仪式匕首带回给泰恩；他让你过几天再回来。

source: Tannen has tricked you! He swapped the orb for a false one that brought you to a demonic plane. Find the exit, and get revenge!
target: 泰恩把你耍了！他换了个错的水晶球给你，把你传送到了恶魔的空间，找到出口回去找他算账！

source: Tannen revealed himself as the vile scum he really is and trapped you in his tower.
target: 泰恩暴露出了他的确是个卑鄙的人渣，他把你囚禁在他的塔牢里。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* The portal to the Far East is now functional and can be used to go back.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 通向远东的传送门开始运作了，你可以用它来回去。#WHITE#

source: Tannen points to the location of Telmur on your map.
target: 泰恩在你的地图上指出了泰尔玛的位置。

source: A portal appears in the center of the tower!
target: 在塔的中间出现了一个传送门!
安格利文传令官 梅拉纳斯

source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you are back in Last Hope.
target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼的功夫你已经回到了最后的希望。

source: You successfully escorted the %s to the recall portal on level %s.
target: 你成功地将%s护送到了%s的召回传送门。

source: You failed to protect the %s from death by %s.
target: 你未能保护%s，他被%s杀死了。

source: Escort the %s to the recall portal on level %s.
target: 将%s护送到%s的召回传送门

source: Ungrol of Last Hope asked you to look for his wife's friend Celia, who has been reported missing. She frequently visits her late husband's mausoleum, in the graveyard near Last Hope.
target: 最后的希望城的温格洛请你寻找他妻子的朋友赛利亚；据说她失踪了。赛利亚常去最后的希望附近墓地中她亡夫的陵墓。

source: You searched for Celia in the graveyard near Last Hope, and found a note. In it, Celia reveals that she has been conducting experiments in the dark arts, in an attempt to extend her life... also, she is pregnant.
target: 你在最后的希望附近的墓地寻找赛利亚，并发现了一张字条。字条中，赛利亚透露自己一直在研究黑暗法术，试图延长寿命……而且她怀孕了。

source: You have tracked Celia to her husband's mausoleum in the graveyard near Last Hope. It seems she has taken some liberties with the corpses there.
target: 你跟踪赛利亚到了她亡夫在最后的希望附近墓地的陵墓里，似乎她在那里复活了一些尸体。

source: You have laid Celia to rest, putting an end to her gruesome experiments.
target: 你埋葬了赛利亚，终结了她阴森恐怖的实验。

source: You have laid Celia to rest, putting an end to her failed experiments. You have taken her heart, for your own experiments. You do not plan to fail as she did.
target: 你埋葬了赛利亚，终结了她失败的实验，你拿走了她的心脏为自己的实验做准备，你相信你不会重蹈她的覆辙。

source: You have vanquished the masters of the Orc Pride. Now you must venture inside the most dangerous place of this world: the High Peak.
target: 你征服了兽人军团的最高领袖，现在你必须向这个世界最危险的地方挺进：巅峰。

source: Seek the Sorcerers and stop them before they bend the world to their will.
target: 找到那些妄图扭曲这个世界的法师并阻止他们。

source: To enter, you will need the four orbs of command to remove the shield over the peak.
target: 想要进去的话，你必须找到那四个指令水晶来移除塔顶的防护罩。

source: The entrance to the peak passes through a place called 'the slime tunnels', probably located inside or near Grushnak Pride.
target: 通往巅峰的入口要经过一个名为“史莱姆通道”的地方，它大概位于格鲁希纳克部落内部或附近。

source: You have reached the summit of the High Peak, entered the sanctum of the Sorcerers and destroyed them, freeing the world from the threat of evil.
target: 你已登上巅峰之巅，进入法师们的圣所并消灭了他们，将世界从邪恶的威胁中解放出来。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You encountered Sun Paladin Aeryn who blamed you for the loss of the Sunwall. You were forced to kill her.#LAST#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你遇到了太阳骑士艾琳；她将太阳堡垒的陷落归咎于你，你不得不杀了她。#LAST#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You encountered Sun Paladin Aeryn who blamed you for the loss of the Sunwall, but you spared her.#LAST#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你遭遇了太阳骑士艾琳，她把太阳堡垒陷落的责任归咎在你的头上，但是你饶恕了她。#LAST#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You defeated the Sorcerers before the Void portal could open.#LAST#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你在虚空传送门打开之前击败了那些法师。#LAST#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You defeated the Sorcerers and Aeryn sacrificed herself to close the Void portal.#LAST#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你击败了那些法师，艾琳牺牲了她自己关闭了虚空传送门。#LAST#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You defeated the Sorcerers and sacrificed yourself to close the Void portal.#LAST#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你击败了那些法师，并牺牲了自己关闭虚空传送门。#LAST#

source: #LIGHT_RED#As you enter the level you hear a familiar voice.
target: #LIGHT_RED#当你进入地图你听到了一个熟悉的声音。

source: #LIGHT_RED#Fallen Sun Paladin Aeryn: '%s YOU BROUGHT ONLY DESTRUCTION TO THE SUNWALL! YOU WILL PAY!'
target: #LIGHT_RED#堕落太阳骑士艾琳：“%s 你只给太阳堡垒带来了毁灭！你会为此付出代价！”

source: Ruins of the Gates of Morning
The Sunwall was destroyed while you were trapped in the High Peak.
target: 当你在巅峰被困的时候，太阳堡垒被摧毁了。

source: #GOLD#Well done! You have won the Tales of Maj'Eyal: The Age of Ascendancy#WHITE#
target: #GOLD#干得好！你赢得了《马基·埃亚尔的传说：卓越纪》#WHITE#

source: The Sorcerers are dead, and the Orc Pride lies in ruins, thanks to your efforts.
target: 法师已经死去，兽人部落也沦为废墟，这都归功于你的努力。

source: Your patron's plan worked. As your body was crushed by the raw forces of the void portal it opened wide. In an instant the connection was made and waves of heat came through.
target: 你的庇护者的计划成功了。你的身体被虚空传送门的原始力量碾碎，传送门随之完全开启。连接转瞬建立，滚滚热浪从门中涌出。

source: The mad sun brought forth all its power through the portal, turning the High Peak into a giant searing needle!
target: 疯狂的太阳带着所有力量穿越了传送门，将巅峰化为一根灼烧的巨针！

source: A few minutes later the whole world was set ablaze, nothing survived except Faeros elementals.
target: 几分钟后，整个世界都被点燃，除了法罗元素，没有任何幸存者。

source: In the aftermath of the battle the Distant Sun tried to force you to open the portal to bring it forth onto Eyal.
target: 战斗结束后，遥远的太阳试图强迫你开启传送门，让它降临埃亚尔。

source: Through an incredible display of willpower you resisted long enough to ask Aeryn to kill you.
target: 你凭借惊人的意志力抵抗了足够久，终于得以请求艾琳杀死你。

source: She sadly agreed and ran her sword through you, enabling you to do the last sacrifice you could for the world.
target: 她怀着悲痛的心情用长剑刺穿了你的身躯，你终于为这个世界做出了最后的贡献。

source: Through an incredible display of willpower you resisted for a few decisive seconds. During this time a Sher'tul appeared, took the Staff and killed you.
target: 你以惊人的意志力抵抗了关键的数秒，夏图尔人出现了，取走了法杖并杀死了你。

source: Though you succumbed to the fight, your mind was already gone, burnt to ashes by your mad patron sun. But the world was saved.
target: 虽然你最终屈服了，思维消散，被疯狂的太阳烧成灰烬。但世界被拯救了。

source: Your sacrifice worked. Your mental energies were imbued with farportal energies. The Way radiated from the High Peak toward the rest of Eyal like a mental tidal wave.
target: 你的牺牲起作用了，你的精神能量被远传送门能量所灌注。维网从巅峰向埃亚尔各处辐射出一股精神冲击波。

source: Every sentient being in Eyal is now part of the Way. Peace and happiness are enforced for all.
target: 所有埃亚尔有知觉的生物都成为了维网的一部分，和平与幸福被强加于所有生物。

source: Only the mages of Angolwen were able to withstand the mental shock and thus are the only unsafe people left. But what can they do against the might of the Way?
target: 只有安格利文的法师能够抵制住这道精神冲击，从而他们成为了仅存的危险人类，不过他们又能对强大的维网怎么样呢？

source: In the aftermath of the battle the Way tried to force you to act as a vessel to bring the Way to every sentient being.
target: 在战斗结束后，维网试图强迫你用你的身躯作为通道将维网传输到所有知觉生物的身体中。

source: You have prevented the portal to the Void from opening and thus stopped the Creator from bringing about the end of the world.
target: 你阻止了虚空传送门的开启，并终止了世界末日的到来。

source: In a selfless act, High Sun Paladin Aeryn sacrificed herself to close the portal to the Void and thus stopped the Creator from bringing about the end of the world.
target: 高阶太阳骑士艾琳无私地牺牲了自己，关闭通往虚空的传送门，从而阻止造物主毁灭世界。

source: In a selfless act, you sacrificed yourself to close the portal to the Void and thus stopped the Creator from bringing about the end of the world.
target: 你无私地牺牲了自己，关闭通往虚空的传送门，从而阻止造物主毁灭世界。

source: The Gates of Morning have been destroyed and the Sunwall has fallen. The last remnants of the free people in the Far East will surely diminish, and soon only orcs will inhabit this land.
target: 晨曦之门已被摧毁，太阳堡垒已经陷落。远东自由人民最后的残余势力必将衰亡，不久后，这片土地上将只剩兽人。

source: The orc presence in the Far East has greatly been diminished by the loss of their leaders and the destruction of the Sorcerers. The free people of the Sunwall will be able to prosper and thrive on this land.
target: 随着首领丧生、法师被消灭，远东的兽人势力已大幅削弱。太阳堡垒的自由人民将得以在这片土地上繁衍兴盛。

source: Maj'Eyal will once more know peace. Most of its inhabitants will never know they even were on the verge of destruction, but then this is what being a true hero means: to do the right thing even though nobody will know about it.
target: 马基·埃亚尔将重归和平。大多数居民永远不会知道自己曾濒临毁灭，但这正是真正英雄的意义：即使无人知晓，也要做正确的事。

source: You may continue playing and enjoy the rest of the world.
target: 你可以继续在这个世界上探险。

source: You have entered the Infinite Dungeon. There is no going back now.
target: 你进入了无限地下城。你已不能再走回头路了。

source: Go deep, fight, win or die in a blaze of glory!
target: 深入地下城去战斗吧，胜利或者为荣耀而死！

source: You have begun to look for a way to overcome the curse that afflicts you.
target: 你开始寻求方法以驱除一直困扰着你的诅咒。

source: You have found a small iron acorn which you keep as a reminder of your past.
target: 你找到了一个小小的铁质橡果，将它保留下来，作为对过去的提醒。

source: You have destroyed the merchant caravan that you once considered family.
target: 你摧毁了那个你曾经视作家人的商队。

source: Kyless, the one who brought the curse, is dead by your hand.
target: 克里斯，那个曾经为你带来诅咒的人，死在了你的手上。

source: Berethh is dead, may he rest in peace.
target: 贝里斯已死，但愿他能安息。

source: Your curse has changed the iron acorn which now serves as a cruel reminder of your past and present.
target: 你的诅咒使铁橡果成为了使你回忆起残酷过去和现实的信物。

source: You have found a small iron acorn which you keep as a reminder of your past
target: 你找到了一个小小的铁质橡果，将它保留下来，作为对过去的提醒。

source: Your curse has defiled the iron acorn which now serves as a reminder of your vile nature.
target: 你的诅咒污浊了铁橡果，它成为了使你回想起你卑劣本性的信物。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You need to find Berethh, the last person who may be able to help you.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你得找到贝里斯，也许他是最后一个可以帮助你的人。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Seek out Kyless' cave in the northern part of the meadow and end him. Perhaps the curse will end with him.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#找出位于草原北部的克里斯的洞穴，然后杀掉他，他的死也许会解除这个诅咒。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Discover the meaning of the acorn and the dream.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#搞清楚铁橡果与这个梦境的含义。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You may have to revist your past to unlock some secret buried there.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你可以回忆一下过去来解开埋藏在这里的秘密。

source: #VIOLET#The time has come to learn the true nature of your curse.
target: #VIOLET#是时候搞清楚你诅咒的本质了。

source: #VIOLET#Your hate surges. You refuse to succumb to death!
target: #VIOLET#你仇恨涌动，你不屈服于死亡！

source: #VIOLET#You have discovered a small iron acorn, a link to your past.
target: #VIOLET#你发现了一个小铁橡果，它和你的过去有关。

source: #VIOLET#The merchant caravan from the past has appeared in your dream.
target: #VIOLET#很久以前商队的往事出现在你的梦里。

source: #VIOLET#You have begun your hunt for Kyless!
#VIOLET#You have a marker to the entrance of Kyless' cave!
target: #VIOLET#你在通往克里斯洞穴的入口上有一个记号！

source: #VIOLET#You have found the entrance to Kyless' cave!
target: #VIOLET#你找到了通往克里斯洞穴的入口！

source: #VIOLET#You have found the entrance to a vault!
target: #VIOLET#你找到了通往一处宝库的入口！

source: You recognize this door as the entrance to a second vault. There are some scuffling noises and heavy breathing coming from the other side of the door.
target: 你认出来这扇门是通向另一处宝库的门户。你可以听到门的另一边有拖曳的脚步声和沉重的呼吸声

source: #VIOLET#You have found Kyless. You must destroy him.
target: #VIOLET#你找到了克里斯，你必须杀死他。

source: You discovered a sect worshipping a demon named Kryl-Feijan in a crypt.
target: 你在一个地穴中发现了一个崇拜名为卡洛·斐济的恶魔的教派。

source: They were trying to bring it back into the world using a human sacrifice.
target: 他们试图用献祭活人来召唤恶魔到这个世界上。

source: You defeated the acolytes and saved the woman. She told you she is the daughter of a rich merchant of Last Hope.
target: 你打败了那些侍僧并救下了这个女人。她告诉你，她是最后的希望城中一位富商的女儿。

source: You failed to protect her when escorting her out of the crypt.
target: 你没能成功地将她护送出这个地穴。

source: You failed to defeat the acolytes in time - the woman got torn apart by the demon growing inside her.
target: 你没能及时杀死那些侍僧，那个女人被在她体内成长的恶魔撕成了碎片。

source: The affairs of this mortal world are trifling compared to your true goal: To conquer death.
target: 凡人世界的那些琐事，与你的终极目标——超越死亡——相比，都是微不足道的。

source: Your studies have uncovered much surrounding this subject, but now you must prepare for your glorious rebirth.
target: 你关于这个主题的研究已经令你发现了很多东西，现在，你必须准备你辉煌的重生仪式。

source: #SLATE#* The ceremony will require that you are worthy, experienced, and possessed of a certain amount of power (level 25, Magic over 50, Willpower over 25 and one prodigy point available).#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 仪式要求你具备资格、经验丰富，并拥有足够的力量（达到 25 级、魔力超过 50、意志超过 25，且有 1 点可用的觉醒点）。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have 'extracted' the heart of one of your fellow necromancers.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经取得了你死灵法师同类的心脏。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* The beating heart of a powerful necromancer.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 一个死灵法师跳动的心脏。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Yiilkgur the Sher'tul Fortress is a suitable location.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 夏·图尔堡垒伊克格是个合适的地方。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You are now on the path of lichdom.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经做好了成为巫妖的准备。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* Use the control orb of Yiilkgur to begin the ceremony.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 使用伊克格的控制水晶球来开启仪式。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* Your lair must amass enough energy to use in your rebirth (40 energy).#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你的堡垒中必须积累足够的能量才能开启重生仪式。（40 能量）#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* The ceremony will require a suitable location, secluded and given to the channelling of energy#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 仪式必须在一个合适的地方进行，要足够隐蔽但是又能传输能量。#WHITE#

source: The secrets of death lay open to you! You are to become a Lich upon your next death!
target: 死亡的秘密已经朝你打开了！你下一次死亡就会转生为巫妖！

source: As you approached Derth you saw a huge dark cloud over the small town.
target: 当你接近德斯镇时，你看到一大片漆黑的乌云笼罩在小镇上方。

source: When you entered you were greeted by an army of air elementals slaughtering the population.
target: 当你进入小镇时，迎面所见是一群正在屠杀居民的空气元素。

source: * You have dispatched the elementals but the cloud lingers still. You must find a powerful ally to remove it. There are rumours of a secret town in the mountains, to the southwest. You could also check out the Ziguranth group that is supposed to fight magic.
target: * 你已经驱散了元素生物，但是天上乌云并未就此散去。你需要寻找一位盟友来帮助你。传说中，在西南方的山脉之中有一个神秘的小镇，你也能顺便调查一下伊格兰斯这个反魔法军团。

source: * You have learned the real threat comes from a rogue Archmage, a Tempest named Urkis. The mages of Angolwen are ready to teleport you there.
target: * 你得知真正的威胁来自于一个叛逃的元素法师，名字叫厄奇斯，精通风暴法术，安格利文的法师已经准备好把你传送到那里去了。

source: * You have learned the real threat comes from a rogue Archmage, a Tempest. You have been shown a secret entrance to his stronghold.
target: * 你得知真正的威胁来自于一位叛逃的元素法师，也就是一位风暴法师。有人为你指出了通往他秘密据点的一条隐秘通道。

source: * You have slain Urkis.  Return to Angolwen or Zigur for a reward.
target: * 你干掉了厄奇斯。现在返回安格利文或者伊格领取奖励吧。

source: * Urkis has been dealt with. Permanently.
target: * 厄奇斯被永远解决掉了。

source:
You step out on unfamiliar grounds. You are nearly on top of one of the highest peaks you can see.
The storm is raging above your head.
target:
你进入了一个不熟悉的地方。你几乎站在了你能看到的最高峰位置。
风暴在你的头顶肆虐。

source:
As you arrive in Derth you notice a huge dark cloud hovering over the town.
You hear screams coming from the town square.
target:
当你到达德斯镇时你注意到小镇上空有一大团黑压压的乌云。
你听到小镇广场上传来的尖叫声。

source:
It seems the Ziguranth have kept their word.
Derth is free of the storm cloud.
target:
似乎伊格兰斯们遵守了他们的诺言。
德斯镇的风暴威胁解除了。

source:
It seems the mages have kept their word.
Derth is free of the storm cloud.
target:
似乎法师们遵守了他们的诺言。
德斯镇的风暴威胁解除了。

source: You heard a plea for help and decided to investigate...
target: 你听到了求救声，决定去调查一下……

source: Only to find yourself trapped inside an unknown tunnel complex.
target: 却发现自己被困在一片陌生的地下通道群中。

source: A stairway out appears at your feet. The Lord says: 'And remember, you are MINE. I will call you.'
target: 一道通往外界的楼梯出现在你脚下。盗贼领主说道：“记住，你是我的人。我会召唤你的。”

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#The merchant thanks you for saving his life. He gives you 8 gold and asks you to meet him again in Last Hope.
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#商人感谢你救了他的命。他给了你8金币，邀请你在最后的希望见他。

source: After rescuing Melinda from Kryl-Feijan and the cultists you met her again in Last Hope.
target: 在你从卡洛·斐济邪教手中解救了梅琳达之后，你在最后的希望又碰到了她。

source: Melinda was saved from the brink of death at the beach, by a strange wave of blight.
target: 在海滩上，一股奇异的枯萎能量将梅琳达从死亡边缘救了回来。

source: Melinda died to a Yaech raiding party at the beach.
target: 梅琳达被沙滩上的夺魂魔杀死了。

source: The Fortress Shadow said she could be cured.
target: 堡垒之影说她会得到治疗。

source: Melinda decided to come live with you in your Fortress.
target: 梅琳达决定和你一起在堡垒里生活。

source: The Fortress Shadow has established a portal for her so she can come and go freely.
target: 堡垒之影为她建造了一个传送门，他让她能够自由来去。

source: After your victory you came back to Last Hope and reunited with Melinda, who after many years remains free of demonic corruption.
target: 在你的胜利之后，你回到了最后的希望，并与梅琳达重聚，梅琳达在许多年后没有再受到恶魔腐化的影响。

source: You lived together and led a happy life. Melinda even learned a few adventurer's tricks and you both traveled Eyal, making new legends.
target: 你们住在一起，过着幸福的生活。梅琳达甚至学会了一些冒险家的技能，你们俩一起去旅行，创造了新的传奇。

source: You saved her from the depth of a cultists' lair and fell in love with her. She has moved into the Fortress to see you more often.
target: 你把她从邪教徒的巢穴中救了出来，并且与她相爱了。她现在搬到了堡垒里，可以经常见到你。

source: You met a half-mad lumberjack fleeing a small village, rambling about an untold horror lurking there, slaughtering people.
target: 你遇到了一个吓得魂飞魄散的伐木工人从一个小村庄里跑出来，大声喊着有个没见过的吓人的东西在里面杀人。

source: He points in the direction of the Riljek forest to the north.
target: 他指着北方的里尔约克森林。

source: The remaining lumberjacks collect some gold to thank you (%0.2f).
target: 剩余的伐木工人收集了一些黄金来谢谢你(%0.2f)。

source: You saved %s of us, please take this as a reward. (They give you %s)
target: 你救下了我们中的%s人，请你收下这个作为奖励吧。 (他们给了你 %s)

source: #LIGHT_RED#A lumberjack falls to the ground, dead.
target: #LIGHT_RED#一个伐木工人倒在了地上，死了。

source: You met a novice mage who was tasked to collect an arcane powered artifact.
target: 你碰到了一个法师学徒，他被指派去搜集一件充满奥术力量的神器。

source: He asked for your help, should you collect some that you do not need.
target: 如果你收集到自己不需要的奥术物品，他希望你能交给他。

source: #SLATE#* Collect an artifact arcane powered item.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 收集一件强力的奥术神器。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_RED#As the apprentice touches the staff he begins to scream, flames bursting out of his mouth. Life seems to be drained away from him, and in an instant he collapses in a lifeless husk.
target: #LIGHT_RED#当学徒触摸这根法杖，他开始尖叫，火焰从他的嘴里喷射了出来。他的生命似乎被从他的体内吸取了出来。瞬间他只剩下一具毫无生机的空壳。

source: You found an ancient tome about gems.
target: 你发现一本关于珠宝的旧书。

source: You should bring it to the jeweler in the Gates of Morning.
target: 你应该把这本书带给晨曦之门的珠宝匠看看。

source: Limmir told you to look for the Valley of the Moon in the southern mountains.
target: 利米尔让你去南部山脉寻找新月峡谷。

source: #VIOLET#This tome seems to be about the power of gems. Maybe you should bring it to the jeweler in the Gates of Morning.
target: #VIOLET#这本册子似乎描述了关于宝石的力量。也许应该带给晨曦之门的珠宝匠看看。

source: Limmir points to the entrance to a cave on your map. This is supposed to be the way to the valley.
target: 利米尔在你的地图上指出了山洞的入口。这是一条通往山谷的路。

source: You must be near the moonstone to summon Limmir.
target: 你必须在月亮石附近召唤利米尔。

source: You do not have the summoning scroll!
You have found an orb of command that seems to be used to open the shield protecting the High Peak.
target: 你找到了一个指令水晶球，似乎是用来开启巅峰护盾的钥匙。

source: There seems to be a total of four of them. The more you have the weaker the shield will be.
target: 似乎一共有四个水晶球，你得到的越多，护盾的防御力越弱。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#There is a loud crack. The way is open.
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#随着一声巨响，道路被打开了。

source: You have encountered a dying sun paladin that told you about the orcs breeding pit, a true abomination.
target: 你遇到了一个垂死的太阳骑士，他告诉了你有关兽人育种棚的消息，那是一个真正的梦魇。

source: You have decided to report the information to Aeryn so she can deal with it.
target: 你已经决定把这个消息报告给艾琳，让她处理此事。

source: Aeryn said she would send troops to deal with it.
target: 艾琳说她会派军队去处理。

source: You have taken upon yourself to cleanse it and deal a crippling blow to the orcs.
target: 你决定自己行动，清理了它，对兽人造成了致命的打击。
这个可怕的任务完成了。

source: Entrance to the orc breeding pit
The elder in Last Hope sent you to the old Dwarven kingdom of Reknor, deep under the Iron Throne, to investigate the orc presence.
target: 最后的希望城的长者派你前往钢铁王座地下深处的古老矮人王国瑞库纳，调查兽人的踪迹。

source: Find out if they are in any way linked to the lost staff.
target: 查清楚他们是不是和遗失的法杖有关。

source: But be careful -- even the Dwarves have not ventured in these old halls for many years.
target: 小心，矮人们已经很多年没有进过那些古老的大厅了。

source: The elder points to Reknor on your map, to the north on the western side of the Iron Throne.
target: 长老在你的地图上指出了瑞库纳的位置，在钢铁王座西部边境的北部。

source: The many Prides of the Orcs
Investigate the bastions of the Pride.
#SLATE#* Rak'shor Pride, in the west of the southern desert.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 拉克·肖部落，位于南部沙漠西部。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* Vor Pride, in the north east.#WHITE#

target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你击败了格鲁希纳克部落。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* Grushnak Pride, near a small mountain range in the north west.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 格鲁希纳克部落在西北部一个小山脉附近。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* Gorbat Pride, in a mountain range in the southern desert.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 加伯特部落，在南部沙漠的一个山脉中。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* All the bastions of the Pride lie in ruins, their masters destroyed. High Sun Paladin Aeryn would surely be glad of the news!#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 所有的部落基地被摧毁，他们的首领被杀死了，高阶太阳骑士艾琳应该对这个消息感到很高兴！#WHITE#

source: You have met what seems to be a future version of yourself.
target: 你看到了一个未来的自己。

source: You tried to kill yourself to prevent you from doing something, or going somewhere... you were not very clear.
target: 你尝试杀掉自己，以免他做什么你不知道的事或者到某个……你也不清楚的地方。

source: You were killed by your future self, and thus this event never occured.
target: 你被未来的自己杀掉了，这件事就像没有发生过一样。

source: You killed your future self. In the future, you might wish to avoid time-traveling back to this moment...
target: 你杀死了未来的自己，在未来，你可不希望再穿越时空到这个时间点……

source: A later (less fortunate?) version of %s, possibly going mad.
target: 某个未来的（并且不太走运的？）%s，恐怕已经陷入了疯狂。

source: but nobody knew why #sex# suddenly became evil
target: 但是没有人知道为什么#sex#突然变得邪恶了

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#Killing your own future self does feel weird, but you know that you can avoid this future. Just do not time travel.
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#杀死未来的自己确实感觉很怪，但你知道自己可以避免这样的未来。只要别穿越时间。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#Your future self kills you! The timestreams are broken by the paradox!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你未来的自己杀死了你！时间流被混乱所打破！

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#All those events never happened. Except they did, somewhen.
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#所有这些从来没有发生过，除了他们在某个时候干过。

source: This rift in time has been created by the paradox. You dare not enter it; it could make things worse. Another Warden will have to fix your mess.
target: 这个时间裂隙是时空紊乱造成的。你不敢进入，事情可能会变得更糟，另外一个守卫将不得不前去修复混乱。

source: Orcs were spotted with the staff you seek in an arid waste in the southern desert.
target: 有人看到兽人带着你所寻找的法杖，出现在南部沙漠的一片干旱荒地中。

source: You should go investigate what is happening there.
target: 你得去调查一下那里发生了什么事。

source: Aeryn explained where the orcs were spotted.
target: 艾琳告诉你哪里发现了兽人的踪迹。

source: Light at the end of the tunnel
You must find a way to Maj'Eyal through the tunnel to the north of the island.
target: 你必须在小岛北部找到一条穿过这个通道到达马基·埃亚尔的路。

source: You have found a slavers' compound and entered it.
target: 你发现了一处奴隶贩子的营地，并走了进去。

source: You decided to join the slavers and take part in their game. You won the ring of blood!
target: 你决定加入奴隶贩子，参与他们的游戏。你赢得了鲜血之环！

source: You decided you cannot let slavers continue their dirty work and destroyed them!
target: 你认定不能任由奴隶贩子继续干这种肮脏勾当，于是消灭了他们！

source: The orb seems to fizzle without the Blood Master.
target: 没有血之领主在场，水晶球似乎只是发出嘶嘶声，无法生效。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#As you touch the orb your will fills the slave's body. You take full control of his actions!
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#当你触摸水晶球时你的意志进入了奴隶的体内，你可以完全控制他的行动！

source: #CRIMSON#A new foe appears in the ring of blood!
target: #CRIMSON#新的对手出现在了鲜血之环！

source: You found notes from an explorer inside the Old Forest. He spoke about Sher'Tul ruins sunken below the surface of the lake of Nur, at the forest's center.
target: 在古老森林里找到了一个探险者的笔记，里面提到在森林中心的纳尔湖底下有一个沉没的夏·图尔遗迹。

source: With one of the notes there was a small gem that looks like a key.
target: 和笔记在一起被发现的还有个小小的宝石，样子看上去像一把钥匙。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You used the key inside the ruins of Nur and found a way into the fortress of old.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你在纳尔湖的底部使用这把钥匙，进入了一个古老的堡垒。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* The Weirdling Beast is dead, freeing the way into the fortress itself.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 异形触手死了，进入堡垒的道路被打开了。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have activated what seems to be a ... butler? with your rod of recall.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你用回归之杖激活了一个……管家？#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have bound the transmogrification chest to the Fortress power system.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你把转化之盒连接到了堡垒的能量系统#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have upgraded the transmogrification chest to automatically transmute metallic items into gems before transmogrifying them.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你升级了转化之盒，现在它会在转化的时候自动把金属物品转化成宝石了。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have unlocked the training room.#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#* You have unlocked the hall of reflections.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你解锁了反射之镜的大厅。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have upgraded your rod of recall to transport you to the fortress.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你升级了回归之杖，现在可以用它传送到堡垒。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* The fortress shadow has asked that you come back as soon as possible.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 堡垒之影希望你尽快回来。#WHITE#

source: #RED#* You have forced a recall while in an exploratory farportal zone. The farportal was rendered unusable in the process.#WHITE#
target: #RED#* 你在探索用远古传送门区域内强制启动了回归之杖，导致这座远古传送门彻底无法使用。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have entered the exploratory farportal room and defeated the horror lurking there. You can now use the farportal.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你进入了探索用远古传送门所在的房间，并消灭了潜伏其中的恐魔。现在你可以使用这座远古传送门了。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have re-enabled the fortress flight systems. You can now fly around in your fortress!#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你重新激活了堡垒的飞行系统。你可以操控你的堡垒飞行了！#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* The fortress shadow has asked that you find an Ancient Storm Sapphire, along with at least 250 energy, to re-enable the fortress flight systems.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 堡垒之影需要你找到远古风暴蓝宝石，并准备至少 250 点能量，才能重启堡垒飞行系统。#WHITE#

source: The fortress's current energy level is: #LIGHT_GREEN#%d#WHITE#.
Master, you have sent enough energy to improve your rod of recall. Please return to the fortress.
target: 主人，你已经收集了足够升级回归之杖的能量。请尽快回到堡垒来。

source:
Master, you have sent enough energy to activate the exploratory farportal.
However, there seems to be a disturbance in that room. Please return as soon as possible.
target:
主人，你已经注入了足够启动探索用远古传送门的能量。
然而，那个房间里似乎有些异动。请尽快回来。

source: The energy is too low. It needs to be at least 15.
target: 能量过低，至少需要15点能量。

source: #VIOLET#Your rod of recall glows brightly for a moment.
target: #VIOLET#你的回归之杖短暂地闪耀起来。

source: The energy is too low. It needs to be at least 25.
target: 能量过低，至少需要25点能量。

source: #VIOLET#Your transmogrification chest glows brightly for a moment.
Enter the caverns of Ardhungol and look for Sun Paladin Rashim.
target: 进入阿尔德胡格山洞寻找太阳骑士拉希姆。

source: But be careful; those are not small spiders...
target: 当心，那里的蜘蛛个头可不小……

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You have killed Ungolë in Ardhungol and saved the Sun Paladin.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你杀死了阿尔德胡格里的温格勒并救了太阳骑士。

source: She marks the location of Ardhungol on your map.
target: 她在你的地图上指出阿尔德胡格的位置。

source: Portal back to the Gates of Morning
target: 返回晨曦之门的传送门

source: A portal appears right under you, and Rashim rushes through.
target: 一道传送门在你的脚下出现，拉希姆冲了过去。

source: Deep in the Dreadfell you fought and destroyed the Master, a powerful vampire.
target: 在恐惧王座深处你和一个强大的吸血鬼大法师战斗并杀死了他。

source: On your way out of the Dreadfell you were ambushed by a band of orcs.
target: 当你走出恐惧王座的时候你受到了一队兽人小队的偷袭。

source: On your way out of the Dreadfell you were ambushed by a band of orcs and left for dead.
target: 当你走出恐惧王座时，你遭到一队兽人伏击，并被他们丢下等死。

source: They asked about the staff and stole it from you.
target: 他们从你那里得知了法杖的消息，把法杖抢走了。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#立刻到最后的希望汇报所发生的情况！

source: You told them nothing and vanquished them.
target: 你什么也没告诉他们，并把他们全都消灭了。

source: In its remains, you found a strange staff. It radiates power and danger and you dare not use it yourself.
target: 在他的尸体上，你发现了一根奇怪的法杖，它辐射出的力量和危险使你不敢使用它。

source: You should bring it to the elders of Last Hope in the southeast.
target: 你应该把它带给位于东南方的最后的希望长老们。

source: #00FFFF#You can feel the power of this staff just by carrying it. This is both ancient and dangerous.
target: #00FFFF#你拿着法杖就可以感受到它的力量。它既古老又危险。

source: #00FFFF#It should be shown to the wise elders in Last Hope!
target: #00FFFF#应该把它交给最后的希望的智慧长老看看！

source: #VIOLET#As you come out of the Dreadfell, you encounter a band of orcs!
target: #VIOLET#当你走出恐惧王座，你遭遇了一队兽人！

source:
You wake up after a few hours, surprised to be alive, but the staff is gone!
#VIOLET#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
target:
几个小时以后，你醒了过来，惊讶地发现自己还活着，不过法杖已经不见了！
#VIOLET#立刻返回最后的希望报告这件事！

source:
You are surprised to still be alive.
#VIOLET#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
target:
令人惊讶，你竟然活了下来！
#VIOLET#立刻返回最后的希望报告这件事！

source: Explore the caves below the ruins of Kor'Pul and the Trollmire in search of treasure and glory!
target: 到卡·普尔废墟和巨魔沼泽的地下城去发现宝藏和荣耀！

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Trollmire and vanquished Shax the Troll.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了巨魔沼泽并击败了巨魔夏克斯。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Trollmire and vanquished Prox the Troll.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了巨魔沼泽并击败了巨魔普罗克斯。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Trollmire and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你必须进入食人魔沼泽去调查那里潜伏着什么怪物并找到那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ruins of Kor'Pul and vanquished the Possessed.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你探索了卡·普尔废墟并击败了恶灵附身的强盗头目。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ruins of Kor'Pul and vanquished the Shade.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你探索了卡·普尔废墟并击败了暗影骷髅。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the ruins of Kor'Pul and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你必须进入卡·普尔废墟去调查那里潜伏着什么怪物并找到那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

source: The Abashed Expanse is a part of Eyal torn apart by the Spellblaze and thrown into the void between the stars.
target: 次元浮岛曾是埃亚尔大陆的一部分，在魔法大爆炸中被撕裂并轰击到星辰之间的虚无之中。

source: It has recently begun to destabilize, threatening to crash onto Eyal, destroying everything in its path.
target: 它现在变的越来越不稳定，有与埃亚尔大陆发生碰撞的危险，这将会摧毁一切它所碰到的东西。

source: You have entered it and must now stabilize three wormholes by firing any spell at them.
target: 你已经进入了那里，现在必须对三个虫洞施法以稳定它们。

source: Remember, the floating islands are not stable and might teleport randomly. However, the disturbances also help you: your Phase Door spell is fully controllable even if not of high level yet.
target: 记住，浮岛上很不稳定，有可能将你随机传送，不过也有一个好处，你可以完全控制你的相位门技能，就算你的技能等级不够高也没关系。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the expanse and closed all three wormholes.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了整个浮岛并关闭了所有三个虫洞。#WHITE#

source: You were part of a group of dwarves sent to investigate the situation of the kingdom of Reknor.
target: 你是被指派到瑞库纳王国去调查情况的一个矮人小分队的一员。

source: When you arrived there you found nothing but orcs, well organized and very powerful.
target: 当你到达那里时，你只发现了组织严密且非常强大的兽人。

source: Most of your team was killed there and now you and Norgan (the sole survivor besides you) must hurry back to the Iron Council to bring the news.
target: 你队伍中大多数人被杀死，现在你和诺尔甘 ( 除你以外的唯一幸存者 ) 必须赶紧回到钢铁议会去汇报这里的情况。

source: Both Norgan and you made it home.
target: 你和诺尔甘都回到了家。

source: The unhallowed morass is the name of the 'zone' surrounding Point Zero.
target: 混沌之沼是零点圣域周围区域的名字。

source: The temporal spiders that inhabit it are growing restless and started attacking at random. You need to investigate what is going on.
target: 栖息在那里的时空蜘蛛开始变得有攻击性，你得去调查一下到底发生了什么事。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the morass and destroyed the weaver queen, finding strange traces on it.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你探索了混沌之沼并杀死了织网蛛后，发现了奇怪的痕迹。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have helped defend Point Zero.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你成功守卫了零点圣域。#WHITE#

source: You have heard that within the scintillating caves lie strange crystals imbued with Spellblaze energies.
target: 你听说在闪光洞穴中有一些被魔法大爆炸能量影响的奇怪水晶。

source: There are also rumours of a renegade Shaloren camp to the west.
target: 有传闻说西面有堕落的永恒精灵的营地。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the scintillating caves and destroyed the Spellblaze Crystal.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了闪光洞穴，并摧毁了魔法大爆炸水晶。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the scintillating caves.#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Rhaloren camp and killed the Inquisitor.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了罗兰精灵营地并杀死了检察官。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the renegade Shaloren camp.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索那些堕落的永恒精灵的营地。#WHITE#

source:
Nagas are invading the slazish fens. The Sunwall cannot fight on two fronts; you need to stop the invaders before it is too late.
 Locate and destroy the invaders' portal.
target:
娜迦正在攻击斯拉伊什沼泽，太阳堡垒不能同时两线作战，你必须抓紧时间阻止那些侵略者，以免为时过晚。
 找到并摧毁侵略者的传送门。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have destroyed the naga portal. The invasion is stopped.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你摧毁了娜迦的传送门，侵略者被阻止了。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You are back in Var'Eyal, the Far East as the people from the west call it.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你回到了瓦·埃亚尔——来自西方的人称呼远东大陆的名字。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* However, you were teleported to a distant land. You must find a way back to the Gates of Morning.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 然而，你被传送到了一个遥远的区域，你必须找到返回晨曦之门的方法。#WHITE#

source: The Thaloren forest is disrupted. Corruption is spreading. Norgos the guardian bear is said to have gone mad.
target: 自然精灵森林陷入了混乱，到处肆虐着堕落。据说守护巨熊诺尔格斯已经陷入了疯狂。

source: On the western border of the forest a gloomy aura has been set up. Things inside are... twisted.
target: 在森林的西部边境被设置了一个黑暗光环，里面的东西已陷入了扭曲。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored Norgos' Lair and stopped the shivgoroth invasion.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了诺尔格斯的巢穴并阻止了寒冰元素的侵略。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored Norgos' Lair and put it to rest.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了诺尔格斯的巢穴并埋葬了它。#WHITE#
#SLATE#* 你必须调查诺尔格斯的巢穴。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Heart of the Gloom and slain the Dreaming One.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了黑暗之心并杀死了沉梦者。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Heart of the Gloom and slain the Withering Thing.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了黑暗之心并杀死了凋零之物。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Heart of the Gloom.#WHITE#
The rotting stench of the dead
You have been resurrected as an undead by some dark powers.
However, the ritual failed in some way and you retain your own mind. You need to get out of this dark place and try to carve a place for yourself in the world.
target: 不过，复活仪式似乎出了点问题，你保留了自己的意识，你必须离开这个黑暗地方并找到属于自己的栖息地。

source: You have found a very special cloak that will help you walk among the living without trouble.
target: 你发现了一个非常神奇的斗篷，可以使你在活人之中自由生活而不会陷入麻烦。

source: You have been tasked to remove at least one of the threats to the yeeks.
target: 你被派去清除对夺心魔的两大威胁之一。

source: Protect the Way, and vanquish your foes.
target: 守护维网，征服你的敌人。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the underwater zone and vanquished the naga invader, Lady Nashva.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了水下区域并击败了娜迦侵略者纳纱瓦女士。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the underwater zone and vanquished Murgol.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了水下区域并击败了穆格尔。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the underwater lair of Murgol.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你必须调查一下穆格尔位于水下的巢穴。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ritch tunnels and vanquished their queen.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你调查了里奇通道并击败了它们的虫母。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the ritch tunnels.#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你必须调查一下里奇通道。#WHITE#

source: You should head to the tunnel to Maj'Eyal and explore the world. For the Way.
target: 你应该通过通道到达马基·埃亚尔，探索这个世界。为了维网。

source: It is time to explore some new places -- dark, forgotten and dangerous ones.
target: 是时候去一些新的地方探索一下了——那些黑暗、被遗忘和危险的地方。

source: The Old Forest is just south-east of the town of Derth.
target: 在德斯镇东南方向是古老森林。

source: The Maze is west of Derth.
The Sandworm Lair is to the far west of Derth, near the sea.
target: 在德斯镇远一点的西面，靠近海岸的地方是沙虫巢穴。

source: The Daikara is on the eastern borders of the Thaloren forest.
target: 在自然精灵树林的东部边境那里是岱卡拉。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Old Forest and vanquished Shardskin.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了古老森林并杀死了水晶树精。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Old Forest and vanquished Wrathroot.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了古老森林并杀死了狂怒树精。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Old Forest and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你应当探索古老森林，查清那里潜伏的危险，并获得那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Maze and vanquished the Horned Horror.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了迷宫并杀死了长角恐魔。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Maze and vanquished the Minotaur.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了迷宫并杀死了米诺陶。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Maze and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你应当探索迷宫，查清那里潜伏的危险，并获得那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Sandworm Lair and vanquished their Queen.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了沙虫巢穴并杀死了沙虫女王。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Sandworm Lair and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索沙虫巢穴，查明那里潜伏着什么，以及能获得什么宝藏！#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Daikara and vanquished the huge fire dragon that dwelled there.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了岱卡拉并杀死了这里的火龙。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Daikara and vanquished the huge ice dragon that dwelled there.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了岱卡拉并杀死了这里的冰龙。#WHITE#

source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Daikara and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
target: #SLATE#* 你应当探索岱卡拉，查清那里潜伏的危险，并获得那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

source: You arrived through the farportal in a cave, probably in the Far East.
target: 你穿过了山洞的远古传送门，可能会到达远东大陆。

source: Upon arrival you met an Elf and an orc fighting.
target: 你碰到了一个精灵在和一个兽人战斗。

source: You decided to side with the Elven lady.
target: 你决定帮助那位精灵女士。

source: You decided to side with the orc.
Fillarel told you to go to the southeast and meet with High Sun Paladin Aeryn.
target: 菲拉瑞尔告诉你去东南方会见高阶太阳骑士艾琳。

source: Krogar told you to go to the west and look for the Kruk Pride.
target: 克洛加尔告诉你去西面寻找克鲁克部落。

source: %s go to the west, and find Kruk Pride!
%s go to the southeast, and tell Aeryn what happened to me!
target: %s，去东南方，告诉艾琳我的遭遇！

source: Ukllmswwik asked you to take his portal to the Temple of Creation and kill Slasul who has turned mad.
target: 乌克勒姆斯维奇请求你穿过他的传送门到造物者神庙去杀死发疯了的萨拉苏尔。

source: Slasul told you his side of the story. Now you must decide: which of them is corrupt?
target: 萨拉苏尔告诉了你关于他的故事，你现在必须决定：到底谁才是真正的堕落者。

source: Slasul bound his lifeforce to yours and gave your a powerful trident in return.
target: 萨拉苏尔将自己的生命力与你的生命力绑定，并以一把强大的三叉戟作为回报。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have killed both Ukllmswwik and Slasul, betraying them both.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你把乌克勒姆斯维奇和萨拉苏尔都杀掉了，同时背叛了他们两个。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have sided with Ukllmswwik and killed Slasul.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你选择相信乌克勒姆斯维奇并杀死了萨拉苏尔。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have sided with Slasul and killed Ukllmswwik.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你选择相信萨拉苏尔并杀死了乌克勒姆斯维奇。#WHITE#

source: Portal to the Temple of Creation
target: 通向造物主神庙的传送门
乌克勒姆斯维奇身后开启了一道传送门。
通向淹没的洞穴的传送门

source: A portal opens to the flooded cave.
target: 一道通往被淹没洞穴的传送门开启了。

source: Back and Back and Back to the Future
After passing through some kind of time anomaly you met a temporal warden who told you to destroy the abominations of this alternate timeline.
target: 穿过了异常时空你碰到了一个时空守卫，他告诉你去摧毁这个变换时间线里的怪物。

source: You have found all the clues leading to the hidden treasure. There should be a way on the third level of the Trollmire.
target: 你已经找到了所有有关秘密财宝的线索，在食人魔沼泽第三层应该能找到一条通往那里的路。

source: It looks extremely dangerous, however - beware.
target: 注意：看样子那里非常危险。

source: You have slain Bill. His treasure is yours for the taking.
target: 你已经干掉了比尔，他的财宝现在归你了。

source: way to the hidden trollmire treasure
target: 通往巨魔沼泽隐藏宝藏的路

source: This way leads to the lair of a mighty troll. Traces of blood are everywhere. Are you sure?
target: 这条路通往巨魔的巢穴，一路上到处都是血迹，你确定要进去么？

source: The way to the treasure is to the east. But beware, death probably awaits there.
target: 通向宝藏的路在东边。但是请当心，死亡常常相伴。

source: Explore the Dungeon of Adventurer Enlightenment to learn about ToME's combat mechanics.
target: 探索冒险者启蒙地下城，学习 ToME 的战斗机制。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You have navigated the Dungeon of Adventurer Enlightenment!#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你已经通过冒险者启蒙地下城！#WHITE#

source: You must venture in the heart of the forest and kill the Lone Wolf, who randomly attacks villagers.
target: 你必须进入森林的中心地带并杀死孤狼——那个肆意屠杀村民的凶手。

source: In the void, no one can hear you scream
target: 虚空之中无人会听到你的叫喊

source: You have destroyed the sorcerers. Sadly, the portal to the Void remains open; the Creator is coming.
target: 你已经消灭了那些法师。遗憾的是，通往虚空的传送门仍然敞开；造物主即将降临。

source: This cannot be allowed to happen. After thousands of years trapped in the Void between the stars, Gerlyk is mad with rage.
target: 绝不能让这种事发生。盖里克被困在群星之间的虚空中数千年，如今已因愤怒而疯狂。

source: You must now finish what the Sher'tuls started. Take the Staff of Absorption and become a Godslayer yourself.
target: 现在，你必须完成夏·图尔开启的未竟之事。拿起吸能法杖，亲自成为弑神者。

source: Zemekkys in the Gates of Morning can build a portal back to your homeland for you.
target: 晨曦之门的伊莫克斯可以为你建造一座返回故乡的传送门。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have found a Blood-Runed Athame.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你找到了血符仪式匕首。#WHITE#

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have found the Resonating Diamond.#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#* The portal is now functional and can be used to go back, although, like all portals, it is one-way only.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 传送门现已启用，可以用它返回；不过和所有传送门一样，它只能单向通行。#WHITE#

source: Zemekkys points to the location of Vor Armoury on your map.
target: 伊莫克斯在你的地图上指出了沃尔军械库的位置。

source: Zemekkys points to the location of Briagh's lair on your map.
target: 伊莫克斯在你的地图上指出了布莱亚的巢穴的位置。

source: #VIOLET#Zemekkys starts to draw runes on the floor using the athame and gem dust.
target: #VIOLET#伊莫克斯开始用仪式匕首和宝石粉末在地板上绘制符文。
#VIOLET#伊莫克斯说道：“传送门已经开启！”
高阶时空法师伊莫克斯

source: There must be a way to go into the far east from the lair of Golbug. Find it and explore the unknown far east, looking for clues.
target: 在高尔布格巢穴内肯定有一条通往远东大陆的路，去寻找线索并找到它，然后探索那未知而遥远的东方。

source: Air capacity in your lungs. Entities that need not breathe are not affected.
target: 你肺部的空气量。不需要呼吸的生物不受其影响。

source: Stamina represents your physical fatigue.  Most physical abilities consume it.
target: 体力值代表你身体的疲劳程度。大部分物理技能都会消耗体力值。

source: Mana represents your reserve of magical energies. Most spells cast consume mana and each sustained spell reduces your maximum mana.
target: 法力值代表你存储的魔法能量。大部分法术都要消耗法力值，持续法术技能会降低你的最大法力值

source: Equilibrium represents your standing in the grand balance of nature. The closer it is to 0 the more balanced you are. Being out of equilibrium will adversely affect your ability to use Wild Gifts.
target: 失衡值代表你在自然宏大平衡中的位置。失衡值越接近 0，你就越平衡；失衡会对你使用自然系技能的能力产生不利影响。

source: Vim represents the amount of life energy/souls you have stolen. Each corruption talent requires some.
target: 活力值代表你窃取的生命能量/灵魂。堕落系技能需要活力值。

source: Positive energy represents your reserve of positive power. It slowly increases.
target: 正能量代表你存储的太阳力量。它会缓慢增加。

source: Negative energy represents your reserve of negative power. It slowly increases.
target: 负能量代表你存储的星空力量。它会缓慢增加。

source: Hate represents your soul's primal antipathy towards others.  It generally decreases whenever you have no outlet for your rage, and increases when you are damaged or destroy others.
target: 仇恨值代表你灵魂中对他人的原始憎恶。当你无处发泄怒火时，它通常会下降；当你受到伤害或杀死他人时，它会增加。

source: Paradox represents how much damage you've done to the space-time continuum. A high Paradox score makes Chronomancy less reliable and more dangerous to use but also amplifies its effects.
target: 紊乱值代表你对时空连续性造成的损害。较高的紊乱值会使时空法术变得更难控制，更加危险，但也会提升时空法术的效果。

source: Psi represents your reserve of psychic energy.
target: 灵能值代表你存储的精神力量

source: This is the number of soul fragments you have extracted from your foes for your own use.
target: 这是你从敌人身上抽取、留供己用的灵魂碎片数量。

source: Your devotion grants you additional protection.
target: 你的虔诚信仰为你带来额外防护。

source: Chant the glory of the Sun.
Invoke the power of the light to heal and mend.
target: 祈求光明之力来治疗并修复创伤。

source: Your devotion allows you to combat your foes with indomitable determination.
target: 虔诚信仰使你能以不屈的决心迎战敌人。

source: You channel the light of the sun through your body.
target: 引导太阳之光流经全身。

source: Forgo your shield for the chance to crush your foes with a mighty two handed weapon.
target: 舍弃盾牌，改用强大的双手武器粉碎敌人。

source: Summon the power of the Sun to burn your foes.
target: 召唤太阳之力灼烧敌人。

source: Bind the brilliant powers into glyphs to trap your foes.
target: 将璀璨之力束入符文，困住敌人。

source: Stand between the darkness and the light, harnessing both.
target: 立于光明与黑暗之间，同时驾驭二者。

source: Call the fury of the Stars and the Moon to destroy your foes.
target: 召唤群星与月亮的怒火摧毁敌人。

source: Chant the glory of the Moon.
Bind the power of the Moon into circles at your feet.
target: 将月亮之力束入脚下的法阵。

source: The moment of the Eclipse is the moment of Truth, when Sun and Moon are in tandem and the energies of the world hang in the balance. Intense focus allows the greatest Anorithils to harness these energies to unleash devastating forces...
target: 日蚀之时便是真理显现之时；当太阳与月亮并行，世界的能量悬于平衡。唯有最强大的星月术士，才能以高度专注驾驭这些能量，释放毁灭性的力量……

source: Signature magics of the Fallen.  The sun shines for the guilty and the innocent alike.
target: 堕落者的特有魔法。 无论罪恶与否，阳光依然闪耀。

source: Celestial combat techniques inspired by the dark places that are not empty.
target: 并非虚无的黑暗，亦能激发天空系的作战技巧。

source:
You chant the glory of the Sun, granting you %d Mental Save and increasing your maximum life by %0.1f%% (Currently:  %d).
		You may only have one Chant active at once.
		The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
颂赞日之荣耀，使你获得 %d 精神豁免，并增加 %0.1f%% 最大生命值（当前加成：%d）。
		同时只能激活一种赞歌。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
You chant the glory of the Sun, granting you %d%% physical damage resistance, %d physical save, %d armour and +15%% armour hardiness.
		You may only have one Chant active at once.
		The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
颂赞日之荣耀，使你获得 %d%% 物理抗性， %d 物理豁免， %d 护甲与 15%% 护甲强度。
		同时只能激活一种赞歌。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
You chant the glory of the Sun, granting you %d%% fire, lightning, acid and cold damage resistance, %d spell save and reduces the damage from enemies 3 or more spaces away by %d%%.
	You may only have one Chant active at once.
	The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
颂赞日之荣耀，使你获得 %d%% 火焰、闪电、酸性和寒冷抗性， %d 法术豁免，并减少三格外敌人对你造成的伤害 %d%%。
	同时只能激活一种赞歌。
	效果受法术强度加成。

source:
You chant the glory of the Sun, empowering your light and fire elemental attacks so that they do %d%% additional damage.
		In addition, this talent surrounds you with a shield of light, dealing %0.1f light damage to anything that hits you in melee.
		Your lite radius is also increased by %d.
		You may only have one Chant active at once and this Chant costs less power to sustain.
		The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
颂赞日之荣耀，强化你的光系与火系攻击，使其额外造成 %d%% 伤害。
		此外，该技能以光之护盾环绕你，对任何近战命中你的敌人造成 %0.1f 点光系伤害。
		你的光照半径同时增加 %d。
		同时只能激活一种赞歌，且维持此赞歌消耗的能量更少。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
You have learned to sing the praises of the Sun, in the form of three defensive Chants.
			Chant of Fortitude: Increases your mental save by %d and maximum life by %d%%.
			Chant of Fortress: Increases your physical save by %d, your physical resistance by %d%%, your armour by %d and your armour hardiness by 15%%.
			Chant of Resistance: Increases you spell save by %d, your fire/cold/lightning/acid resistances by %d%% and reduces all damage that comes from distant enemies (3 spaces or more) by %d%%.
			You may only have one Chant active at a time.
target:
你学会了三种防御赞歌，以此咏唱对太阳的赞颂：
			坚韧赞歌：增加 %d 精神豁免， %d%% 最大生命值
			堡垒赞歌：增加 %d 物理豁免， %d%% 物理抗性， %d 护甲， 15%% 护甲强度
			元素赞歌：增加 %d 法术豁免， %d%% 火焰 /寒冷 /闪电 /酸性抗性，减少三格外敌人对你造成的伤害 %d%%。
			你同时只能激活一种赞歌。

source:
Your Chants now bathe you in a cloak of light, which increases your stamina and mana regenerations by %0.2f per turn and does %0.2f light damage to anyone who hits you in melee.
		These values scale with your Spellpower.
target:
咏唱赞歌使你沐浴在光辉斗篷中，使你的体力与法力每回合回复量提高 %0.2f，并对任何近战命中你的敌人造成 %0.2f 点光系伤害。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
Your skill at Chanting now extends the cloak of light, increasing your light radius by %d.
		Also, when you start a new Chant, you will be cured of all cross-tier effects and cured of up to %d debuffs.
		Chant of Fortitude cures mental effects.
		Chant of Fortress cures physical effects.
		Chant of Resistance cures magical effects.
target:
咏唱赞歌的娴熟技艺让光明得以扩散，增加 %d 光照半径。
		每次你咏唱新的赞歌时，你将解除自身的越层效果（失去平衡、法术冲击和思维封锁），并额外解除 %d 项相应类型的负面状态。
		坚韧赞歌：解除精神负面状态 
		堡垒赞歌：解除物理负面状态
		元素赞歌：解除魔法负面状态

source:
Your passion for singing the praises of the Sun reaches its zenith.
		Your Chanting now increases your light and fire damage by %d%% and, up to %d times per turn when you are hit by a weapon attack, you will gain %0.1f Positive Energy.
		These values scale with your Spellpower.
target:
咏唱赞歌歌颂太阳的热情达到了顶峰。
		你的赞歌现在让你的火焰与光系伤害增加 %d%%。当你被武器攻击击中的时候，你恢复 %0.1f 点正能量，这一效果最多每回合触发 %d 次。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
Creates a circle of radius %d at your feet; the circle increases your defense and all saves by %d while dealing %0.2f darkness damage per turn to everyone else within its radius. The circle lasts %d turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
在你的脚下创造一个半径 %d 的法阵，使你的闪避和所有豁免提高 %d，并使范围内除你之外的所有生物每回合受到 %0.2f 点暗影伤害。法阵持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

source: Creates a circle of radius %d at your feet; the circle protects you from silence effects while you remain in its radius while silencing and dealing %d light damage to everyone else who enters. The circle lasts %d turns.
target:
在你的脚下制造一个 %d 码半径范围的法阵，当你在法阵内，它会使你免疫沉默效果，沉默进入此范围内的敌人，并对其造成 %d 光系伤害。
		阵法持续 %d 回合。

source:
Creates a circle of radius %d at your feet; the circle slows incoming projectiles by %d%% and attempts to push all creatures other than yourself out of its radius, inflicting %0.2f light damage and %0.2f darkness damage per turn as it does so.  The circle lasts %d turns.
		The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
在你的脚下制造一个 %d 码半径范围的法阵，它会减慢 %d%% 抛射物速度并将除你外的其他生物推出去。
		同时，每回合对目标造成 %0.2f 光系伤害和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。
		法阵持续 %d 回合。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
Conjure a surge of celestial power through your circles. Any foe standing within one of your circles will be slowed by %d%% for %d turns and take %d light and %d darkness damage.
		Residual power from the surge will emanate from your circles for %d turns; each circle you stand in will increase your celestial resources.
		Shifting Shadows: +1 negative.
		Sanctity: +1 postive.
		Warding: +0.5 postive and negative.
target:
从你的法阵中召唤天体能量的潮涌。任何站在你的法阵中的敌人将在 %d 回合内受到 %d%% 的减速效果，并受到 %d 光系和 %d 暗影伤害。
		能量潮涌的残余力量将会从你的法阵中发出。在 %d 回合内，你每站在一个法阵中，都会获得额外的天体能量恢复。
		暗影之阵：获得 +1 负能量。
		圣洁之阵：获得 +1 正能量。
		守护之阵：获得 +0.5 正能量和负能量。

source: Your Weapon of Light nows pulls in all foes in radius 5.
target: 你的光明之刃现在将5格范围内的敌人拉过来。

source:
Infuse your weapon with the power of the Sun, adding %0.1f light damage on each melee hit.
		Additionally, if you have a temporary damage shield active, melee hits will increase its power by %d once per turn.
		The damage dealt and shield bonus will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
使你的武器充满太阳能量，每击造成 %0.1f 光系伤害。
		如果你同时打开了临时伤害护盾，每回合一次，你的近战攻击命中可以增加护盾 %d 强度。
		伤害和护盾加成受法术强度加成。

source:
In a pure display of power, you project a ranged melee attack, doing %d%% weapon damage.
		If the target is outside of melee range, you have a chance to project a second attack against it for %d%% weapon damage.
		The second strike chance (which increases with distance) is %0.1f%% at range 2 and %0.1f%% at the maximum range of %d.
		The range will increase with your Strength.
target:
你展现纯粹的力量，发动一次远程近战攻击，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		如果目标在近战范围以外，有一定几率进行二次打击，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		二次打击几率随距离增加，距离 2 时为 %0.1f%%，距离最大（ %d ）时几率为 %0.1f%%。
		攻击距离受力量值加成。

source:
Your weapon attacks burn with righteous fury, dealing %d%% of your lost HP as additional Fire damage (up to %d, Current:  %d).
		Targets struck are also afflicted with a Martyrdom effect that causes them to take %d%% of all damage they deal for 4 turns.
		The bonus damage can only occur once per turn.
target:
你使用武器攻击时，造成相当于 %d%% 你已损失的生命值的火焰伤害 , 至多 %d 点,当前 %d 点 
		然后令目标进入殉难状态，受到 %d%% 自己造成的伤害，持续 4 回合。
		每回合最多触发一次额外伤害。

source: Any attack that would drop you below 1 hit point instead triggers Second Life, deactivating the talent, setting your hit points to 1, then healing you for %d.
target: 任何使你生命值降到 1 点以下的攻击都会激活第二生命，自动中断此技能并将你的生命值恢复到 1 点,然后受到 %d 点治疗。

source:
Infuse your weapon with the power of the Sun, adding %0.1f light damage on each melee hit.
		Additionally, if you have a temporary damage shield active, melee hits will increase its power by %d and set its duration to 2 (if not already higher), once per turn.
		The damage dealt and shield bonus will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
使你的武器充满太阳能量，每击造成 %0.1f 光系伤害。
		如果你同时打开了临时伤害护盾，每回合一次，你的近战攻击命中可以增加护盾 %d 强度，并且可以延长当前护盾持续时间至2回合。
		伤害和护盾加成受法术强度加成。

source: You require a two handed weapon to use this talent.
target: 你需要装备一把双手武器来施展这个技能。

source:
You strike your foe with your two handed weapon, dealing %d%% weapon damage.
		If the attack hits, all foes in radius 2 will have their light resistance reduced by %d%% and their damage reduced by %d%% for 5 turns.
target:
你用双手武器攻击敌人，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		如果攻击命中，半径 2 以内的敌人光系抗性下降 %d%%，伤害下降 %d%% , 持续 5 回合。

source: You mark a target with light for 3 turns, causing all melee hits you deal to it to heal you for %d%% of the damage done.
target: 你用光标记目标 3 回合，你对它近战攻击时，将受到相当于 %d%% 伤害的治疗。

source:
While wielding a two handed weapon, your critical strike chance is increased by %d%%, and your melee criticals instill you with righteous strength, increasing all physical and light damage you deal by %d%%, stacking up to 3 times.
		In addition, your melee critical strikes leave a lasting lightburn on the target, dealing %0.2f light damage over 5 turns and reducing opponents armour by %d.
		The damage increases with your Spellpower.
target:
当装备双手武器时，你的暴击率增加 %d%% , 同时你的近战暴击会引发光明之力，增加 %d%% 物理和光系伤害加成，最多叠加 3 次。
		同时，你的近战暴击会在目标身上留下灼烧痕迹， 5 回合内造成 %0.2f 光系伤害，同时减少 %d 护甲。
		伤害受法强加成。

source:
Infuse your two handed weapon with light while spinning around.
		All creatures in radius one take %d%% weapon damage.
		In addition while spinning your weapon shines so much it deals %d%% light weapon damage to all foes in radius 2.
		At level 4 your spinning blade creates a shield that blocks all damage for 1 turn.
target:
旋转一周，同时将光明之力充满武器。
		半径 1 以内的敌人将受到 %d%% 武器伤害，同时半径 2 以内的敌人将受到 %d%% 光系武器伤害。
		技能等级 4 或以上时，在旋转时你会制造一层护盾，吸收 1 回合内的所有攻击。

source:
Open a radius 1 rift in spacetime at the targeted location for %d turns, increasing in radius by 1 each turn to a maximum of %d.
		All caught within the rift are pulled towards the center and take %0.2f gravity damage.
The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
在目标地点开启半径1的时空裂缝，持续 %d 回合。每回合半径增加1，最大 %d。
		所有被裂缝波及的目标都会被朝中心牵引，受到 %0.2f 重力伤害。
伤害受法术强度加成。

source:
Attune yourself to the endless hunger of distant dead suns.  For the next %d turns, your attacks will inflict an additional %0.2f gravity damage and attempt to pull enemies closer.  After three turns, you will recover half of all damage taken during this effect.
The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
你将死星那无尽的饥饿赋予自己。在接下来的 %d 回合里，你的攻击造成额外 %0.2f 重力伤害并会试图将敌人拉近。3回合之后，你获得此效果期间所受伤害一半的回复。
伤害受法术强度加成。

source: Create a gravity field around you that converts %d%% of all damage you deal into physical damage, slows incoming projectiles by %d%%, and causes your gravity damage to reduce the target's knockback resistance by half for two turns.
target: 在你身边制造一个重力场，将你造成伤害的 %d%% 转化为物理伤害，使向你发射的飞行物减速 %d%%，并使你的重力伤害令目标的击退抗性减半，持续 2 回合。

source:
Infuse your weapon with overwhelming gravitational power while spinning around.
							All creatures within radius 2 take %d%% weapon damage as physical (gravity) and are pulled closer.
							Then, all adjacent creatures take %d%% weapon damage.  This second strike shields you for between %d and %d, increasing with more enemies hit.  The shield lasts for 2 turns.
The shield strength will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
旋转一周，同时将毁灭性的重力注入武器。
							半径2以内的生物受到 %d%% 物理（重力）武器伤害并被拉近。
							然后所有相邻的生物受到 %d%% 武器伤害。这第二次攻击给予你 %d 到 %d 的护盾，数值随被击中的敌人数量增大，持续2回合。
护盾量受法术强度加成。

source:
Hits the target with your weapon, doing %d%% damage. If the attack hits, the target is stunned for %d turns and has their bleed resistance reduced by 50%%.
The stun chance increases with your Physical Power.

#{italic}#It may not bleed, exactly, but you'll make it hurt.#{normal}#
target:
攻击目标造成 %d%% 武器伤害。如果命中，目标震慑 %d 回合且流血抗性降低 50%%。
震慑概率受物理强度加成。

#{italic}#或许不会出血，但绝对很疼。#{normal}#

source:
Your curse feeds on the magic, which in turn is powered by the curse.
You gain a bonus to Spellpower equal to %d%% of your Willpower.
You gain a bonus to Mindpower equal to %d%% of your Magic.

#{italic}#Something is not quite right inside you.  Your solar spells are somehow twisted, but your bloody rites make things clear as day.#{normal}#
target:
你的诅咒汲取着魔法同时又驱动着魔法。
你获得相当于 %d%% 意志的法术强度加值。
你获得相当于 %d%% 魔法的精神强度加值。

#{italic}#你里面有些不对劲。你的太阳法术被遮蔽了，但你血腥的行径使得事物依然如同白昼一样清晰。#{normal}#

source:
Fade into the darkness and reappear elsewhere within range %d.  When you emerge from the shadows, you are accompanied by a bright flash, dealing %0.2f light damage to enemies in radius 1.
						 The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
匿迹于黑暗之中并在距离 %d 码范围内的另一处重现。一道闪光会伴随着你从阴影中现身，对半径1码范围内的敌人造成 %0.2f 光系伤害。
						 伤害受法术强度加成。

source:
Put all of your physical and magical might into one devastating attack.
Strike all adjacent enemies for %d%% weapon damage and daze them (using your highest power) for 3 turns.

Using this talent consumes all of your Positive Energy and prevents you from generating positive energy for 5 turns.
Every point of positive energy increases the damage by %.2f%%.
Every %d points of positive energy increase the radius by 1 (up to 10).
target:
将你所有的物理和魔法力量化作一次毁灭性的攻击。
攻击所有相邻的敌人造成 %d%% 武器伤害并眩晕它们3回合（使用你最高的强度）。

使用此技能会耗尽你的正能量且5回合内你无法回复正能量。
每一点正能量增加伤害 %.2f%%。
每 %d 点正能量增加半径1（最大10）。

source:
Sing a song of wasting and desolation which sustains you in hard times.

This dirge increases your health regeneration by %d.  The regeneration will increase with your level.
target:
为荒废和孤寂悲叹一曲来支持困境中的你。

增加你的生命回复%d。回复量受等级加成。

source:
Sing a song of violence and victory (mostly violence) and sustain yourself through cruelty.
Each time you deal a critical strike you gain 10%% of a turn (only once per turn).
Each time you kill a creature you gain %d%% of a turn (only once per turn).
target:
为暴力和（通过暴力取得的）胜利高歌一曲来支持残酷的你。
你每次暴击时获得 10%% 个回合的时间（每回合限一次）。
你每次杀死一个生物时获得 %d%% 个回合的时间（每回合限一次）。

source:
Sing a song of decay and defiance and sustain yourself through spite.
							Each time you suffer a detrimental effect, you gain a shield with strength %d, that lasts as long as the effect would.  This will add to and extend an existing shield if possible.
							This can only trigger once every %d turns
target:
为腐败和暴乱轻唱一曲来支持仇恨中的你。
							每次你受到负面状态时你获得 %d 的护盾，持续时间与那个状态的持续时间相同。这可以强化你已有的伤害护盾。
							这一效果每 %d 回合只能触发一次。

source:
Even now, something compels you to sing.
			Dirge of Famine: Increases health regen by %d.
			Dirge of Conquest: Gives you part of a turn on critical (10%%) or kill (%d%%).
			Dirge of Pestilence: Shields you for %d when an enemy inflicts a detrimental effect on you (5 turn cooldown).
			You may only have one Dirge active at a time.
target:
每时每刻，都有什么驱使着你歌唱。
			饥荒挽歌：增加生命回复 %d。
			征服挽歌：给予你暴击时 10%% 回合或杀戮时 %d%% 回合的时间。
			瘟疫挽歌：敌人对你造成负面效果时获得 %d 的护盾（5 回合冷却）。
			你同时只能激活一种挽歌。

source:
Your dirges carry the pain within you, which threatens to swallow those who come too close.  Anyone who hits you in melee suffers %0.2f mind damage.
							You, on the other hand, are steadied by the song.  Your dirges increase your resistance to stun and knockback by %d%%.
							The damage will increase with your Mindpower and your level.
target:
你的挽歌中寄寓着痛苦，过于接近你的生物可能会被这份痛苦吞噬。任何近战击中你的敌人会受到 %0.2f 精神伤害。
							而你则被这歌声激励着。挽歌增加你 %d%% 的震慑和击退抗性。
							伤害受精神强度和等级加成。

source:
Your dirges echo mournfully through the air.  When you end a dirge, you continue to gain its acolyte-level effects for %d turns.  You can only benefit from one such lingering dirge at a time.

Furthermore, you are given focus by the song.  Your dirges increase your resistance to confusion and fear by %d%%.
target:
你的挽歌在周围回荡着悲伤。当你结束挽歌时，你持续获得其入门效果 %d 回合。你同时只能受到一种挽歌的余音效果。

而且歌声使得你更加专注。挽歌增加你 %d%% 的混乱和恐惧抗性。

source:
Your dirges deaden you to the outside world, reducing all incoming damage by %d.
The damage reduction will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
你的挽歌使你对外界变得迟钝，减免所有伤害 %d。
伤害减免受法术强度加成。

source: Increases your spell critical chance by %d%%.
target: 增加你 %d%% 法术暴击率。

source:
Increases your light and darkness resistance penetration by %d%% for %d turns, and reduces the cooldown of all Celestial skills by %d.
		The resistance penetration will increase with your Cunning.
target:
增加 %d%% 光系和暗影抗性穿透，持续 %d 回合。同时，使你所有天空系技能的冷却时间减少 %d 回合。
		抗性穿透受灵巧加成。

source:
Each time one of your spells criticals, you project a bolt of light or shadow at up to %d targets within radius %d, doing %0.2f light damage or %0.2f darkness damage per bolt.
		This effect costs 2 positive or 2 negative energy each time it's triggered, and will not activate if either your positive or negative energy is below 2.
		The damage scales with your Spellpower.
		This spell cannot crit.
target:
每当你的法术打出暴击时，你会向射程 %d 内最多 %d 个目标发射光明或暗影箭矢，每支造成 %0.2f 点光系伤害或 %0.2f 点暗影伤害。
		每次触发该效果时消耗 2 点正能量或 2 点负能量；当你的正能量或负能量低于 2 时不会触发。
		受法术强度影响，伤害按比例加成。
		该法术造成的伤害不能暴击。

source: Shroud foes within radius %d in darkest light, dealing %0.2f light and %0.2f darkness damage per turn and converting %d%% of the damage they deal between light and darkness for %d turns.
target: 用至暗之光笼罩半径 %d 范围内的所有敌人，每回合对其造成 %0.2f 光系和 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并使它们所造成伤害的 %d%% 在光系与暗影之间转换，持续 %d 回合。

source: Deals %d light damage and heals the summoner for %d
target: 造成 %d 光系伤害，并恢复召唤者 %d 生命值。

source: Deals %d darkness damage and saps the foes energy, reducing all damage dealt by %d%% for %d turns.
target: 造成 %d 暗影伤害，并吸收敌人的能量，使其造成的所有伤害降低 %d%%，持续 %d 回合。

source: Explodes knocking the enemy 1 space in a random direction and dealing %d light and %d darkness damage.
target: 爆炸将敌人向随机方向击退1格，造成 %d 光系和 %d 暗影伤害。

source:
When one of your spells goes critical, you bind glyphs in radius 1 centered on a random target in range %d at the cost of 5 positive and 5 negative energy.
		Glyphs last for %d turns and cause various effects when an enemy enters their grid.
		Glyphs will only spawn on enemies that aren't adjacent to an existing glyph.
		This can only happen every %d game turns.
		Glyph effects will scale with your Spellpower.

		Available glyphs are:
		#ffd700#Glyph of Sunlight#LAST#:  Bind sunlight into a glyph. When triggered it will release a brilliant light, dealing %0.2f light damage and healing you for %d.
		#7f7f7f#Glyph of Moonlight#LAST#:  Bind moonlight into a glyph. When triggered it will release a fatiguing darkness,  dealing %0.2f darkness damage and reducing the foes damage dealt by %d%% for %d turns.
		#9D9DC9#Glyph of Twilight#LAST#:  Bind twilight into a glyph. When triggered it will release a burst of twilight, dealing %0.2f light and %0.2f darkness damage and knocking the foe back %d tiles.
target:
每当你的法术暴击时，你消耗 5 点正能量和负能量，在范围 %d 内的随机目标周围 1 码半径的区域内放置随机圣印。
		圣印持续 %d 回合，当敌人踩上时，会对其产生特殊效果。
		圣印只会在周围没有圣印的敌人周围产生。
		每 %d 游戏回合最多触发一次该效果。
		圣印效果受法术强度加成。
		
		有以下几种可用的圣印：
		#ffd700#日光圣印#LAST#——将阳光注入圣印。当其触发时，将会释放出明亮耀眼的光芒，造成 %0.2f 光系伤害，并恢复你 %d 生命值。
		#7f7f7f#月光圣印#LAST#——将月光注入圣印。当其触发时，将会释放出疲惫困倦的黑暗，造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并使目标所造成的伤害减少 %d%%，持续 %d 回合。
		#9D9DC9#暮光圣印#LAST#——将暮光注入圣印。当其触发时，将会释放出突然爆炸的暮光，造成 %0.2f 光系和 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并将目标击退 %d 格。

source:
Your glyphs are imbued with celestial fury; they last %d turns longer and when triggered they will deal damage.
		#ffd700#Glyph of Sunlight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f light damage.
		#7f7f7f#Glyph of Moonlight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f darkness damage.
		#9D9DC9#Glyph of Twilight#LAST#:  Deals %0.2f light and %0.2f darkness damage.
target:
你的圣印被注入了来自天空的怒火。
		它们的持续时间延长 %d 回合，并在触发时造成额外伤害。
		#ffd700#日光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 光系伤害。
		#7f7f7f#月光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害。
		#9D9DC9#暮光圣印#LAST#：造成 %0.2f 光系和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。

source: Up to 3 times per turn when one of your glyphs triggers you feel a surge of celestial power, increasing your darkness and light resistance and affinity by 5%% for %d turns, stacking up to %d times.
target: 当你的圣印触发时，天空能量的涌动让你获得暗影、光系抗性和伤害吸收各 5%%，持续 %d 回合，最多叠加 %d 次。该效果每回合最多触发 3 次。

source:
Destabilize your glyphs, triggering every glyph in radius 10 with an enemy standing on it.
		At talent level 2 glyphs triggered this way will leave a residue of themselves on the ground, dealing damage each turn for %d turns.
		#ffd700#Sunlight#LAST#:  %0.2f light damage.
		#7f7f7f#Moonlight#LAST#:  %0.2f darkness damage.
		#9D9DC9#Twilight#LAST#:  %0.2f light and %0.2f darkness damage
target:
激发所有圣印，10格内所有上方站着敌人的圣印将被触发。
		技能等级2时，该效果触发的圣印将在地面遗留能量，在 %d 回合内持续造成伤害。
		#ffd700#日光圣印#LAST#： %0.2f 光系伤害。
		#7f7f7f#月光圣印#LAST#： %0.2f 暗影伤害。
		#9D9DC9#暮光圣印#LAST#： %0.2f 光系和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。

source:
Infuse your shield with light, healing you for %0.2f each time you take damage at the expense of up to 2 positive energy.
		If you do not have any positive energy, the effect will not trigger.
		Additionally, once per turn successful melee attacks will trigger a bonus attack with your shield dealing %d%% light damage.
		The healing done will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
为盾牌注入光能。每次受到伤害时，以最多 2 点正能量为代价恢复 %0.2f 点生命。
		如果你没有任何正能量，效果不会触发。
		此外，每回合一次，近战攻击命中时会触发一次额外盾击，造成 %d%% 光系伤害。
		治疗量随法术强度提高。

source: You cannot use Brandish without a shield!

Hits the target with your weapon doing %d%% damage, and with a shield strike doing %d%% damage. If the shield strike connects, your shield will explode in a burst of light that inflicts %0.2f light damage on all targets except yourself within radius %d of the target, and light up all tiles in that radius.
		The light damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
用你的武器对目标造成 %d%% 伤害，同时盾击目标造成 %d%% 伤害。如果盾牌击中目标，则会产生光系爆炸，对范围内除你以外的所有目标造成 %0.2f 光系范围伤害（半径 %d 码）并照亮受影响区域。
		光系伤害受法术强度加成。

source: You cannot use Retribution without a shield!

Retribution negates half of all damage you take while it is active. Once Retribution has negated %0.2f damage, your shield will explode in a burst of light, inflicting damage equal to the amount negated in a radius of %d and deactivating the talent.
		The amount absorbed will increase with your Spellpower.
		%s
target:
吸收你受到的一半伤害。一旦惩戒之盾吸收 %0.2f 伤害值，它会产生光系爆炸，在 %d 码半径范围内造成等同吸收值的伤害并中断技能效果。
		伤害吸收值受法术强度加成。
		%s

source: You cannot use Crusade without a shield!
target: 使用十字军打击必须使用盾牌!

source:
You demonstrate your dedication to the light with a measured attack striking once with your weapon for %d%% Light damage and once with your shield for %d%% Light damage.
			If the first strike connects %d random talent cooldowns are reduced by 1.
			If the second strike connects you are cleansed of %d debuffs.
target:
你用武器攻击造成 %d%% 光系伤害，再用盾牌攻击造成 %d%% 光系伤害。
			如果第一次攻击命中，随机 %d 个技能冷却时间减少1回合 。
			如果第二次攻击命中，除去你身上至多 %d 个 debuff。

source: #CRIMSON#As your "talk" with the star ends, you feel its power, the whole area around you erupts in flames, burning your foes to cinders!
target: #CRIMSON#当你和遥远恒星的"交谈"结束后，你感受到了它的力量，火焰在你周围爆发，将敌人烧成灰烬！

source:
Chant the glory of the Moons, gaining the agility of shadows.
		This increases your movement speed by %d%% and your spell speed by %d%%.
		You may only have one Hymn active at once.
		The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
赞颂月之荣耀，使你获得暗影之灵敏。
		移动速度增加 %d%%，施法速度增加 %d%%
		同时只能激活一种圣诗。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
Chant the glory of the Moons, granting you stealth detection (+%d power), and invisibility detection (+%d power).
		You may also attack creatures you cannot see without penalty and your critical hits do %d%% more damage.
		You may only have one Hymn active at once.
		The stealth and invisibility detection will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
赞颂月之荣耀，使你的潜行侦测强度提高 %d，隐形侦测强度提高 %d。
		你也能无惩罚地攻击不可见生物，并使暴击伤害提高 %d%%。
		同时只能激活一种圣诗。
		潜行与隐形侦测强度随法术强度提高。

source:
Chant the glory of the Moons, granting you %d%% stun, blindness and confusion resistance.
		You may only have one Hymn active at once.
target:
赞美月之荣耀，增加你 %d%% 震慑、致盲和混乱抵抗。
		同时只能激活 1 个圣诗。

source:
Chant the glory of the Moons, conjuring a shroud of dancing shadows that follows you as long as this spell is active.
		Each turn, a shadowy beam will hit up to %d of your foes within radius 5 for 1 to %0.2f damage.
		This powerful spell will drain %0.1f negative energy for each beam; no beam will fire if your negative energy is too low.
		You may only have one Hymn active at once.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
赞颂月之荣耀，召唤一层舞动的暗影帷幕，在技能激活期间跟随你。
		每回合，暗影射线会击中半径 5 码内至多 %d 个敌人，造成 1 到 %0.2f 点伤害。
		这个强大法术的每道射线消耗 %0.1f 点负能量；负能量过低时不会发射射线。
		同时只能激活一种圣诗。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

source:
You have learned to sing the praises of the Moons, in the form of three defensive Hymns:

Hymn of Shadows: Increases your movement speed by %d%% and your spell casting speed by %d%%.

Hymn of Detection: Increases your ability to see stealthy creatures by %d and invisible creatures by %d, and increases your critical power by %d%%.

Hymn of Perseverance: Increases your resistance to stun, confusion and blinding by %d%%.

You may only have one Hymn active at a time.
target:
你学会了三种防御圣诗，以此咏唱对月亮的赞颂：
		暗影圣诗：增加 %d%% 移动速度和 %d%% 施法速度。
		侦测圣诗：潜行侦测强度提高 %d，隐形侦测强度提高 %d，暴击伤害提高 %d%%。
		坚毅圣诗：增加 %d%% 震慑、混乱、致盲抗性。
		你同时只能激活一种圣诗。

source:
Your Hymns now focus darkness near you, which increases your darkness damage by %d%% and does %0.2f darkness damage to anyone who hits you in melee.
		These values scale with your Spellpower.
target:
圣诗让暗影集中在你身边，你的黑暗伤害增加 %d%%，并对所有近战攻击你的敌人造成 %0.2f 暗属性伤害。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
Your skill in Hymns now improves your sight in darkness, increasing your infravision radius by %d.
		Also, when you end a Hymn, you will gain a buff of a type based on which Hymn you ended.
		Hymn of Shadows increases your movement speed by %d%% for one turn.
		Hymn of Detection makes you invisible (power %d) for %d turns.
		Hymn of Perseverance grants a damage shield (power %d) for %d turns.
target:
咏唱圣诗的娴熟技艺让黑暗不再阻碍你的视线，增加 %d 暗视半径。
		每次你结束旧的圣诗时，你将获得圣诗提供的增益效果。
		暗影圣诗：增加 %d%% 移动速度，持续 1 回合。
		侦测圣诗：获得强度 %d 的隐形，持续 %d 回合。
		坚毅圣诗：护盾 ( %d 强度) 持续 %d 回合。

source:
Your passion for singing the praises of the Moons reaches its zenith.
		Your Hymns now fire shadowy beams that will hit up to %d of your foes within radius 5 for %0.2f damage, with a 25%% chance of blinding.
		This powerful effect will drain %0.1f negative energy each time it fires at at least 1 target; no beam will fire if your negative energy is too low.
		These values scale with your Spellpower.
target:
咏唱圣诗歌颂月亮的热情达到了顶峰。
		你的圣诗自动产生阴影射线攻击周围 5 格内至多 %d 个敌人，造成 %0.2f 伤害，同时有 25%% 几率触发致盲效果。
		这项效果每产生一发射线并击中至少一个目标将抽取 %0.1f 负能量，能量过低时无法产生射线。
		效果受法术强度加成。

source:
An invigorating ray of Sunlight shines upon you, healing your body for %d life.
		The amount healed will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
一束充满活力的阳光照耀着你，治疗你 %d 点生命值。
		治疗量受法术强度加成。

source:
A magical zone of Sunlight appears around you, healing and shielding all within a radius of %d for %0.2f per turn and increasing healing effects on everyone within by %d%%. The effect lasts for %d turns.
		Existing damage shields will be added to instead of overwritten and have their duration set to 2 if it isn't higher.
		If the same shield is refreshed 20 times it will become unstable and explode, removing it.
		It also lights up the affected area.
		The amount healed will increase with the Magic stat
target:
阳光倾泻在你周围 %d 码范围内，每回合治疗所有单位 %0.2f 生命值, 给予其等量的护盾 , 并增加此范围内所有人 %d%% 治疗效果。此效果持续 %d 回合。
		如果已经存在护盾，则护盾将会增加等量数值，如果护盾持续时间不足 2 回合，会延长至 2 回合。
		当同一个护盾被刷新 20 次后，将会因为不稳定而破碎。
		它同时会照亮此区域。
		治疗量受魔力值加成。

source:
A protective shield forms around you that lasts for up to %d turns and negates %d damage.
 		The total damage the barrier can absorb will increase with your Spellpower and can crit.
target:
一个持续 %d 回合的保护性圣盾围绕着你，可吸收 %d 点伤害。
		 圣盾的最大吸收量受法术强度加成，该技能可以暴击。

source: Places you under the protection of a ray of sunlight. For %d turns, the light removes a single negative effect from you every turn.
target: 你位于阳光的保护下，每回合移除 1 种负面状态，持续 %d 回合。

source: You somehow fail to set the corrosive seed.

target: 爆炸 (范围 1) 造成 %d 光系伤害。

source:
You bind light in a glyph on the floor. All enemies walking over the glyph will be dazed for %d turns.
		The glyph is a hidden trap (%d detection and %d disarm power based on your Magic) and lasts for %d turns.
target:
你用光能在地上刻画圣印。所有经过的敌人会被眩晕 %d 回合。
		圣印视为隐藏陷阱（%d 侦查强度，%d 点解除强度，基于魔法）持续 %d 回合。

source: Deals %d physical damage, knocking the target back.
target: 造成 %d 物理伤害，击退目标。

source:
You bind light in a glyph on the floor. All enemies walking over the glyph will be hit by a blast that does %0.2f physical damage and knocks them back.
		The glyph is a hidden trap (%d detection and %d disarm power based on your Magic) and lasts for %d turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
你用光能在地上刻画圣印。所有经过圣印的敌人会受到 %0.2f 物理伤害并被击退。
		圣印视为隐藏陷阱（%d 侦查强度，%d 点解除强度，基于魔法）持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

source:
You bind light in a glyph on the floor. All enemies walking over the glyph will be slowed by %d%% for 5 turns.
		The glyph is a hidden trap (%d detection and %d disarm power based on your Magic) and lasts for %d turns.
target:
你用光能在地上刻画圣印。所有经过的目标会减速 %d%%，持续 5 回合。
		圣印视为隐藏陷阱（%d 侦查强度，%d 点解除强度，基于魔法）持续 %d 回合。

source:
You are so infused with sunlight that your body glows permanently in radius %d, even in dark places.
		Your vision and body adapt to this glow, giving you %d%% blindness resistance, %d%% light resistance, and %d%% light affinity.
		The light radius overrides your normal light if it is bigger (it does not stack).
target:
你的体内充满了阳光，即使身处黑暗之中，身体也会永久发出半径 %d 的光芒。
		你的眼睛和身体适应了光明，获得 %d%% 目盲免疫， %d%% 光系抗性和 %d%% 光系伤害吸收。
		光照超过你的灯具时取代之，不与灯具叠加光照。

source:
Fire a glowing orb of light at each enemy within your Radiance.  Each orb will slowly follow its target until it connects, dealing %d light damage to anything else it contacts along the way.  When the target is reached the orb will explode dealing %d light damage in radius 1 and healing you for 50%% of the damage dealt.
